      - name: recurrence_eligibility_window
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Recurrence eligibility window setting from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: reset_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide reset timestamp from guide_info (pass-through; format/timezone unchanged; NULL preserved).
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: app_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application display name from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application platform from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: created_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the creating user from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: created_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Username of the creating user from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: last_updated_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the last updating user from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: last_updated_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Username of the last updating user from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: count_steps
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of steps in the guide from guide_info (pass-through; NULL preserved).
      - name: count_accounts

      - name: count_visitors

      - name: first_event_at

        description: Timestamp of first event from metrics (left join; format/timezone unchanged; NULL if no match).
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timestamp of last event from metrics (left join; format/timezone unchanged; NULL if no match).

blocks.original_text:
- name: guide_daily_metrics
      description: Daily guide-by-day spine from guide creation through the build date with left-joined usage metrics.
      grain: One row per guide_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- From guide info, derive created_on as the calendar day of created_at; keep guide_id and guide_name. - Build a guide-by-day spine by joining the calendar spine where date_day falls between created_on and the warehouse current date (inclusive at both ends). - For each (guide_id, date_day) in the spine, left join daily metrics where occurred_on equals date_day and guide_id matches. - Output date_day, guide_id, guide_name, count_accounts, and count_visitors exactly as in sources. - Missing metric rows are not backfilled; if no match exists, metric fields remain NULL. - No aggregation, de-duplication, or ordering is applied; duplicate source rows propagate as-is. - The upper bound (current date) is evaluated at model run time using the warehouse clock.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date in the spine from guide creation through the build date; join key to daily metrics by occurred_on.
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier from guide info; key for the spine and the metrics join.
      - name: guide_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide name from guide info at build time; not historically versioned.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily account count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily visitor count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.

blocks.original_text:
- name: page
      description: Core page dimension with latest page attributes joined to aggregated event metrics
      grain: One row per page_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- Build event metrics from staging.stg_pendo__page_event grouped by page_id: - Distinct visitor count. - Distinct account count. - Total pageviews as the sum of num_events (null values do not contribute). - Total event records counted across all rows. - First and last pageview timestamps as the earliest and latest occurred_at. - Visitor averages: - Average minutes per distinct visitor = total num_minutes divided by the distinct visitor count. - Average pageviews per distinct visitor = total num_events divided by the distinct visitor count. - When the distinct visitor count is zero, these averages are not computed. - Left join these metrics to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on page_id. - Apply final handling: - Counts and sums default to 0 when there are no matching events. - Averages are rounded to 3 decimal places and default to 0 when no visitors. - First and last pageview timestamps remain null when there are no matching events. - Output includes all columns from latest_page plus the metrics; one row per page_id present in latest_page.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique page identifier and join key; exactly one row per page_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest page name from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Page creation timestamp from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who created the page from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: is_dirty
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating unsaved changes in latest page info
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Group identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who last updated the page from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: valid_through
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Validity end timestamp of the latest page record snapshot
      - name: latest_page_index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Index of the latest page record in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct visitors for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct accounts for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: sum_pageviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total pageviews from num_events; 0 if no events
      - name: count_pageview_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total event records for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: first_pageview_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at for the page; NULL if no events
      - name: last_pageview_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at for the page; NULL if no events
      - name: avg_visitor_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per distinct visitor rounded to 3 decimals; 0 if no visitors
      - name: avg_visitor_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average pageviews per distinct visitor rounded to 3 decimals; 0 if no visitors

blocks.original_text:
- name: page_daily_metrics
      description: Daily page-level metrics aligned to a date spine within each page’s active window.
      grain: One row per page_id per date_day (inclusive from created_on through valid_through or today if missing).
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - intermediate.int_pendo__page_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Use the date_day spine from intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine. - For each page in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page, set created_on as the calendar date of created_at; set the window end as the calendar date of valid_through, defaulting to the current timestamp’s date when valid_through is missing. - Build page_spine by keeping (date_day, page) pairs where date_day falls within the inclusive range from created_on through the window end. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__page_daily_metrics to page_spine on matching page_id and where date_day equals occurred_on. - Output page/date attributes from page_spine and metric fields from daily_metrics; when a metric is missing, return 0; other attributes retain their original values including NULLs. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication is performed; multiple matching rows in the source daily_metrics will produce duplicate output rows.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine within the page’s active window (inclusive).
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page identifier from latest_page; used to join daily metrics.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name from latest_page for the active window; NULLs preserved.
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Product area identifier from latest_page; NULLs preserved.
      - name: sum_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total page views for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_first_time_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_first_time_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_return_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_return_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per visitor for the page and date; 0 when missing; no rounding performed.
      - name: avg_daily_pageviews_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average pageviews per visitor for the page and date; 0 when missing; no rounding performed.
      - name: percent_of_daily_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily pageviews attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: percent_of_daily_page_visitors
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily page visitors attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: percent_of_daily_page_accounts
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily page accounts attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_pageview_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of pageview events for the page and date; 0 when missing.

blocks.original_text:
- name: page_event
      description: Page event fact table enriched with previous-event context and page metadata.
      grain: One row per event from staging.stg_pendo__page_event that has a matching page_id in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor
      business_logic: '- Base rows: take all columns from staging.stg_pendo__page_event without de-duplication or aggregation. - Previous-event context: - For each visitor_id, order events by occurred_at ascending. - Attach values from the immediately prior event for the same visitor: previous_page_id, previous_page_event_at, previous_page_num_minutes, previous_page_num_events. - The first event per visitor has NULLs in these fields; if the prior event''s value is NULL, the attached value is NULL. - Ordering uses occurred_at only; if multiple events share the same occurred_at for a visitor, the chosen prior event is not deterministically defined. - Current page enrichment: - Inner join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on page_id to add page_name and product_area_id (from group_id). - Events without a matching page_id are removed. - Previous page enrichment: - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on previous_page_id to add previous_page_name and previous_page_product_area_id (from group_id). - If previous_page_id is NULL or has no match, these fields are NULL. - Left joins to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor and intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account are performed; no columns are selected from them. When those tables are unique by key, row counts are unchanged. - All other staging columns are passed through unchanged; NULLs and duplicates are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier passed through from staging; may be NULL.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier passed through from staging; may be NULL.
      - name: num_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Event count from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: num_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Minutes from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current page identifier from staging; only events with a matching page in latest_page are retained.
      - name: remote_ip
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Remote IP address from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: server_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Server name from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp used to order events within each visitor for previous-event derivations; ties are not deterministically broken.
      - name: user_agent
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User agent string from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from staging; used to group events for previous-event context; may be NULL.
      - name: page_event_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opaque event key from staging; passed through unchanged; uniqueness not enforced.
      - name: previous_page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page ID from the immediately prior event for the same visitor when ordered by occurred_at ascending; NULL for the first event or if the prior event's page_id is NULL.
      - name: previous_page_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp from the immediately prior event for the same visitor when ordered by occurred_at ascending; NULL for the first event; tie handling follows occurred_at ordering only.
      - name: previous_page_num_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Minutes from the immediately prior event for the same visitor when ordered by occurred_at ascending; NULL for the first event.
      - name: previous_page_num_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Event count from the immediately prior event for the same visitor when ordered by occurred_at ascending; NULL for the first event.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name from latest_page joined on page_id; may be NULL if the matched page has a NULL name.
      - name: product_area_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current page group identifier from latest_page joined on page_id; may be NULL if the matched page has a NULL group.
      - name: previous_page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name from latest_page joined on previous_page_id (left); NULL if no previous_page_id or no match.
      - name: previous_page_product_area_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Group identifier from latest_page joined on previous_page_id (left); NULL if no previous_page_id or no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: product_adoption_analytics
      description: Feature adoption aggregates by feature and app with distinct user counts and user-level averages.
      grain: One row per feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, page_name
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event (feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id, num_events, num_minutes, occurred_at)
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_history (feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, created_at, page_id)
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_history (page_id, page_name)
      business_logic: '- Build feature_usage_base from feature_event: - Group by feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id. - Compute per group: usage_sessions (row count); total_feature_events (sum of num_events); total_feature_minutes (sum of num_minutes); first_used_at (earliest occurred_at); last_used_at (latest occurred_at); active_days_with_feature (count of distinct calendar days from occurred_at); avg_events_per_session (average num_events per row); avg_minutes_per_session (average num_minutes per row). Aggregations ignore NULL inputs; distinct counts exclude NULLs. - Build feature_info by left joining feature_history to page_history on page_id: - Select feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, feature_created_at, page_id, page_name. Multiple historical rows per feature_id may exist; page_name can be NULL if no page match. - Join and aggregate: - Left join feature_usage_base to feature_info on feature_id. - Group by feature_id, feature_name, is_core_event, page_name, app_id (from feature_usage_base). - Metrics: - total_users_tried: distinct visitor_id in the group (dedup across account_id). - avg_events_per_user: for each user-account pair, sum events across sessions; average that per-pair total across the group. - avg_minutes_per_user: for each user-account pair, sum minutes across sessions; average that per-pair total across the group. - avg_active_days_per_user: for each user-account pair, count distinct calendar days with usage; average that per-pair count across the group. - regular_users: distinct visitor_id with at least one user-account pair having 10 or more active days. - casual_users: distinct visitor_id with at least one user-account pair having 1 to 9 active days. - Duplicate rows from feature_info replicate feature_usage_base rows evenly; distinct counts are unaffected and averages remain the same; metrics may repeat across multiple historical names/pages for the same feature. - calculated_at is the system timestamp at execution and is the same for all rows in a single run.'
      columns:
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pendo feature identifier; part of the grouping key.
      - name: feature_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature name from history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: is_core_event
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Core-event flag from history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name via feature_history.page_id joined to page_history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from event data; part of the grouping key.
      - name: total_users_tried
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with any usage in the group; dedup across account_id; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: avg_events_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of total events (sum across sessions) within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: avg_minutes_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of total minutes (sum across sessions) within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: avg_active_days_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of distinct active days within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: regular_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with at least one user-account pair having 10+ active days; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: casual_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with at least one user-account pair having 1–9 active days; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp for the run; identical across all rows in one run.

blocks.original_text:
- name: product_adoption_summary
      description: Feature-level adoption summary by account and app with user/session counts, activity days, adoption category, health score, and calculation timestamp.
      grain: One row per feature_id x account_id x app_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Input: all rows from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event using feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id, num_events, num_minutes, occurred_at. - Group by feature_id, account_id, app_id; produce one row per group. - Metrics: - total_users: number of distinct visitor_id values; NULL visitor_id is ignored; result is zero or greater. - usage_sessions: total number of rows in the group; counts all rows regardless of NULLs in other fields. - total_events: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored; if every num_events is NULL, the sum is NULL. - total_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored; if every num_minutes is NULL, the sum is NULL. - active_days: number of unique calendar days present in occurred_at at day granularity; NULL occurred_at contributes nothing; result is zero or greater. - avg_events_per_session: average of num_events over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - avg_minutes_per_session: average of num_minutes over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - adoption_level (evaluated in order) using active_days and total_events: - Power Users: active_days ≥ 20 and total_events ≥ 100 - Regular Users: active_days ≥ 10 and total_events ≥ 50 - Casual Users: active_days ≥ 5 and total_events ≥ 20 - Trial Users: active_days ≥ 1 and total_events ≥ 5 - Minimal Users: all other cases; if total_events is NULL none of the prior thresholds match, yielding Minimal Users. - feature_health_score: calculated as (distinct users × 2) + (average num_events × 5) + (active_days × 3), then capped at a maximum of 100; if there are no non-NULL num_events the score is NULL; no minimum floor and no rounding applied. - calculated_at: set to the current system timestamp at query execution time; value varies per run; no ordering or window functions are used.'
      columns:
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature identifier and grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier and grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier and grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users per group; NULL visitor_id excluded; never NULL.
      - name: usage_sessions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total event rows per group; counts all rows; never NULL.
      - name: total_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of num_events; NULLs ignored; NULL if all num_events are NULL.
      - name: total_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Sum of num_minutes; NULLs ignored; NULL if all num_minutes are NULL; units: minutes.'
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique active calendar days from occurred_at at day granularity; NULL occurred_at ignored; never NULL.
      - name: avg_events_per_session
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average num_events per group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all are NULL; not rounded.
      - name: avg_minutes_per_session
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average num_minutes per group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all are NULL; not rounded.
      - name: adoption_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category from ordered thresholds based on active_days and total_events: Power/Regular/Casual/Trial/Minimal; always non-NULL.'
      - name: feature_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Score = (distinct users×2) + (avg num_events×5) + (active_days×3), capped at 100; becomes NULL if no non-NULL num_events; not rounded.
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the query runs; varies by run; timezone-aware.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Input: all rows from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event using feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id, num_events, num_minutes, occurred_at. - Group by feature_id, account_id, app_id; produce one row per group. - Metrics: - total_users: number of distinct visitor_id values; NULL visitor_id is ignored; result is zero or greater. - usage_sessions: total number of rows in the group; counts all rows regardless of NULLs in other fields. - total_events: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored; if every num_events is NULL, the sum is NULL. - total_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored; if every num_minutes is NULL, the sum is NULL. - active_days: number of unique calendar days present in occurred_at at day granularity; NULL occurred_at contributes nothing; result is zero or greater. - avg_events_per_session: average of num_events over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - avg_minutes_per_session: average of num_minutes over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - adoption_level (evaluated in order) using active_days and total_events: - Power Users: active_days ≥ 20 and total_events ≥ 100 - Regular Users: active_days ≥ 10 and total_events ≥ 50 - Casual Users: active_days ≥ 5 and total_events ≥ 20 - Trial Users: active_days ≥ 1 and total_events ≥ 5 - Minimal Users: all other cases; if total_events is NULL none of the prior thresholds match, yielding Minimal Users. - feature_health_score: calculated as (distinct users × 2) + (average num_events × 5) + (active_days × 3), then capped at a maximum of 100; if there are no non-NULL num_events the score is NULL; no minimum floor and no rounding applied. - calculated_at: set to the current system timestamp at query execution time; value varies per run; no ordering or window functions are used.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: visitor_daily_metrics
      description: Visitor-date spine joined to daily metrics from each visitor’s first dated event through the run date.
      grain: One row per visitor_id per date_day in the spine; if multiple daily_metrics rows exist for a visitor_id and date_day, multiple rows are returned.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build a daily calendar spine using date_day from intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine. - From intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics, derive first_event_on per visitor_id as the earliest non-null occurred_on; visitors without any dated events are excluded. - Create a visitor-date spine with one row for each visitor_id on every date_day from first_event_on through the current run date, inclusive. - Left join the visitor-date spine to intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics by exact match on visitor_id and date_day to occurred_on. - Select date_day and visitor_id from the spine, and pass through sum_minutes, sum_events, count_event_records, count_pages_viewed, and count_features_clicked from the matched daily_metrics row; no additional aggregation, casting, or rounding is performed. - Null policy: when no daily_metrics row matches a visitor_id and date_day, all metric fields are NULL. - Duplicates: if multiple daily_metrics rows share the same visitor_id and occurred_on, multiple output rows are produced; no deduplication is applied. - Ordering: no explicit sort is applied to the result.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine for each visitor from first_event_on through the run date (inclusive).

- name: visitor_feature
      description: Visitor-feature metrics aggregated from raw feature events
      grain: One row per visitor_id + feature_id present in staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event (using visitor_id, feature_id, occurred_at, num_events, num_minutes). - Group by visitor_id and feature_id; emit one row per group. - Compute metrics within each group: - first_click_at: earliest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL. - last_click_at: latest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL. - sum_clicks: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored; result is NULL if all num_events are NULL. - count_click_events: count all rows in the group; NULLs in any field do not affect this count. - sum_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored; result is NULL if all num_minutes are NULL. - count_active_days: number of distinct calendar days derived from occurred_at; determine the day by removing the time component; NULL occurred_at do not contribute; multiple events on the same day are counted once; result is 0 if no non-NULL occurred_at exists. - Compute avg_daily_minutes as sum_minutes divided by count_active_days, rounded to 3 decimal places; result is NULL if count_active_days is 0 or sum_minutes is NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from source; grouping key; NULLs are preserved
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature identifier from source; grouping key; NULLs are preserved
      - name: first_click_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at across the group's events; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: last_click_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at across the group's events; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: sum_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total of num_events across the group's rows; NULL num_events are ignored; result is NULL if all num_events are NULL
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total minutes from num_minutes across the group's rows; NULL num_minutes are ignored; result is NULL if all num_minutes are NULL
      - name: avg_daily_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: sum_minutes divided by count_active_days, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if count_active_days is 0 or sum_minutes is NULL
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar days with non-NULL occurred_at; multiple events on the same day counted once
      - name: count_click_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows per visitor_id + feature_id; counts all rows regardless of NULLs

              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: server_name
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "server_name = NULLIF(TRIM(server_name), '')"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: occurred_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: user_agent
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "user_agent = NULLIF(TRIM(user_agent), '')"

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      description: Customer behavior profile per resolved customer with cross-platform engagement, lifecycle metrics, and segmentation
      grain: One row per source match key (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id) with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build per-customer behavior and segmentation by: - Source inputs: - Marketo (intermediate.int_customer360__marketo) per lead_id - Stripe (intermediate.int_customer360__stripe) per customer_id - Zendesk (intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk) per user_id - Identity map (intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches) providing the cross-platform ID linkage - Per-platform metrics: - Marketo: - marketo_first_touch = created_at; marketo_last_activity = updated_at - marketo_engagement_score: - 0 if is_unsubscribed = true or is_email_invalid = true - else 3 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 2 if < 90 - else 1 - has_organization_data = 1 if organization_name_no_suffix not null and length > 3 else 0 - has_phone_contact = 1 if phone or mobile_phone present else 0 - address_completeness_score: - 3 if country_code, state_code, and city all present - 2 if country_code present and at least one of state_code or city present - 1 if only country_code present - 0 otherwise - Stripe: - stripe_first_transaction = created_at; stripe_last_activity = updated_at - stripe_engagement_score: - 0 if is_deleted = true - 1 if is_delinquent = true (and not deleted) - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - payment_reliability_score: - 3 if is_delinquent = false and is_deleted = false - 1 if is_delinquent = true and is_deleted = false - 0 otherwise - billing_completeness_score: - 2 if customer_address_line_1 and customer_country_code present - 1 if only customer_country_code present - 0 otherwise - Zendesk: - zendesk_first_contact = created_at; zendesk_last_activity = updated_at - zendesk_engagement_score: - 0 if is_suspended = true or is_deleted = true - 1 if is_active = false - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - org_relationship_strength: - 2 if organization_id and organization_name_no_suffix present - 1 if only organization_id present - 0 otherwise - Join and aggregate: - Left join per-platform metrics to source_matches on respective IDs - primary_email = coalesce(Marketo.email, Stripe.email, Zendesk.email); rows with NULL primary_email are excluded - email_domain and primary_organization use the same COALESCE order (Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk) - customer_first_touchpoint = the earliest of the three per-platform first-touch timestamps - customer_last_activity = the latest of the three per-platform last-activity timestamps - If any of the three timestamps is NULL, the earliest/latest result is NULL - marketo_engagement/stripe_engagement/zendesk_engagement = respective per-platform scores with NULL → 0 - composite_engagement_score = weighted average (weights: Marketo 0.3, Stripe 0.5, Zendesk 0.2), rounded to two decimals and stored with one decimal precision - in_marketo/in_stripe/in_zendesk = 1 if respective joined record exists, else 0 - organization_data_quality = coalesce(has_organization_data,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(org_relationship_strength,0) - has_contact_phone = coalesce(has_phone_contact, 0) - address_data_quality = coalesce(address_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) - marketing_to_sales_days = days between Marketo first touch and Stripe first transaction only if both present; else NULL - sales_to_support_days = days between Stripe first transaction and Zendesk first contact only if both present; else NULL - account_age_days = days between the earliest available first-touch and current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL - customer_maturity (derived from the same earliest timestamp vs current_date): - ''New Customer'' if < 90 days - ''Growing Relationship'' if < 365 days - ''Established Customer'' if < 1095 days - ''Long-term Customer'' otherwise (including when the start date is NULL) - customer_journey_pattern based on platform presence, evaluated in this order: - ''Full Journey'' if all three present - ''Marketing to Sales'' if Marketo and Stripe - ''Sales to Support'' if Stripe and Zendesk - ''Marketing to Support'' if Marketo and Zendesk - ''Marketing Only'' if only Marketo - ''Sales Only'' if only Stripe - ''Support Only'' if only Zendesk - ''Unknown'' otherwise - payment_reliability = coalesce(Stripe.payment_reliability_score, 0) - Classification: - customer_segment (first match wins): - ''Champion'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''Loyal Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.0 and customer_journey_pattern = ''Full Journey'' - ''Potential Loyalist'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''New Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.0 and account_age_days < 90 - ''At Risk'' if composite_engagement_score >= 1.5 - ''Hibernating'' if composite_engagement_score > 0 - ''Lost'' otherwise - churn_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if payment_reliability = 0 or composite_engagement_score < 1 - ''Medium Risk'' if composite_engagement_score < 2 and account_age_days > 365 - ''Medium Risk'' if customer_last_activity is more than 90 days ago - ''Low Risk'' otherwise (including when comparisons evaluate to NULL) - recommended_action based on customer_segment: - ''Upsell/Cross-sell'' for ''Champion'' or ''Loyal Customer'' - ''Engagement Campaign'' for ''Potential Loyalist'' - ''Onboarding Focus'' for ''New Customer'' - ''Win-back Campaign'' for ''At Risk'' - ''Reactivation Campaign'' for ''Hibernating'' - ''Recovery Campaign'' otherwise - Output filter and ordering: - Keep only rows where primary_email is not NULL - Order rows by composite_engagement_score descending, then account_age_days descending'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Marketo mapping exists
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Stripe mapping exists
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Zendesk mapping exists
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary email chosen by Marketo then Stripe then Zendesk; not null due to final filter; casing and spacing preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email domain chosen by the same precedence as primary_email; NULL if all source domains are NULL; formatting preserved
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization chosen by precedence Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk; NULL if all are NULL
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest timestamp across the three platform first-touch timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest timestamp across the three platform last-activity timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: marketo_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Marketo engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3); NULL Marketo row yields 0
      - name: stripe_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stripe engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Stripe row yields 0
      - name: zendesk_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Zendesk engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Zendesk row yields 0
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Weighted average of platform scores (weights 0.3, 0.5, 0.2), rounded to two decimals then stored with one decimal; missing scores treated as 0; range 0.0–3.7
      - name: in_marketo
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Marketo (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_stripe
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Stripe (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_zendesk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Zendesk (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: organization_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Aggregate org data score = has_organization_data(0/1) + billing_completeness_score(0/1/2) + org_relationship_strength(0/1/2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: has_contact_phone
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if Marketo has phone or mobile_phone, else 0; NULL treated as 0; values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: address_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address/billing completeness = Marketo.address_completeness_score(0–3) + Stripe.billing_completeness_score(0–2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: marketing_to_sales_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Marketo first touch to Stripe first transaction; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: sales_to_support_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Stripe first transaction to Zendesk first contact; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from the earliest first-touch timestamp to current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL; computed at execution time
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle label based on days since earliest touch: New Customer (<90), Growing Relationship (<365), Established Customer (<1095), else Long-term Customer; NULL start yields Long-term Customer'
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Journey coverage across platforms with precedence: Full Journey; Marketing to Sales; Sales to Support; Marketing to Support; Marketing Only; Sales Only; Support Only; else Unknown'
      - name: payment_reliability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Stripe-derived reliability score: 3 (not delinquent and not deleted), 1 (delinquent and not deleted), 0 otherwise; NULL Stripe row yields 0'
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Segment assigned by ordered rules: Champion; Loyal Customer; Potential Loyalist; New Customer; At Risk; Hibernating; else Lost'
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk level by ordered rules: High if payment_reliability=0 or composite<1; Medium if composite<2 and age>365; Medium if last activity >90 days ago; else Low'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Next best action mapped from customer_segment: Upsell/Cross-sell; Engagement Campaign; Onboarding Focus; Win-back Campaign; Reactivation Campaign; else Recovery Campaign'

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN m_created IS NULL OR s_created IS NULL OR z_created IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(m_created, s_created, z_created) END
CASE WHEN m_updated IS NULL OR s_updated IS NULL OR z_updated IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(m_updated, s_updated, z_updated) END
CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CAST(CASE WHEN NOT m_created IS NULL AND NOT s_created IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', m_created, s_created) END AS BIGINT)
CAST(CASE WHEN NOT s_created IS NULL AND NOT z_created IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', s_created, z_created) END AS BIGINT)
CASE WHEN age_days < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN age_days < 365 THEN 'Growing Relationship' WHEN age_days < 1095 THEN 'Established Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END

CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Full Journey' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Sales' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing Only' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales Only' WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Support Only' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN composite >= 3.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Champion' WHEN composite >= 3.0 AND NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Loyal Customer' WHEN composite >= 2.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Potential Loyalist' WHEN composite >= 2.0 AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', first_touch, CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN composite >= 1.5 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN composite > 0 THEN 'Hibernating' ELSE 'Lost' END

CASE WHEN reliability = 0 OR composite < 1 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN composite < 2 AND age_days > 365 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN last_activity < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END

CASE segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 'Upsell/Cross-sell' WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 'Upsell/Cross-sell' WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 'Engagement Campaign' WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 'Onboarding Focus' WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 'Win-back Campaign' WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 'Reactivation Campaign' ELSE 'Recovery Campaign' END

runtime_hits.line_text: select *, date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date)::bigint as age_days,
when composite >= 2.0 and date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date) < 90 then 'New Customer'
when last_activity < current_timestamp - interval '90 days' then 'Medium Risk' else 'Low Risk' end as churn_risk

references.name: intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build per-customer behavior and segmentation by: - Source inputs: - Marketo (intermediate.int_customer360__marketo) per lead_id - Stripe (intermediate.int_customer360__stripe) per customer_id - Zendesk (intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk) per user_id - Identity map (intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches) providing the cross-platform ID linkage - Per-platform metrics: - Marketo: - marketo_first_touch = created_at; marketo_last_activity = updated_at - marketo_engagement_score: - 0 if is_unsubscribed = true or is_email_invalid = true - else 3 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 2 if < 90 - else 1 - has_organization_data = 1 if organization_name_no_suffix not null and length > 3 else 0 - has_phone_contact = 1 if phone or mobile_phone present else 0 - address_completeness_score: - 3 if country_code, state_code, and city all present - 2 if country_code present and at least one of state_code or city present - 1 if only country_code present - 0 otherwise - Stripe: - stripe_first_transaction = created_at; stripe_last_activity = updated_at - stripe_engagement_score: - 0 if is_deleted = true - 1 if is_delinquent = true (and not deleted) - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - payment_reliability_score: - 3 if is_delinquent = false and is_deleted = false - 1 if is_delinquent = true and is_deleted = false - 0 otherwise - billing_completeness_score: - 2 if customer_address_line_1 and customer_country_code present - 1 if only customer_country_code present - 0 otherwise - Zendesk: - zendesk_first_contact = created_at; zendesk_last_activity = updated_at - zendesk_engagement_score: - 0 if is_suspended = true or is_deleted = true - 1 if is_active = false - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - org_relationship_strength: - 2 if organization_id and organization_name_no_suffix present - 1 if only organization_id present - 0 otherwise - Join and aggregate: - Left join per-platform metrics to source_matches on respective IDs - primary_email = coalesce(Marketo.email, Stripe.email, Zendesk.email); rows with NULL primary_email are excluded - email_domain and primary_organization use the same COALESCE order (Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk) - customer_first_touchpoint = the earliest of the three per-platform first-touch timestamps - customer_last_activity = the latest of the three per-platform last-activity timestamps - If any of the three timestamps is NULL, the earliest/latest result is NULL - marketo_engagement/stripe_engagement/zendesk_engagement = respective per-platform scores with NULL → 0 - composite_engagement_score = weighted average (weights: Marketo 0.3, Stripe 0.5, Zendesk 0.2), rounded to two decimals and stored with one decimal precision - in_marketo/in_stripe/in_zendesk = 1 if respective joined record exists, else 0 - organization_data_quality = coalesce(has_organization_data,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(org_relationship_strength,0) - has_contact_phone = coalesce(has_phone_contact, 0) - address_data_quality = coalesce(address_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) - marketing_to_sales_days = days between Marketo first touch and Stripe first transaction only if both present; else NULL - sales_to_support_days = days between Stripe first transaction and Zendesk first contact only if both present; else NULL - account_age_days = days between the earliest available first-touch and current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL - customer_maturity (derived from the same earliest timestamp vs current_date): - ''New Customer'' if < 90 days - ''Growing Relationship'' if < 365 days - ''Established Customer'' if < 1095 days - ''Long-term Customer'' otherwise (including when the start date is NULL) - customer_journey_pattern based on platform presence, evaluated in this order: - ''Full Journey'' if all three present - ''Marketing to Sales'' if Marketo and Stripe - ''Sales to Support'' if Stripe and Zendesk - ''Marketing to Support'' if Marketo and Zendesk - ''Marketing Only'' if only Marketo - ''Sales Only'' if only Stripe - ''Support Only'' if only Zendesk - ''Unknown'' otherwise - payment_reliability = coalesce(Stripe.payment_reliability_score, 0) - Classification: - customer_segment (first match wins): - ''Champion'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''Loyal Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.0 and customer_journey_pattern = ''Full Journey'' - ''Potential Loyalist'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''New Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.0 and account_age_days < 90 - ''At Risk'' if composite_engagement_score >= 1.5 - ''Hibernating'' if composite_engagement_score > 0 - ''Lost'' otherwise - churn_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if payment_reliability = 0 or composite_engagement_score < 1 - ''Medium Risk'' if composite_engagement_score < 2 and account_age_days > 365 - ''Medium Risk'' if customer_last_activity is more than 90 days ago - ''Low Risk'' otherwise (including when comparisons evaluate to NULL) - recommended_action based on customer_segment: - ''Upsell/Cross-sell'' for ''Champion'' or ''Loyal Customer'' - ''Engagement Campaign'' for ''Potential Loyalist'' - ''Onboarding Focus'' for ''New Customer'' - ''Win-back Campaign'' for ''At Risk'' - ''Reactivation Campaign'' for ''Hibernating'' - ''Recovery Campaign'' otherwise - Output filter and ordering: - Keep only rows where primary_email is not NULL - Order rows by composite_engagement_score descending, then account_age_days descending'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      description: Customer lifecycle metrics, health scoring, retention/churn risk, and cohort/tier enrichments derived from customer behavior analysis
      grain: One row per customer from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (one row per resolved customer), compute lifecycle metrics and enrichments: - Activity windows and recency: - days_since_last_activity = number of days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is missing. - active_X_days flags (X ∈ {30,60,90,180,365}) = 1 if customer_last_activity occurred within X days of today, else 0; missing customer_last_activity yields 0. - Lifecycle stage (first match wins): - ''Acquisition'' if account_age_days ≤ 30 - ''Activation'' if account_age_days ≤ 90 and last_activity within 30 days - ''Growth'' if account_age_days ≤ 365 and last_activity within 60 days - ''Maturity'' if account_age_days > 365 and last_activity within 90 days - ''Dormant'' if last_activity older than 180 days - Else ''Retention'' - Note: NULL account_age_days or last_activity causes earlier conditions to fail and typically falls through to ''Retention''. - Cohort and platform consistency: - acquisition_cohort_month = month of the first touchpoint (truncated to month); NULL if first_touchpoint is missing. - platform_consistency_score ∈ {1,2,3}: sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); 3 if sum ≥ 3, 2 if sum = 2, else 1. NULL in any flag leads to the else path → 1. - Value and engagement scores: - estimated_customer_value (DECIMAL(6,2)) by customer_segment: - ''Champion'' 5000.00; ''Loyal Customer'' 3500.00; ''Potential Loyalist'' 2000.00; ''New Customer'' 800.00; ''At Risk'' 1200.00; ''Hibernating'' 500.00; else 200.00. - frequency_score (1–5): 5 if platform_consistency_score = 3 and active_30_days = 1; 4 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_60_days = 1; 3 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_90_days = 1; 2 if active_180_days = 1; else 1. - recency_score (1–5) by days_since_last_activity: 5 (≤7), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤60), 2 (≤180), else 1; NULL days_since_last_activity maps to 1. - estimated_transaction_count (DOUBLE): simulated per run: - If segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') → integer 2–9 - If ''Potential Loyalist'' → integer 1–4 - Else → integer 0–1 - Stored as DOUBLE; values vary each execution. - customer_health_score (DECIMAL(15,2)) = rounded to 2 decimals from: recency_component*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 + segment_component*0.4, where: - recency_component: 5/4/3/2/1 as in recency_score logic - segment_component: ''Champion'' 5.0; ''Loyal Customer'' 4.5; ''Potential Loyalist'' 3.5; ''New Customer'' 3.0; ''At Risk'' 2.0; ''Hibernating'' 1.5; else 1.0 - Advanced lifecycle metrics: - estimated_customer_ltv (DECIMAL(18,2)) = estimated_customer_value × (1 + 0.2 × frequency_score) × (1 + 0.1 × platform_consistency_score) × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - ''High Growth Potential'' if lifecycle_stage in (''Acquisition'',''Activation'') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - ''Expansion Ready'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - ''Upsell Candidate'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Maturity'' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - ''Stable Account'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Retention'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - ''Reactivation Needed'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' - Else ''Monitor'' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Acquisition'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: ''Holiday Season'' if month in (11,12,1); ''Summer Season'' if in (6,7,8); ''Spring Season'' if in (3,4,5); else ''Fall Season'' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→''Immediate''; 4→''This Week''; 3→''This Month''; else ''Routine''. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ ''Dormant''; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in (''Growth'',''Maturity''); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: ''Above Expectation'' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; ''Meeting Expectation'' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else ''Below Expectation''. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.'

        description: Segment-based monetary value estimate with fixed mapping; never NULL
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Engagement frequency score (1–5) from platform consistency and recent activity per ordered rules
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Recency score (1–5) from days_since_last_activity thresholds; NULL recency maps to 1
      - name: estimated_transaction_count
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Simulated integer count: 2–9 for top segments, 1–4 for Potential Loyalist, else 0–1; varies each run'
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: 'Weighted composite: 0.3×recency_component + 0.3×platform_consistency + 0.4×segment_component; rounded to 2 decimals'
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: LTV estimate from value × frequency × platform × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Probability mapped from customer_health_score thresholds (≥4.5→0.95 down to else 0.20)
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Inverse of retention mapping from customer_health_score (≥4.5→0.05 up to else 0.80)
      - name: revenue_at_risk
        data_type: DECIMAL(9,2)
        description: Estimated_customer_value multiplied by churn mapping; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical potential per ordered rules using lifecycle_stage, platform consistency, and health score
      - name: action_priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Next-action priority (2–5) from ordered rules using churn mapping, lifecycle, platform consistency, health, and value
      - name: acquisition_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number (1–12) extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: months_since_acquisition
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_season
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season by acquisition month: Holiday (11,12,1), Summer (6,7,8), Spring (3,4,5), else Fall (default for NULL/not matched)'
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic'
      - name: is_strategic_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 or (segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') and platform_consistency_score = 3), else FALSE
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Urgency label by action_priority: 5→Immediate; 4→This Week; 3→This Month; else Routine'
      - name: expected_retention_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Expected rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90, 0.85, 0.75 (non-Dormant), 0.60 (Growth/Maturity), else 0.45'
      - name: performance_vs_expectation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Comparison of retention_probability vs expected_retention_rate: Above (>), Meeting (≥80%), or Below'

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN customer_last_activity >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_last_activity >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_last_activity >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_last_activity >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '180' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_last_activity >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '365' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN account_age_days <= 30 THEN 'Acquisition' WHEN account_age_days <= 90 AND active_30_days = 1 THEN 'Activation' WHEN account_age_days <= 365 AND active_60_days = 1 THEN 'Growth' WHEN account_age_days > 365 AND active_90_days = 1 THEN 'Maturity' WHEN days_since_last_activity > 180 THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Retention' END
CASE WHEN platform_sum >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN platform_sum = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

CAST(CASE customer_segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 5000.00 WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 3500.00 WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 2000.00 WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 800.00 WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 1200.00 WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 500.00 ELSE 200.00 END AS DECIMAL(6, 2))
CASE WHEN platform_sum >= 2 AND active_90_days = 1 THEN 3 WHEN active_180_days = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
CASE WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 7 THEN 5 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 30 THEN 4 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 60 THEN 3 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 180 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

CAST(CASE WHEN customer_segment IN ('Champion', 'Loyal Customer') THEN 2 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 8) WHEN customer_segment = 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 1 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 4) ELSE FLOOR(RANDOM() * 2) END AS DOUBLE)

CAST(ROUND(recency_score * 0.3 + platform_consistency_score * 0.3 + (CASE customer_segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 4.5 WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 3.5 WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END) * 0.4, 2) AS DECIMAL(15, 2))

CAST(ROUND(estimated_customer_value * (1 + 0.2 * frequency_score) * (1 + 0.1 * platform_consistency_score) * (CASE lifecycle_stage WHEN 'Growth' THEN 1.5 WHEN 'Maturity' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'Retention' THEN 1.8 WHEN 'Activation' THEN 1.2 ELSE 1.0 END), 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))

CAST(CASE WHEN customer_health_score >= 4.5 THEN 0.95 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 0.85 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 0.75 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 0.65 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2.5 THEN 0.50 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2 THEN 0.35 ELSE 0.20 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2))

CAST(CASE WHEN customer_health_score >= 4.5 THEN 0.05 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 0.15 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 0.25 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 0.35 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2.5 THEN 0.50 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2 THEN 0.65 ELSE 0.80 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2))
CASE WHEN NOT acquisition_cohort_month IS NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(acquisition_cohort_month) AS BIGINT) END
CASE WHEN NOT acquisition_cohort_month IS NULL THEN CAST(MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) AS BIGINT) END
CASE WHEN NOT acquisition_cohort_month IS NULL THEN CAST(DATE_DIFF('MONTH', CAST(acquisition_cohort_month AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) END

CASE WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (11, 12, 1) THEN 'Holiday Season' WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer Season' WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring Season' ELSE 'Fall Season' END

CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 8000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2500 THEN 'Silver' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 'Bronze' ELSE 'Basic' END
CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 OR (customer_segment IN ('Champion', 'Loyal Customer') AND platform_consistency_score = 3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
CASE action_priority WHEN 5 THEN 'Immediate' WHEN 4 THEN 'This Week' WHEN 3 THEN 'This Month' ELSE 'Routine' END

CAST(CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 8000 THEN 0.90 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 0.85 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2500 AND lifecycle_stage <> 'Dormant' THEN 0.75 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 AND lifecycle_stage IN ('Growth', 'Maturity') THEN 0.60 ELSE 0.45 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2))
CASE WHEN retention_probability > expected_retention_rate THEN 'Above Expectation' WHEN retention_probability >= expected_retention_rate * 0.8 THEN 'Meeting Expectation' ELSE 'Below Expectation' END

CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage IN ('Acquisition', 'Activation') AND customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 'High Growth Potential' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND platform_consistency_score >= 2 THEN 'Expansion Ready' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Maturity' AND customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 'Upsell Candidate' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Retention' AND customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 'Stable Account' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' THEN 'Reactivation Needed' ELSE 'Monitor' END

CASE WHEN churn_probability >= 0.65 THEN 5 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Acquisition' AND customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 4 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND platform_consistency_score >= 2 THEN 4 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 AND estimated_customer_value >= 3000 THEN 3 WHEN churn_probability >= 0.35 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END

references.line_text: business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (one row per resolved customer), compute lifecycle metrics and enrichments: - Activity windows and recency: - days_since_last_activity = number of days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is missing. - active_X_days flags (X ∈ {30,60,90,180,365}) = 1 if customer_last_activity occurred within X days of today, else 0; missing customer_last_activity yields 0. - Lifecycle stage (first match wins): - ''Acquisition'' if account_age_days ≤ 30 - ''Activation'' if account_age_days ≤ 90 and last_activity within 30 days - ''Growth'' if account_age_days ≤ 365 and last_activity within 60 days - ''Maturity'' if account_age_days > 365 and last_activity within 90 days - ''Dormant'' if last_activity older than 180 days - Else ''Retention'' - Note: NULL account_age_days or last_activity causes earlier conditions to fail and typically falls through to ''Retention''. - Cohort and platform consistency: - acquisition_cohort_month = month of the first touchpoint (truncated to month); NULL if first_touchpoint is missing. - platform_consistency_score ∈ {1,2,3}: sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); 3 if sum ≥ 3, 2 if sum = 2, else 1. NULL in any flag leads to the else path → 1. - Value and engagement scores: - estimated_customer_value (DECIMAL(6,2)) by customer_segment: - ''Champion'' 5000.00; ''Loyal Customer'' 3500.00; ''Potential Loyalist'' 2000.00; ''New Customer'' 800.00; ''At Risk'' 1200.00; ''Hibernating'' 500.00; else 200.00. - frequency_score (1–5): 5 if platform_consistency_score = 3 and active_30_days = 1; 4 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_60_days = 1; case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '60 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_60_days,
case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '90 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_90_days,
case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '180 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_180_days,
case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '365 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_365_days,

when ba.customer_last_activity >= current_date - interval '90 days' then 1
when ba.customer_last_activity >= current_date - interval '180 days' then 1
when ba.customer_last_activity >= current_date - interval '365 days' then 1

when ba.account_age_days <= 365 and ba.customer_last_activity >= current_date - interval '60 days' then 'Growth'

- name: int_customer360__marketo
      description: Marketo leads passed through from raw.marketo_leads with non-empty emails and timestamps cast
      grain: One row per raw.marketo_leads record where email IS NOT NULL and email != ''
      source_models:
      - raw.marketo_leads
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from raw.marketo_leads. - Select the listed columns exactly as in the source; no joins, aggregations, or de-duplication; duplicates are preserved. - Keep only records where email is neither NULL nor an empty string; emails containing only whitespace are retained because no trimming is applied. - Cast updated_at and created_at to TIMESTAMP; all other fields are passed through unchanged from source. - Nulls from the source are preserved for all pass-through columns. - No specific row ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Lead identifier from source; duplicates may exist
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address used for filtering; must be non-null and not empty; case and whitespace preserved
      - name: email_address_stripped
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Standardized email from source
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email domain from source
      - name: full_name_clean
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cleaned full name from source
      - name: first_name_clean
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cleaned first name from source
      - name: last_name_clean
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cleaned last name from source
      - name: name_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name title from source
      - name: name_suffix
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name suffix from source
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from source
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from source
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from source
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name from source
      - name: organization_name_no_suffix
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name without suffix from source
      - name: organization_name_suffix
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name suffix from source
      - name: inferred_organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inferred organization name from source
      - name: inferred_organization_name_no_suffix
