blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__risk_assessment
      description: Multi-dimensional customer risk assessment derived from behavior, lifecycle, payment, and support signals with computed scores, classifications, flags, interventions, ROI, and timestamp
      grain: One row per intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = ''High Risk'' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from behavior_analysis; NULL allowed; used to gate email_engagement_risk
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to stripe_data; NULL allowed
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to zendesk_data; NULL allowed
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary customer email; final output filtered to non-NULL; duplicates preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer organization name from behavior_analysis; used in org_relationship_risk; NULL allowed
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Behavioral engagement score from behavior_analysis; used in email_engagement_risk; no rounding applied here
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Behavioral segment from behavior_analysis; used in satisfaction_risk_score; NULL allowed
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical churn risk level from behavior_analysis; used in satisfaction_risk_score and primary_risk_factor
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between last recorded customer activity and today; NULL if no activity timestamp
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Lifecycle health score from lifecycle_metrics; used in lifecycle_transition_risk and risk_trend; NULL allowed
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle_metrics; used in lifecycle_transition_risk, satisfaction_risk_score, and recommended_intervention
      - name: active_30_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity count/flag over last 30 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: active_90_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity count/flag over last 90 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: platform_consistency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Consistency score across platforms from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Estimated customer lifetime value from lifecycle_metrics; used in revenue_at_risk_score, interventions, ROI, and value calculations
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Lifecycle churn probability from lifecycle_metrics; used in multiple calculations; range [0,1]; NULL allowed
      - name: activity_decline_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: days_since_last_activity >90 →3; >60 →2; >30 →1; else →0; NULL days_since_last_activity yields 0'
      - name: platform_abandonment_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket from sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk): sum=1 →2; sum=2 →1; else →0'
      - name: lifecycle_transition_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: Dormant →3; Retention with customer_health_score<3.0 →2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity>30 →2; else →0'
      - name: email_engagement_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket if marketo_lead_id present: days_since_last_activity>60 →2; else if composite_engagement_score<2.0 →1; else →0; if marketo_lead_id missing →0'
      - name: is_delinquent
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe delinquency flag from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe deletion flag from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_account_created
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe account creation timestamp from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_last_update
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe last update timestamp from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: payment_behavior_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: is_delinquent=true →3; else if stripe_deleted=true →4; else if LTV>5000 and churn_probability>0.5 →2; else →0'
      - name: account_stability_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at <30 →1; else if stripe_deleted=true →3; else →0'
      - name: revenue_at_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: LTV≥10000 and churn≥0.5 →4; else LTV≥5000 and churn≥0.5 →3; else LTV≥2000 and churn≥0.7 →2; else churn≥0.8 →1; else →0'
      - name: zendesk_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk active flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_suspended
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk suspended flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk deletion flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk organization_id; used in org_relationship_risk; NULL allowed
      - name: zendesk_account_created
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk account creation timestamp from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_last_update
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk last update timestamp from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: support_engagement_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: suspended →3; else deleted →2; else active=false →2; else if user present and last_update>90 days →1; else →0'
      - name: org_relationship_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: NULL organization_id with non-NULL primary_organization →1; suspended with non-NULL organization_id →2; else →0'
      - name: satisfaction_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') →2; else churn_risk_level=''High Risk'' →3; else Dormant and zendesk_active=false →2; else →0'
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Weighted sum of seven risk components (0.2, 0.15, 0.15, 0.1, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: risk_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification from the sum of seven risk components: ≥8 Critical; ≥5 High; ≥3 Medium; ≥1 Low; else Minimal'
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Primary factor by precedence: Payment Issues; Engagement Decline; Lifecycle Transition; High Value at Risk; Support Issues; Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring'
      - name: risk_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend by precedence: Improving; Stable; Declining; Deteriorating; else Unknown, based on days_since_last_activity, customer_health_score, and churn_probability'
      - name: potential_revenue_loss
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Estimated loss as LTV × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if either input is NULL
      - name: intervention_timeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Time sensitivity by precedence: Immediate (24h); Urgent (1 week); High Priority (2 weeks); Medium Priority (1 month); else Standard Priority'
      - name: recommended_intervention
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention by precedence: Account Management Call; Executive Outreach; Customer Success Check-in; Personalized Email Campaign; Product Adoption Workshop; Lifecycle-specific Campaign; else Automated Monitoring'
      - name: intervention_success_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Success probability from the sum of seven risk components: ≥8 → 0.30; ≥5 → 0.60; ≥3 → 0.80; ≥1 → 0.90; else → 0.95'
      - name: customer_priority_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(13,1)
        description: Overall priority = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4); logic rounds to 2 decimals and value is stored with one-decimal precision
      - name: risk_adjusted_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Value = LTV × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if inputs are NULL
      - name: critical_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 or revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4; else false
      - name: high_value_at_risk_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000; else false
      - name: engagement_warning_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 and customer_health_score < 3.0; else false
      - name: intervention_roi
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: ROI = (LTV × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − intervention cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost per intervention per defined schedule
      - name: risk_assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp captured at run time with time zone

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 90 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 2 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk = 1 THEN 2 WHEN in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' THEN 3 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Retention' AND customer_health_score < 3 THEN 2 WHEN lifecycle_stage IN ('Acquisition', 'Activation') AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN marketo_lead_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 2 WHEN composite_engagement_score < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN is_delinquent THEN 3 WHEN stripe_deleted THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 AND churn_probability > 0.5 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT stripe_customer_id IS NULL AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', stripe_account_created, stripe_last_update) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN stripe_deleted THEN 3 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 AND churn_probability >= 0.5 THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 AND churn_probability >= 0.5 THEN 3 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 AND churn_probability >= 0.7 THEN 2 WHEN churn_probability >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN zendesk_suspended THEN 3 WHEN zendesk_deleted THEN 2 WHEN zendesk_active = FALSE THEN 2 WHEN NOT zendesk_user_id IS NULL AND zendesk_last_update < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN organization_id IS NULL AND NOT primary_organization IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN zendesk_suspended AND NOT organization_id IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_segment IN ('At Risk', 'Hibernating', 'Lost') THEN 2 WHEN churn_risk_level = 'High Risk' THEN 3 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' AND zendesk_active = FALSE THEN 2 ELSE 0 END

ROUND(activity_decline_risk * 0.2 + platform_abandonment_risk * 0.15 + lifecycle_transition_risk * 0.15 + email_engagement_risk * 0.1 + payment_behavior_risk * 0.25 + account_stability_risk * 0.1 + revenue_at_risk_score * 0.05, 2)
CASE WHEN S >= 8 THEN 'Critical' WHEN S >= 5 THEN 'High' WHEN S >= 3 THEN 'Medium' WHEN S >= 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Minimal' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk > 0 THEN 'Payment Issues' WHEN activity_decline_risk > 0 THEN 'Engagement Decline' WHEN lifecycle_transition_risk > 0 THEN 'Lifecycle Transition' WHEN revenue_at_risk_score > 0 THEN 'High Value at Risk' WHEN support_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Support Issues' WHEN email_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Communication Breakdown' ELSE 'Standard Monitoring' END

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) <= 7 AND customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 'Improving' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 AND churn_probability < 0.3 THEN 'Stable' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN 'Declining' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 'Deteriorating' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk >= 3 THEN 'Immediate (24h)' WHEN activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk >= 5 THEN 'Urgent (1 week)' WHEN revenue_at_risk_score >= 3 THEN 'High Priority (2 weeks)' WHEN activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk >= 3 THEN 'Medium Priority (1 month)' ELSE 'Standard Priority' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk > 0 THEN 'Account Management Call' WHEN activity_decline_risk >= 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'Executive Outreach' WHEN support_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Customer Success Check-in' WHEN email_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Personalized Email Campaign' WHEN platform_abandonment_risk > 0 THEN 'Product Adoption Workshop' WHEN NOT lifecycle_stage IS NULL THEN 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' ELSE 'Automated Monitoring' END
CASE WHEN S >= 8 THEN 0.30 WHEN S >= 5 THEN 0.60 WHEN S >= 3 THEN 0.80 WHEN S >= 1 THEN 0.90 ELSE 0.95 END

CAST(ROUND((CASE risk_category WHEN 'Critical' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 4 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.6 + CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 THEN 5 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 THEN 3 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.4), 2) AS DECIMAL(13, 1))

ROUND(estimated_customer_ltv * intervention_success_probability * 0.7 - CASE recommended_intervention WHEN 'Account Management Call' THEN 500 WHEN 'Executive Outreach' THEN 1000 WHEN 'Customer Success Check-in' THEN 200 WHEN 'Personalized Email Campaign' THEN 50 WHEN 'Product Adoption Workshop' THEN 300 WHEN 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' THEN 100 ELSE 25 END, 2)

references.name: intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = ''High Risk'' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__source_matches
      description: Email-based identity matches across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk with coalesced IDs and combined timestamps (overall latest/earliest across systems and preferred-source values).
      grain: One row per merged match of (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id) produced by full outer joins of the pairwise email matches; duplicates may occur when inputs contain multiple rows for the same email.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo_for_matching
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe_for_matching
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk_for_matching
      business_logic: '- Build three pairwise match sets using exact email equality (no normalization): - Marketo↔Stripe on identical email. - Marketo↔Zendesk on identical email. - Stripe↔Zendesk on identical email. - Merge matches: - Full outer join Marketo↔Stripe with Marketo↔Zendesk on Marketo lead ID. - Full outer join the result with Stripe↔Zendesk when either Stripe customer ID matches or Zendesk user ID matches. - Derive IDs: - Marketo lead ID: take the Marketo ID from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Marketo↔Zendesk match. - Stripe customer ID: take the Stripe ID from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match. - Zendesk user ID: take the Zendesk ID from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match. - Derive timestamps: - Overall updated_at (named marketo_updated_at): choose the latest non-null among the Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk updated_at values available from the merged matches. - Stripe updated_at: take the Stripe updated_at from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk updated_at: take the Zendesk updated_at from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk organization updated_at: take from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Overall created_at (named marketo_created_at): choose the earliest non-null among the Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk created_at values available from the merged matches. - Stripe created_at: take the Stripe created_at from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk created_at: take the Zendesk created_at from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk organization created_at: take from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - No aggregation, sorting, or deduplication is applied; all resulting rows are retained and nulls are handled by selecting the first available or by taking latest/earliest across systems as described.'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead ID from the available pairwise email match; null when no Marketo match exists.
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer ID from the available pairwise email match; null when no Stripe match exists.
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user ID from the available pairwise email match; null when no Zendesk match exists.
      - name: marketo_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest non-null updated_at across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk available in the merged matches; null when all are null.
      - name: stripe_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe updated_at taken from Marketo↔Stripe when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.
      - name: zendesk_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk updated_at taken from Marketo↔Zendesk when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.
      - name: zendesk_organization_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk organization updated_at taken from Marketo↔Zendesk when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.
      - name: marketo_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest non-null created_at across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk available in the merged matches; null when all are null.
      - name: stripe_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe created_at taken from Marketo↔Stripe when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.
      - name: zendesk_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk created_at taken from Marketo↔Zendesk when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.
      - name: zendesk_organization_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk organization created_at taken from Marketo↔Zendesk when present, otherwise from Stripe↔Zendesk; null when neither provides a value.

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__address
      description: Consolidated customer addresses from Marketo and Stripe enriched with standardized country/state names and priority-based ranking
      grain: One row per sourced address per customer360_id (duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes
      - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes
      business_logic: '- Read pass-through datasets: - marts.customer360__mapping as mapping (provides marketo_lead_id and stripe_customer_id per customer360_id) - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes as country_codes - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes as state_codes - Build Marketo addresses (inner join mapping.marketo_lead_id = int_customer360__marketo.lead_id): - Primary address: include rows where address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "primary", priority = 1; select address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_code, country_code, postal_code - Billing address: include rows where billing_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "billing", priority = 2; map billing_* fields to output columns - Build Stripe addresses (inner join mapping.stripe_customer_id = int_customer360__stripe.customer_id): - Customer address: include rows where customer_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "customer", priority = 1; map customer_* fields - Shipping address: include rows where shipping_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "shipping", priority = 2; map shipping_* fields - Union all Marketo and Stripe address rows; no de-duplication; only addresses with non-NULL address_line_1 are included. - Enrich with geographic names via left joins: - state: join state_codes on (state_code AND country_code) to derive state_territory; unmatched → NULL - country and country_alt_name: join country_codes on alpha-2 country code; unmatched → NULL - Compute rank: per customer360_id, assign row numbers ordered by priority ascending; within the same priority, order is unspecified and non-deterministic. - Output passes through source text as-is (casing/whitespace preserved); no normalization beyond the joins.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer key from mapping used to group and rank addresses; multiple rows per customer360_id
      - name: source_system
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin system literal ('marketo' or 'stripe'); set per source and always non-null
      - name: address_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Address category set per source: Marketo → ''primary'' or ''billing''; Stripe → ''customer'' or ''shipping'''
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary address line; rows are included only when this is non-null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary address line from source; may be null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from source; may be null; no transformation
      - name: state_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from source used for state name enrichment; may be null; case preserved
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved state/territory name from stg_customer360__state_territory_codes via (state_code,country_code) match; null if no match
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from source used for joins; may be null; case preserved
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved country name from stg_customer360__country_codes via country_code_alpha_2; null if no match
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from stg_customer360__country_codes; null if no match
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from source stored as BIGINT; may be null; numeric-only storage means leading zeros are not preserved
      - name: priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address priority set by source (1 for primary/customer, 2 for billing/shipping); lower number indicates higher priority
      - name: rank
        data_type: BIGINT

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis
      description: Conversion funnel metrics and optimization insights derived from behavior, lifecycle, and activity sources
      grain: One row per behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, primary_email, primary_organization, customer_first_touchpoint, customer_last_activity, customer_journey_pattern, customer_segment, marketing_to_sales_days, sales_to_support_days, account_age_days, in_marketo, in_stripe, in_zendesk, marketo_engagement, stripe_engagement, zendesk_engagement)
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (primary_email, lifecycle_stage, customer_health_score, estimated_customer_ltv, customer_tier)
      - marts.customer360__customer_activity_metrics (primary_email, activity_grade, weighted_engagement_score, primary_engagement_channel)
      business_logic: '- Begin with behavior_analysis and left join lifecycle_metrics and activity_metrics on primary_email. - Stage flags: reached_awareness = in_marketo; reached_conversion = in_stripe; reached_support = in_zendesk (1/0/NULL passthrough). - Speed buckets: awareness_to_conversion_speed from marketing_to_sales_days: ≤30 → Fast; ≤90 → Medium; ≤180 → Slow; >180 → Very Slow; missing → Direct to Sales. conversion_to_support_speed from sales_to_support_days: ≤7 → Immediate; ≤30 → Quick; ≤90 → Standard; >90 → Delayed; missing → No Support Needed. - journey_completeness_score: 3 if all three stage flags = 1; 2 if any two = 1; 1 if any one = 1; else 0. - Engagement quality passthrough: awareness_engagement_quality = marketo_engagement; conversion_engagement_quality = stripe_engagement; support_engagement_quality = zendesk_engagement. - funnel_efficiency: in_marketo = 1 and in_stripe = 1 and marketing_to_sales_days ≤ 60 → High Efficiency; same but ≤120 → Medium Efficiency; same (no day threshold) → Low Efficiency; in_stripe = 1 and in_marketo = 0 → Direct Conversion; else → No Conversion. - next_stage_conversion_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)): If reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0: awareness_engagement_quality ≥ 4 and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → 0.85; ≥3 and ≥3.5 → 0.70; ≥2 and ≥3.0 → 0.55; ≥1 → 0.35; else → 0.15. Else if reached_conversion = 1 and reached_support = 0: conversion_engagement_quality ≥ 4 and customer_tier in {Platinum, Gold} → 0.75; ≥3 and customer_tier in {Gold, Silver} → 0.60; ≥2 → 0.45; else → 0.25. Else → 1.00. - value_realization_pattern: If reached_conversion = 1: estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 5000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed = Fast → Quick Value Realization; estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 2000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in {Fast, Medium} → Standard Value Realization; awareness_to_conversion_speed in {Slow, Very Slow} → Delayed Value Realization; else → Unknown Value Timeline. Else → Pre-Value Stage. - drop_off_risk: reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0 and account_age_days > 180 → High Drop-off Risk; reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0 and awareness_engagement_quality ≤ 2 → Medium Drop-off Risk; reached_conversion = 1 and reached_support = 0 and conversion_engagement_quality ≤ 2 → Support Adoption Risk; else → Low Drop-off Risk. - journey_velocity: Use the sum of marketing_to_sales_days and sales_to_support_days, treating missing values as 0: completeness = 3 and sum ≤ 60 → Accelerated Journey; completeness ≥ 2 and sum ≤ 120 → Standard Journey; completeness ≥ 1 and sum ≤ 300 → Slow Journey; else → Stalled Journey. - cross_stage_engagement_consistency (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): If completeness ≥ 2: average of stage engagement scores where missing counts as 0 (sum divided by completeness). Else: use the single available score in order awareness, then conversion, then support; if none present use 0. - revenue_velocity_monthly (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): If reached_conversion = 1: monthly velocity = (estimated_customer_ltv ÷ days to sales), using 30 days when unavailable or less than 30, then ×30; else 0. Returns NULL if LTV is NULL. - optimization_recommendation: Awareness→Conversion is Slow/Very Slow and reached_conversion = 0 → if awareness_engagement_quality ≥ 3 then Accelerate Sales Qualification Process else Improve Marketing Lead Quality; Conversion→Support is Delayed and reached_support = 0 → Enhance Customer Success Onboarding; cross_stage_engagement_consistency < 2.5 → Implement Cross-Channel Coordination; journey_velocity = Stalled Journey → Reduce Funnel Friction Points; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.7 → Accelerate High-Probability Conversions; drop_off_risk = High Drop-off Risk → Implement Retention Intervention; else → Standard Funnel Management. - expected_optimization_value (DECIMAL(18,2), rounded to 2 decimals): estimated_customer_ltv × (next_stage_conversion_probability − reduction) × tier_multiplier, where reduction = next_stage_conversion_probability × 0.7 if drop_off_risk is not Low Drop-off Risk else × 0.9, and tier_multiplier = 1.0 if LTV ≥ 5000, 0.8 if ≥2000, 0.6 if ≥1000, else 0.4. Returns NULL if LTV is NULL. - intervention_priority: next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.7 and estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000 → Critical Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 or estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 5000 → High Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.4 → Medium Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.2 → Low Priority; else → Monitor Only. - success_target: completeness = 3 → Maintain Full Journey Excellence; completeness = 2 and next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 → Complete Journey Progression; completeness = 1 and drop_off_risk = Low Drop-off Risk → Advance to Next Stage; drop_off_risk in {High Drop-off Risk, Medium Drop-off Risk} → Prevent Drop-off; else → Engage and Qualify. - funnel_performance_grade: completeness = 3 and journey_velocity = Accelerated Journey → A+; completeness = 3 and journey_velocity = Standard Journey → A; completeness = 2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency ≥ 3.5 → B+; completeness = 2 and ≥ 3.0 → B; completeness = 1 and next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 → C+; completeness = 1 and ≥ 0.4 → C; completeness = 1 → D; else → F. - journey_efficiency_index (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): 0.3 × completeness + 0.3 × velocity_score + 0.4 × cross_stage_engagement_consistency, where velocity_score = 5 for Accelerated Journey, 4 for Standard Journey, 2 for Slow Journey, else 1. - predictive_full_journey_probability (DOUBLE, rounded to 3 decimals): 0.4 × next_stage_conversion_probability + 0.3 × drop_off_weight + 0.3 × (cross_stage_engagement_consistency ÷ 5.0), where drop_off_weight = 0.9 for Low Drop-off Risk, 0.7 for Support Adoption Risk, 0.5 for Medium Drop-off Risk, else 0.2. - funnel_analysis_timestamp: set to the current system timestamp (time zone aware). - Final selection and ordering: include only records with a present primary_email; order by intervention_priority (descending lexicographic), then expected_optimization_value (descending), journey_efficiency_index (descending), predictive_full_journey_probability (descending).'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer ID from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user ID from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary email join key; rows with NULL are excluded from the final output
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization associated with primary_email from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer segment label from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier from lifecycle_metrics (e.g., Platinum/Gold/Silver); may be NULL
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle_metrics; may be NULL
      - name: reached_awareness
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stage flag copied from in_marketo (1/0/NULL) indicating marketing awareness; NULL if missing in source
      - name: reached_conversion
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stage flag copied from in_stripe (1/0/NULL) indicating sales conversion; NULL if missing in source
      - name: reached_support
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stage flag copied from in_zendesk (1/0/NULL) indicating support engagement; NULL if missing in source
      - name: journey_completeness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score: 3 if all stages reached, 2 if any two, 1 if any one, else 0'
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer journey pattern string from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: funnel_efficiency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Efficiency category by in_marketo/in_stripe and marketing_to_sales_days: High≤60, Medium≤120, Low if both reached, Direct Conversion if stripe-only, else No Conversion'
      - name: marketing_to_sales_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Days from first marketing touch to sales conversion from behavior_analysis; unit: days; may be NULL'
      - name: sales_to_support_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Days from sales conversion to first support touch from behavior_analysis; unit: days; may be NULL'
      - name: awareness_to_conversion_speed
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Speed bucket from marketing_to_sales_days: Fast≤30, Medium≤90, Slow≤180, Very Slow>180, or Direct to Sales if NULL'
      - name: conversion_to_support_speed
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Speed bucket from sales_to_support_days: Immediate≤7, Quick≤30, Standard≤90, Delayed>90, or No Support Needed if NULL'
      - name: journey_velocity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Journey speed bucket using completeness and total days (missing counted as 0): Accelerated≤60, Standard≤120, Slow≤300, else Stalled Journey'
      - name: revenue_velocity_monthly
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If reached_conversion=1, monthly velocity = round(LTV ÷ days to sales (use 30 if missing or <30) × 30, 2); else 0; NULL if LTV is NULL
      - name: awareness_engagement_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Awareness-stage engagement score from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: conversion_engagement_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Conversion-stage engagement score from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: support_engagement_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Support-stage engagement score from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: cross_stage_engagement_consistency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 2 decimals; if completeness≥2 then average of stage scores (missing counted as 0), else the single available score or 0
      - name: weighted_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted engagement score from activity_metrics; may be NULL
      - name: primary_engagement_channel
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary engagement channel from activity_metrics; may be NULL
      - name: next_stage_conversion_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Two-decimal probability per stage based on engagement, health, and tier thresholds; defaults to 1.00 when past final stage
      - name: predictive_full_journey_probability
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 3 decimals; composite likelihood using next_stage_conversion_probability, drop_off_risk weight, and cross_stage_engagement_consistency
      - name: drop_off_risk
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk category by stage, engagement thresholds, and account age: High, Medium, Support Adoption, or Low'
      - name: value_realization_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Value timeline category based on conversion status, LTV thresholds, and awareness_to_conversion_speed
      - name: optimization_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Prescriptive recommendation derived from speed bottlenecks, engagement consistency, journey velocity, probability, and risk
      - name: expected_optimization_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Rounded to 2 decimals; expected value = LTV × (probability − reduction) × tier multiplier; NULL if LTV is NULL
      - name: intervention_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority level based on next_stage_conversion_probability and LTV thresholds (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Monitor Only)
      - name: success_target
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Success objective determined by completeness, probability, and drop_off_risk
      - name: funnel_performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Overall grade (A+, A, B+, B, C+, C, D, F) based on completeness, velocity, consistency, and probability
      - name: journey_efficiency_index
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 2 decimals; index = 0.3*completeness + 0.3*velocity_score + 0.4*cross_stage_engagement_consistency
      - name: activity_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer activity grade from activity_metrics; may be NULL
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Health score from lifecycle_metrics; used in probability logic; may be NULL
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Estimated lifetime value from lifecycle_metrics; currency numeric; may be NULL
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account age in days from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of first customer touchpoint from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of most recent customer activity from behavior_analysis; may be NULL
      - name: funnel_analysis_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Current timestamp at query execution (time zone aware); same for all rows in a run

CASE WHEN in_marketo = 1 AND in_stripe = 1 AND marketing_to_sales_days <= 60 THEN 'High Efficiency' WHEN in_marketo = 1 AND in_stripe = 1 AND marketing_to_sales_days <= 120 THEN 'Medium Efficiency' WHEN in_marketo = 1 AND in_stripe = 1 THEN 'Low Efficiency' WHEN in_stripe = 1 AND in_marketo = 0 THEN 'Direct Conversion' ELSE 'No Conversion' END

CASE WHEN marketing_to_sales_days IS NULL THEN 'Direct to Sales' WHEN marketing_to_sales_days <= 30 THEN 'Fast' WHEN marketing_to_sales_days <= 90 THEN 'Medium' WHEN marketing_to_sales_days <= 180 THEN 'Slow' ELSE 'Very Slow' END

CASE WHEN sales_to_support_days IS NULL THEN 'No Support Needed' WHEN sales_to_support_days <= 7 THEN 'Immediate' WHEN sales_to_support_days <= 30 THEN 'Quick' WHEN sales_to_support_days <= 90 THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Delayed' END

CASE WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 AND COALESCE(marketing_to_sales_days, 0) + COALESCE(sales_to_support_days, 0) <= 60 THEN 'Accelerated Journey' WHEN journey_completeness_score >= 2 AND COALESCE(marketing_to_sales_days, 0) + COALESCE(sales_to_support_days, 0) <= 120 THEN 'Standard Journey' WHEN journey_completeness_score >= 1 AND COALESCE(marketing_to_sales_days, 0) + COALESCE(sales_to_support_days, 0) <= 300 THEN 'Slow Journey' ELSE 'Stalled Journey' END
CASE WHEN in_stripe = 1 THEN estimated_customer_ltv * 30.0 / GREATEST(COALESCE(marketing_to_sales_days, 30), 30) ELSE 0 END

CAST(CASE WHEN reached_awareness = 1 AND reached_conversion = 0 THEN CASE WHEN marketo_engagement >= 4 AND customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 0.85 WHEN marketo_engagement >= 3 AND customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 0.70 WHEN marketo_engagement >= 2 AND customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 0.55 WHEN marketo_engagement >= 1 THEN 0.35 ELSE 0.15 END WHEN reached_conversion = 1 AND reached_support = 0 THEN CASE WHEN stripe_engagement >= 4 AND customer_tier IN ('Platinum', 'Gold') THEN 0.75 WHEN stripe_engagement >= 3 AND customer_tier IN ('Gold', 'Silver') THEN 0.60 WHEN stripe_engagement >= 2 THEN 0.45 ELSE 0.25 END ELSE 1.00 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2))

CASE WHEN reached_awareness = 1 AND reached_conversion = 0 AND account_age_days > 180 THEN 'High Drop-off Risk' WHEN reached_awareness = 1 AND reached_conversion = 0 AND marketo_engagement <= 2 THEN 'Medium Drop-off Risk' WHEN reached_conversion = 1 AND reached_support = 0 AND stripe_engagement <= 2 THEN 'Support Adoption Risk' ELSE 'Low Drop-off Risk' END

CASE WHEN reached_conversion = 1 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 AND awareness_to_conversion_speed = 'Fast' THEN 'Quick Value Realization' WHEN reached_conversion = 1 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 AND awareness_to_conversion_speed IN ('Fast', 'Medium') THEN 'Standard Value Realization' WHEN reached_conversion = 1 AND awareness_to_conversion_speed IN ('Slow', 'Very Slow') THEN 'Delayed Value Realization' WHEN reached_conversion = 1 THEN 'Unknown Value Timeline' ELSE 'Pre-Value Stage' END

CASE WHEN awareness_to_conversion_speed IN ('Slow', 'Very Slow') AND reached_conversion = 0 THEN CASE WHEN marketo_engagement >= 3 THEN 'Accelerate Sales Qualification Process' ELSE 'Improve Marketing Lead Quality' END WHEN conversion_to_support_speed = 'Delayed' AND reached_support = 0 THEN 'Enhance Customer Success Onboarding' WHEN cross_stage_engagement_consistency < 2.5 THEN 'Implement Cross-Channel Coordination' WHEN journey_velocity = 'Stalled Journey' THEN 'Reduce Funnel Friction Points' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.7 THEN 'Accelerate High-Probability Conversions' WHEN drop_off_risk = 'High Drop-off Risk' THEN 'Implement Retention Intervention' ELSE 'Standard Funnel Management' END

ROUND(estimated_customer_ltv * (next_stage_conversion_probability - (CASE WHEN drop_off_risk <> 'Low Drop-off Risk' THEN next_stage_conversion_probability * 0.7 ELSE next_stage_conversion_probability * 0.9 END)) * CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 1 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 THEN 0.8 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.4 END, 2)

CASE WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.7 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 3000 THEN 'Critical Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.6 OR estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.4 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.2 THEN 'Low Priority' ELSE 'Monitor Only' END

CASE WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 THEN 'Maintain Full Journey Excellence' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 2 AND next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.6 THEN 'Complete Journey Progression' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 AND drop_off_risk = 'Low Drop-off Risk' THEN 'Advance to Next Stage' WHEN drop_off_risk IN ('High Drop-off Risk', 'Medium Drop-off Risk') THEN 'Prevent Drop-off' ELSE 'Engage and Qualify' END

CASE WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 AND journey_velocity = 'Accelerated Journey' THEN 'A+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 AND journey_velocity = 'Standard Journey' THEN 'A' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 2 AND cross_stage_engagement_consistency >= 3.5 THEN 'B+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 2 AND cross_stage_engagement_consistency >= 3 THEN 'B' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 AND next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.6 THEN 'C+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 AND next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.4 THEN 'C' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END

ROUND(0.3 * journey_completeness_score + 0.3 * CASE journey_velocity WHEN 'Accelerated Journey' THEN 5 WHEN 'Standard Journey' THEN 4 WHEN 'Slow Journey' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END + 0.4 * cross_stage_engagement_consistency, 2)

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__customer
      description: Unified customer and organization header profile with pass-through attributes and deterministic sample metrics/aggregations.
      grain: One row per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - marts.customer360__summary
      business_logic: '1) Build a dimensions set by inner joining marts.customer360__mapping to marts.customer360__summary on customer360_id, selecting: customer360_organization_id, is_organization_header, source_ids (from mapping) and email, full_name, organization_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, country, country_alt_name, postal_code, ip_address, phone (from summary). Only ids present in both sources are kept; all fields are passed through as stored. 2) For non-organization headers (is_organization_header = FALSE), assign sample metrics per customer360_id: - For ''sample_customer_1'': sends=10, opens=3, clicks=1, sales_amount=1250.00, sales_count=2, first_sale_date=2024-01-15, most_recent_sale_date=2024-03-15, tickets_created=3, tickets_resolved=2, avg_satisfaction=4.5. - For all others: sends=5, opens=2, clicks=0, sales_amount=750.00, sales_count=1, first_sale_date=2024-02-10, most_recent_sale_date=2024-02-10, tickets_created=1, tickets_resolved=1, avg_satisfaction=5.0. 3) Combine dimensions with these metrics by customer360_id. For rows without assigned metrics (headers), set numeric metrics to 0 (including avg_satisfaction_score) and leave first_sale_date and most_recent_sale_date as NULL. 4) For organization headers only, produce one row per unique header by aggregating the combined dataset across the header’s own rows: sum email sends/opens/clicks, sum sales amount and sales count, take the earliest first_sale_date, the latest most_recent_sale_date, sum tickets created/resolved, and average the satisfaction score. Aggregations consider only header rows (child/customer rows are not included in header rollups); standard null handling applies to aggregates (nulls are ignored in averages; earliest/latest dates return NULL if all inputs are NULL). 5) Output includes all non-header rows from step 3 and the aggregated header rows from step 4 appended together. No specific output ordering is enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary identifier; one output row per id; also the join key between mapping and summary.
      - name: customer360_organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier from mapping; passed through unchanged.
      - name: is_organization_header
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE for organization headers (included via header aggregation), FALSE for individual/non-header customers (receive sample metrics).
      - name: source_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier(s) from mapping; passed through with original formatting.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from summary; passed through.
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from summary; passed through.
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name from summary; passed through.
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 1 from summary; passed through.
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 2 from summary; passed through.
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from summary; passed through.
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/region from summary; passed through.
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from summary; passed through.
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from summary; passed through.
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal/ZIP code from summary stored as numeric; passed through.
      - name: ip_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IP address from summary; passed through.
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number from summary; passed through.
      - name: marketing_email_sends
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing emails sent; non-headers: 10 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 5; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: marketing_email_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing email opens; non-headers: 3 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: marketing_email_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing email clicks; non-headers: 1 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 0; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: total_sales_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: 'Total sales amount; non-headers: 1250.00 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 750.00; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.00.'
      - name: total_sales_count
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total number of sales; non-headers: 2 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 1; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: first_sale_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: 'First sale date; non-headers: 2024-01-15 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2024-02-10; headers: earliest across header rows; NULL if no non-NULL values.'
      - name: most_recent_sale_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: 'Most recent sale date; non-headers: 2024-03-15 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2024-02-10; headers: latest across header rows; NULL if no non-NULL values.'
      - name: support_tickets_created
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of support tickets created; non-headers: 3 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 1; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: support_tickets_resolved
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of support tickets resolved; non-headers: 2 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 1; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: avg_satisfaction_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average satisfaction score; non-headers: 4.5 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 5.0; headers: averaged across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.0.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '1) Build a dimensions set by inner joining marts.customer360__mapping to marts.customer360__summary on customer360_id, selecting: customer360_organization_id, is_organization_header, source_ids (from mapping) and email, full_name, organization_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, country, country_alt_name, postal_code, ip_address, phone (from summary). Only ids present in both sources are kept; all fields are passed through as stored. 2) For non-organization headers (is_organization_header = FALSE), assign sample metrics per customer360_id: - For ''sample_customer_1'': sends=10, opens=3, clicks=1, sales_amount=1250.00, sales_count=2, first_sale_date=2024-01-15, most_recent_sale_date=2024-03-15, tickets_created=3, tickets_resolved=2, avg_satisfaction=4.5. - For all others: sends=5, opens=2, clicks=0, sales_amount=750.00, sales_count=1, first_sale_date=2024-02-10, most_recent_sale_date=2024-02-10, tickets_created=1, tickets_resolved=1, avg_satisfaction=5.0. 3) Combine dimensions with these metrics by customer360_id. For rows without assigned metrics (headers), set numeric metrics to 0 (including avg_satisfaction_score) and leave first_sale_date and most_recent_sale_date as NULL. 4) For organization headers only, produce one row per unique header by aggregating the combined dataset across the header’s own rows: sum email sends/opens/clicks, sum sales amount and sales count, take the earliest first_sale_date, the latest most_recent_sale_date, sum tickets created/resolved, and average the satisfaction score. Aggregations consider only header rows (child/customer rows are not included in header rollups); standard null handling applies to aggregates (nulls are ignored in averages; earliest/latest dates return NULL if all inputs are NULL). 5) Output includes all non-header rows from step 3 and the aggregated header rows from step 4 appended together. No specific output ordering is enforced.'
