business_logic: '- Build organization_entities: - Join behavior_analysis to lifecycle_metrics on primary_email; join behavior_analysis to value_analysis on primary_email. - Retain ids (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id), journey/segment fields, LTV/health/engagement fields. - Standardize fields: - standardized_org_name: uppercase and trim primary_organization; if null/blank set "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - email_domain: take the substring after "@" in primary_email; if missing set "unknown.domain". - organization_type by primary_organization text patterns: - null/blank → Individual - contains inc/corp/llc/ltd → Corporation - contains university/college/school → Education - contains government/dept/agency → Government - contains nonprofit/foundation/charity → Non-Profit - otherwise → Business - estimated_org_size: - domain in {gmail.com,yahoo.com,hotmail.com,outlook.com} → Personal - domain in {microsoft.com,google.com,amazon.com,apple.com,facebook.com} → Enterprise - else if name length > 20 → Large Business; > 10 → Medium Business; > 0 → Small Business; otherwise → Individual - Aggregate to organization_aggregates at (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size): - Counts (distinct primary_email): total_contacts; marketing_contacts when marketo_lead_id present; sales_contacts when stripe_customer_id present; support_contacts when zendesk_user_id present. - Journey distribution: full_journey_contacts when journey pattern = "Full Journey"; also compute marketing_to_sales_contacts and sales_to_support_contacts (used downstream). - Value metrics: total_organization_ltv (sum of estimated_customer_ltv), avg_customer_ltv, highest_customer_ltv (max), total_adjusted_ltv (sum). - Engagement/health: avg_engagement_score (average composite_engagement_score), max_engagement_score (max), avg_health_score (average customer_health_score). - Strategic classification: strategic_accounts, key_accounts, growth_accounts, recovery_accounts from strategic_classification. - Revenue tiers: tier1_contacts, tier2_contacts, tier3_contacts from revenue_tier. - Customer segments: champions, loyal_customers, at_risk_customers from customer_segment. - Lifecycle stages (for health calc): growth_stage_contacts when stage = "Growth"; maturity_stage_contacts when stage = "Maturity"; dormant_contacts when stage = "Dormant". - Diversity: email_domains_count = distinct email_domain within the group (will be 1); customer_tiers_represented = distinct customer_tier. - Compute organization_scoring: - organization_value_score: weighted sum of three 1–5 tiers, rounded to two decimals (stored with one-decimal precision): - LTV tier: ≥50000→5; ≥25000→4; ≥10000→3; ≥5000→2; else→1 (weight 0.4). - Contacts tier: ≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - Avg engagement tier: ≥4.0→5; ≥3.0→4; ≥2.5→3; ≥2.0→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - organization_health_score: 0.4×avg_health_score + 0.3×(champions+loyal_customers)/total_contacts×5 + 0.3×(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)/total_contacts×5; if total_contacts=0, both ratios are 0; round to two decimals. - account_penetration_score: share of contacts linked across marketing, sales, and support out of three touchpoints, scaled to a 0–5 score and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - organization_maturity: - if total_contacts≥10 and full_journey_contacts≥3 → Mature Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 and (strategic_accounts+key_accounts)≥2 → Developing Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥3 and total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Mid-Market - else if total_contacts≥2 → Small Business - else → Individual/Micro - growth_potential: - if growth_accounts≥2 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → High Growth Potential - else if growth_accounts≥1 or avg_engagement_score≥3.5 → Medium Growth Potential - else if total_contacts≥2 and avg_health_score≥3.0 → Stable Growth Potential - else → Limited Growth Potential - organization_risk_level: - if at_risk_customers ≥ 50% of total_contacts → High Risk - else if dormant_contacts ≥ 30% of total_contacts → Medium Risk - else if recovery_accounts ≥ 1 → Attention Needed - else → Stable - strategic_value_tier: - if strategic_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥100000 → Strategic Enterprise - else if key_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥50000 → Key Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 or total_organization_ltv≥25000 → Important Account - else if total_contacts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Standard Account - else → Small Account - engagement_breadth_percentage: weighted coverage across marketing (30%), sales (40%), and support (30%) among contacts, expressed as a percentage and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - concentration_risk: - if total_contacts=1 → High Concentration Risk - else if total_contacts≤3 → Medium Concentration Risk - else if email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts≥5 → Domain Concentration Risk - else → Low Concentration Risk - Perform network_analysis: - market_share_within_type: percent share of total_organization_ltv within the same organization_type, rounded to four decimals; null when the type total is zero. - Rankings within organization_type: ltv_rank_within_type by total_organization_ltv descending; contacts_rank_within_type by total_contacts descending; value_score_rank_within_type by organization_value_score descending; ties break arbitrarily. - cross_sell_opportunity_score (integer 0–7): sum of three components, then rounded (remains integer): - Channel gap: if total_contacts≥5 and marketing_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥3 and sales_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥2 and support_contacts=0 →2; else →0. - Growth: High Growth Potential →2; Medium Growth Potential →1; else →0. - Engagement: avg_engagement_score≥3.5 →2; ≥3.0 →1; else →0. - expansion_priority: - if strategic_value_tier in {Strategic Enterprise, Key Enterprise} and growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Immediate Expansion - else if organization_value_score≥4.0 and organization_health_score≥4.0 → High Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥3 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → Medium Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥2 and organization_risk_level=Stable → Low Priority Expansion - else → Maintenance Mode - recommended_strategy: - if organization_risk_level=High Risk → Risk Mitigation & Recovery - else if strategic_value_tier=Strategic Enterprise → White Glove Account Management - else if strategic_value_tier=Key Enterprise → Dedicated Account Management - else if growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Growth & Expansion Focus - else if total_contacts=1 → Relationship Expansion - else → Standard Account Management - Finalization: - organization_influence_score: weighted score rounded to two decimals = 0.3×organization_value_score + 0.3×contacts tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1) + 0.2×breadth tier (≥80→5; ≥60→4; ≥40→3; ≥20→2; else→1) + 0.2×market-share tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥2→3; ≥1→2; else→1). - risk_adjusted_organization_value: total_adjusted_ltv multiplied by expansion priority multiplier (Immediate 1.5; High 1.3; Medium 1.1; else 1.0), then reduced by risk penalty (High Risk 40%; Medium Risk 20%; Attention Needed 10%; else 0%), rounded to two decimals. - network_analysis_timestamp: set to the current timestamp at computation time. - Exclude rows where standardized_org_name = "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - Order output by organization_influence_score (desc), then total_organization_ltv (desc), then total_contacts (desc).'

- name: customer360__phone
      description: Distinct phones with extensions collected from Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk, deduplicated per customer and assigned a per-customer index ordered by phone ascending.
      grain: One row per (customer360_id, phone, extension)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Use marts.customer360__mapping to link each customer360_id to source records. - For each source, inner join via mapped IDs and collect phone fields only when the phone is not NULL; keep values as-is (no trimming or normalization): - Marketo: phone/phone_extension, company_phone/company_phone_extension, mobile_phone/mobile_phone_extension via mapping.marketo_lead_id = marketo.lead_id. - Stripe: phone/phone_extension, shipping_phone/shipping_phone_extension via mapping.stripe_customer_id = stripe.customer_id. - Zendesk: phone/phone_extension via mapping.zendesk_user_id = zendesk.user_id. - Combine all collected phones across sources without altering values; any per-source index or source label is not retained. - Remove duplicates by exact match of (customer360_id, phone, extension); NULL extensions are allowed and treated as equal for duplicate checking. - Per customer360_id, assign a sequential index starting at 1 based on phone sorted ascending; extension does not affect sort; ties where phone strings are identical (with different extensions) have unspecified order; indices are contiguous with no gaps. - Output columns: customer360_id, phone, extension, index.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer 360 identifier; phones are grouped and indexed per customer.
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone string from sources; NULL phones are excluded; value is preserved; used for deduplication and ascending sort for indexing.
      - name: extension
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optional phone extension; included in deduplication; not used for sorting.
      - name: index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per-customer sequential index starting at 1 after deduplication, ordered by phone ascending; tie order for identical phone strings is unspecified; no gaps.

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__status
      description: Unified customer communication preferences and account status aggregated across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk
      grain: One row per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__summary
      description: Summary per customer360_id with first-ranked profile fields joined to all IP address records.
      grain: One row per customer360_id per ip_address record; if any ranked source has multiple index=1 or rank=1 rows for an id, rows multiply accordingly; if no ip_address exists, one row per customer360_id.
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - marts.customer360__email
      - marts.customer360__phone
      - marts.customer360__name
      - marts.customer360__organization
      - marts.customer360__address
      - marts.customer360__ip_address
      business_logic: '- Use marts.customer360__mapping as the base set keyed by customer360_id. - From each profile source, keep only rows marked as first-ranked: - Email, Phone, Name, Organization: rows where the index equals 1. - Address: rows where the rank equals 1. If none exist for an id, the joined values are NULL. If multiple rows satisfy the first-ranked condition for an id, all are kept and will multiply output rows. - Left join the ranked subsets to mapping on customer360_id. - Left join marts.customer360__ip_address on customer360_id without ranking or de-duplication; each ip_address record produces a separate output row. - Emit selected fields exactly as stored in sources; no additional sorting, distinct, trimming, normalization, or formatting is applied. Nulls arise naturally from left joins.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key from mapping used to join all sources; row multiplicity follows the joins described.
      - name: source_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Value taken verbatim from mapping.
      - name: customer360_organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier from mapping.
      - name: is_organization_header
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Boolean flag from mapping indicating the organization header record.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from the email source where the id’s index equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone from the phone source where the id’s index equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from the name source where the id’s index equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name from the organization source where the id’s index equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary address line from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary address line from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State or region from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from the address source where the id’s rank equals 1; NULL if no such row.
      - name: ip_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IP address from all matching ip_address records; NULL if none.

- name: customer360__updates
      description: Per-customer summary of updates from Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk, showing latest and earliest timestamps, total updates, and distinct source/type lists.
      grain: One row per customer360_id that has at least one joined update from any source
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Read customer-to-source IDs from marts.customer360__mapping (customer360_id, marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id). - Create update rows via inner joins: - Marketo: join mapping.marketo_lead_id to intermediate.int_customer360__marketo.lead_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''marketo'' and update_type=''lead_update''. - Stripe: join mapping.stripe_customer_id to intermediate.int_customer360__stripe.customer_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''stripe'' and update_type=''customer_update''. - Zendesk: join mapping.zendesk_user_id to intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk.user_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''zendesk'' and update_type=''user_update''. - Union all per-source rows; duplicates are preserved. - Aggregate by customer360_id: - last_updated: the latest non-null last_updated across all rows; returns null if all are null. - first_seen: the earliest non-null first_seen across all rows; returns null if all are null. - total_updates: the count of all joined rows across sources; includes duplicates and rows with null timestamps. - updated_by_systems: concatenate distinct source_system values with ", "; case preserved; nulls excluded; no guaranteed ordering. - update_types: concatenate distinct update_type values with ", "; case preserved; nulls excluded; no guaranteed ordering. - Output includes only customers with at least one joined update row.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique customer identifier; one row per value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: last_updated
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest non-null update timestamp across sources; null if none.
      - name: first_seen
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest non-null creation timestamp across sources; null if none.
      - name: total_updates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of joined update rows across sources; includes duplicates and rows with null timestamps.
      - name: updated_by_systems
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct source systems concatenated with ', '; order not guaranteed; case preserved; nulls excluded.
      - name: update_types
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct update types concatenated with ', '; order not guaranteed; case preserved; nulls excluded.

- name: stg_customer360__country_codes
      description: "Standardized country code reference data supporting ISO 3166 standards for geographic data validation and normalization"
      source_table: raw.country_codes
      columns:
        - name: country_name
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "LENGTH(TRIM(country_name)) > 0"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: alternative_country_name
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
        - name: country_code_numeric
          data_type: INTEGER
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "country_code_numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 999"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: country_code_alpha_2
          data_type: VARCHAR(2)
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "LENGTH(country_code_alpha_2) = 2"

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__account_enhanced
      description: Enhanced Salesforce accounts with standardized geography, size segmentation, normalization, completeness scoring, and high-value flag; excludes deleted accounts
      grain: One row per account_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__account and keep only rows where is_deleted is false (rows with true or NULL are excluded). - Pass through fields: account_id, account_name, type → account_type, industry, annual_revenue, number_of_employees, billing_street, billing_city, billing_state, billing_postal_code, billing_country, website, owner_id. - Set unavailable fields to NULL: phone, created_date, last_modified_date. - Derive account_size_segment from annual_revenue: - >= 10,000,000 → "Enterprise" - >= 1,000,000 and < 10,000,000 → "Mid-Market" - >= 100,000 and < 1,000,000 → "SMB" - > 0 and < 100,000 → "Small" - Else (NULL or <= 0) → "Unknown" - Derive geographic_region using case-insensitive billing_country matching: - North America if in {US, USA, UNITED STATES, CANADA, CA} - Europe if in {UK, UNITED KINGDOM, FRANCE, GERMANY, SPAIN, ITALY, NETHERLANDS, BELGIUM, SWEDEN, NORWAY, DENMARK, FINLAND, IRELAND, PORTUGAL, AUSTRIA, SWITZERLAND} - Asia-Pacific if in {CHINA, JAPAN, INDIA, AUSTRALIA, SINGAPORE, SOUTH KOREA, THAILAND, MALAYSIA, INDONESIA, PHILIPPINES, VIETNAM, NEW ZEALAND} - Latin America if in {BRAZIL, MEXICO, ARGENTINA, CHILE, COLOMBIA, PERU, VENEZUELA, ECUADOR, BOLIVIA, URUGUAY, PARAGUAY} - Else (including NULL or blanks) → "Other" - Set account_age_days to NULL and account_maturity_stage to constant "Unknown" (placeholders). - industry_normalized: remove leading/trailing spaces when industry is present; else NULL; original casing and internal spacing preserved. - data_completeness_score: sum four 25-point checks, then round to two decimals (scores remain whole numbers 0/25/50/75/100): - +25 if website is present and non-blank after trimming - +25 if industry is present and non-blank after trimming - +25 if annual_revenue is present and > 0 - +25 if number_of_employees is present and > 0 - is_high_value_account: true if annual_revenue >= 5,000,000, or if account_type equals "Customer" and annual_revenue >= 1,000,000; otherwise false; NULL revenue never meets thresholds.'

      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key; exactly one output row per account_id
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough account name; NULLs preserved; casing unchanged
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source type renamed; used in high-value logic via exact match to 'Customer'; NULLs preserved
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough industry; used in completeness scoring; not trimmed
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Passthrough revenue; drives size segment and high-value; NULL or <=0 fails thresholds
      - name: number_of_employees

      - name: billing_street
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough billing street; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough billing city; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough billing state; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_postal_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough billing postal code; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough billing country; used for case-insensitive region mapping; NULL maps to 'Other'
      - name: phone
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL placeholder; source field unavailable
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough website; completeness checks use non-blank after trimming; value itself not trimmed
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough owner ID; NULLs preserved
      - name: created_date
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL placeholder; source field unavailable
      - name: last_modified_date
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL placeholder; source field unavailable
      - name: account_size_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from annual_revenue: >=10M Enterprise; >=1M Mid-Market; >=100k SMB; >0 Small; else Unknown'
      - name: geographic_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Derived from case-insensitive billing_country membership in fixed lists; else 'Other'
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL placeholder; created_date unavailable
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' placeholder
      - name: industry_normalized
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry with leading/trailing spaces removed; casing preserved; NULL if industry NULL
      - name: data_completeness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Whole-number score 0–100 in 25-point steps from four checks; rounding to two decimals does not change values
      - name: is_high_value_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if annual_revenue >= 5,000,000 or (account_type='Customer' and annual_revenue >= 1,000,000); else false; NULL revenue yields false

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
      description: Lead conversion metrics and funnel attributes derived from non-deleted Salesforce leads
      grain: One row per lead_id from non-deleted staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__lead and keep only records where is_deleted is false; emit each remaining source row without aggregation or deduplication. - Pass through source attributes and derive: - lead_name: If both first_name and last_name are present, set to "first_name last_name"; if only last_name is present, set to last_name; otherwise null. Exactly one space is inserted when both are present; original casing is preserved. - lead_age_days: For converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and converted_date; for non-converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and the current date at execution. If a required date is missing, the result is null. Time-of-day is ignored. - conversion_time_days: For converted leads only, the number of days between the date parts of created_date and converted_date; null otherwise or when dates are missing. Time-of-day is ignored. - lead_source_category: Categorize lead_source using case-insensitive substring matches in this order: Digital if it contains web/online/social/search; Referral if it contains referral/partner/word; Marketing if it contains trade/event/conference/campaign; Direct if it contains phone/call/direct; otherwise Other. Null lead_source is treated as Other. - lead_quality_score: Integer score (0–100) computed as the sum of points: +20 for an email containing "@" and a later ".", +15 if phone or mobile_phone is present, +10 if industry is non-empty after trimming, +15 if annual_revenue is greater than 0, +10 if number_of_employees is greater than 0, +20 if lead_source equals referral, website, or partner referral (case-insensitive), and +10 if company is non-empty after trimming and does not contain test/example/demo (case-insensitive). - has_complete_conversion: True only when is_converted is true and all of converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are present; otherwise false. - conversion_speed_category: For converted leads with a non-null conversion_time_days, assign Fast Track for <=7 days, Standard for <=30 days, Slow for <=90 days, and Extended for >90 days; otherwise null. - lead_temperature: Hot for scores >=80, Warm for >=60, Cool for >=40, else Cold. - Output exactly the selected pass-through and derived columns; no additional filtering or ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier from source
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from source
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from source
      - name: lead_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Display name: ''first_name last_name'' when both are present, last_name when only last_name is present, otherwise null; preserves original casing'
      - name: company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name; used in scoring after trimming and case-insensitive checks to exclude test/example/demo
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address; adds to score when it contains '@' and a later '.'
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary phone; adds to score when present
      - name: mobile_phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mobile phone; adds to score when present
      - name: lead_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead source; used for categorization and scoring with case-insensitive comparisons
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status from source
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry; treated as present for scoring when trimmed value is non-empty
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Annual revenue; adds +15 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count; adds +10 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: is_converted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Conversion flag controlling age, conversion time, completeness, and speed category
      - name: converted_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Conversion timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: converted_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead owner ID from source
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: lead_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Age in days: converted leads use days between created and converted dates; non-converted use days between created date and the run''s current date; null if a required date is missing; time-of-day ignored'
      - name: conversion_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to conversion only for converted leads; null otherwise or if dates are missing; time-of-day ignored
      - name: lead_source_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Case-insensitive substring match with ordered precedence: Digital (web, online, social, search) > Referral (referral, partner, word) > Marketing (trade, event, conference, campaign) > Direct (phone, call, direct) > Other; null lead_source yields Other'
      - name: lead_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '0–100 integer score summed from conditions: email pattern ''@'' before ''.'', phone or mobile present, trimmed industry non-empty, annual revenue > 0, employees > 0, lead_source equals referral/website/partner referral (case-insensitive), company trimmed non-empty and does not include test/example/demo (case-insensitive)'
      - name: has_complete_conversion
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when converted and all three converted IDs are present; false otherwise
      - name: conversion_speed_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For converted leads with conversion_time_days: Fast Track (<=7), Standard (<=30), Slow (<=90), Extended (>90); null for non-converted or when conversion_time_days is null'
      - name: lead_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket from lead_quality_score: Hot (>=80), Warm (>=60), Cool (>=40), else Cold'

Null lead_source is treated as Other. - lead_quality_score: Integer score (0–100) computed as the sum of points: +20 for an email containing "@" and a later ".", +15 if phone or mobile_phone is present, +10 if industry is non-empty after trimming, +15 if annual_revenue is greater than 0, +10 if number_of_employees is greater than 0, +20 if lead_source equals referral, website, or partner referral (case-insensitive), and +10 if company is non-empty after trimming and does not contain test/example/demo (case-insensitive). - has_complete_conversion: True only when is_converted is true and all of converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are present; otherwise false. - conversion_speed_category: For converted leads with a non-null conversion_time_days, assign Fast Track for <=7 days, Standard for <=30 days, Slow for <=90 days, and Extended for >90 days; otherwise null. - lead_temperature: Hot for scores >=80, Warm for >=60, Cool for >=40, else Cold. - Output exactly the selected pass-through and derived columns; no additional filtering or ordering is applied.'

- name: salesforce__account_daily_history
      description: Daily snapshots of Salesforce account history, keeping the latest change per account per calendar day
      grain: One row per account_id per snapshot_date
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account_history
      business_logic: '- Read all records from staging.stg_salesforce__account_history. - Exclude records marked as deleted. - For each account and calendar day (based on the date part of created_date), sort records by created_date in descending order and keep the first record; if multiple records share the exact same created_date within that day, the choice among them is not deterministic. - Define snapshot_date as the calendar date of created_date from the kept record. - All other fields are taken directly from the kept record without transformation or aggregation; data types are preserved and NULLs are retained. - The final result is ordered by account_id and snapshot_date for readability only.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce Account ID for the snapshot.
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the kept change for the account; one row per account and date; ties on identical created timestamps that day are non-deterministic.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the kept change that day.
      - name: account_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account source from the kept change that day.
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry from the kept change that day.
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Annual revenue from the kept change that day.
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count from the kept change that day.
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user ID from the kept change that day.
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type from the kept change that day.
      - name: billing_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing city from the kept change that day.
      - name: billing_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing state from the kept change that day.
      - name: billing_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing country from the kept change that day.
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Website from the kept change that day.
      - name: rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Rating from the kept change that day.
      - name: ownership
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ownership from the kept change that day.
      - name: parent_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account ID from the kept change that day.
      - name: last_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Last activity date from the kept change that day.

          data_type: TIMESTAMP

            - rule: "last_viewed_date = CASE WHEN last_viewed_date IS NOT NULL AND last_viewed_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN NULL WHEN last_viewed_date IS NOT NULL AND last_viewed_date < '2020-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE last_viewed_date END"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: master_record_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: number_of_employees
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: owner_id

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics
      description: Account-level daily KPIs with rolling averages, efficiency metrics, 30-day trend deltas, scoring, maturity, and data-quality flags joined to most-recent account info
      grain: One row per account_id, source_relation, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history (filtered to is_most_recent_record = true)
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats as daily_stats (no filtering). - From staging.stg_google_ads__account_history, keep only rows where is_most_recent_record = true (account_info). - Compute rolling_metrics per (account_id, source_relation), ordered by date_day: - 7-day rolling averages: for each day, average spend, clicks, and impressions across the current day and up to six prior days; averages ignore NULLs and use smaller windows at the start. - 30-day lags: prior 30th-day values for spend and conversions for month-over-month comparisons. - Efficiency metrics (rounded to 4 decimals): - CTR: percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks; 0 when impressions <= 0. - CPC: spend per click; 0 when clicks <= 0. - CPM: spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when impressions <= 0. - Cost per conversion: spend per conversion; NULL when conversions <= 0. - ROAS: conversion value divided by spend; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0. - Compute account_scoring: - days_since_first_activity: days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative. - performance_score: clamp to 0–100 for the sum of: CTR*10; ROAS*10 capped at 50; +20 if cost_per_conversion < 50; and either +10 if clicks_7d_avg > 100 else + (clicks_7d_avg / 10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL. - spend_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - conversions_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - account_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <30 → "New Account"; <90 → "Growing Account"; <365 → "Established Account"; else "Mature Account". - performance_tier by performance_score: ≥80 → "Excellent"; ≥60 → "Good"; ≥40 → "Average"; ≥20 → "Below Average"; else "Poor". - Final select joins account_scoring to account_info on (account_id, source_relation) with a left join; account_name, currency_code, and time_zone may be NULL if no match. - Apply final filters: keep rows where spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, date_day IS NOT NULL, and account_id IS NOT NULL. - Output is ordered by account_id, date_day (ordering does not affect computed values).'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier for the source dataset; used for window partitioning and joining to account_info
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Ads account ID; with source_relation and date_day defines the row grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most-recent history; NULL when no matching record
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: time_zone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account time zone from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the daily metrics from stats; required for window ordering and lag calculations
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost in account currency; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value in account currency; used in ROAS; may be zero or NULL
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per click in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks <= 0
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per 1,000 impressions in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per conversion in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions <= 0
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Conversion value divided by spend, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0
      - name: spend_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of spend per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: clicks_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of clicks per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: impressions_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of impressions per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: conversions_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on days_since_first_activity: <30 New; <90 Growing; <365 Established; else Mature'
      - name: performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite score clamped to 0–100 from CTR (x10), ROAS (x10 capped at 50), cost-per-conversion bonus (20 if <50), and clicks_7d_avg bonus (10 if >100 else clicks_7d_avg/10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by performance_score: ≥80 Excellent; ≥60 Good; ≥40 Average; ≥20 Below Average; else Poor'
      - name: has_spend_no_clicks_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 0 and clicks = 0; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: invalid_metrics_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks exceed impressions; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: high_spend_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when daily spend > 10000; else false
        tests:
        - not_null

averages ignore NULLs and use smaller windows at the start. - 30-day lags: prior 30th-day values for spend and conversions for month-over-month comparisons. - Efficiency metrics (rounded to 4 decimals): - CTR: percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks; 0 when impressions <= 0. - CPC: spend per click; 0 when clicks <= 0. - CPM: spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when impressions <= 0. - Cost per conversion: spend per conversion; NULL when conversions <= 0. - ROAS: conversion value divided by spend; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0. - Compute account_scoring: - days_since_first_activity: days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative. - performance_score: clamp to 0–100 for the sum of: CTR*10; ROAS*10 capped at 50; +20 if cost_per_conversion < 50; and either +10 if clicks_7d_avg > 100 else + (clicks_7d_avg / 10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL. - spend_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - conversions_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - account_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <30 → "New Account"; <90 → "Growing Account"; <365 → "Established Account"; else "Mature Account". - performance_tier by performance_score: ≥80 → "Excellent"; ≥60 → "Good"; ≥40 → "Average"; ≥20 → "Below Average"; else "Poor". - Final select joins account_scoring to account_info on (account_id, source_relation) with a left join; account_name, currency_code, and time_zone may be NULL if no match. - Apply final filters: keep rows where spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, date_day IS NOT NULL, and account_id IS NOT NULL. - Output is ordered by account_id, date_day (ordering does not affect computed values).'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis
      description: Daily Google Ads campaign cohort and lifecycle analysis with cumulative metrics, cohort benchmarks, ranks, and quality flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, campaign_id, and date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Use the most recent campaign_history records (is_most_recent_record = true) providing campaign_id, source_relation, campaign_name, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, status, start_date, end_date. - Use all rows from campaign_stats providing campaign_id, source_relation, date_day, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value. - Join and row set: - Join stats to latest history on campaign_id and source_relation; keep only matched rows (effective inner join). - Grain is per source_relation, campaign_id, and date_day from stats with a matching history record. - Cohort and lifecycle: - campaign_launch_cohort is the first day of the month of start_date; NULL if start_date is missing. - days_since_launch is the whole-day difference between start_date and date_day; may be negative; NULL if start_date is missing. - lifecycle_stage is bucketed by days_since_launch: <=7 Launch Phase; <=30 Optimization Phase; <=90 Growth Phase; <=365 Maturity Phase; otherwise Legacy Phase. When days_since_launch is NULL, assign Legacy Phase. - Daily performance metrics: - spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value are taken as-is from stats. - ctr is 100 * clicks / impressions rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions = 0. - cpc is spend / clicks rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks = 0. - cost_per_conversion is spend / conversions rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions = 0. - roas is conversions_value / spend rounded to 4 decimals when both spend and conversions_value are > 0; otherwise 0. - Cumulative metrics: - For each campaign_id and source_relation, ordered by date_day ascending, compute running totals for spend, clicks, conversions, and conversions_value including the current day; NULL inputs are ignored in the sums. - Cohort benchmarks and ranks: - cohort averages (spend, ctr, roas) are computed across all rows sharing the same campaign_launch_cohort and lifecycle_stage, including the current row; NULLs are ignored. - roas_rank_in_cohort is the position of a row when ROAS is sorted high to low within its cohort-stage; 1 is highest; ties are resolved arbitrarily; rows without ROAS are placed after those with ROAS. - total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage is the count of rows within the same cohort-stage, including the current row. - Performance vs cohort (percent deltas): - spend_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_spend rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_spend is not positive. - ctr_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_ctr rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_ctr is not positive. - roas_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_roas rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_roas is not positive. - Composite indicators: - campaign_health_score combines: CTR contributes 5× its value; ROAS contributes 20× its value capped at 60; cost_per_conversion contributes 20 if below 100, otherwise decreases linearly and does not go below 0; cumulative_conversions contributes 20 if at least 10, otherwise 2 points per conversion. The sum is bounded between 0 and 100. If cost_per_conversion is missing, the score is NULL. - performance_tier_in_cohort is assigned by ROAS rank thresholds within cohort-stage: Top 20% if rank is within the top 20% of rows (rounded up), Top 50% if within 50%, Bottom 50% if within 80%, else Bottom 20%. - investment_tier by cumulative_spend: <1000 Low Investment; <5000 Medium Investment; <20000 High Investment; otherwise Premium Investment. - momentum_indicator: High Momentum in Launch/Optimization when ROAS exceeds the cohort average; High Momentum in Growth/Maturity when ROAS is at least 20% above the cohort average; Low Momentum when ROAS is at least 20% below the cohort average; otherwise Stable Momentum. - Quality flags: - data_quality_issue is true when clicks > impressions. - underperforming_flag is true when spend > 0, conversions = 0, and days_since_launch > 30; NULL days_since_launch evaluates to false. - exceptional_performance_flag is true when roas > 10. - Final row filter and ordering: - Keep only rows with spend, clicks, impressions, and conversions all >= 0, and with non-null date_day and campaign_id. - Output is ordered by campaign_id then date_day; ordering does not change computed values.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier used in the join and window partitions
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Ads campaign ID; join and grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the most recent history record
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel type from campaign history
      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel subtype from campaign history
      - name: campaign_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign status from the most recent history record
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Statistical date from campaign_stats
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_launch_cohort
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month of start_date for cohort grouping; NULL if start_date is missing
      - name: days_since_launch
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole-day difference between start_date and date_day; may be negative; NULL when start_date is missing
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle bucket: <=7 Launch, <=30 Optimization, <=90 Growth, <=365 Maturity, else Legacy'
        tests:
        - lifecycle_stage IN ('Launch Phase','Optimization Phase','Growth Phase','Maturity Phase','Legacy Phase')
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily spend; rows with spend < 0 are excluded
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks; rows with clicks < 0 are excluded
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions; rows with impressions < 0 are excluded
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; rows with conversions < 0 are excluded
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value from stats
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: CTR percent rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions = 0
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per click rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks = 0
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per conversion rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions = 0
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0
      - name: cumulative_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of spend by campaign and source including the current day
      - name: cumulative_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of clicks by campaign and source including the current day
      - name: cumulative_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversions by campaign and source including the current day
      - name: cumulative_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversion value by campaign and source including the current day
      - name: cohort_avg_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average spend within the same launch cohort and lifecycle stage
      - name: cohort_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR percent within the same launch cohort and lifecycle stage
      - name: cohort_avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS within the same launch cohort and lifecycle stage
      - name: spend_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference from cohort average spend rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the cohort average is not positive
      - name: ctr_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference from cohort average CTR rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the cohort average is not positive
      - name: roas_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference from cohort average ROAS rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the cohort average is not positive
      - name: campaign_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite score from CTR, ROAS, cost_per_conversion, and cumulative_conversions; bounded 0–100; NULL when cost_per_conversion is NULL
      - name: performance_tier_in_cohort
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by ROAS rank within cohort-stage: Top 20%, Top 50%, Bottom 50%, or Bottom 20%'
        tests:
        - performance_tier_in_cohort IN ('Top 20%','Top 50%','Bottom 50%','Bottom 20%')
      - name: investment_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Investment tier by cumulative_spend: Low, Medium, High, or Premium'
        tests:
        - investment_tier IN ('Low Investment','Medium Investment','High Investment','Premium Investment')
      - name: momentum_indicator
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Momentum classification: High Momentum, Low Momentum, or Stable Momentum'
        tests:
        - momentum_indicator IN ('High Momentum','Low Momentum','Stable Momentum')
      - name: roas_rank_in_cohort
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position of ROAS in descending order within the cohort-stage; 1 is highest; ties arbitrary
        tests:
        - roas_rank_in_cohort >= 1
      - name: total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows within the same launch cohort and lifecycle stage
        tests:
        - total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage >= 1
      - name: data_quality_issue
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks exceed impressions, else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: underperforming_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 0, conversions = 0, and days_since_launch > 30; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: exceptional_performance_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ROAS > 10, else false
        tests:
        - not_null

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN days_since_launch <= 7 THEN 'Launch Phase' WHEN days_since_launch <= 30 THEN 'Optimization Phase' WHEN days_since_launch <= 90 THEN 'Growth Phase' WHEN days_since_launch <= 365 THEN 'Maturity Phase' ELSE 'Legacy Phase' END
CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN CAST(clicks AS DOUBLE) / impressions * 100 ELSE 0 END, 4) AS REAL)
ROUND(CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN spend / clicks ELSE 0 END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN conversions > 0 THEN spend / conversions END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN spend > 0 AND conversions_value > 0 THEN conversions_value / spend ELSE 0 END, 4)
SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions_value) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_launch_cohort, lifecycle_stage ORDER BY roas DESC)
ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_spend > 0 THEN (spend - cohort_avg_spend) / cohort_avg_spend * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_ctr > 0 THEN (ctr - cohort_avg_ctr) / cohort_avg_ctr * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_roas > 0 THEN (roas - cohort_avg_roas) / cohort_avg_roas * 100 END, 2)

CASE WHEN cost_per_conversion IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(100.0, GREATEST(0.0, ctr * 5 + LEAST(roas * 20, 60) + GREATEST(0, 20 - GREATEST(cost_per_conversion - 100, 0) * 0.2) + LEAST(cumulative_conversions, 10) * 2)) END

CASE WHEN roas_rank_in_cohort <= CEIL(total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage * 0.2) THEN 'Top 20%' WHEN roas_rank_in_cohort <= CEIL(total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage * 0.5) THEN 'Top 50%' WHEN roas_rank_in_cohort <= CEIL(total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage * 0.8) THEN 'Bottom 50%' ELSE 'Bottom 20%' END
CASE WHEN cumulative_spend < 1000 THEN 'Low Investment' WHEN cumulative_spend < 5000 THEN 'Medium Investment' WHEN cumulative_spend < 20000 THEN 'High Investment' ELSE 'Premium Investment' END

CASE WHEN (lifecycle_stage IN ('Launch Phase', 'Optimization Phase') AND roas > cohort_avg_roas) OR (lifecycle_stage IN ('Growth Phase', 'Maturity Phase') AND roas >= cohort_avg_roas * 1.2) THEN 'High Momentum' WHEN roas <= cohort_avg_roas * 0.8 THEN 'Low Momentum' ELSE 'Stable Momentum' END

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation
      description: Daily keyword performance with campaign benchmarks, segmentation tiers, bid recommendations, and quality/optimization flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats (ks). - Join dimensional data: - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history (agi) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on ad_group_id and source_relation. - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history (ci) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on campaign_id and source_relation. - Compute per-row performance metrics (rounding to 4 decimals unless noted; NULL policies explicit): - ctr: if impressions > 0 → (clicks / impressions) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - cpc: if clicks > 0 → spend / clicks; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cpm: if impressions > 0 → spend / impressions * 1000; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cost_per_conversion: if conversions > 0 → spend / conversions; else NULL; rounded 4 decimals. - roas: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 → conversions_value / spend; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - conversion_rate: if clicks > 0 → (conversions / clicks) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - Compute lifetime cumulative metrics using window sums partitioned by (keyword_id = ks.criterion_id, ad_group_id) ordered by date_day, rows unbounded preceding: - lifetime_spend, lifetime_clicks, lifetime_conversions, lifetime_conversions_value. - Compute days_since_first_activity: number of days between the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition and the current date_day; non-negative integer. - Compute campaign-level benchmarks over (partition by campaign_id, date_day): - campaign_avg_ctr, campaign_avg_cpc, campaign_avg_conversion_rate, campaign_avg_roas (simple averages of per-row metrics). - Percentile ranks: ctr_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by ctr ascending; conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by conversion_rate ascending; roas_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by roas descending; range [0,1]. - Derive segmentation and recommendations: - ctr_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 → ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr) / campaign_avg_ctr) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - roas_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 → ((roas - campaign_avg_roas) / campaign_avg_roas) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - keyword_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <7 → "New Keyword"; <30 → "Testing Phase"; <90 → "Optimization Phase"; <365 → "Mature Keyword"; else "Legacy Keyword". - performance_tier based on percentiles (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): ctr_pct >= 0.8 and conv_pct >= 0.8 → "Star Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.6 and conv_pct >= 0.6 → "Strong Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.4 and conv_pct >= 0.4 → "Average Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.2 or conv_pct >= 0.2 → "Weak Performer"; else "Poor Performer". - bid_recommendation: roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr*1.2 → "Increase Bid (+20%)"; roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.2 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr → "Increase Bid (+10%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.7 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr*0.8 → "Decrease Bid (-20%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.8 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr → "Decrease Bid (-10%)"; conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 30 → "Consider Pausing"; else "Maintain Bid". - efficiency_score: treat any missing percentile as 0, weight (ctr 30, conv_rate 40, roas 30), clamp to [0,100]; final output rounded to 1 decimal. - volume_tier by lifetime_spend: <100 → "Low Volume"; <1000 → "Medium Volume"; <5000 → "High Volume"; else "Premium Volume". - value_tier by lifetime_conversions_value: <500 → "Low Value"; <2500 → "Medium Value"; <10000 → "High Value"; else "Premium Value". - Derive quality/ops flags (always non-NULL booleans): - data_quality_flag: clicks > impressions. - optimization_needed_flag: spend > 100 and conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 14. - scale_opportunity_flag: roas > 5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr * 1.5. - pause_candidate_flag: efficiency_score < 20 and days_since_first_activity > 30. - Final filter (rows must satisfy): spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, and date_day, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id are NOT NULL. - Output rows are ordered by keyword_id, ad_group_id, date_day; no de-duplication beyond the final filter.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system relation identifier used for dimensional joins and lineage
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword criterion_id from keyword_stats; grouping key for lifetime windows and grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier; part of grain and lifetime window partition
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier used for benchmark partitions and joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent ad group name from ad_group_history; may be NULL if no match
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent campaign name from campaign_history; may be NULL if no match
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign advertising channel type from campaign_history; values as stored by source
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Activity date; part of grain and window ordering
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost for the keyword; non-negative per final filter; used in CPC/CPM/ROAS calculations
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPC/conversion_rate calculations
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPM calculations
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; non-negative per final filter; used in cost_per_conversion and conversion_rate
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value; used in ROAS; if spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0 then ROAS = 0
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Click-through rate in percentage: if impressions > 0 then (clicks/impressions)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals; not capped'
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per click: if clicks > 0 then spend/clicks else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per thousand impressions: if impressions > 0 then spend/impressions*1000 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per conversion: if conversions > 0 then spend/conversions else NULL; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Return on ad spend: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 then conversions_value/spend else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Conversion rate in percentage: if clicks > 0 then (conversions/clicks)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: lifetime_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative spend up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative clicks up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversions up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversion value up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Days since first activity: current date_day minus the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition; non-negative'
      - name: campaign_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) across keywords; unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row CTR
      - name: campaign_avg_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPC within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row CPC
      - name: campaign_avg_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average conversion rate within (campaign_id, date_day); unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row rate
      - name: campaign_avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row ROAS
      - name: ctr_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CTR vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 then ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr)/campaign_avg_ctr)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: roas_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'ROAS vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 then ((roas - campaign_avg_roas)/campaign_avg_roas)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: ctr_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of conversion_rate within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: roas_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered descending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: keyword_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage derived from days_since_first_activity: New Keyword, Testing Phase, Optimization Phase, Mature Keyword, Legacy Keyword'
        tests:
        - keyword_maturity_stage IN ('New Keyword','Testing Phase','Optimization Phase','Mature Keyword','Legacy Keyword')
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on CTR and conversion rate percentiles: Star/Strong/Average/Weak/Poor Performer'
        tests:
        - performance_tier IN ('Star Performer','Strong Performer','Average Performer','Weak Performer','Poor Performer')
      - name: bid_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation based on ROAS/CTR versus campaign benchmarks and activity: Increase/Decrease with percent, Consider Pausing, or Maintain Bid'
        tests:
        - bid_recommendation IN ('Increase Bid (+20%)','Increase Bid (+10%)','Decrease Bid (-20%)','Decrease Bid (-10%)','Consider Pausing','Maintain Bid')
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted score from percentiles (30/40/30), missing percentiles treated as 0, clamped to [0,100] and rounded to 1 decimal
        tests:
        - efficiency_score >= 0
        - efficiency_score <= 100
      - name: volume_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Volume classification by lifetime_spend: Low/Medium/High/Premium Volume'
        tests:
        - volume_tier IN ('Low Volume','Medium Volume','High Volume','Premium Volume')
      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Value classification by lifetime_conversions_value: Low/Medium/High/Premium Value'
        tests:
        - value_tier IN ('Low Value','Medium Value','High Value','Premium Value')
      - name: data_quality_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks > impressions; flags anomalous CTR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: optimization_needed_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 100, conversions = 0, and days_since_first_activity > 14
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when roas > 5 and ctr > 1.5 × campaign_avg_ctr
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: pause_candidate_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when efficiency_score < 20 and days_since_first_activity > 30
        tests:
        - not_null

ROUND(CASE WHEN conversions > 0 THEN spend / conversions END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN spend > 0 AND conversions_value > 0 THEN conversions_value / spend ELSE 0 END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN conversions / clicks * 100 ELSE 0 END, 4)
SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id, ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id, ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id, ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions_value) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id, ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, date_day ORDER BY ctr)

CASE WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.8 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.8 THEN 'Star Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.6 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.6 THEN 'Strong Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.4 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.4 THEN 'Average Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.2 OR conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0.2 THEN 'Weak Performer' ELSE 'Poor Performer' END

CASE WHEN lifetime_conversions_value < 500 THEN 'Low Value' WHEN lifetime_conversions_value < 2500 THEN 'Medium Value' WHEN lifetime_conversions_value < 10000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Premium Value' END

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__account_report
      description: Daily account-level aggregation of Google Ads stats joined to the most recent account attributes with summed performance metrics
      grain: One row per distinct combination of source_relation, date_day, account_id, account_name, currency_code, auto_tagging_enabled, time_zone
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats (stats). - Load rows from staging.stg_google_ads__account_history (accounts) flagged as the most recent record. - Left join stats to accounts by matching account_id and source_relation. - Group by source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, auto_tagging_enabled, and time_zone. - For each group, sum spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, and view_through_conversions from stats. - Aggregation behavior: - Sums ignore NULL inputs; if all inputs for a metric in a group are NULL, the result is NULL. - No additional filters, rounding, casting, or currency conversion are applied; numeric types follow engine defaults (DOUBLE for monetary/fractional metrics, HUGEINT for count metrics). - If multiple “most recent” account rows exist for the same account_id and source_relation, the join duplicates stats rows and those duplicates are included in the sums. - Account attributes (account_name, currency_code, auto_tagging_enabled, time_zone) come from the joined accounts record and are NULL when no match exists; values are preserved as stored.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source relation identifier from stats; part of the grouping key; preserved as stored
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from stats; part of the grouping key; no timezone transformation
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most recent accounts record; may be NULL if no match
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from stats; part of the join and grouping key; preserved as stored
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency code from accounts; may be NULL; spend and conversions_value are reported in this currency when present
      - name: auto_tagging_enabled
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Boolean flag from accounts indicating auto-tagging; may be NULL if no match
      - name: time_zone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account time zone from accounts; may be NULL; value preserved as stored
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of spend per group from stats; unit is account currency; NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL; no rounding
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks per group from stats; NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions per group from stats; NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversions per group from stats (fractional supported); NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversions_value per group from stats; unit is account currency; NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view_through_conversions per group from stats; NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all inputs are NULL
