blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__ad_report
      description: Ad-level daily performance with latest creative and hierarchy attributes
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, ad_name, ad_id, ad_type, status, display_url
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_history
      business_logic: '- Read ad performance from staging.stg_google_ads__ad_stats (stats). - From each history table (accounts, campaigns, ad_groups, ads), restrict to is_most_recent_record = TRUE. - Left join stats to: - ads on (ad_id, source_relation) - ad_groups on (ad_group_id, source_relation) - campaigns on (campaign_id, source_relation) - accounts on (account_id, source_relation) - Group by source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, ad_name, ad_id, ad_type, status, display_url. - Aggregate metrics as SUM over grouped rows: spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions. - SUM skips NULL inputs; if all inputs are NULL, the result is NULL; no defaulting to zero. - Descriptive attributes (names, ad_type, status, display_url, currency_code) are taken from the most recent history record and remain NULL if no match exists. - Monetary fields (spend, conversions_value) are in the account currency indicated by currency_code and retain scale 2. - Assumes each history table returns a single most recent row per (source_relation, entity_id); otherwise, joins may duplicate stats prior to aggregation.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source relation identifier used to disambiguate records across sources; propagated from stats
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the performance metrics from stats
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most recent account_history; NULL if no match
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from stats used for joining to account attributes
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency from the most recent account_history; used for spend and value; may be NULL
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the most recent campaign_history; NULL if no match
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from stats used for joining to campaign attributes
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group name from the most recent ad_group_history; NULL if no match
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier from stats used for joining to ad group attributes
      - name: ad_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad name from the most recent ad_history; NULL if no match
      - name: ad_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad identifier from stats; primary ad key within the grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad type from the most recent ad_history; NULL if no match
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad status from the most recent ad_history; NULL if no match
      - name: display_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display URL from the most recent ad_history; NULL if no match
      - name: spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of spend across grouped stats rows in account currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across grouped stats rows; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across grouped stats rows; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversions across grouped stats rows; may be fractional; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversion value across grouped stats rows in account currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view-through conversions across grouped stats rows; NULL if all inputs are NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__campaign_report
      description: Daily campaign performance aggregated from stats with current campaign/account attributes
      grain: One row per combination of source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, status
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history
      business_logic: '- Base: use all rows from staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_stats as the fact table (stats). - Dimension scoping: use only records flagged as most recent in staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history and staging.stg_google_ads__account_history. - Joins: - Left join campaigns by matching source_relation and campaign_id to bring in campaign attributes. - Left join accounts by matching the joined campaign''s source_relation and account_id to bring in account attributes. - Account attributes populate only when a campaign match exists and that campaign links to a matching most recent account; otherwise they remain NULL. - No deduplication beyond the most-recent filters; if multiple "most recent" rows exist per key, stats rows will repeat per join semantics. - Grouping: group by these 10 fields to form the row grain: source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, status. - Aggregations over stats: - For each group, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversion value, and view-through conversions are calculated by adding values from all contributing stats rows; rows are not deduplicated; NULL inputs are ignored, and if all inputs are NULL the result is NULL; no rounding is applied. - Currency: spend and conversion value are expressed in the account currency_code; no currency conversion is performed. - Output: return exactly the grouped dimensions and aggregated measures, one row per group.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier carried through from stats and used for joins and grouping
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of performance attribution from stats
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most recent account linked via the joined campaign; NULL if no matching campaign or account
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID from the most recent account linked via the joined campaign; NULL if no matching campaign or account
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO-4217 currency code from the most recent account linked via the joined campaign; units for spend and conversions_value; NULL if no matching campaign or account
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the most recent campaign record; NULL if no matching campaign
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from stats used for joins and grouping
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel type from the most recent campaign record; NULL if no matching campaign
      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel subtype from the most recent campaign record; NULL if no matching campaign
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign status from the most recent campaign record; NULL if no matching campaign
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL; units in currency_code; no rounding
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total conversions for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total conversion value for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL; units in currency_code; no rounding
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total view-through conversions for the group from stats; NULLs ignored; returns NULL if all NULL

- name: google_ads__channel_performance_analysis
      description: Daily performance by channel, subtype, network, and device with aggregates, efficiency metrics, benchmarks, portfolio analytics, classifications, and alerts.
      grain: One row per source_relation + date_day + advertising_channel_type + advertising_channel_subtype + ad_network_type + device (filtered to total_spend > 0, date_day not null, advertising_channel_type not null)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - campaign_performance (cp): intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis - account_stats (ast): staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats - Join: - Left join ast to cp on campaign_id (cast to varchar) = account_id, with matching source_relation and date_day. - ad_network_type and device come from ast and can be NULL when no match exists. - Aggregation (channel_device_performance): - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, ad_network_type, device. - Sums: spend → total_spend; clicks → total_clicks; impressions → total_impressions; conversions → total_conversions; conversions_value → total_conversions_value. - Distinct counts of campaigns: active_campaigns; conditional counts for lifecycle stages (Launch Phase, Growth Phase), momentum (High Momentum), performance tiers (Top 20%, Bottom 20%), and underperforming_flag = true. - Investment sums: premium_spend for investment_tier = Premium Investment; high_investment_spend for investment_tier = High Investment. - Averages: avg_campaign_health_score from campaign_health_score; avg_roas from roas. - Efficiency and benchmarks (efficiency_analysis): - CTR (%): clicks divided by impressions, expressed as percent; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - CPC: spend divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when clicks are 0. - CPM: spend per thousand impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - Cost per conversion (CPA): spend divided by conversions; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions are 0. - ROAS: conversions_value divided by spend; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0. - Conversion rate (%): conversions divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0. - Daily share metrics by date_day: each group''s spend, clicks, and conversions divided by the total for that date, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals; zero totals are treated as missing to avoid division by zero. - Channel benchmarks by date_day: - channel_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - channel_benchmark_roas: average ROAS within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0; not rounded. - Device benchmarks by date_day: - device_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same device; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - device_benchmark_cpa: average CPA within the same device using only rows with conversions; NULLs are ignored; not rounded. - Performance insights: - Deltas vs benchmarks (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is <= 0): - ctr_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, roas_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, ctr_vs_device_benchmark_pct, cpa_vs_device_benchmark_pct (CPA delta is also NULL when cost_per_conversion is NULL). - Channel investment tier by total_spend: <500 → Emerging Channel; <2000 → Developing Channel; <10000 → Established Channel; otherwise Major Channel. - Performance classification (first match applies): - Star Channel: ROAS ≥ 3.0, CTR ≥ channel benchmark, and spend_share_pct ≥ 5. - Strong Channel: ROAS ≥ 2.0 and CTR ≥ 80% of channel benchmark. - Stable Channel: ROAS ≥ 1.0 and CTR ≥ 60% of channel benchmark. - Developing Channel: ROAS ≥ 0.5. - Otherwise: Optimization Needed. - Portfolio percentages (%): high_momentum_pct, top_tier_pct, underperforming_pct each computed as count divided by active_campaigns, expressed as percent and rounded to 1 decimal; set to 0 when active_campaigns is 0. - Channel efficiency score (0–100): weighted blend of CTR delta (30%), ROAS delta (40%), and avg_campaign_health_score (30%); missing inputs default to 50; the score is capped between 0 and 100. - Final processing: - premium_spend_pct: premium_spend divided by total_spend, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals. - Rounding: avg_campaign_health_score to 1 decimal; avg_roas to 4 decimals; channel_efficiency_score to 1 decimal. - Alerts: roi_alert when ROAS < 0.5 and total_spend > 1000; portfolio_health_alert when underperforming_pct > 50; strategic_review_needed when spend_share_pct > 30 and performance_classification is Optimization Needed; growth_opportunity when high_momentum_pct > 50 and channel_efficiency_score > 80. - Filter rows: keep only total_spend > 0, date_day not null, and advertising_channel_type not null; sort by date_day descending, then total_spend descending.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from campaign data; used for grouping; may be NULL.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Report date; rows with NULL are excluded in the final output.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel type from campaign data; rows with NULL are excluded in the final output.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel subtype from campaign data; may be NULL.
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad network type sourced from account stats via left join; may be NULL.
      - name: device
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Device sourced from account stats via left join; may be NULL.
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend summed over the group; positive due to final filter; units follow campaign spend.
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks summed over the group; non-negative integer.
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions summed over the group; non-negative integer.
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total conversions summed over the group; non-negative and may be fractional.
      - name: total_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total conversion value summed over the group; non-negative monetary amount.
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Click-through rate as percent from clicks over impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions are 0.
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per click; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0.
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per thousand impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions are 0.
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions are 0.
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend or conversion value is 0.
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Conversion rate as percent from conversions over clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0.
      - name: spend_share_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of spend within the same date_day, as percent rounded to 2 decimals; NULL only if the daily total is 0.
      - name: clicks_share_pct
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of clicks within the same date_day, as percent rounded to 2 decimals; NULL only if the daily total is 0.
      - name: conversions_share_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of conversions within the same date_day, as percent rounded to 2 decimals; NULL only if the daily total is 0.
      - name: channel_investment_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Spend tier by total_spend: Emerging (<500), Developing (<2000), Established (<10000), else Major.'
      - name: channel_benchmark_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR percent for the same advertising_channel_type and date_day; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded.
      - name: channel_benchmark_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS for the same advertising_channel_type and date_day; uses 0 when spend or conversion value is 0; not rounded.
      - name: device_benchmark_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR percent for the same device and date_day; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded.
      - name: device_benchmark_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPA for the same device and date_day using rows with conversions; ignores NULLs; not rounded.
      - name: ctr_vs_channel_benchmark_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference versus the channel CTR benchmark; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is ≤ 0.
      - name: roas_vs_channel_benchmark_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference versus the channel ROAS benchmark; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is ≤ 0.
      - name: ctr_vs_device_benchmark_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference versus the device CTR benchmark; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is ≤ 0.
      - name: cpa_vs_device_benchmark_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference versus the device CPA benchmark; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is ≤ 0 or cost_per_conversion is NULL.
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count within the group.
      - name: launch_phase_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count in Launch Phase.
      - name: growth_phase_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count in Growth Phase.
      - name: high_momentum_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count flagged as High Momentum.
      - name: top_tier_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count in the Top 20% performance tier.
      - name: bottom_tier_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count in the Bottom 20% performance tier.
      - name: underperforming_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count with underperforming_flag = true.
      - name: high_momentum_pct
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: High Momentum campaigns as percent of active_campaigns; rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when active_campaigns is 0.
      - name: top_tier_pct
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Top-tier campaigns as percent of active_campaigns; rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when active_campaigns is 0.
      - name: underperforming_pct
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Underperforming campaigns as percent of active_campaigns; rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when active_campaigns is 0.
      - name: premium_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend summed where investment_tier = Premium Investment.
      - name: high_investment_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend summed where investment_tier = High Investment.
      - name: premium_spend_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of spend classified as Premium Investment; rounded to 2 decimals; denominator is total_spend (>0).
      - name: avg_campaign_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average campaign health score across the group; rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if no values.
      - name: avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS across the group; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if no values.
      - name: performance_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Performance label based on ROAS, CTR relative to the channel benchmark, and spend share; first matching rule is applied.
      - name: channel_efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted composite score (0–100) combining CTR delta (30%), ROAS delta (40%), and average health score (30%); missing inputs default to 50; capped and rounded to 1 decimal.
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation chosen by priority using ROAS vs channel benchmark, spend share, top-tier share, underperforming share, momentum, and health score.
      - name: roi_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ROAS < 0.5 and total_spend > 1000; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: portfolio_health_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when underperforming_pct > 50; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: strategic_review_needed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend_share_pct > 30 and performance_classification is Optimization Needed; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: growth_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when high_momentum_pct > 50 and channel_efficiency_score > 80; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN total_impressions > 0 THEN CAST(total_clicks AS DOUBLE) / total_impressions * 100 ELSE 0 END, 4) AS REAL)

ROUND(CASE WHEN total_impressions > 0 THEN total_spend / total_impressions * 1000 ELSE 0 END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN total_conversions > 0 THEN total_spend / total_conversions END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN total_spend > 0 AND total_conversions_value > 0 THEN total_conversions_value / total_spend ELSE 0 END, 4)
ROUND(CASE WHEN total_clicks > 0 THEN total_conversions / total_clicks * 100 ELSE 0 END, 4)
ROUND(100 * total_spend / NULLIF(SUM(total_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY date_day), 0), 2)
CAST(ROUND(100 * total_clicks / NULLIF(SUM(total_clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY date_day), 0), 2) AS REAL)
ROUND(100 * total_conversions / NULLIF(SUM(total_conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY date_day), 0), 2)
CASE WHEN total_spend < 500 THEN 'Emerging Channel' WHEN total_spend < 2000 THEN 'Developing Channel' WHEN total_spend < 10000 THEN 'Established Channel' ELSE 'Major Channel' END
AVG(CASE WHEN total_impressions > 0 THEN CAST(total_clicks AS DOUBLE) / total_impressions * 100 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY advertising_channel_type, date_day)
AVG(CASE WHEN total_spend > 0 AND total_conversions_value > 0 THEN total_conversions_value / total_spend ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY advertising_channel_type, date_day)
AVG(CASE WHEN total_impressions > 0 THEN CAST(total_clicks AS DOUBLE) / total_impressions * 100 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY device, date_day)
ROUND(CASE WHEN channel_benchmark_ctr > 0 THEN (ctr - channel_benchmark_ctr) / channel_benchmark_ctr * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN channel_benchmark_roas > 0 THEN (roas - channel_benchmark_roas) / channel_benchmark_roas * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN device_benchmark_ctr > 0 THEN (ctr - device_benchmark_ctr) / device_benchmark_ctr * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN device_benchmark_cpa > 0 AND NOT cost_per_conversion IS NULL THEN (cost_per_conversion - device_benchmark_cpa) / device_benchmark_cpa * 100 END, 2)

LEAST(100.0, GREATEST(0.0, COALESCE(50 + COALESCE(ctr_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, 0) * 0.3, 50) * 0.3 + COALESCE(50 + COALESCE(roas_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, 0) * 0.4, 50) * 0.4 + COALESCE(avg_campaign_health_score, 50) * 0.3))

CASE WHEN roas >= 3 AND ctr >= channel_benchmark_ctr AND spend_share_pct >= 5 THEN 'Star Channel' WHEN roas >= 2 AND ctr >= channel_benchmark_ctr * 0.8 THEN 'Strong Channel' WHEN roas >= 1 AND ctr >= channel_benchmark_ctr * 0.6 THEN 'Stable Channel' WHEN roas >= 0.5 THEN 'Developing Channel' ELSE 'Optimization Needed' END

CASE WHEN roas < 0.5 AND total_spend > 1000 THEN 'Review ROI and reduce inefficient spend' WHEN 100.0 * underperforming_campaigns / NULLIF(active_campaigns, 0) > 50 THEN 'Improve underperforming campaign portfolio' WHEN high_momentum_pct > 50 THEN 'Scale high-momentum campaigns' ELSE 'Maintain channel strategy and monitor performance' END

high_investment_spend for investment_tier = High Investment. - Averages: avg_campaign_health_score from campaign_health_score; avg_roas from roas. - Efficiency and benchmarks (efficiency_analysis): - CTR (%): clicks divided by impressions, expressed as percent; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - CPC: spend divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when clicks are 0. - CPM: spend per thousand impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - Cost per conversion (CPA): spend divided by conversions; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions are 0. - ROAS: conversions_value divided by spend; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0. - Conversion rate (%): conversions divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0. - Daily share metrics by date_day: each group''s spend, clicks, and conversions divided by the total for that date, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals; zero totals are treated as missing to avoid division by zero. - Channel benchmarks by date_day: - channel_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - channel_benchmark_roas: average ROAS within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0; not rounded. - Device benchmarks by date_day: - device_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same device; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - device_benchmark_cpa: average CPA within the same device using only rows with conversions; NULLs are ignored; not rounded. - Performance insights: - Deltas vs benchmarks (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is <= 0): - ctr_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, roas_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, ctr_vs_device_benchmark_pct, cpa_vs_device_benchmark_pct (CPA delta is also NULL when cost_per_conversion is NULL). - Channel investment tier by total_spend: <500 → Emerging Channel; <2000 → Developing Channel; <10000 → Established Channel; otherwise Major Channel. - Performance classification (first match applies): - Star Channel: ROAS ≥ 3.0, CTR ≥ channel benchmark, and spend_share_pct ≥ 5. - Strong Channel: ROAS ≥ 2.0 and CTR ≥ 80% of channel benchmark. - Stable Channel: ROAS ≥ 1.0 and CTR ≥ 60% of channel benchmark. - Developing Channel: ROAS ≥ 0.5. - Otherwise: Optimization Needed. - Portfolio percentages (%): high_momentum_pct, top_tier_pct, underperforming_pct each computed as count divided by active_campaigns, expressed as percent and rounded to 1 decimal; set to 0 when active_campaigns is 0. - Channel efficiency score (0–100): weighted blend of CTR delta (30%), ROAS delta (40%), and avg_campaign_health_score (30%); missing inputs default to 50; the score is capped between 0 and 100. - Final processing: - premium_spend_pct: premium_spend divided by total_spend, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals. - Rounding: avg_campaign_health_score to 1 decimal; avg_roas to 4 decimals; channel_efficiency_score to 1 decimal. - Alerts: roi_alert when ROAS < 0.5 and total_spend > 1000; portfolio_health_alert when underperforming_pct > 50; strategic_review_needed when spend_share_pct > 30 and performance_classification is Optimization Needed; growth_opportunity when high_momentum_pct > 50 and channel_efficiency_score > 80. - Filter rows: keep only total_spend > 0, date_day not null, and advertising_channel_type not null; sort by date_day descending, then total_spend descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__customer_acquisition_analysis
      description: Customer acquisition analysis by account and date with matched campaign context, cohort-based CAC/LTV, running totals, cohort benchmarks, segmentation, recommendations, and alert flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, account_id, date_day, and matched campaign cohort row (joined on source_relation, account_id=campaign_id, and date_day); if no match, one row with NULL campaign fields
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics (source_relation, account_id, account_name, date_day, account_maturity_stage, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, ctr, cpc, cost_per_conversion, roas)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis (source_relation, campaign_id, date_day, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, lifecycle_stage)
      business_logic: '- Begin with account_performance (ap); left join campaign_cohorts (cc) on source_relation, account_id=campaign_id, and date_day. - Keep only ap rows where conversions > 0 or spend > 0. - Acquisition cohort: for each account_id, find the earliest date_day with conversions > 0 and use the first day of that month; set to NULL if the account has no conversions. - Days since first conversion: calendar days between the account’s first conversion date and the current date_day; NULL if no first conversion date. - Channel and lifecycle: take advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, and lifecycle_stage (as campaign_lifecycle_stage) from cc; these may be NULL. - Running totals within each account_id ordered by date_day from earliest to current: - cumulative_acquisition_cost: running sum of spend. - cumulative_conversions: running sum of conversions. - cumulative_ltv: running sum of conversions_value. - If multiple rows share the same date_day, accumulation follows the row order. - Daily portfolio counts per account_id and date_day (based on joined cc rows; NULLs ignored): - active_campaigns_count: distinct campaign_id count. - channel_diversity_count: distinct advertising_channel_type count. - Derived economics per row: - customer_acquisition_cost (CAC): cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL. - average_customer_ltv: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - ltv_cac_ratio: average_customer_ltv divided by customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_acquisition_cost > 0 and cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - estimated_payback_days: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value on the row (conversions_value divided by conversions), scaled to 30 days and rounded to a whole number when cost_per_conversion > 0 and conversions_value > 0; otherwise NULL. - Cohort benchmarks: - cohort_avg_cac: average of (cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions) across rows sharing acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - cohort_avg_ltv: average of (cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions) across the same cohort/channel; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - Percentile ranks within acquisition_cohort: - cac_efficiency_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on customer_acquisition_cost with lower values ranked higher. - ltv_cac_performance_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on ltv_cac_ratio with higher values ranked higher. - Segmentation and insights: - acquisition_efficiency_tier by ltv_cac_ratio: ≥3.0 Excellent; ≥2.0 Good; ≥1.0 Break-even; ≥0.5 Negative; else Poor. - cac_performance_tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: ≥0.8 Top CAC Efficiency; ≥0.6 Above Average CAC; ≥0.4 Average CAC; ≥0.2 Below Average CAC; else High CAC. - customer_maturity_stage from days_since_first_conversion: Not Acquired (NULL), ≤30 New Customer, ≤90 Early Stage, ≤365 Developing Customer, ≤1095 Mature Customer, else Long-term Customer. - acquisition_sophistication_score: clamp to [0,100] of (channel_diversity_count*15 + active_campaigns_count*5 + up to 30 from average_customer_ltv, and up to 25 from ltv_cac_ratio); rounded to 1 decimal in the final output. - cac_vs_cohort_pct: ((customer_acquisition_cost − cohort_avg_cac) / cohort_avg_cac) * 100 rounded to 2 decimals when cohort_avg_cac > 0; otherwise NULL. - ltv_vs_cohort_pct: ((average_customer_ltv − cohort_avg_ltv) / cohort_avg_ltv) * 100 rounded to 2 decimals when cohort_avg_ltv > 0; otherwise NULL. - strategic_customer_segment selected by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, average_customer_ltv, days_since_first_conversion, and CAC vs cohort comparisons. - acquisition_recommendation selected by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, cac_efficiency_percentile, channel_diversity_count, days_since_first_conversion, CAC vs cohort, and active_campaigns_count. - Alerts in the final projection: - negative_roi_alert: true when ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 and cumulative_acquisition_cost > 1000; else false. - high_cac_alert: true when customer_acquisition_cost > 2× cohort_avg_cac; else false. - scale_opportunity: true when ltv_cac_ratio ≥ 4.0 and cac_efficiency_percentile ≥ 0.9; else false. - retention_risk: true when days_since_first_conversion > 365 and ltv_cac_ratio < 1.5; else false. - Final filter: keep rows where cumulative_conversions > 0 or spend > 0, and date_day and account_id are not NULL; ordered by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source identifier from account performance and join key to campaign cohorts
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ads account identifier from account performance; non-null in the final result
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ads account name from account performance
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date used for joining and for ordering running totals; non-null in the final result
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: acquisition_cohort
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month start of the account’s first conversion date; NULL if the account has never converted
      - name: days_since_first_conversion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar days from the account’s first conversion date to the current date_day; NULL if no first conversion date
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel type from the matched campaign cohort row; may be NULL
      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel subtype from the matched campaign cohort row; may be NULL
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account maturity stage from account performance
      - name: customer_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer stage derived from days_since_first_conversion
      - name: campaign_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from the matched campaign cohort row; may be NULL
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily spend from account performance; rows exist only when spend > 0 or conversions > 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks from account performance
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions from account performance
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions from account performance; used in running totals and payback calculation
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value from account performance; used in running LTV and payback calculation
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Click-through rate from account performance
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per click from account performance
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion from account performance; used in payback calculation
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend from account performance
      - name: customer_acquisition_cost
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Running CAC: cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL'
      - name: average_customer_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Running average conversion value: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0'
      - name: ltv_cac_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of average_customer_ltv to customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when both are defined; otherwise 0
      - name: estimated_payback_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Estimated days to recover CAC: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value, scaled to 30 days and rounded when applicable; otherwise NULL'
      - name: cumulative_acquisition_cost
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of spend within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cumulative_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversions within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cumulative_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversion value within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cohort_avg_cac
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average running CAC within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded
      - name: cohort_avg_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average running LTV per conversion within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded
      - name: cac_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference vs cohort CAC, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_cac is missing or not positive
      - name: ltv_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference vs cohort LTV, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_ltv is missing or not positive
      - name: cac_efficiency_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) of CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with lower CAC ranked higher; ties share rank
      - name: ltv_cac_performance_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) of LTV:CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with higher ratios ranked higher; ties share rank
      - name: acquisition_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by ltv_cac_ratio thresholds: Excellent (≥3.0), Good (≥2.0), Break-even (≥1.0), Negative (≥0.5), else Poor'
      - name: cac_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: Top CAC Efficiency (≥0.8), Above Average CAC (≥0.6), Average CAC (≥0.4), Below Average CAC (≥0.2), else High CAC'
      - name: strategic_customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategic segment chosen by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, average_customer_ltv, days_since_first_conversion, and CAC vs cohort
      - name: acquisition_sophistication_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Score clamped to [0,100] using channel diversity, active campaigns, LTV, and LTV:CAC; rounded to 1 decimal in the final output
      - name: active_campaigns_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored
      - name: channel_diversity_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct advertising_channel_type count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored
      - name: acquisition_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation selected by ordered rules using LTV:CAC, CAC percentile, channel diversity, days since first conversion, CAC vs cohort, and active campaigns
      - name: negative_roi_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 and cumulative_acquisition_cost > 1000; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: high_cac_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when customer_acquisition_cost > cohort_avg_cac × 2; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ltv_cac_ratio ≥ 4.0 and cac_efficiency_percentile ≥ 0.9; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retention_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when days_since_first_conversion > 365 and ltv_cac_ratio < 1.5; else false
        tests:
        - not_null

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN days_since_first_conversion IS NULL THEN 'Not Acquired' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 30 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 90 THEN 'Early Stage' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 365 THEN 'Developing Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 1095 THEN 'Mature Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END
CASE WHEN cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN ROUND(cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions, 2) ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN cumulative_acquisition_cost > 0 AND cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN ROUND((cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions) / (cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions), 2) ELSE 0 END
ROUND(CASE WHEN cost_per_conversion > 0 AND conversions_value > 0 AND conversions > 0 THEN cost_per_conversion / (conversions_value / conversions) * 30 END, 0)
SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(conversions_value) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW)
AVG(customer_acquisition_cost) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type)
AVG(average_customer_ltv) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type)
ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_cac > 0 THEN (customer_acquisition_cost - cohort_avg_cac) / cohort_avg_cac * 100 END, 2)
ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_ltv > 0 THEN (average_customer_ltv - cohort_avg_ltv) / cohort_avg_ltv * 100 END, 2)
PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY customer_acquisition_cost DESC)
PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY ltv_cac_ratio)
CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 3 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 2 THEN 'Good' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 1 THEN 'Break-even' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Poor' END

CASE WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.8 THEN 'Top CAC Efficiency' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.6 THEN 'Above Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.4 THEN 'Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.2 THEN 'Below Average CAC' ELSE 'High CAC' END

CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 4 AND average_customer_ltv > 1000 THEN 'High-value scale customer' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 THEN 'Unprofitable customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 30 THEN 'New customer development' WHEN cac_vs_cohort_pct > 50 THEN 'High CAC customer' ELSE 'Core customer' END
COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, date_day)
COUNT(DISTINCT advertising_channel_type) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, date_day)

CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 3 AND cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.8 THEN 'Scale acquisition investment' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 THEN 'Reduce acquisition cost' WHEN channel_diversity_count < 2 THEN 'Diversify acquisition channels' WHEN cac_vs_cohort_pct > 30 THEN 'Optimize CAC versus cohort' ELSE 'Maintain acquisition strategy' END

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__executive_dashboard
      description: Executive summary of Google Ads performance with daily account KPIs, trends, portfolio composition, and prescriptive flags
      grain: One row per account_id per date_day (only days with total_spend > 0; account_id and date_day not null)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics (source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, ctr, cpc, cost_per_conversion, roas)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis (date_day, campaign_id, lifecycle_stage, momentum_indicator, performance_tier_in_cohort, investment_tier, underperforming_flag, spend)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation (date_day, campaign_id, keyword_id, performance_tier, bid_recommendation, efficiency_score, pause_candidate_flag)
      business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics and rename core metrics to account-level totals: total_spend=spend; total_clicks=clicks; total_impressions=impressions; total_conversions=conversions; total_conversions_value=conversions_value; overall_ctr=ctr; overall_cpc=cpc; overall_cost_per_conversion=cost_per_conversion; overall_roas=roas. Also carry: source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct. 2) Build campaign_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis: active_campaigns=count of distinct campaigns; campaigns_in_launch/growth/maturity=count of distinct campaigns in each lifecycle stage; high_momentum_campaigns=count with momentum_indicator=''High Momentum''; underperforming_campaigns=count with underperforming_flag=true; premium_investment_campaigns=count with investment_tier=''Premium Investment''; premium_investment_spend=sum of spend for ''Premium Investment''. Null campaign/category values are not counted; missing dates yield no records. 3) Build keyword_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation: active_keywords=count of distinct keywords; star_performer_keywords=count with performance_tier=''Star Performer''; bid_increase_opportunities=count where bid_recommendation starts with ''Increase''; pause_candidate_keywords=count with pause_candidate_flag=true; avg_keyword_efficiency_score=average efficiency_score. Missing dates yield no records. 4) Join account-level metrics to campaign_aggregates and keyword_aggregates on date_day; replace missing aggregate counts and premium_investment_spend with 0; set avg_keyword_efficiency_score to 0 when missing. 5) Compute trends per account_id ordered by date_day: - spend_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_spend vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - conversions_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_conversions vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - spend_30d_avg: rolling average of total_spend over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 2 decimals. - roas_30d_avg: rolling average of overall_roas over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 4 decimals. - performance_score_30d_avg: rolling average of performance_score over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 1 decimal. Window partition: by account_id; order: date_day ascending. 6) Derive classifications and flags: - premium_investment_pct: premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100; round to 2 decimals; if total_spend=0 then null (rows with 0 spend are excluded by filter). - performance_alert (first match wins): spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''High Spend Growth Alert''; spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Spend Decline Alert''; conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''Conversion Growth Opportunity''; conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Conversion Decline Alert''; overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000 → ''ROI Optimization Needed''; underperforming_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Health Issue''; else ''Normal Performance''. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 and bid_increase_opportunities > 10 using safe divide → ''Scale High Performers''; pause_candidate_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Optimization Needed''; high_momentum_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Invest in Growth''; avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 → ''Keyword Strategy Review''; premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → ''Consider Premium Investments''; else ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - budget_efficiency_tier: ''Highly Efficient'' if overall_roas >= 4.0; ''Efficient'' if >= 2.0; ''Break-even'' if >= 1.0; ''Underperforming'' if >= 0.5; else ''Poor Performance''. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; treat missing inputs as 0. - immediate_attention_required: true if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000; else false. - trending_alert: true if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30; else false. - scale_opportunity: true if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 using safe divide; else false. - top_performer_account: true if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80; else false. 7) Filter to executive-relevant rows: total_spend > 0, account_id present, date_day present. Order by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream relation identifier for the account metrics row
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier; join and window partition key for trends
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable account name from source
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Three-letter currency code associated with the account
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date; window order key; exactly one row per account_id per date_day post-filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily spend (from source); rows with total_spend <= 0 are excluded; used as denominator for premium_investment_pct
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account daily clicks (from source) without rounding or imputation
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account daily impressions (from source) without rounding or imputation
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily conversions (from source) used in WoW trend calculations
      - name: total_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily conversion value/revenue (from source)
      - name: overall_ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Account click-through rate ratio (0–1) as provided by source (no re-scaling)
      - name: overall_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account average cost-per-click as provided by source
      - name: overall_cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account cost per conversion as provided by source
      - name: overall_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account return on ad spend (revenue/spend) as provided by source
      - name: spend_wow_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in total_spend vs value 7 days prior for same account; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if prior <= 0 or missing
      - name: conversions_wow_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in total_conversions vs value 7 days prior for same account; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if prior <= 0 or missing
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month spend change percentage as provided by source (no recomputation or rounding here)
      - name: conversions_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month conversions change percentage as provided by source (no recomputation or rounding here)
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns active on date_day; COALESCE to 0 when missing
      - name: campaigns_in_launch
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Launch Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: campaigns_in_growth
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Growth Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: campaigns_in_maturity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Maturity Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: high_momentum_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with momentum_indicator='High Momentum' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: underperforming_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with underperforming_flag=true on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with investment_tier='Premium Investment' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Global spend sum for campaigns with investment_tier='Premium Investment' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Premium investment share of total_spend as a percentage (0–100), computed as premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100 and rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if total_spend=0 (rows with 0 spend are filtered out)
      - name: active_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: star_performer_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with performance_tier='Star Performer' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: bid_increase_opportunities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with bid_recommendation starting with 'Increase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: pause_candidate_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with pause_candidate_flag=true on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_keyword_efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Global average of efficiency_score on date_day rounded to 1 decimal in final; COALESCE to 0 before rounding when missing
      - name: performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account performance score from source used in health score and top_performer_account logic
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account performance tier label from source (passed through unchanged)
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account maturity stage label from source (passed through unchanged)
      - name: spend_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of total_spend over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: roas_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of overall_roas over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: performance_score_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of performance_score over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: performance_alert
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical alert derived by ordered CASE (see business logic); emits one of: High Spend Growth Alert, Spend Decline Alert, Conversion Growth Opportunity, Conversion Decline Alert, ROI Optimization Needed, Portfolio Health Issue, Normal Performance'
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical recommendation derived by ordered CASE (see business logic); emits one of: Scale High Performers, Portfolio Optimization Needed, Invest in Growth, Keyword Strategy Review, Consider Premium Investments, Maintain Current Strategy'
      - name: budget_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Budget efficiency classification: Highly Efficient, Efficient, Break-even, Underperforming, or Poor Performance'
      - name: overall_account_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite health score capped to [0,100] = performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 with bounding via least/greatest
      - name: immediate_attention_required
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000, else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: trending_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30, else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 (safe-divide), else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: top_performer_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80, else false
        tests:
        - not_null

CASE WHEN spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 THEN 'High Spend Growth Alert' WHEN spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 THEN 'Spend Decline Alert' WHEN conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 THEN 'Conversion Growth Opportunity' WHEN conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 THEN 'Conversion Decline Alert' WHEN overall_roas < 1 AND total_spend > 1000 THEN 'ROI Optimization Needed' WHEN under_pct > 30 THEN 'Portfolio Health Issue' ELSE 'Normal Performance' END

CASE WHEN star_pct > 20 AND bid_increase_opportunities > 10 THEN 'Scale High Performers' WHEN pause_pct > 20 THEN 'Portfolio Optimization Needed' WHEN momentum_pct > 30 THEN 'Invest in Growth' WHEN avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 THEN 'Keyword Strategy Review' WHEN premium_investment_pct < 10 THEN 'Consider Premium Investments' ELSE 'Maintain Current Strategy' END

CASE WHEN overall_roas >= 4 THEN 'Highly Efficient' WHEN overall_roas >= 2 THEN 'Efficient' WHEN overall_roas >= 1 THEN 'Break-even' WHEN overall_roas >= 0.5 THEN 'Underperforming' ELSE 'Poor Performance' END

references.name: intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics
references.line_text: business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics and rename core metrics to account-level totals: total_spend=spend; total_clicks=clicks; total_impressions=impressions; total_conversions=conversions; total_conversions_value=conversions_value; overall_ctr=ctr; overall_cpc=cpc; overall_cost_per_conversion=cost_per_conversion; overall_roas=roas. Also carry: source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct. 2) Build campaign_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis: active_campaigns=count of distinct campaigns; campaigns_in_launch/growth/maturity=count of distinct campaigns in each lifecycle stage; high_momentum_campaigns=count with momentum_indicator=''High Momentum''; underperforming_campaigns=count with underperforming_flag=true; premium_investment_campaigns=count with investment_tier=''Premium Investment''; premium_investment_spend=sum of spend for ''Premium Investment''. Null campaign/category values are not counted; missing dates yield no records. 3) Build keyword_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation: active_keywords=count of distinct keywords; star_performer_keywords=count with performance_tier=''Star Performer''; bid_increase_opportunities=count where bid_recommendation starts with ''Increase''; pause_candidate_keywords=count with pause_candidate_flag=true; avg_keyword_efficiency_score=average efficiency_score. Missing dates yield no records. 4) Join account-level metrics to campaign_aggregates and keyword_aggregates on date_day; replace missing aggregate counts and premium_investment_spend with 0; set avg_keyword_efficiency_score to 0 when missing. 5) Compute trends per account_id ordered by date_day: - spend_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_spend vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - conversions_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_conversions vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - spend_30d_avg: rolling average of total_spend over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 2 decimals. - roas_30d_avg: rolling average of overall_roas over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 4 decimals. - performance_score_30d_avg: rolling average of performance_score over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 1 decimal. Window partition: by account_id; order: date_day ascending. 6) Derive classifications and flags: - premium_investment_pct: premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100; round to 2 decimals; if total_spend=0 then null (rows with 0 spend are excluded by filter). - performance_alert (first match wins): spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''High Spend Growth Alert''; spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Spend Decline Alert''; conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''Conversion Growth Opportunity''; conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Conversion Decline Alert''; overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000 → ''ROI Optimization Needed''; underperforming_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Health Issue''; else ''Normal Performance''. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 and bid_increase_opportunities > 10 using safe divide → ''Scale High Performers''; pause_candidate_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Optimization Needed''; high_momentum_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Invest in Growth''; avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 → ''Keyword Strategy Review''; premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → ''Consider Premium Investments''; else ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - budget_efficiency_tier: ''Highly Efficient'' if overall_roas >= 4.0; ''Efficient'' if >= 2.0; ''Break-even'' if >= 1.0; ''Underperforming'' if >= 0.5; else ''Poor Performance''. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; treat missing inputs as 0. - immediate_attention_required: true if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000; else false. - trending_alert: true if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30; else false. - scale_opportunity: true if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 using safe divide; else false. - top_performer_account: true if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80; else false. 7) Filter to executive-relevant rows: total_spend > 0, account_id present, date_day present. Order by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'

premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → ''Consider Premium Investments''; else ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - budget_efficiency_tier: ''Highly Efficient'' if overall_roas >= 4.0; ''Efficient'' if >= 2.0; ''Break-even'' if >= 1.0; ''Underperforming'' if >= 0.5; else ''Poor Performance''. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; - name: google_ads__keyword_report
      description: Daily keyword performance aggregated and enriched with most-recent account, campaign, ad group, and keyword attributes
      grain: One row per unique combination of source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, criterion_id, type, status, keyword_match_type, keyword_text
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_criterion_history
      business_logic: '- Load stats from staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats (no filters). - Restrict each history table to is_most_recent_record = true to represent current attributes. - Left join stats to: - criterions on (criterion_id, source_relation), - ad_groups on (ad_group_id, source_relation), - campaigns on (campaign_id, source_relation), - accounts on (account_id, source_relation). - Group by the 14 attribute columns: source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, criterion_id, type, status, keyword_match_type, keyword_text. - Aggregate metrics with SUM: spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions. Determinism: - SUM ignores NULL inputs; if all inputs in a group are NULL the result is NULL. - If a history table has multiple most-recent rows for the same id and source_relation, joins will duplicate stats rows and sums will inflate accordingly. - Attributes (names, status, match type, text, currency) come from the most recent history records; if a join does not find a match, those attributes are NULL but the stats group remains. - No ordering is applied in the final output; one row is returned per grouped attribute set with summed metrics; original casing and spacing are preserved.'

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source relation identifier used to disambiguate IDs across sources

        tests:

      - name: ad_group_id

      - name: status

        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversions for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversion value for the group in account currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - conversions_value >= 0
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view-through conversions for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - view_through_conversions >= 0

      description: Daily URL performance aggregated from ad stats with denormalized account, campaign, and ad group context.
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, ad_id, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_history (is_most_recent_record = true)
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history (is_most_recent_record = true)
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history (is_most_recent_record = true)
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history (is_most_recent_record = true)
      business_logic: '- Use ad stats as the base. - Limit each history table (ads, ad groups, campaigns, accounts) to its most recent record. - Join ads to stats on matching ad_id, ad_group_id, and source_relation from stats. - Join ad groups to ads on matching ad_group_id and source_relation. - Join campaigns to ad groups on matching campaign_id and source_relation. - Join accounts to campaigns on matching account_id and source_relation. - Keep only rows where the joined ad has a non-null final URL. - Set dimensions: - base_url from the ad’s final_urls; url_host and url_path as the literal "unknown". - utm_source = "google"; utm_medium = "cpc"; utm_term = "unknown". - utm_campaign from campaign_name; utm_content from ad_group_name. - For each unique combination of the listed grain fields, aggregate metrics by summing spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, and view_through_conversions from ad stats. - Summations skip null inputs and return null if all inputs in the group are null; no ordering or de-duplication beyond the grouping keys; numeric precision follows the column types.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier from ad stats used to align joins across tables.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Stats date that defines the daily grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most recent account record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID from the most recent account record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency code from the most recent account record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the most recent campaign record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from the most recent campaign record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group name from the most recent ad group record; may be NULL if the join does not match.
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group ID from ad stats used in joins and as a grouping key.
      - name: ad_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad ID from ad stats used in joins and as a grouping key.
      - name: base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Final URL from the most recent ad record; always non-NULL due to the filter.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: url_host

        description: Static placeholder set to 'unknown'.
      - name: url_path
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Static placeholder set to 'unknown'.
      - name: utm_source

        description: Static UTM source set to 'google'.
      - name: utm_medium
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Static UTM medium set to 'cpc'.
      - name: utm_campaign
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM campaign mirrored from campaign_name; may be NULL.

- name: stg_google_ads__search_term_keyword_stats
      description: "Cleaned and validated search term performance data with query-keyword matching using 2-CTE structure with field validations"
      source_table: "raw.search_term_keyword_stats_data"
      implementation: "2-CTE structure: base -> validated (with field-level CASE validations)"
      columns:
        - name: source_relation
          data_type: VARCHAR(100)
          generation: "source_relation || '-' || platform final concatenation"
        - name: account_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null]
          source: "customer_id"
          casting: "CAST(customer_id AS VARCHAR(20))"
        - name: date_day
          data_type: DATE
          constraints: [not_null]
          source: "date"
          casting: "CAST(date AS DATE)"
        - name: ad_group_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null]
          source: "ad_group_id"
          casting: "CAST(ad_group_id AS VARCHAR(20))"
        - name: campaign_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null]
          source: "campaign_id"
          casting: "CAST(campaign_id AS VARCHAR(20))"
        - name: criterion_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          source: "keyword_ad_group_criterion"
          casting: "CASE WHEN keyword_ad_group_criterion IS NOT NULL AND keyword_ad_group_criterion != '' THEN CAST(keyword_ad_group_criterion AS VARCHAR(20)) ELSE NULL END"
        - name: search_term_match_type
          data_type: VARCHAR(30)
          source: "search_term_match_type"
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "search_term_match_type IN ('EXACT', 'PHRASE', 'BROAD', 'NEAR_EXACT', 'NEAR_PHRASE')"
              implementation: "CASE WHEN search_term_match_type IN (...) THEN search_term_match_type ELSE NULL END"
        - name: search_term
          data_type: VARCHAR(500)
          source: "search_term"
          validation: "CASE WHEN search_term != '' THEN search_term ELSE NULL END"
        - name: ad_network_type
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          source: "ad_network_type"
          default: "'SEARCH' (forced for search term data)"
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "ad_network_type IN ('SEARCH', 'DISPLAY', 'MIXED', 'YOUTUBE')"
              implementation: "CASE WHEN ad_network_type IN (...) THEN ad_network_type ELSE 'SEARCH' END"
        - name: device
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          source: "device"
          default: "'UNKNOWN' (default due to missing raw data)"
          validation: "CASE WHEN device IN ('DESKTOP', 'MOBILE', 'TABLET') THEN device ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END"
        - name: clicks
          data_type: BIGINT
          source: "clicks"
          quality_action: "coalesce(try_cast(clicks AS BIGINT), 0)"
        - name: spend
          data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
          source: "cost_micros"
          calculation: "cost_micros / 1000000.0"
        - name: impressions
          data_type: BIGINT
          source: "impressions"
          quality_action: "coalesce(try_cast(impressions AS BIGINT), 0)"
        - name: conversions
          data_type: DECIMAL(10,2)
          source: "conversions"
          quality_action: "coalesce(try_cast(conversions AS DOUBLE), 0.0)"
        - name: conversions_value
          data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
          source: "conversions_value"
          quality_action: "coalesce(try_cast(conversions_value AS DOUBLE), 0.0)"
        - name: view_through_conversions
          data_type: BIGINT
          source: "view_through_conversions"
          quality_action: "coalesce(try_cast(view_through_conversions AS BIGINT), 0)"
