blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_play__revenue_analytics
      description: Revenue analytics per package/sku/country/day with transaction categorization, rolling trends, subscription integration, performance scoring, and risk flagging
      grain: One row per date_day, package_name, buyer_country, sku_id, product_title, merchant_currency
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__earnings (transaction_date, package_name, buyer_country, sku_id, product_title, merchant_currency, amount_merchant_currency, transaction_type, order_id)
      - staging.stg_google_play__subscriptions_country (date_day, package_name, product_id, country, new_subscriptions, cancelled_subscriptions, total_active_subscriptions)
      business_logic: '1) Prepare bases: - Earnings: keep rows where amount, transaction_date, and package_name are present; rename transaction_date to date_day. - Subscriptions: keep rows where new_subscriptions, cancelled_subscriptions, and total_active_subscriptions are all nonnegative; rename product_id to sku_id. 2) Classify each earnings transaction: - gross_revenue: amount when the type is a charge and the amount is positive; otherwise 0. - refund_amount: absolute amount when the type is a refund and the amount is negative; otherwise 0. - other_adjustments: amount when the type is neither charge nor refund; otherwise 0. - paying_transactions: 1 for charge with a positive amount; otherwise 0. - refund_transactions: 1 for refund, counted regardless of amount sign; otherwise 0. 3) Aggregate by (date_day, package_name, buyer_country, sku_id, product_title, merchant_currency): - daily_gross_revenue: sum of gross_revenue. - daily_refunds: sum of refund_amount. - daily_paying_transactions: sum of paying_transactions. - daily_refund_transactions: sum of refund_transactions. - total_transactions: number of unique order_ids (NULLs excluded). - daily_net_revenue: gross minus refunds plus other_adjustments. - average_transaction_value: gross revenue divided by paying transactions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no paying transactions. - refund_rate: refund transactions divided by paying transactions, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if no paying transactions. - revenue_per_transaction: daily net revenue divided by unique orders, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no orders. 4) Compute trends within each (package_name, sku_id) ordered by date_day: - avg_7d_net_revenue: 7-day rolling average of daily net revenue including the current day. - avg_30d_net_revenue: 30-day rolling average of daily net revenue including the current day. - weekly_revenue_growth_rate: growth ratio versus the value 7 days earlier; NULL if that earlier value is missing or not positive. - cumulative_net_revenue: running sum of daily net revenue from the start of the series. 5) Left join subscriptions on (date_day, package_name, sku_id, buyer_country=country) and compute: - revenue_per_new_subscription: daily net revenue divided by new subscriptions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if new subscriptions are not positive. - arpu_daily: daily net revenue divided by total active subscriptions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if total active subscriptions are not positive. - subscription_churn_rate: cancelled divided by total active subscriptions, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if total active subscriptions are not positive. - net_subscriber_growth: new subscriptions minus cancellations. 6) Categorize performance: - revenue_tier by daily_net_revenue: ≥1000 High Performer; ≥100 Medium Performer; ≥10 Low Performer; >0 Minimal Performer; otherwise No Revenue. - growth_momentum by weekly_revenue_growth_rate: >0.2 Accelerating; >0.05 Growing; between -0.05 and 0.05 Stable; >-0.2 Declining; otherwise Steep Decline when growth exists; New Product when growth is NULL. - revenue_health_score (0–100): 0 when daily_net_revenue≤0; otherwise sum the component points (revenue presence 30, growth up to 25, refund rate up to 20, churn up to 25 with 12 points if churn is missing) and cap at 100; final score rounded to 2 decimals before capping. 7) Final output and filters: - Round to 2 decimals: daily_gross_revenue, daily_refunds, daily_net_revenue, avg_7d_net_revenue, avg_30d_net_revenue, cumulative_net_revenue. - Keep previously rounded metrics: average_transaction_value (2 decimals), refund_rate (4 decimals), revenue_per_transaction (2 decimals). - risk_flag precedence: High Refund Risk if refund_rate>0.3; else High Churn Risk if subscription_churn_rate>0.2; else Revenue Decline Risk if weekly_revenue_growth_rate<-0.3; else Overall Health Risk if revenue_health_score<30; otherwise Low Risk. - Exclude rows where date_day, package_name, or sku_id is NULL; other dimensions may be NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Transaction date used for grouping, rolling windows, and subscription joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier used for grouping and subscription joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: buyer_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO country code from earnings used to match subscriptions; may be NULL
      - name: sku_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: SKU/product identifier used for grouping and subscription joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: product_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product title from earnings; part of the grouping key; may be NULL
      - name: merchant_currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency from earnings; all amounts are expressed and rounded in this currency; may be NULL
      - name: daily_gross_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of positive charge amounts; rounded to 2 decimals; nonnegative; in merchant_currency
      - name: daily_refunds
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of absolute refund amounts when negative; rounded to 2 decimals; nonnegative; in merchant_currency
      - name: daily_net_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Gross minus refunds plus other adjustments for non-charge/refund types; rounded to 2 decimals; may be negative; in merchant_currency
      - name: daily_paying_transactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of charge transactions with a positive amount; integer ≥ 0
      - name: daily_refund_transactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of refund transactions counted regardless of amount sign; integer ≥ 0
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique orders in the group; NULL order_id excluded; may be 0
      - name: average_transaction_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross revenue divided by paying transactions; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no paying transactions; in merchant_currency
      - name: refund_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Refund transactions divided by paying transactions; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if no paying transactions; may exceed 1.0
      - name: revenue_per_transaction
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily net revenue divided by unique orders; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no orders; in merchant_currency
      - name: avg_7d_net_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of daily net revenue within each package and SKU including the current day; rounded to 2 decimals; in merchant_currency
      - name: avg_30d_net_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day rolling average of daily net revenue within each package and SKU including the current day; rounded to 2 decimals; in merchant_currency
      - name: weekly_revenue_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Week-over-week growth versus the value 7 days earlier; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if the earlier value is missing or ≤ 0
      - name: cumulative_net_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Running sum of daily net revenue within each package and SKU ordered by date; rounded to 2 decimals; in merchant_currency
      - name: new_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: New subscriptions on date_day from the subscriptions feed matched by country; nonnegative when present; NULL if no match
      - name: cancelled_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Subscriptions cancelled on date_day from the subscriptions feed matched by country; nonnegative when present; NULL if no match
      - name: total_active_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active subscriptions on date_day from the subscriptions feed matched by country; nonnegative when present; NULL if no match
      - name: revenue_per_new_subscription
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily net revenue divided by new subscriptions; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if new subscriptions are ≤ 0 or missing; in merchant_currency
      - name: arpu_daily
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily net revenue divided by total active subscriptions; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if total active subscriptions are ≤ 0 or missing; in merchant_currency
      - name: subscription_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cancelled subscriptions divided by total active subscriptions; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if total active subscriptions are ≤ 0 or missing
      - name: net_subscriber_growth
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: New subscriptions minus cancellations; NULL if either input is missing
      - name: revenue_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by daily_net_revenue: High Performer (≥1000), Medium Performer (≥100), Low Performer (≥10), Minimal Performer (>0), No Revenue (≤0)'
        tests:
        - in_values:
            values:
            - High Performer
            - Medium Performer
            - Low Performer
            - Minimal Performer
            - No Revenue
      - name: growth_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorization based on weekly_revenue_growth_rate thresholds; 'New Product' when growth is NULL
        tests:
        - in_values:
            values:
            - Accelerating
            - Growing
            - Stable
            - Declining
            - Steep Decline
            - New Product
      - name: revenue_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite 0–100 score from revenue presence (30), growth (up to 25), refund rate (up to 20), and churn (up to 25 with 12 if churn is missing); capped at 100
      - name: risk_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority-based risk: High Refund Risk, High Churn Risk, Revenue Decline Risk, Overall Health Risk, else Low Risk'
        tests:
        - in_values:
            values:
            - High Refund Risk
            - High Churn Risk
            - Revenue Decline Risk
            - Overall Health Risk
            - Low Risk

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN net >= 1000 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN net >= 100 THEN 'Medium Performer' WHEN net >= 10 THEN 'Low Performer' WHEN net > 0 THEN 'Minimal Performer' ELSE 'No Revenue' END

CASE WHEN growth IS NULL THEN 'New Product' WHEN growth > 0.2 THEN 'Accelerating' WHEN growth > 0.05 THEN 'Growing' WHEN growth >= -0.05 THEN 'Stable' WHEN growth > -0.2 THEN 'Declining' ELSE 'Steep Decline' END

CASE WHEN net <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(LEAST(100, ROUND(30 + CASE WHEN growth > 0 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN refund_rate <= 0.1 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN churn IS NULL THEN 12 WHEN churn <= 0.1 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END, 2)) AS INT) END
CASE WHEN refund_rate > 0.3 THEN 'High Refund Risk' WHEN churn > 0.2 THEN 'High Churn Risk' WHEN growth < -0.3 THEN 'Revenue Decline Risk' WHEN net <= 0 THEN 'Overall Health Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END

- name: int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics
      description: Daily app metrics by package and country, including installs/uninstalls, rolling averages, growth, churn, ratings, and segmentations.
      grain: One row per (package_name, country, date_day)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country (date_day, package_name, country, daily_device_installs, daily_device_uninstalls, active_device_installs)
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_country (date_day, package_name, country, daily_average_rating, total_average_rating)
      business_logic: '1) Filter sources: - Installs source: keep rows where daily_device_installs, daily_device_uninstalls, and active_device_installs are each >= 0 (rows with NULLs or negatives are excluded). - Ratings source: keep rows where daily_average_rating and total_average_rating are both within 1.0 to 5.0 inclusive. 2) Left join ratings to installs on (date_day, package_name, country); missing matches leave rating fields NULL. 3) For each (package_name, country), ordered by date_day, compute: - 7-day rolling averages for device installs and device uninstalls using up to the last 7 days including the current day. - 30-day rolling average for device installs using up to the last 30 days including the current day. - Weekly install growth rate: percent change vs the value 7 days prior; returned only when the 7-days-prior value is > 0; rounded to 4 decimals. - Daily churn rate: daily_device_uninstalls divided by active_device_installs; returned only when active_device_installs > 0; rounded to 4 decimals. - Rating 7 days ago via a 7-day lag of daily_average_rating (may be NULL when data is missing). 4) Segmentations: - user_engagement_level: • High Engagement when avg_7d_device_installs >= 100, daily_churn_rate <= 0.05, and daily_average_rating >= 4.0. • Medium Engagement when avg_7d_device_installs >= 50, daily_churn_rate <= 0.1, and daily_average_rating >= 3.5. • Low Engagement when avg_7d_device_installs >= 10 and daily_churn_rate <= 0.2. • Otherwise At Risk (any NULL condition fails). - growth_momentum: • Accelerating if weekly_install_growth_rate > 0.1. • Growing if weekly_install_growth_rate is between 0.0 and 0.1 inclusive. • Stable if weekly_install_growth_rate is between -0.1 and 0.0 inclusive. • Declining if weekly_install_growth_rate < -0.1. • Otherwise New Market (e.g., when the rate is NULL). - rating_trend: • Rating Improving if the 7-day rating change is greater than 0.1. • Rating Declining if the 7-day rating change is less than -0.1. • Otherwise Rating Stable (also when inputs are NULL). 5) Final outputs: - avg_7d_device_installs, avg_7d_device_uninstalls, and avg_30d_device_installs are rounded to 2 decimals. - weekly_install_growth_rate and daily_churn_rate retain 4-decimal rounding from computation. - install_uninstall_ratio is daily_device_installs divided by daily_device_uninstalls only when uninstalls > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise NULL. - market_maturity is based on the unrounded 30-day rolling average of installs: >1000 Mature Market; >100 Growing Market; >10 Emerging Market; else Niche Market. - Keep only rows where date_day, package_name, and country are not NULL; grain is one row per (package_name, country, date_day).'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metric row.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country code provided by the source.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: daily_device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily count of device installs; rows with negative or NULL values are excluded upstream.
        tests: []
      - name: daily_device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily count of device uninstalls; rows with negative or NULL values are excluded upstream.
        tests: []
      - name: active_device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active installed devices at end of day; rows with negative or NULL values are excluded upstream.
        tests: []
      - name: avg_7d_device_installs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of device installs within each (package_name, country), using days up to and including the current day; output rounded to 2 decimals.
        tests: []
      - name: avg_7d_device_uninstalls
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of device uninstalls within each (package_name, country), using days up to and including the current day; output rounded to 2 decimals.
        tests: []
      - name: avg_30d_device_installs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day rolling average of device installs within each (package_name, country), using days up to and including the current day; output rounded to 2 decimals.
        tests: []
      - name: weekly_install_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Week-over-week rate of change in device installs vs 7 days prior; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if the prior value is <= 0 or missing.
        tests: []
      - name: daily_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily uninstalls divided by active devices; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when active devices are <= 0.
        tests: []
      - name: daily_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating when a ratings row exists and passes the 1.0–5.0 filter; otherwise NULL.
        tests: []
      - name: user_engagement_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category based on thresholds of 7-day installs, churn, and rating; defaults to 'At Risk' if conditions are unmet or NULL.
        tests:
        - values_in_set:
            values:
            - High Engagement
            - Medium Engagement
            - Low Engagement
            - At Risk
      - name: growth_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Growth category derived from weekly install growth: >0.1 Accelerating; 0.0–0.1 Growing; -0.1–0.0 Stable; < -0.1 Declining; NULL -> New Market.'
        tests:
        - values_in_set:
            values:
            - Accelerating
            - Growing
            - Stable
            - Declining
            - New Market
      - name: rating_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on 7-day rating change: >0.1 Rating Improving; < -0.1 Rating Declining; else Rating Stable (also when inputs are NULL).'
        tests:
        - values_in_set:
            values:
            - Rating Improving
            - Rating Declining
            - Rating Stable
      - name: install_uninstall_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily installs divided by daily uninstalls when uninstalls > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise NULL.
        tests: []
      - name: market_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Market stage from unrounded 30-day installs average: >1000 Mature Market; >100 Growing Market; >10 Emerging Market; else Niche Market.'
        tests:
        - values_in_set:
            values:
            - Mature Market
            - Growing Market
            - Emerging Market
            - Niche Market

- name: int_google_play__user_retention_analysis
      description: Cohort-based Google Play retention and churn metrics by package_name, country, and install_date
      grain: One row per package_name, country, install_date
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country
      business_logic: '- Build install_cohorts: - From staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country select rows with date_day not null and both daily_device_installs > 0 and daily_user_installs > 0. - Rename: install_date = date_day; cohort_size source = new_installs = daily_device_installs; keep package_name, country. - Build active_users_daily: - From the same source select rows with active_device_installs > 0; rename: active_devices = active_device_installs; keep date_day, package_name, country. - Build uninstall_data: - From the same source select rows with daily_device_uninstalls >= 0 and daily_user_uninstalls >= 0; rename: uninstalls = daily_device_uninstalls; keep date_day, package_name, country. - Cohort activity mapping (cohort_analysis): - Inner join install_cohorts to active_users_daily on package_name and country; keep rows where activity_date is between install_date and install_date + 90 days inclusive. - Compute days_since_install as the number of days between install_date and activity_date. - Map retention_period only for exact days_since_install in {0,1,7,14,30,60,90}; others => null. - Retained counts per cohort (retention_rates): - Group by install_date, package_name, country, new_installs. - For each retention_period in {Day 0, Day 1, Day 7, Day 14, Day 30, Day 60, Day 90}, take the maximum active_devices as the retained count for that period (to deterministically select if multiple rows exist). - Rename cohort_size = new_installs. - Retention percentages (retention_calculated): - Cap retained counts at cohort_size. - For each period in {1,7,14,30,60,90}, compute retention_rate = (capped retained / cohort_size) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the retained count is missing. - Churn metrics (churn_analysis): - Left join uninstall_data to active_users_daily on package_name, country, date_day. - daily_churn_rate = (uninstalls / active_devices) * 100, rounded to 4 decimals when active_devices > 0; else null. - avg_7d_churn_rate = 7-row rolling average by date_day within (package_name, country) of (uninstalls / active_devices) * 100; rows with active_devices <= 0 contribute null and are excluded; not rounded here. - Combine retention and churn (comprehensive_retention): - Left join each cohort to the latest available churn row for its package_name+country (date_day = max(date_day) in churn_analysis for that partition). - current_daily_churn_rate = daily_churn_rate (as computed); current_avg_7d_churn_rate = avg_7d_churn_rate rounded to 4 decimals. - retention_quality_score = 0.3*day_1_retention_rate + 0.4*day_7_retention_rate + 0.3*day_30_retention_rate, rounded to 2 decimals; null if any input is null. - retention_category by day_30_retention_rate: >=40 Excellent; >=25 Good; >=15 Average; >=5 Poor; if not null and <5 Critical; if null Insufficient Data. - churn_risk_level by the latest unrounded 7-day average churn: >10 High; >5 Medium; >2 Low; if not null and <=2 Minimal; if null Unknown Risk. - Trend and comparisons (retention_trends): - prev_week_day_7_retention = day_7_retention_rate from 7 rows earlier within (package_name, country) ordered by install_date. - prev_month_day_30_retention = day_30_retention_rate from 30 rows earlier within the same partition/order. - retention_trend compares day_7_retention_rate to the 7-row lag: Improving if greater, Declining if less, else Stable (includes cases with null lag or equality). - Final projection and filters: - Output the selected fields. - Derive product_stickiness by thresholds: if day_1>=70 and day_7>=30 Sticky; else if day_1>=50 and day_7>=20 Engaging; else if day_1>=30 and day_7>=10 Standard; else if day_1 not null Struggling; else Insufficient Data. - Derive cohort_lifecycle_stage by days since install_date relative to current_date at execution time: <30 New Cohort; <90 Maturing Cohort; else Mature Cohort. - Keep rows where install_date, package_name, country are not null and cohort_size > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: install_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Cohort install date from source rows where daily_device_installs>0 and daily_user_installs>0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country/region code from source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_size
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Cohort size on install_date based on daily_device_installs; strictly > 0 due to filters
        tests:
        - not_null
        - cohort_size > 0
      - name: day_1_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 1 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-1 activity
        tests:
        - day_1_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_1_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_7_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 7 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-7 activity
        tests:
        - day_7_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_7_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_14_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 14 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-14 activity
        tests:
        - day_14_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_14_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_30_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 30 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-30 activity
        tests:
        - day_30_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_30_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_60_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 60 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-60 activity
        tests:
        - day_60_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_60_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_90_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent retained at day 90 using capped retained/cohort_size*100; rounded to 2 decimals; null if no day-90 activity
        tests:
        - day_90_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_90_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: current_daily_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latest daily uninstall rate for package+country as uninstalls/active_devices*100; rounded to 4 decimals; null if active_devices<=0 or no churn row
        tests:
        - current_daily_churn_rate >= 0
        - current_daily_churn_rate <= 100
      - name: current_avg_7d_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latest 7-row rolling average daily churn (%) within package+country over date_day; rows with active_devices<=0 are excluded; rounded to 4 decimals; null if none
        tests:
        - current_avg_7d_churn_rate >= 0
        - current_avg_7d_churn_rate <= 100
      - name: retention_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted score (0–100) = 0.3*day_1 + 0.4*day_7 + 0.3*day_30; rounded to 2 decimals; null if any input missing
        tests:
        - retention_quality_score >= 0
        - retention_quality_score <= 100
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category by day_30_retention_rate: >=40 Excellent, >=25 Good, >=15 Average, >=5 Poor, <5 Critical; null day_30 => Insufficient Data'
        tests:
        - retention_category IN ('Excellent Retention', 'Good Retention', 'Average Retention', 'Poor Retention', 'Critical Retention', 'Insufficient Data')
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category by latest unrounded 7-day average churn: >10 High, >5 Medium, >2 Low, <=2 Minimal; null => Unknown Risk'
        tests:
        - churn_risk_level IN ('High Churn Risk', 'Medium Churn Risk', 'Low Churn Risk', 'Minimal Churn Risk', 'Unknown Risk')
      - name: retention_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend comparing day_7_retention_rate vs 7-row lag within package+country ordered by install_date: Improving if greater, Declining if less, else Stable'
        tests:
        - retention_trend IN ('Improving', 'Stable', 'Declining')
      - name: prev_week_day_7_retention
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: day_7_retention_rate from 7 rows prior within package+country ordered by install_date; inherits 2-decimal rounding; null if fewer than 7 prior rows
        tests:
        - prev_week_day_7_retention >= 0
        - prev_week_day_7_retention <= 100
      - name: prev_month_day_30_retention
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: day_30_retention_rate from 30 rows prior within package+country ordered by install_date; inherits 2-decimal rounding; null if fewer than 30 prior rows
        tests:
        - prev_month_day_30_retention >= 0
        - prev_month_day_30_retention <= 100

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build install_cohorts: - From staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country select rows with date_day not null and both daily_device_installs > 0 and daily_user_installs > 0. - Rename: install_date = date_day; cohort_size source = new_installs = daily_device_installs; keep package_name, country. - Build active_users_daily: - From the same source select rows with active_device_installs > 0; rename: active_devices = active_device_installs; keep date_day, package_name, country. - Build uninstall_data: - From the same source select rows with daily_device_uninstalls >= 0 and daily_user_uninstalls >= 0; rename: uninstalls = daily_device_uninstalls; keep date_day, package_name, country. - Cohort activity mapping (cohort_analysis): - Inner join install_cohorts to active_users_daily on package_name and country; keep rows where activity_date is between install_date and install_date + 90 days inclusive. - Compute days_since_install as the number of days between install_date and activity_date. - Map retention_period only for exact days_since_install in {0,1,7,14,30,60,90}; others => null. - Retained counts per cohort (retention_rates): - Group by install_date, package_name, country, new_installs. - For each retention_period in {Day 0, Day 1, Day 7, Day 14, Day 30, Day 60, Day 90}, take the maximum active_devices as the retained count for that period (to deterministically select if multiple rows exist). - Rename cohort_size = new_installs. - Retention percentages (retention_calculated): - Cap retained counts at cohort_size. - For each period in {1,7,14,30,60,90}, compute retention_rate = (capped retained / cohort_size) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the retained count is missing. - Churn metrics (churn_analysis): - Left join uninstall_data to active_users_daily on package_name, country, date_day. - daily_churn_rate = (uninstalls / active_devices) * 100, rounded to 4 decimals when active_devices > 0; else null. - avg_7d_churn_rate = 7-row rolling average by date_day within (package_name, country) of (uninstalls / active_devices) * 100; rows with active_devices <= 0 contribute null and are excluded; not rounded here. - Combine retention and churn (comprehensive_retention): - Left join each cohort to the latest available churn row for its package_name+country (date_day = max(date_day) in churn_analysis for that partition). - current_daily_churn_rate = daily_churn_rate (as computed); current_avg_7d_churn_rate = avg_7d_churn_rate rounded to 4 decimals. - retention_quality_score = 0.3*day_1_retention_rate + 0.4*day_7_retention_rate + 0.3*day_30_retention_rate, rounded to 2 decimals; null if any input is null. - retention_category by day_30_retention_rate: >=40 Excellent; >=25 Good; >=15 Average; >=5 Poor; if not null and <5 Critical; if null Insufficient Data. - churn_risk_level by the latest unrounded 7-day average churn: >10 High; >5 Medium; >2 Low; if not null and <=2 Minimal; if null Unknown Risk. - Trend and comparisons (retention_trends): - prev_week_day_7_retention = day_7_retention_rate from 7 rows earlier within (package_name, country) ordered by install_date. - prev_month_day_30_retention = day_30_retention_rate from 30 rows earlier within the same partition/order. - retention_trend compares day_7_retention_rate to the 7-row lag: Improving if greater, Declining if less, else Stable (includes cases with null lag or equality). - Final projection and filters: - Output the selected fields. - Derive product_stickiness by thresholds: if day_1>=70 and day_7>=30 Sticky; else if day_1>=50 and day_7>=20 Engaging; else if day_1>=30 and day_7>=10 Standard; else if day_1 not null Struggling; else Insufficient Data. - Derive cohort_lifecycle_stage by days since install_date relative to current_date at execution time: <30 New Cohort; <90 Maturing Cohort; else Mature Cohort. - Keep rows where install_date, package_name, country are not null and cohort_size > 0.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__app_version_report
      description: App version performance by date with installs, uninstalls, crashes/ANRs, ratings, and cumulative metrics per OS version and device
      grain: One row per date_day, package_name, app_version_code, android_os_version, device
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_app_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_app_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_app_version
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Installs: per date, package, app_version_code, android_os_version, device - Ratings: per date, package, app_version_code - Crashes: per date, package, app_version_code, android_os_version - Compute cumulative install totals on the installs input: - total_device_installs: cumulative sum of daily_device_installs by date_day ascending within (package_name, app_version_code) - total_device_uninstalls: cumulative sum of daily_device_uninstalls by date_day ascending within (package_name, app_version_code) - Note: ordering is by date_day only; if multiple rows share the same date_day, the physical/source row order determines evaluation within that day; device and android_os_version are not included in the partition. - Full outer join to unify datasets: - First join installs with ratings on (date_day, package_name, app_version_code) using null-safe comparison by substituting NULL app_version_code with ''null_version'' - Then join crashes on the available date from installs or ratings, plus (package_name, app_version_code, android_os_version), using null-safe comparison by substituting NULL app_version_code with ''null_version'' and NULL android_os_version with ''null_os''; android_os_version is compared as a string; device is not part of any join key. - Output dimensions: - date_day, app_version_code, package_name selected from installs if present, else ratings, else crashes - android_os_version from installs if present else crashes (as string) - device from installs only (NULL if the row originates only from ratings/crashes) - Populate metrics with deterministic null handling: - From installs: active_device_installs → active_devices_last_30_days; all daily device/user/event metrics treat missing values as 0 - From crashes: crashes and anrs treat missing values as 0; values repeat across devices because device is not joined - From ratings: average_rating is the daily average rating (NULL if missing); rolling_total_average_rating is the total-average rating (may be NULL) - Forward-fill selected metrics across dates within (package_name, app_version_code): - For rolling_total_average_rating and each cumulative total, create a segment identifier as the running count of non-NULL values by date_day ascending - Within each segment, carry forward the first observed non-NULL value to subsequent rows; values remain NULL until the first non-NULL appears - Finalize outputs: - total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls are treated as 0 when still missing after forward-fill - net_device_installs = total_device_installs − total_device_uninstalls - No aggregation or de-duplication beyond the joins; duplicates from sources are preserved; original string casing and spacing are preserved'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Selected from installs if present, else ratings, else crashes
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_version_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Taken from whichever source is present; may be NULL; joins substitute NULL with 'null_version'
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier selected from the available source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: android_os_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Android OS version from installs else crashes, compared as strings with 'null_os' used when missing
      - name: device
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Device identifier from installs; NULL when only ratings/crashes data exists
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash count joined by date/package/version/OS; missing values become 0 and values repeat across devices
      - name: anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily ANR count joined by date/package/version/OS; missing values become 0 and values repeat across devices
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating from ratings; NULL if unavailable; range 1–5 when present
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Total-average rating forward-filled by date within (package_name, app_version_code); NULL until the first non-NULL appears
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs by date within (package_name, app_version_code), forward-filled across gaps; missing values become 0; same-day tie order follows source row order
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device uninstalls by date within (package_name, app_version_code), forward-filled across gaps; missing values become 0; same-day tie order follows source row order
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total device installs minus total device uninstalls; may be negative; never NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__comprehensive_performance_dashboard
      description: Daily Google Play app performance combining installs, stability, engagement, retention, revenue, store conversion, risk, and recommended actions.
      grain: One or more rows per date_day and package_name (rows can repeat when multiple countries exist for the same day and app).
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_retention_analysis
      - mart.google_play__overview_report
      business_logic: 'Build user_behavior per date_day, package_name, and country by summing installs, uninstalls, and active devices, averaging churn and weekly installs, and counting distinct countries meeting engagement and growth conditions. Build revenue_performance per date_day and package_name by summing net revenue, transactions, and new subscriptions, averaging transaction value, refund rate, ARPU, and revenue health. Build retention_insights per package_name over the last 30 days by averaging day-1/7/30 retention and retention quality, and counting distinct countries with strong retention or high churn risk. Build overview_base per date_day and package_name by summing installs, uninstalls, crashes, ANRs, store acquisitions, and visitors, and averaging rating. Fully outer join these on date_day and package_name; for each metric, prefer overview_base where applicable, then user_behavior or revenue_performance, and default to 0 when unavailable (except conversion rate). Set default quality_score=75.0, crash_rate_per_1k=0.0, anr_rate_per_1k=0.0, and version_fragmentation=1. Compute store_conversion_rate only when visitors > 0 as acquisitions divided by visitors times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise NULL. Derive business_health_status with tiers: Thriving (installs > 2x uninstalls, quality >= 70, and revenue > 0), Healthy (installs > uninstalls, quality >= 50, and churn <= 0.10), Stable (installs >= uninstalls or quality >= 40), At Risk (quality >= 30), else Critical. Compute overall_performance_score (0–100) by adding points: installs activity (15 if installs > 0), quality (up to 20 by thresholds 80/60/40), rating (up to 15 by thresholds 4.5/4.0/3.5), retention via churn (up to 20 by thresholds 0.05/0.10/0.20), revenue (15 if revenue > 0), and store conversion (up to 15 by thresholds 5/2/1 percent); clamp to 0–100 and round to 2 decimals. Set growth_trend by comparing installs to the value 7 days earlier within the same package: Growing if higher, Declining if lower, else Stable (also Stable when no prior value). Compute install_uninstall_ratio as installs divided by uninstalls rounded to 2 decimals when uninstalls > 0; else NULL. Compute total_issues_per_1k_devices as (crashes + ANRs) per 1,000 active devices rounded to 2 decimals when active devices > 0; else NULL. Left join retention_insights by package_name so the same package-level 30-day averages apply to all dates. In the final output, round: quality_score to 1 decimal; average_rating to 2 decimals; crash and ANR rates per 1k to 2 decimals; daily_churn_rate to 4 decimals; day-1/7/30 retention to 1 decimal; daily_net_revenue to 2 decimals; avg_transaction_value to 2 decimals; refund_rate to 4 decimals; ARPU to 2 decimals; revenue_health_score to 1 decimal; overall_performance_score to 2 decimals; store_conversion_rate is already rounded to 2 decimals. Set primary_risk_flag with priority: Stability Risk (high crash/ANR rates), Retention Risk (high churn), Revenue Risk (high refunds), Performance Risk (low score), else Low Risk. Set recommended_action from the score: Optimize and Scale (>=80), Improve Quality (>=60), Focus on Retention (>=40), else Critical Review Required. Exclude rows where date_day or package_name is NULL and sort by date_day descending, then by overall_performance_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        description: Calendar date of the metrics; rows with NULL are excluded.
      - name: package_name
        description: Android app package identifier; rows with NULL are excluded.
      - name: daily_installs
        description: Device installs for the day, preferring overview data, else user_behavior totals; defaults to 0.
      - name: daily_uninstalls
        description: Device uninstalls for the day, preferring overview data, else user_behavior totals; defaults to 0.
      - name: active_devices
        description: Active devices from user_behavior; defaults to 0 when unavailable.
      - name: daily_crashes
        description: Crash count from overview; defaults to 0.
      - name: daily_anrs
        description: ANR count from overview; defaults to 0.
      - name: quality_score
        description: Default quality score set to 75.0 and rounded to 1 decimal.
      - name: average_rating
        description: Average store rating from overview, rounded to 2 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: crash_rate_per_1k_devices
        description: Crashes per 1,000 active devices; currently defaults to 0.00 and is rounded to 2 decimals.
      - name: anr_rate_per_1k_devices
        description: ANRs per 1,000 active devices; currently defaults to 0.00 and is rounded to 2 decimals.
      - name: version_fragmentation
        description: Default value set to 1.
      - name: daily_churn_rate
        description: Average churn rate from user_behavior, rounded to 4 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: high_engagement_markets
        description: Count of distinct countries classified as High Engagement for the day; defaults to 0.
      - name: accelerating_markets
        description: Count of distinct countries with Accelerating growth momentum for the day; defaults to 0.
      - name: day_1_retention_rate
        description: Average day-1 retention over the last 30 days per package, rounded to 1 decimal.
      - name: day_7_retention_rate
        description: Average day-7 retention over the last 30 days per package, rounded to 1 decimal.
      - name: day_30_retention_rate
        description: Average day-30 retention over the last 30 days per package, rounded to 1 decimal.
      - name: strong_retention_markets
        description: Distinct countries with Excellent/Good retention over the last 30 days.
      - name: high_churn_markets
        description: Distinct countries flagged High Churn Risk over the last 30 days.
      - name: daily_net_revenue
        description: Total net revenue for the day from revenue analytics, rounded to 2 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: daily_transactions
        description: Total paying transactions for the day; defaults to 0.
      - name: avg_transaction_value
        description: Average transaction value, rounded to 2 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: refund_rate
        description: Average refund rate, rounded to 4 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: new_subscriptions
        description: New subscriptions started on the day; defaults to 0.
      - name: average_revenue_per_user
        description: Average revenue per user (ARPU), rounded to 2 decimals; defaults to 0.
      - name: revenue_health_score
        description: Average revenue health score, rounded to 1 decimal; defaults to 0.
      - name: store_acquisitions
        description: Store listing acquisitions from overview; defaults to 0.
      - name: store_visitors
        description: Store listing visitors from overview; defaults to 0.
      - name: store_conversion_rate
        description: If visitors > 0, acquisitions divided by visitors times 100 rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise NULL.
      - name: business_health_status
        description: 'Tiered status from installs vs uninstalls, quality, churn, and revenue: Thriving, Healthy, Stable, At Risk, or Critical.'
      - name: overall_performance_score
        description: 0–100 score from weighted components (installs, quality, rating, retention via churn, revenue, store conversion), clamped and rounded to 2 decimals.
      - name: growth_trend
        description: Growing, Declining, or Stable based on installs versus the value 7 days earlier within the same package.
      - name: install_uninstall_ratio
        description: Installs divided by uninstalls rounded to 2 decimals when uninstalls > 0; otherwise NULL.
      - name: total_issues_per_1k_devices
        description: Crashes plus ANRs per 1,000 active devices rounded to 2 decimals when active devices > 0; otherwise NULL.
      - name: primary_risk_flag
        description: 'Risk priority based on thresholds: Stability, Retention, Revenue, or Performance; Low Risk if none apply.'
      - name: recommended_action
        description: 'Action based on overall_performance_score: Optimize and Scale (>=80), Improve Quality (>=60), Focus on Retention (>=40), else Critical Review Required.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__country_report
      description: Country-level performance metrics by package and day, joined across installs, ratings, and store performance and enriched with country metadata
      grain: One row per package_name per country_short per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__store_performance_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Load installs, ratings, store_performance, and country_codes staging tables. - From installs: compute running cumulative device installs and uninstalls per (country, package_name) across ascending dates. - From store_performance: compute running cumulative store listing installers and visitors per (country, package_name) across ascending dates. - Full outer join installs and ratings on matching date_day and package_name; match country null-safe by treating missing country codes as a shared placeholder so missing values match each other. - Full outer join store_performance to the combined result using the available date_day, package_name, and null-safe country from either side. - Build daily fields on the joined rows: - For daily counts (device_installs, device_uninstalls, device_upgrades, user_installs, user_uninstalls, install_events, uninstall_events, update_events, store_listing_acquisitions, store_listing_visitors, active_devices_last_30_days) replace missing values with 0. - Pass through store_listing_conversion_rate as provided (may be missing). - Pass through ratings.daily_average_rating and ratings.total_average_rating (may be missing). - Forward-fill cumulative totals and rolling_total_average_rating: - For each country and package, segment the timeline by each new non-missing occurrence of the cumulative field. - Within each segment, carry the most recently observed non-missing value forward to later days; values remain missing before the first observation. - Enrich with country metadata: - Left join country_codes on ISO alpha-2; set country_long to alternative name when available, otherwise the standard name; include region and sub_region. - Final computations: - Replace any remaining missing cumulative totals (device installs/uninstalls, store acquisitions/visitors) with 0. - rolling_store_conversion_rate = cumulative installers divided by cumulative visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; result is NULL when visitors is zero or missing. - net_device_installs = cumulative device installs minus cumulative device uninstalls.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date resolved from any joined source; used to order window calculations
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier; join key across sources; may be NULL if missing in all sources
      - name: country_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from sources; may be NULL if absent; used for partitioning and country enrichment
      - name: country_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country display name from codes, preferring the alternative name when available; NULL if no code match
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country codes; NULL if no code match
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country codes; NULL if no code match
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install events from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall events from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update events from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: store_listing_acquisitions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Daily installers from store listing; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: store_listing_visitors
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Daily visitors to the store listing; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: store_listing_conversion_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily store listing conversion rate from store_performance; passed through as is; may be NULL
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; missing values replaced with 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating from ratings; may be NULL; typical range 1.000–5.000
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Forward-filled cumulative average rating; NULL until first observed, then carried forward by date
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Forward-filled running total of device installs per (country, package); set to 0 in final output when missing
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Forward-filled running total of device uninstalls per (country, package); set to 0 in final output when missing
      - name: total_store_acquisitions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Forward-filled running total of store listing installers per (country, package); set to 0 in final output when missing
      - name: total_store_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Forward-filled running total of store listing visitors per (country, package); set to 0 in final output when missing
      - name: rolling_store_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative installers divided by cumulative visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when visitors is zero or missing
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs minus cumulative device uninstalls; uses 0 when missing; may be negative

- name: google_play__device_report
      description: Device-level daily performance joined from installs and ratings with forward-filled cumulative totals.
      grain: Rows per package_name, device, date_day from the full outer join; duplicates may exist if sources contain duplicates.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_device
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_device
      business_logic: '- Read installs and ratings from their staging sources. - In installs, compute running totals by device and package_name ordered by date_day ascending: - total_device_installs accumulates daily_device_installs. - total_device_uninstalls accumulates daily_device_uninstalls. - Full outer join installs and ratings on date_day and package_name, and match device values treating NULLs as equal; choose date_day, device, and package_name from the non-NULL side. - Set daily install/user/event metrics and active_devices_last_30_days to 0 when missing; keep ratings as provided: - average_rating comes from the daily rating. - rolling_total_average_rating comes from the life-to-date rating on that day. - Forward-fill within each device and package_name over ascending date_day: - Carry the latest non-NULL rolling_total_average_rating forward; it remains NULL until the first non-NULL appears. - Carry the latest non-NULL total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls forward. - Finalize: - Replace remaining NULLs in total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls with 0. - Compute net_device_installs as total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls. - Notes: - All running and forward-fill operations are ordered by date_day ascending. - No de-duplication is performed; if sources contain multiple rows for the same keys and date, all are retained.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date used to align and order metrics.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: device
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Device identifier chosen from installs or ratings; may be NULL only if missing in both sources.
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier chosen from installs or ratings.
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - device_installs >= 0
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - device_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - device_upgrades >= 0
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - user_installs >= 0
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - user_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install events from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - install_events >= 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall events from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - uninstall_events >= 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update events from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - update_events >= 0
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; NULLs are set to 0.
        tests:
        - active_devices_last_30_days >= 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating from ratings; may be NULL when no rating is reported.
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Life-to-date average rating forward-filled within device+package by ascending date; NULL until the first non-NULL.
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs within device+package ordered by date, forward-filled, then set to 0 when still missing.
        tests:
        - total_device_installs >= 0
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device uninstalls within device+package ordered by date, forward-filled, then set to 0 when still missing.
        tests:
        - total_device_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Difference of cumulative installs and uninstalls after null-to-zero handling; may be negative.

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__finance_report
      description: Daily Google Play earnings and subscription activity, fully outer-joined and enriched with product and country metadata.
      grain: One row per (date_day, package_name, country_short, sku_id); source duplicates are preserved and may multiply across the join.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__earnings
      - staging.stg_google_play__subscriptions_country
      - intermediate.int_google_play__latest_product_info
      - staging.stg_google_play__country_codes
      business_logic: 'Inputs: - Earnings: intermediate.int_google_play__earnings (monetary amounts and transaction counts, merchant_currency). - Subscriptions: staging.stg_google_play__subscriptions_country (new, cancelled, active by country). - Product metadata: intermediate.int_google_play__latest_product_info (title by package_name and sku_id). - Country metadata: staging.stg_google_play__country_codes (names, region, sub_region by ISO alpha-2). Steps: - Join earnings and subscriptions with a full outer join on date_day, package_name, SKU (earnings.sku_id = subscriptions.product_id), and country code; null country codes are treated as equal between the two sources for matching (a temporary placeholder is used only for join matching and never appears in outputs). - For each output row, choose identifiers as follows: - date_day: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - country_short: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - package_name: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - sku_id: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - merchant_currency: taken from earnings (subscriptions do not supply currency). - Metric null handling: - Earnings metrics (net_amount, transactions, charge_amount, charge_transactions, refund_amount, refund_transactions, other_amount, other_transactions): if missing, output 0; amounts use merchant_currency; signs are preserved; no additional rounding beyond source precision (3 decimal places). - Subscription flow metrics (new_subscriptions, cancelled_subscriptions): if missing, output 0. - Active subscriptions forward-fill: - For each (country_short, sku_id), sort rows by date_day ascending. - When a non-null active count appears, carry that value forward to later days until another non-null value replaces it. - Days before the first non-null active count remain unset during filling and are finally output as 0. - Enrichment: - Left join product metadata by (package_name, sku_id) to add product_title. - Left join country metadata by country_short to add country_long (alternative name when available, else standard name), region, and sub_region. - No aggregation or de-duplication is applied; output row order is not enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null.
      - name: country_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join country metadata.
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join product metadata.
      - name: sku_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product SKU from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join product metadata.
      - name: merchant_currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency code sourced from earnings; may be null; unit for all amount columns.
      - name: net_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Net amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: charge_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Charge amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: charge_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Charge transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: refund_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Refund amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: refund_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Refund transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: other_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Other amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: other_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Other transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: new_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: New subscriptions from the subscriptions source; missing values output as 0.
      - name: cancelled_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Cancelled subscriptions from the subscriptions source; missing values output as 0.
      - name: total_active_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active subscriptions after forward-filling within (country_short, sku_id) by ascending date; if no prior non-null exists on a date, output 0.
      - name: product_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product title from product metadata joined by (package_name, sku_id); null if no match.
      - name: country_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country name from country metadata by country_short using alternative name when available, else standard name; null if no match.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country metadata joined by country_short; null if no match.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country metadata joined by country_short; null if no match.

Steps: - Join earnings and subscriptions with a full outer join on date_day, package_name, SKU (earnings.sku_id = subscriptions.product_id), and country code; null country codes are treated as equal between the two sources for matching (a temporary placeholder is used only for join matching and never appears in outputs). - For each output row, choose identifiers as follows: - date_day: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - country_short: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - package_name: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - sku_id: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - merchant_currency: taken from earnings (subscriptions do not supply currency). - Metric null handling: - Earnings metrics (net_amount, transactions, charge_amount, charge_transactions, refund_amount, refund_transactions, other_amount, other_transactions): if missing, output 0; amounts use merchant_currency; signs are preserved; no additional rounding beyond source precision (3 decimal places). - Subscription flow metrics (new_subscriptions, cancelled_subscriptions): if missing, output 0. - Active subscriptions forward-fill: - For each (country_short, sku_id), sort rows by date_day ascending. - When a non-null active count appears, carry that value forward to later days until another non-null value replaces it. - Days before the first non-null active count remain unset during filling and are finally output as 0. - Enrichment: - Left join product metadata by (package_name, sku_id) to add product_title. - Left join country metadata by country_short to add country_long (alternative name when available, else standard name), region, and sub_region. - No aggregation or de-duplication is applied; output row order is not enforced.'
