blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__geo_market_analysis
      description: Geo market summary per app-country over the last 30 days combining behavior, revenue, retention, store performance, default quality, and derived market scoring/classification
      grain: One row per package_name + country with positive avg_active_devices in the last 30 days
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_retention_analysis
      - intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance
      - staging.stg_google_play__country_codes
      business_logic: 'Time window and base: - Use last 30 days relative to current_date for all aggregations. - Build user_behavior_geo (from intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics): - Group by package_name, country. - Compute arithmetic averages: daily_device_installs, daily_device_uninstalls, active_device_installs, daily_churn_rate, avg_7d_device_installs, avg_30d_device_installs, weekly_install_growth_rate. - Compute modes via mode() within group (order by <value>) for: user_engagement_level, growth_momentum, market_maturity. Determinism: returns the most frequent non-NULL value; ties resolved by ascending order of the value; returns NULL if all values are NULL. - Count distinct date_day as active_days. - Build revenue_geo (from intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics): - Filter date_day to last 30 days and daily_net_revenue > 0. - Group by package_name, buyer_country as country. - Aggregate: sum(daily_net_revenue) as total_revenue_30d; avg(daily_net_revenue) as avg_daily_revenue; sum(daily_paying_transactions) as total_transactions_30d; avg(average_transaction_value) as avg_transaction_value; avg(refund_rate) as avg_refund_rate; sum(new_subscriptions) as total_new_subscriptions; avg(total_active_subscriptions) as avg_active_subscriptions; avg(arpu_daily) as avg_arpu; avg(revenue_health_score) as avg_revenue_health; mode() within group (order by revenue_tier) as dominant_revenue_tier; count distinct date_day as revenue_days. - Build retention_geo (from intermediate.int_google_play__user_retention_analysis): - Filter install_date to last 30 days. - Group by package_name, country. - Aggregate averages: day_1_retention_rate, day_7_retention_rate, day_30_retention_rate, retention_quality_score, current_avg_7d_churn_rate. - Modes with same determinism as above: retention_category, churn_risk_level, product_stickiness. - Count distinct install_date as cohort_count. - Build store_performance_geo (from intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance): - Filter date_day to last 30 days and performance_type = ''country''. - Group by package_name, country. - Aggregate: sum(store_listing_visitors) as total_store_visitors; sum(store_listing_installers) as total_store_installs; avg(store_listing_conversion_rate) as avg_store_conversion_rate; count distinct date_day as store_active_days. - Country metadata (from staging.stg_google_play__country_codes): select country_code_alpha_2 and coalesce(alternative_country_name, country_name) as country_name, plus region, sub_region. Join and defaults: - Start from user_behavior_geo (required presence). - Left join country codes on country = country_code_alpha_2. - Left join revenue_geo, retention_geo, and store_performance_geo on (package_name, country). - Apply defaults via COALESCE: - Revenue metrics: total_revenue_30d, avg_daily_revenue, avg_transaction_value, avg_refund_rate, avg_arpu default to 0; revenue_tier defaults to ''No Revenue''. - Retention: avg_day_1_retention, avg_day_7_retention, avg_day_30_retention default to 0; retention_category defaults to ''Unknown''; churn_risk_level defaults to ''Unknown Risk''; product_stickiness defaults to ''Unknown''. - Store performance: total_store_visitors, total_store_installs default to 0; avg_store_conversion_rate defaults to 0. - Quality metrics are set to constants: app_quality_score = 75.0; app_crash_rate = 0.0; app_quality_category = ''Good''. Scoring: - market_size_score from avg_active_devices: >=10000→5; >=5000→4; >=1000→3; >=100→2; else 1. - revenue_opportunity_score from avg_daily_revenue: >=100→5; >=50→4; >=10→3; >=1→2; >0→1; else 0. - growth_potential_score from avg_growth_rate: >0.2→5; >0.1→4; >0.05→3; >0→2; ≥-0.05→1; else 0 (NULL compares false and falls to else 0). - user_quality_score from avg_day_30_retention: ≥40→5; ≥25→4; ≥15→3; ≥10→2; >0→1; else 0. - store_performance_score from avg_store_conversion_rate: ≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥2→3; ≥1→2; >0→1; else 0. Overall score and classifications: - overall_market_score = round(0.25*market_size_score + 0.25*revenue_opportunity_score + 0.20*growth_potential_score + 0.20*user_quality_score + 0.10*store_performance_score, 2). - market_tier uses the unrounded weighted sum (same coefficients): ≥4.0 → ''Tier 1 - Strategic''; ≥3.0 → ''Tier 2 - Important''; ≥2.0 → ''Tier 3 - Develop''; ≥1.0 → ''Tier 4 - Monitor''; else ''Tier 5 - Low Priority''. - investment_recommendation (first-match wins): - revenue_opportunity_score ≥ 4 and growth_potential_score ≥ 3 → ''High Investment''; - else market_size_score ≥ 4 and user_quality_score ≥ 3 → ''Medium Investment''; - else growth_potential_score ≥ 4 → ''Growth Investment''; - else (market_size_score ≥ 3 or revenue_opportunity_score ≥ 3) → ''Selective Investment''; - else ''Maintain Current Level''. - opportunity_type (first-match wins): - market_maturity_level = ''Emerging Market'' and growth_potential_score ≥ 3 → ''High Growth Opportunity''; - else revenue_opportunity_score ≥ 4 and user_quality_score ≥ 3 → ''Revenue Optimization''; - else market_size_score ≥ 4 and avg_churn_rate > 0.1 → ''Retention Focus''; - else store_performance_score ≤ 2 and market_size_score ≥ 3 → ''Acquisition Focus''; - else ''Stable Operation''. - market_insight (first-match wins): - avg_growth_rate > 0.1 and avg_day_7_retention > 20 → ''High Growth + Strong Retention''; - else total_revenue_30d > 1000 and avg_arpu > 1 → ''High Value Market''; - else avg_active_devices > 5000 and avg_churn_rate < 0.05 → ''Large Stable Market''; - else market_maturity_level = ''Emerging Market'' and avg_growth_rate > 0.05 → ''Emerging Opportunity''; - else avg_store_conversion_rate < 1 and avg_active_devices > 1000 → ''Acquisition Challenge''; - else ''Standard Performance''. Final projection and transformations: - Round using DuckDB round(): avg_daily_installs (0), avg_active_devices (0), weekly_growth_rate from avg_growth_rate (4), revenue_last_30_days from total_revenue_30d (2), avg_daily_revenue (2), avg_transaction_value (2), average_revenue_per_user from avg_arpu (2), day_1/7/30_retention_rate (1), daily_churn_rate from avg_churn_rate (4), store_conversion_rate (2), app_quality_score (1), app_crash_rate_per_1k from app_crash_rate (2), overall_market_score (2). - Filter rows where avg_active_devices > 0. - Sort by overall_market_score DESC, then total_revenue_30d DESC (sorting does not affect row content).'
      columns:
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier; grouping key (one row per package_name+country)
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country code from user behavior (two-letter when available) used to join country metadata
      - name: country_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved country name from country codes (alternative_country_name else country_name); NULL if no match
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country codes for the given country; NULL if no match
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country codes for the given country; NULL if no match
      - name: avg_daily_installs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily installs over last 30 days rounded to 0 decimals using DuckDB round(); NULL if upstream average is NULL
      - name: avg_active_devices
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average active devices over last 30 days rounded to 0 decimals; strictly > 0 due to final filter
      - name: weekly_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average weekly install growth rate over last 30 days rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if missing
      - name: market_maturity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of market_maturity over the window; ties resolved by ascending value; NULL if all values are NULL
      - name: dominant_engagement_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of user_engagement_level over the window; ties resolved by ascending value; NULL if all values are NULL
      - name: dominant_growth_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of growth_momentum over the window; ties resolved by ascending value; NULL if all values are NULL
      - name: revenue_last_30_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of daily_net_revenue over last 30 days (only days with revenue > 0), defaulted to 0 and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: avg_daily_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_net_revenue on days with revenue > 0 over last 30 days, defaulted to 0 and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: avg_transaction_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average transaction value on days with revenue > 0 over last 30 days, defaulted to 0 and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: average_revenue_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ARPU on days with revenue > 0 over last 30 days, defaulted to 0 and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of revenue_tier over last 30 days (days with revenue > 0); defaults to 'No Revenue' if none
      - name: day_1_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average 1-day retention over last 30 days rounded to 1 decimal; defaults to 0 if missing
      - name: day_7_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average 7-day retention over last 30 days rounded to 1 decimal; defaults to 0 if missing
      - name: day_30_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average 30-day retention over last 30 days rounded to 1 decimal; defaults to 0 if missing
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of retention_category over last 30 days; defaults to 'Unknown' if none
      - name: product_stickiness
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of product_stickiness over last 30 days; defaults to 'Unknown' if none
      - name: daily_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily churn rate over last 30 days rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if upstream values are all NULL
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mode of churn_risk_level over last 30 days; defaults to 'Unknown Risk' if none
      - name: store_visitors_30d
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total store listing visitors over last 30 days (performance_type='country'); defaults to 0
      - name: store_installs_30d
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total store listing installers over last 30 days (performance_type='country'); defaults to 0
      - name: store_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average store listing conversion rate over last 30 days (performance_type='country') rounded to 2 decimals; defaults to 0
      - name: app_quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant placeholder 75.0 rounded to 1 decimal for all rows
      - name: app_quality_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant placeholder 'Good' for all rows
      - name: app_crash_rate_per_1k
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant placeholder 0.0 crashes per 1k devices rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: overall_market_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(17,2)
        description: Weighted average of component scores (0.25,0.25,0.20,0.20,0.10) rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: market_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from unrounded weighted sum: ≥4.0 Tier 1 - Strategic; ≥3.0 Tier 2 - Important; ≥2.0 Tier 3 - Develop; ≥1.0 Tier 4 - Monitor; else Tier 5 - Low Priority'
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match classification: High Investment, Medium Investment, Growth Investment, Selective Investment, or Maintain Current Level per score thresholds'
      - name: opportunity_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match classification: High Growth Opportunity, Revenue Optimization, Retention Focus, Acquisition Focus, or Stable Operation per conditions'
      - name: market_size_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by avg_active_devices: ≥10000→5, ≥5000→4, ≥1000→3, ≥100→2, else 1'
      - name: revenue_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by avg_daily_revenue: ≥100→5, ≥50→4, ≥10→3, ≥1→2, >0→1, else 0'
      - name: growth_potential_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by avg_growth_rate: >0.2→5, >0.1→4, >0.05→3, >0→2, ≥-0.05→1, else 0'
      - name: user_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by avg_day_30_retention: ≥40→5, ≥25→4, ≥15→3, ≥10→2, >0→1, else 0'
      - name: store_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by avg_store_conversion_rate: ≥10→5, ≥5→4, ≥2→3, ≥1→2, >0→1, else 0'
      - name: market_insight
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match insight: High Growth + Strong Retention, High Value Market, Large Stable Market, Emerging Opportunity, Acquisition Challenge, or Standard Performance'

Join and defaults: - Start from user_behavior_geo (required presence). - Left join country codes on country = country_code_alpha_2. - Left join revenue_geo, retention_geo, and store_performance_geo on (package_name, country). - Apply defaults via COALESCE: - Revenue metrics: total_revenue_30d, avg_daily_revenue, avg_transaction_value, avg_refund_rate, avg_arpu default to 0; revenue_tier defaults to ''No Revenue''. - Retention: avg_day_1_retention, avg_day_7_retention, avg_day_30_retention default to 0; retention_category defaults to ''Unknown''; churn_risk_level defaults to ''Unknown Risk''; product_stickiness defaults to ''Unknown''. - Store performance: total_store_visitors, total_store_installs default to 0; avg_store_conversion_rate defaults to 0. - Quality metrics are set to constants: app_quality_score = 75.0; app_crash_rate = 0.0; app_quality_category = ''Good''. blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__os_version_report
      description: Daily Google Play metrics by package and Android OS version with installs, events, crashes, ratings, and cumulative totals
      grain: One row per package_name, android_os_version, date_day (emitted when any source has data)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_os_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_os_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_os_version
      business_logic: '- Source tables: installs, ratings, and crashes at a daily, package, and Android OS version level. - In installs, compute running cumulative totals of device installs and device uninstalls per package_name and android_os_version, ordered by date_day ascending and inclusive of the current day. - Full outer join installs, ratings, and crashes on date_day, package_name, and android_os_version: - For join equality only, treat NULL android_os_version as the placeholder ''null_os'' to align NULLs across sources. - Output keys (date_day, package_name, android_os_version) are the coalesced values across sources; if all are NULL for a key, the output remains NULL. - Rows are emitted when any source has data; duplicates in sources are not deduplicated. - Null handling: - Device/user counts, event counts, crashes, ANRs, and active devices are set to 0 when missing from their source. - average_rating and rolling_total_average_rating from ratings remain nullable. - Forward-fill within each package_name and android_os_version, ordered by date_day ascending: - Carry the most recent non-NULL value forward for rolling_total_average_rating, total_device_installs, and total_device_uninstalls. - Leading periods before the first non-NULL value remain NULL. - After forward-fill, total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls are set to 0 where still NULL; rolling_total_average_rating remains nullable. - Final calculation: - net_device_installs equals total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls. - All windowed operations are ordered by date_day ascending and partitioned by package_name and android_os_version.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date coalesced from sources; one row per date per package and OS version when any source has data.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: android_os_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Android OS version coalesced from sources; may be NULL when NULL in all; NULLs matched across sources using 'null_os' only for join equality.
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier coalesced from sources.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - device_installs >= 0
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - device_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - device_upgrades >= 0
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - user_installs >= 0
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - user_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install events from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - install_events >= 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall events from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - uninstall_events >= 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update events from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - update_events >= 0
      - name: crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash count from crashes; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - crashes >= 0
      - name: anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily ANR count from crashes; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - anrs >= 0
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; set to 0 when missing.
        tests:
        - active_devices_last_30_days >= 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating from ratings; nullable.
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Total average rating from ratings forward-filled by date within each package and OS; leading gaps remain NULL.
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of device installs within each package and OS ordered by date, forward-filled across later dates without installs, then set to 0 where still NULL; includes the current date.
        tests:
        - total_device_installs >= 0
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of device uninstalls within each package and OS ordered by date, forward-filled across later dates without uninstalls, then set to 0 where still NULL; includes the current date.
        tests:
        - total_device_uninstalls >= 0
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls after forward-fill and zero-fill; may be negative.

- name: google_play__overview_report
      description: Daily Google Play performance overview per app combining installs, events, store listing, crashes/ANRs, and ratings
      grain: One row per package_name per date_day present in any source
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_overview
      - intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance
      business_logic: '- Aggregate store performance: - Filter intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance to performance_type = ''country''. - For each (date_day, package_name), sum visitors and installers; take the simple (unweighted) average of conversion rate, ignoring missing values. - Compute running totals for installs: - For each package_name ordered by date_day ascending, compute cumulative totals of daily_device_installs and daily_device_uninstalls. - Combine sources: - Full outer join installs (with running totals), ratings, store_performance (aggregated), and crashes on (date_day, package_name). - When date or package is missing in a source, choose the first available from installs, then ratings, then store_performance, then crashes. - Set missing counts to 0 for device/user installs, uninstalls, upgrades; install/uninstall/update events; crashes; ANRs; active devices; store installers and visitors. Leave store listing conversion rate and daily average rating as NULL if absent. - Forward-fill selected metrics by app: - Within each package_name ordered by date_day, carry forward the latest non-null values for total average rating, cumulative device installs, and cumulative device uninstalls; before the first non-null appears, these remain NULL. - Final calculations: - Default total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls to 0 in the output. - rolling_store_conversion_rate = acquisitions divided by visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; return NULL when visitors is 0. - net_device_installs = total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls. - Output one row per (package_name, date_day).'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date chosen from the first available among installs, ratings, store performance, and crashes in that order
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App package identifier chosen from the first available among installs, ratings, store performance, and crashes in that order
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash events; missing values set to 0; per app per day
      - name: anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily ANR events; missing values set to 0; per app per day
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: store_listing_acquisitions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of store installers across country rows per day and app; defaults to 0 when store performance is absent
      - name: store_listing_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of store visitors across country rows per day and app; defaults to 0 when store performance is absent
      - name: store_listing_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of store listing conversion rate across country rows per day and app; NULL when no rows; no rounding applied
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; missing values set to 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating; may be NULL; three-decimal precision
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Forward-filled total average rating per app ordered by date; remains NULL until the first non-null appears
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs per app ordered by date; forward-filled across days without install data; defaults to 0 in output
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device uninstalls per app ordered by date; forward-filled across days without install data; defaults to 0 in output
      - name: rolling_store_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Acquisitions divided by visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; returns NULL when visitors equals 0
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total device installs minus total device uninstalls after defaulting NULLs to 0

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__product_portfolio_analysis
      description: Strategic 30-day portfolio metrics and classifications per app with BCG-style scoring and investment guidance.
      grain: One row per package_name with activity in any source within the last 30 days
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_retention_analysis
      business_logic: 'Window and grain: - Use the last 30 days of data per source: revenue_analytics and user_behavior_metrics filter by date_day; user_retention_analysis filters by install_date. - Produce one row per package_name present in any source during the window (full outer join on package_name), then exclude NULL package_name. Revenue_by_app (from int_google_play__revenue_analytics): - Group by package_name and compute: - total_products = distinct SKU count. - total_revenue_30d = sum of daily_net_revenue. - avg_daily_revenue = average of daily_net_revenue. - total_transactions_30d = sum of daily_paying_transactions (not used in final output). - avg_transaction_value = average of average_transaction_value. - avg_refund_rate = average refund_rate (not used). - total_new_subscriptions = sum of new_subscriptions (not used). - avg_arpu = average of arpu_daily. - avg_revenue_health = average revenue_health_score (not used). - revenue_countries = distinct buyer_country count. User_engagement_by_app (from int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics): - Group by package_name and compute: - total_installs_30d = sum of daily_device_installs. - total_uninstalls_30d = sum of daily_device_uninstalls (used for user_base_trend only). - avg_active_devices = average of active_device_installs. - avg_churn_rate = average of daily_churn_rate. - avg_weekly_installs = average of avg_7d_device_installs (not used in final output). - avg_install_growth_rate = average of weekly_install_growth_rate. - high_engagement_markets = distinct country count where user_engagement_level = ''High Engagement''. - total_markets = distinct country count. Retention_by_app (from int_google_play__user_retention_analysis): - Group by package_name and compute: - avg_day_1_retention = average of day_1_retention_rate (not selected). - avg_day_7_retention = average of day_7_retention_rate. - avg_day_30_retention = average of day_30_retention_rate. - avg_retention_quality = average retention_quality_score (not selected). - strong_retention_markets = distinct country count where retention_category in (''Excellent Retention'',''Good Retention''). Join and null policy: - Full outer join the three rollups on package_name; package_name is the coalesced key across sources. - For all numeric measures from sources, replace NULL with 0 before downstream logic; then filter out NULL package_name rows. Default quality metrics: - Use a constant quality baseline: avg_quality_score = 75.0; avg_crash_rate = 0.0; avg_anr_rate = 0.0 (crash/anr not selected). Scoring and classification: - revenue_score (0–100) from total_revenue_30d thresholds: ≥10000→100; ≥5000→85; ≥1000→70; ≥100→50; ≥10→30; >0→15; else 0. - engagement_score = sum of three components, capped at 100, rounded to 2 decimals, then stored as integer (fraction dropped): - Active devices: ≥50000→40; ≥10000→30; ≥1000→20; ≥100→10; else 0. - Install growth rate: >0.10→30; >0.05→20; >0→10; else 0. - Churn rate: ≤0.05→30; ≤0.10→20; ≤0.20→10; else 0. - portfolio_type from total_products: ≥5 Diversified Portfolio; ≥3 Multi-Product; =2 Dual Product; =1 Single Product; else No Products. Strategic metrics: - portfolio_health_score = weighted sum of revenue_score (40%), engagement_score (30%), and the quality baseline value 75.0 (30%), rounded to 2 decimals. - bcg_matrix_category (first-match order): combined score ≥80 Star Performer; ≥65 Cash Cow; engagement_score ≥70 and avg_install_growth_rate > 0.05 Rising Star; revenue_score ≥50 and quality baseline < 50 Problem Child; combined score ≥40 Question Mark; else Dog. - investment_priority (first-match order): combined score ≥80 Invest & Expand; engagement_score ≥70 and avg_install_growth_rate > 0.05 Invest for Growth; revenue_score ≥70 and quality baseline ≥60 Maintain & Optimize; quality baseline < 40 Fix Quality Issues; combined score ≥40 Selective Investment; else Divest or Redesign. Final projections, rounding, and ordering: - Apply rounding: total_revenue_30d 2 decimals; avg_daily_revenue 2; avg_active_devices 0; avg_transaction_value 2; average_revenue_per_user 2; day_7_retention_rate 1; day_30_retention_rate 1; daily_churn_rate 4; quality_score 1. - user_base_trend from 30-day totals: installs > 2× uninstalls → Growing; installs > uninstalls → Stable; else Declining. - growth_stage from avg_install_growth_rate: >0.10 High Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >0 Slow Growth; else Declining. - Distinct country counts are within the 30-day window and exclude NULL countries; numeric outputs are 0 when inputs are NULL. - Sort the final output by portfolio_health_score descending, then by total 30-day revenue descending.'
      columns:
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier; one output row per package_name.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: total_products
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct SKU count per app over the last 30 days; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - total_products >= 0
      - name: portfolio_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on total_products: ≥5 Diversified Portfolio; ≥3 Multi-Product; =2 Dual Product; =1 Single Product; else No Products.'
      - name: total_revenue_30d
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of daily revenue over the last 30 days, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - total_revenue_30d >= 0
      - name: avg_daily_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily revenue over the last 30 days, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - avg_daily_revenue >= 0
      - name: total_installs_30d
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of device installs over the last 30 days; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - total_installs_30d >= 0
      - name: avg_active_devices
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average active devices over the last 30 days, rounded to 0 decimals; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - avg_active_devices >= 0
      - name: total_markets
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct countries from user behavior in the last 30 days; NULL countries excluded; NULL totals as 0.
        tests:
        - total_markets >= 0
      - name: avg_transaction_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average transaction value over the last 30 days, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - avg_transaction_value >= 0
      - name: average_revenue_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily ARPU over the last 30 days, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - average_revenue_per_user >= 0
      - name: day_7_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average 7-day retention over the last 30 days, rounded to 1 decimal (percentage); NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - day_7_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_7_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: day_30_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average 30-day retention over the last 30 days, rounded to 1 decimal (percentage); NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - day_30_retention_rate >= 0
        - day_30_retention_rate <= 100
      - name: daily_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily churn rate over the last 30 days, rounded to 4 decimals (fraction 0–1); NULL treated as 0.
        tests:
        - daily_churn_rate >= 0
        - daily_churn_rate <= 1
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant quality baseline of 75.0, rounded to 1 decimal.
        tests:
        - quality_score >= 0
        - quality_score <= 100
      - name: revenue_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Bucketed by 30-day revenue: ≥10000=100, ≥5000=85, ≥1000=70, ≥100=50, ≥10=30, >0=15, else 0.'
        tests:
        - revenue_score >= 0
      - name: engagement_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of device, growth, and churn components capped at 100, rounded to 2 decimals then stored as integer (fraction dropped).
        tests:
        - engagement_score >= 0
      - name: portfolio_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Weighted sum of revenue_score (40%), engagement_score (30%), and the 75.0 quality value (30%), rounded to 2 decimals.
        tests:
        - portfolio_health_score >= 0
      - name: bcg_matrix_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Strategic category by ordered rules: Star Performer, Cash Cow, Rising Star, Problem Child, Question Mark, Dog.'
      - name: investment_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority by ordered rules: Invest & Expand, Invest for Growth, Maintain & Optimize, Fix Quality Issues, Selective Investment, Divest or Redesign.'
      - name: user_base_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'From 30-day totals: installs > 2× uninstalls → Growing; installs > uninstalls → Stable; else Declining.'
      - name: growth_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'From avg_install_growth_rate: >0.10 High Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >0 Slow Growth; else Declining.'
      - name: high_engagement_markets
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct countries with user_engagement_level='High Engagement' in the last 30 days; NULL countries excluded; NULL totals as 0.
        tests:
        - high_engagement_markets >= 0
      - name: strong_retention_markets
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct countries with retention_category in ('Excellent Retention','Good Retention') in the last 30 days; NULL countries excluded; NULL totals as 0.
        tests:
        - strong_retention_markets >= 0
      - name: revenue_countries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct buyer countries contributing revenue in the last 30 days; NULL countries excluded; NULL totals as 0.
        tests:
        - revenue_countries >= 0

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_play__time_series_trends
      description: Daily Google Play performance trends with rolling averages, growth, volatility, anomalies, and derived insights for the last 90 days
      grain: One row per package_name + date_day within the last 90 days
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics (date_day, package_name, daily_device_installs, daily_device_uninstalls, active_device_installs, daily_churn_rate, country)
      - intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics (date_day, package_name, daily_net_revenue, daily_paying_transactions, average_transaction_value, new_subscriptions, total_active_subscriptions)
      business_logic: '- Aggregate daily by package_name and date_day: - User behavior: sum installs, sum uninstalls, sum active devices, average churn rate, and count distinct countries. - Revenue: sum net revenue, sum paying transactions, average transaction value, sum new subscriptions, and average active subscriptions. - Combine the two daily aggregates with a full outer join on package_name and date_day; for missing values set numeric measures to 0; set defaults: quality_score=75.0, crash_rate=0.0, anr_rate=0.0. - Compute rolling metrics per package_name ordered by date_day: - 7-day moving averages (including the current day): installs, revenue, quality, churn. - 30-day moving averages (including the current day): installs, revenue, quality. - Week-over-week growth rates: compare installs and revenue to the value 7 days earlier; return NULL if the prior value is missing or not positive. - Volatility over 30 days: coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean); return NULL if the mean is not positive. - Derive seasonality and labels: - day_name from day of week (Sunday..Saturday), month_name from month (January..December), and week_of_year from date_day. - install_trend from week-over-week install growth: >0.10 Strong Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >0 Slow Growth; >-0.05 Stable; >-0.10 Declining; else Strong Decline; NULL→Insufficient Data. - revenue_trend from week-over-week revenue growth: >0.20 Revenue Surge; >0.10 Strong Revenue Growth; >0.05 Moderate Revenue Growth; >0 Slow Revenue Growth; >-0.10 Revenue Stable; else Revenue Declining; NULL→No Revenue Data. - install_stability from the 30-day install volatility: >1.0 Highly Volatile; >0.5 Moderately Volatile; >0.2 Low Volatility; not NULL→Very Stable; NULL→Unknown. - performance_momentum: Positive Momentum if growth>0.05 and quality>7-day avg; Building Momentum if growth>0 and quality≥7-day avg; Negative Momentum if growth≤0 and quality<7-day avg; Quality Decline if quality<7-day avg (and prior rules not met); else Stable Momentum. - Anomaly detection (30-day context): - install_anomaly_score and revenue_anomaly_score are absolute z-scores using the 30-day mean and standard deviation; return NULL if the mean is not positive or the standard deviation is zero. - anomaly_flag precedence: Install Anomaly if install z-score>2; else Revenue Anomaly if revenue z-score>2; else Quality Drop if quality is ≥20 points below the 7-day average; else Normal. - Final calculations and rounding: - Rounding: churn 4dp; revenue 2dp; avg transaction value 2dp; active subscriptions 0dp; quality 1dp; crash_rate_per_1k 2dp; anr_rate_per_1k 2dp; 7-day/30-day install MAs 1dp; 7-day/30-day revenue MAs 2dp; 7-day/30-day quality MAs 1dp; 7-day churn MA 4dp; WoW growth rates 4dp; volatility coefficients 4dp; anomaly scores 2dp; install/uninstall ratio 2dp; revenue per active device 4dp. - daily_performance_vs_baseline: Above Average if installs > 1.5× 30-day avg; Below Average if installs < 0.7× 30-day avg; else Average Performance. - risk_growth_profile: High Growth, High Risk if install volatility>0.5 and WoW install growth>0.1; Stable Growth if install volatility≤0.3 and WoW install growth>0.05; Stable & Predictable if install volatility≤0.3 and |WoW install growth|≤0.05; Unpredictable Performance if install volatility>0.5; else Standard Variation. - Filters: keep rows where date_day and package_name are not NULL and date_day is within the last 90 days; final ordering is by package_name and descending date_day.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metrics (limited to the last 90 days)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier for the app
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Day of week name (Sunday..Saturday) based on date_day
      - name: month_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Month name (January..December) based on date_day
      - name: week_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week number of the year based on date_day
      - name: daily_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total installs aggregated per package_name and date_day; missing values default to 0
      - name: daily_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total uninstalls aggregated per package_name and date_day; missing values default to 0
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total active devices aggregated per package_name and date_day; missing values default to 0
      - name: daily_churn_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily churn rate per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing and rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: active_countries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct country count per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing
      - name: daily_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total net revenue per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: daily_transactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total paying transactions per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing
      - name: avg_transaction_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average transaction value per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: new_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total new subscriptions per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing
      - name: active_subscriptions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average active subscriptions per package_name and date_day, defaulted to 0 when missing and rounded to 0 decimals
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Quality score defaulted to 75.0 and rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: crash_rate_per_1k
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Crash rate per 1,000 devices defaulted to 0.0 and rounded to 2 decimals in logic, stored with 1 decimal due to type
      - name: anr_rate_per_1k
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: ANR rate per 1,000 devices defaulted to 0.0 and rounded to 2 decimals in logic, stored with 1 decimal due to type
      - name: ma_7d_installs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day moving average of installs (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: ma_30d_installs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day moving average of installs (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: ma_7d_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day moving average of revenue (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: ma_30d_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day moving average of revenue (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: ma_7d_quality
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day moving average of quality score (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: ma_30d_quality
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day moving average of quality score (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: ma_7d_churn
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day moving average of daily churn rate (includes current day, per package_name ordered by date), rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: wow_install_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Week-over-week install growth versus the value 7 days earlier; NULL if prior value is missing or not positive; rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: wow_revenue_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Week-over-week revenue growth versus the value 7 days earlier; NULL if prior value is missing or not positive; rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: install_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from week-over-week install growth: >0.10 Strong Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >0 Slow Growth; >-0.05 Stable; >-0.10 Declining; else Strong Decline; NULL→Insufficient Data'
      - name: revenue_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from week-over-week revenue growth: >0.20 Revenue Surge; >0.10 Strong Revenue Growth; >0.05 Moderate Revenue Growth; >0 Slow Revenue Growth; >-0.10 Revenue Stable; else Revenue Declining; NULL→No Revenue Data'
      - name: install_volatility_coefficient
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day coefficient of variation for installs; NULL if the 30-day mean is not positive; rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: revenue_volatility_coefficient
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-day coefficient of variation for revenue; NULL if the 30-day mean is not positive; rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: install_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Install volatility classification: >1.0 Highly Volatile; >0.5 Moderately Volatile; >0.2 Low Volatility; not NULL→Very Stable; NULL→Unknown'
      - name: performance_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Positive Momentum if WoW install growth>0.05 and quality>7-day avg; Building Momentum if growth>0 and quality≥7-day avg; Negative Momentum if growth≤0 and quality<7-day avg; Quality Decline if quality<7-day avg (other rules not met); else Stable Momentum
      - name: install_anomaly_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z-score of installs versus the 30-day mean using the 30-day standard deviation; NULL if mean≤0 or stdev=0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_anomaly_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z-score of revenue versus the 30-day mean using the 30-day standard deviation; NULL if mean≤0 or stdev=0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: anomaly_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Install Anomaly if install z-score>2; else Revenue Anomaly if revenue z-score>2; else Quality Drop if quality is 20+ points below the 7-day average; else Normal
      - name: daily_performance_vs_baseline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Above Average Performance if installs > 1.5× 30-day average; Below Average Performance if installs < 0.7× 30-day average; otherwise Average Performance
      - name: risk_growth_profile
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Profile from install volatility and WoW install growth: High Growth, High Risk; Stable Growth; Stable & Predictable; Unpredictable Performance; or Standard Variation'
      - name: daily_install_uninstall_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: daily_installs divided by daily_uninstalls when daily_uninstalls>0; otherwise NULL; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_per_active_device
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: daily_revenue divided by active_devices when active_devices>0 (using unrounded revenue), rounded to 4 decimals

      description: "Reference table for country code mappings and regional classifications"
      source_table: "raw.google_play__country_codes"
      columns:
        - name: country_code_alpha_2
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "country_code_alpha_2 IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(country_code_alpha_2) = 2"
              on_failure: delete_row

              on_failure: correct
        - name: country_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: alternative_country_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: region
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: sub_region
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: country_code_alpha_3
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "country_code_alpha_3 = UPPER(TRIM(country_code_alpha_3))"

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Contact-level lifecycle, email engagement, deal association, and composite engagement scoring
      grain: One row per contact_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust (contact_id, email, created_date, first_conversion_date)
      - raw.email_event_data (recipient, type, created)
      - raw.deal_contact_data (contact_id, deal_id)
      - raw.deal_data (deal_id, property_createdate, property_closedate, property_amount)
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contact universe (one row per contact_id). - Lifecycle metrics: - contact_age_days = whole days from created_date to today. - days_to_conversion = whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, use today. - contact_maturity_segment by age: <30 days = "New Contact"; <90 = "Recent Contact"; <365 = "Established Contact"; otherwise "Mature Contact". - conversion_status = "Converted" if first_conversion_date exists, else "Not Converted". - conversion_velocity_score: if no conversion → 0; else map days-to-first-conversion: ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20. - Email engagement (left join on email = recipient): - Count events per contact_id: SENT, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE (one per matching row); if no matches, counts are 0. - email_open_rate = (OPEN ÷ SENT) × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; email_click_through_rate = (CLICK ÷ OPEN) × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; rates are not rounded or capped and can exceed 100. - last_engagement_date = latest timestamp of OPEN or CLICK events, parsing created from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - Deal association (left join deal_contact_data on contact_id, then deal_data on deal_id): - total_associated_deals = distinct count of linked deals. - total_closed_deals = distinct count of linked deals with a close date. - total_deal_value = sum of amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none. - avg_deal_value = average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals. - first_deal_date = earliest deal create timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - last_deal_closed_date = latest deal close timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - overall_engagement_score (no rounding): - 0.3 × conversion_velocity_score - + if total_emails_sent > 0 then min(email_open_rate × 0.4, 40) else 0 - + if email_open_rate > 0 then min(email_click_through_rate × 0.2, 20) else 0 - + if total_associated_deals > 0 then min(total_associated_deals × 5, 10) else 0 - engagement_tier: "High Engagement" if score ≥ 80; "Medium Engagement" if score ≥ 50; otherwise "Low Engagement". - All joins are left joins from the contact universe; counts and sums default to 0 where specified; averages may be NULL if no qualifying rows; timestamps are parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique contact identifier; exactly one row per contact_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email used to join to email events by exact match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Contact creation timestamp used as the lifecycle anchor; no timezone adjustments applied
      - name: first_conversion_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First recorded conversion timestamp if present; NULL if never converted
      - name: contact_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from created_date to today at query time
      - name: days_to_conversion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, to today; equals contact_age_days when not converted
      - name: contact_maturity_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Age band: <30 New; <90 Recent; <365 Established; otherwise Mature'
      - name: conversion_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Converted if first_conversion_date exists; otherwise Not Converted
      - name: conversion_velocity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Days-to-first-conversion score: no conversion→0; ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20'
      - name: total_emails_sent
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type SENT matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type OPEN matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_clicked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type CLICK matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_bounced
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type BOUNCE matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: OPEN ÷ SENT × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; not rounded or capped and may exceed 100
      - name: email_click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CLICK ÷ OPEN × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; not rounded or capped and may exceed 100
      - name: last_engagement_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest OPEN or CLICK event timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: total_associated_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deals linked to the contact; 0 if none
      - name: total_closed_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of associated deals with a close date; 0 if none
      - name: total_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amounts over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none
      - name: avg_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals
      - name: first_deal_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest associated deal create timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: last_deal_closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest associated deal close timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: overall_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Composite score: 0.3×velocity + min(open rate×0.4, 40) if sent>0 + min(CTR×0.2, 20) if open_rate>0 + min(deals×5, 10) if deals>0; no rounding'
      - name: engagement_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High Engagement if score ≥ 80; Medium Engagement if ≥ 50; otherwise Low Engagement

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT)
CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), COALESCE(CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE)) AS BIGINT)

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 30 THEN 'New Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'Recent Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 365 THEN 'Established Contact' ELSE 'Mature Contact' END
CASE WHEN NOT c.first_conversion_date IS NULL THEN 'Converted' ELSE 'Not Converted' END

CAST(CASE WHEN c.first_conversion_date IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 1 THEN 100 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 7 THEN 80 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 30 THEN 60 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 90 THEN 40 ELSE 20 END AS INT)
CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.total_emails_sent, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(e.total_emails_opened AS DOUBLE) / e.total_emails_sent * 100 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.total_emails_opened, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(e.total_emails_clicked AS DOUBLE) / e.total_emails_opened * 100 ELSE 0 END

0.3 * conversion_velocity_score + CASE WHEN total_emails_sent > 0 THEN LEAST(email_open_rate * 0.4, 40) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN email_open_rate > 0 THEN LEAST(email_click_through_rate * 0.2, 20) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN total_associated_deals > 0 THEN LEAST(total_associated_deals * 5, 10) ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN overall_engagement_score >= 80 THEN 'High Engagement' WHEN overall_engagement_score >= 50 THEN 'Medium Engagement' ELSE 'Low Engagement' END

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contact universe (one row per contact_id). - Lifecycle metrics: - contact_age_days = whole days from created_date to today. - days_to_conversion = whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, use today. - contact_maturity_segment by age: <30 days = "New Contact"; <90 = "Recent Contact"; <365 = "Established Contact"; otherwise "Mature Contact". - conversion_status = "Converted" if first_conversion_date exists, else "Not Converted". - conversion_velocity_score: if no conversion → 0; else map days-to-first-conversion: ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20. - Email engagement (left join on email = recipient): - Count events per contact_id: SENT, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE (one per matching row); if no matches, counts are 0. - email_open_rate = (OPEN ÷ SENT) × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; email_click_through_rate = (CLICK ÷ OPEN) × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; rates are not rounded or capped and can exceed 100. - last_engagement_date = latest timestamp of OPEN or CLICK events, parsing created from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - Deal association (left join deal_contact_data on contact_id, then deal_data on deal_id): - total_associated_deals = distinct count of linked deals. - total_closed_deals = distinct count of linked deals with a close date. - total_deal_value = sum of amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none. - avg_deal_value = average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals. - first_deal_date = earliest deal create timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - last_deal_closed_date = latest deal close timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - overall_engagement_score (no rounding): - 0.3 × conversion_velocity_score - + if total_emails_sent > 0 then min(email_open_rate × 0.4, 40) else 0 - + if email_open_rate > 0 then min(email_click_through_rate × 0.2, 20) else 0 - + if total_associated_deals > 0 then min(total_associated_deals × 5, 10) else 0 - engagement_tier: "High Engagement" if score ≥ 80; "Medium Engagement" if score ≥ 50; otherwise "Low Engagement". - All joins are left joins from the contact universe; counts and sums default to 0 where specified; averages may be NULL if no qualifying rows; timestamps are parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".'

- name: int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust
      schema: intermediate
      description: Pass-through of stg_hubspot__contact excluding rows whose contact_id appears as vid_to_merge in raw.contact_merge_audit_data

- name: int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Deal-level metrics enriched with pipeline stage aggregates and created-quarter trends; one row per deal with stage and quarterly performance.
      grain: One row per deal_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Build base from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced: - Select deal, pipeline, owner, and timestamp fields; rename amount to deal_amount and closed_date to close_date. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of whole days from created_date to close_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - deal_status: - Won: closed_date present and amount > 0 - Lost: closed_date present and amount = 0 - Open: closed_date absent - Unknown: any other case (e.g., closed with negative or NULL amount) - deal_size_category: - Enterprise (100K+): amount >= 100000 - Large (50K-100K): 50000–<100000 - Medium (10K-50K): 10000–<50000 - Small (<10K): >0–<10000 - No Value: amount <= 0 or NULL - created_year/created_quarter are extracted from created_date; closed_year/closed_quarter are extracted only when close_date exists. - Compute pipeline_stage_analysis grouped by (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage), excluding NULL stage IDs: - deals_in_stage: number of deals in the group. - won_from_stage / lost_from_stage: counts where status is Won / Lost. - stage_win_rate: percentage of group deals that are Won (0–100); 0 when the denominator would be zero. - total_stage_value: sum of deal_amount; averages computed over non-NULL amounts. - avg_stage_cycle_time: average cycle time for Won deals only. - median_stage_cycle_time: continuous median (50th percentile) of non-NULL cycle times in the group. - Compute quarterly_performance_trends grouped by (created_year, created_quarter), including only rows with both present: - quarterly_deals_created: number of deals created in the cohort. - quarterly_deal_value_created: sum of deal_amount (NULL if all amounts are NULL). - same_quarter_wins: count of deals that were created and closed Won in the same year-quarter. - same_quarter_revenue: sum of deal_amount for those same-quarter Wins (0 when none in the cohort). - same_quarter_conversion_rate: percentage of cohort deals that closed Won in the same quarter (0–100); 0 when the cohort size is zero. - Left join stage metrics on (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage) and quarterly metrics on (created_year, created_quarter). - If a join has no match (e.g., stage ID or created_date is NULL), all joined metrics from that source are NULL. - Output one row per deal_id with base fields plus matched stage and quarterly metrics; percentages are 0–100 with no rounding; standard aggregates ignore NULL inputs.'
      columns:
      - name: deal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique deal identifier; exactly one output row per deal_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: deal_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deal name from source; may be NULL.
      - name: deal_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Deal monetary amount from source; used in stage and quarterly aggregates; NULLs are ignored by aggregates.
      - name: deal_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage label from source; may be NULL; aggregations use the stage ID.
      - name: deal_pipeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline label from source; used with stage ID to join stage-level aggregates; may be NULL.
      - name: deal_pipeline_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage ID; groups and joins stage-level aggregates; NULL excludes the deal from stage metrics.
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner identifier from source; may be NULL.
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal creation timestamp; drives created_year/quarter and quarterly joins; may be NULL.
      - name: close_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal closed timestamp; may be NULL; used in cycle time and status.
      - name: deal_cycle_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days between created_date and close_date; NULL if either date is NULL.
      - name: deal_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Won (closed and amount > 0), Lost (closed and amount = 0), Open (not closed), or Unknown otherwise.
      - name: deal_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Enterprise (>=100000), Large (>=50000 and <100000), Medium (>=10000 and <50000), Small (>0 and <10000), or No Value (<=0 or NULL).
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from created_date; NULL when created_date is NULL.
      - name: created_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number (1–4) extracted from created_date; NULL when created_date is NULL.
      - name: closed_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from close_date when present; else NULL.
      - name: closed_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number (1–4) extracted from close_date when present; else NULL.
      - name: deals_in_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals in the joined (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage) group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: won_from_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of Won deals in the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: lost_from_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of Lost deals in the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: stage_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of stage deals that are Won (0–100); 0 when the denominator would be zero; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: total_stage_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount across the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match or all amounts are NULL.
      - name: avg_stage_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_amount across the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match or no non-NULL amounts.
      - name: avg_stage_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cycle time (days) for Won deals in the joined stage group; NULL when none or no stage match.
      - name: median_stage_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Continuous median (50th percentile) of non-NULL cycle times in the joined stage group; NULL when none or no stage match.
      - name: quarterly_deals_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals created in the deal's (created_year, created_quarter); NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: quarterly_deal_value_created
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for deals created in the deal's quarter; NULL when no quarterly match or all amounts are NULL.
      - name: same_quarter_wins
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of deals that were created and closed Won in the same year-quarter; NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: same_quarter_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for same-quarter Won deals in the created cohort; 0 when none in the cohort; NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: same_quarter_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of deals created in the quarter that closed Won in the same quarter (0–100); 0 when cohort size is zero; NULL when no quarterly match.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build base from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced: - Select deal, pipeline, owner, and timestamp fields; rename amount to deal_amount and closed_date to close_date. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of whole days from created_date to close_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - deal_status: - Won: closed_date present and amount > 0 - Lost: closed_date present and amount = 0 - Open: closed_date absent - Unknown: any other case (e.g., closed with negative or NULL amount) - deal_size_category: - Enterprise (100K+): amount >= 100000 - Large (50K-100K): 50000–<100000 - Medium (10K-50K): 10000–<50000 - Small (<10K): >0–<10000 - No Value: amount <= 0 or NULL - created_year/created_quarter are extracted from created_date; closed_year/closed_quarter are extracted only when close_date exists. - Compute pipeline_stage_analysis grouped by (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage), excluding NULL stage IDs: - deals_in_stage: number of deals in the group. - won_from_stage / lost_from_stage: counts where status is Won / Lost. - stage_win_rate: percentage of group deals that are Won (0–100); 0 when the denominator would be zero. - total_stage_value: sum of deal_amount; averages computed over non-NULL amounts. - avg_stage_cycle_time: average cycle time for Won deals only. - median_stage_cycle_time: continuous median (50th percentile) of non-NULL cycle times in the group. - Compute quarterly_performance_trends grouped by (created_year, created_quarter), including only rows with both present: - quarterly_deals_created: number of deals created in the cohort. - quarterly_deal_value_created: sum of deal_amount (NULL if all amounts are NULL). - same_quarter_wins: count of deals that were created and closed Won in the same year-quarter. - same_quarter_revenue: sum of deal_amount for those same-quarter Wins (0 when none in the cohort). - same_quarter_conversion_rate: percentage of cohort deals that closed Won in the same quarter (0–100); 0 when the cohort size is zero. - Left join stage metrics on (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage) and quarterly metrics on (created_year, created_quarter). - If a join has no match (e.g., stage ID or created_date is NULL), all joined metrics from that source are NULL. - Output one row per deal_id with base fields plus matched stage and quarterly metrics; percentages are 0–100 with no rounding; standard aggregates ignore NULL inputs.'

- name: int_hubspot__deals_enhanced
      schema: intermediate
      description: Deals enriched with pipeline, stage, and owner details via left joins; no filtering or aggregation
      grain: One row per stg_hubspot__deal record; rows may multiply if joined tables have multiple matches
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline_stage

      schema: intermediate
      description: Counts of 'UNSUBSCRIBED' status changes per email_send_id and email_campaign_id from joined HubSpot event/status tables

- name: int_hubspot__email_event_aggregates
      schema: intermediate
      description: Aggregates email events into per-send counts by event type.
      grain: One row per email_send_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event
      business_logic: '- Source: staging.stg_hubspot__email_event. - Include only rows where sent_by_id is not null. - Group by sent_by_id and output one row per distinct value as email_send_id. - For each group, count events separately for these types: OPEN, SENT, DELIVERED, DROPPED, CLICK, FORWARD, DEFERRED, BOUNCE, SPAMREPORT, PRINT. - Only rows with non-null email_event_id contribute to counts; if a type has no qualifying rows, its count is 0. - Event type matching is exact; no case normalization or trimming is applied. - Duplicates are not removed; each qualifying row adds 1 to its type’s count. - No joins, ordering, windowing, or additional filtering is applied beyond the above.'
      columns:
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier from sent_by_id; one row per non-null sent_by_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of OPEN events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: sends
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of SENT events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: deliveries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of DELIVERED events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: drops
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of DROPPED events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of CLICK events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: forwards
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of FORWARD events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: deferrals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of DEFERRED events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: bounces
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of BOUNCE events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: spam_reports
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of SPAMREPORT events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
      - name: prints
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of PRINT events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.
