blocks.original_text:
- name: int_jira__project_health_scoring
      description: Multi-dimensional Jira project health scoring with binary risk flags and composite scores
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      business_logic: 'Build base metrics per project by left-joining issues to projects and aggregating: - total_issues counts all issues; resolved_issues counts issues with a resolution timestamp; open_issues counts issues without one. - avg_resolution_days averages days from creation to resolution over resolved issues; NULL if none. - high_priority_issues counts issues with any priority_id present (proxy for “has priority,” not true severity). - unique_assignees counts distinct non-null assignee IDs. Derive velocity trends per project: - issues_resolved_30d counts issues resolved in the last 30 days; issues_created_30d counts issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_7d counts issues resolved in the last 7 days. - issues_resolved_prev_30d counts issues resolved 60–30 days before today. Compute quality indicators: - bug_issues counts issues with a non-null issue_type_id; feature_issues uses the same proxy and equals bug_issues. - reopened_issues_count counts all history records whose field value contains “reopen” (case-insensitive). - avg_comments_per_issue averages per-issue comment counts over issues that have at least one comment; NULL if none. Compute team dynamics: - workload_distribution_stddev and max_user_issues are derived from per-assignee issue counts on assigned issues; NULL if no assigned issues. - total_issue_links equals 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0. - sprints_participated equals the number of distinct sprints in the sprint source and is the same for all projects. Assemble risk flags (0/1): - backlog_risk = 1 if open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues else 0. - velocity_risk = 1 if avg_resolution_days > 30 else 0; NULL avg does not trigger the flag. - quality_risk = 1 if bug_issues > 30% of total_issues else 0. - resource_risk = 1 if unique_assignees < 2 else 0. - throughput_risk = 1 if issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d else 0. Compute health scores (each bounded to 0–25): - delivery_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 8 for backlog_risk, 10 for velocity_risk, 7 for throughput_risk. - quality_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 12 for quality_risk, 8 if reopened_issues_count > 10% of total_issues, 5 if avg_comments_per_issue < 1. - team_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 15 for resource_risk, 5 if workload_distribution_stddev > 10, 5 if unique_assignees = 0. - process_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues. - velocity_change_percent is the percent change in resolved count vs the prior 30 days; if the prior is 0 then 0; otherwise rounded to one decimal place. Final outputs: - overall_health_score = sum of the four health scores (0–100). - health_grade: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), else F. - primary_risk_factor: dimension with the lowest health score; ties resolve in order Delivery → Quality → Team → Process. - trajectory_status from velocity_change_percent: >20 Accelerating; >5 Improving; >-5 Stable; >-20 Declining; else Critical Decline. - Final result is ordered by overall_health_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier; grouping key with exactly one row per project_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project key copied from the project source
        tests:
        - not_null

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of issues linked to the project
      - name: open_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues without a resolution timestamp
      - name: resolved_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a resolution timestamp
      - name: avg_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from creation to resolution over resolved issues; NULL if none
      - name: high_priority_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a present priority_id (proxy for 'has priority')
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of non-null assignee IDs across project issues
      - name: issues_resolved_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved in the last 30 days based on resolution date
      - name: issues_created_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues created in the last 30 days based on creation date
      - name: issues_resolved_7d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved in the last 7 days
      - name: issues_resolved_prev_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved 60–30 days before today
      - name: bug_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a non-null issue_type_id (used as bug proxy)
      - name: feature_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a non-null issue_type_id (same as bug_issues)
      - name: reopened_issues_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of history records whose field value contains 'reopen' (case-insensitive) across project issues
      - name: avg_comments_per_issue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average comments per issue over issues with at least one comment; NULL if none
      - name: workload_distribution_stddev
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of issues per assignee within the project; NULL if none
      - name: max_user_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum issues assigned to any single user; NULL if none
      - name: total_issue_links
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Indicator: 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0'
      - name: sprints_participated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct sprints in the sprint source (same for all projects)
      - name: backlog_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues, else 0'
      - name: velocity_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when avg_resolution_days > 30, else 0; NULL avg does not trigger'
      - name: quality_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when bug_issues > 30% of total_issues, else 0'
      - name: resource_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when unique_assignees < 2, else 0'
      - name: throughput_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d, else 0'

        data_type: INTEGER

      - name: process_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 after deducting 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues; bounded to 0–25

        data_type: DOUBLE

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER

      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Letter grade from overall_health_score: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), else F'
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Dimension with the lowest health score; ties resolve in order Delivery, Quality, Team, Process

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from velocity_change_percent: >20 Accelerating; >5 Improving; >-5 Stable; >-20 Declining; else Critical Decline'

business_logic: 'Build base metrics per project by left-joining issues to projects and aggregating: - total_issues counts all issues; resolved_issues counts issues with a resolution timestamp; open_issues counts issues without one. - avg_resolution_days averages days from creation to resolution over resolved issues; NULL if none. - high_priority_issues counts issues with any priority_id present (proxy for “has priority,” not true severity). - unique_assignees counts distinct non-null assignee IDs. Derive velocity trends per project: - issues_resolved_30d counts issues resolved in the last 30 days; issues_created_30d counts issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_7d counts issues resolved in the last 7 days. - issues_resolved_prev_30d counts issues resolved 60–30 days before today. Compute quality indicators: - bug_issues counts issues with a non-null issue_type_id; feature_issues uses the same proxy and equals bug_issues. - reopened_issues_count counts all history records whose field value contains “reopen” (case-insensitive). - avg_comments_per_issue averages per-issue comment counts over issues that have at least one comment; NULL if none. Compute team dynamics: - workload_distribution_stddev and max_user_issues are derived from per-assignee issue counts on assigned issues; NULL if no assigned issues. - total_issue_links equals 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0. - sprints_participated equals the number of distinct sprints in the sprint source and is the same for all projects. Assemble risk flags (0/1): - backlog_risk = 1 if open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues else 0. - velocity_risk = 1 if avg_resolution_days > 30 else 0; NULL avg does not trigger the flag. - quality_risk = 1 if bug_issues > 30% of total_issues else 0. - resource_risk = 1 if unique_assignees < 2 else 0. - throughput_risk = 1 if issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d else 0. Compute health scores (each bounded to 0–25): - delivery_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 8 for backlog_risk, 10 for velocity_risk, 7 for throughput_risk. - quality_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 12 for quality_risk, 8 if reopened_issues_count > 10% of total_issues, 5 if avg_comments_per_issue < 1. - team_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 15 for resource_risk, 5 if workload_distribution_stddev > 10, 5 if unique_assignees = 0. - process_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues. - velocity_change_percent is the percent change in resolved count vs the prior 30 days; if the prior is 0 then 0; otherwise rounded to one decimal place. Final outputs: - overall_health_score = sum of the four health scores (0–100). - health_grade: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), else F. - primary_risk_factor: dimension with the lowest health score; ties resolve in order Delivery → Quality → Team → Process. - trajectory_status from velocity_change_percent: >20 Accelerating; >5 Improving; >-5 Stable; >-20 Declining; else Critical Decline. - Final result is ordered by overall_health_score descending.'
description: Number of issues resolved 60–30 days before today

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_jira__project_metrics
      description: Project-level issue counts and duration metrics (seconds and days) derived from issues; open-age metrics depend on execution time
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and exclude rows with a missing project_id; only projects present in this source appear in the output. - For each project_id: - Counts: - count_closed_issues: number of issues with a resolution timestamp. - count_open_issues: number of issues without a resolution timestamp. - count_open_assigned_issues: number of open issues with an assignee. - count_closed_assigned_issues (internal): number of resolved issues with an assignee. - Sum durations in seconds (non-applicable rows add 0): - Close time: seconds between created_at and resolved_at for resolved issues. - Assigned close time: seconds between first_assigned_at and last_assigned_at for resolved issues where first_assigned_at exists. - Age of currently open: seconds from created_at to the model execution time for open issues. - Age of currently open and assigned: seconds from first_assigned_at to the model execution time for open issues where first_assigned_at exists. - Averages (rounded to the nearest whole second): - avg_close_time_seconds: sum of close time seconds divided by count_closed_issues; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_assigned_close_time_seconds: sum of assigned close time seconds divided by count_closed_assigned_issues; issues missing first_assigned_at contribute 0 seconds but still count in the denominator; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: sum of open-age seconds divided by count_open_issues; computed relative to the execution time; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds: sum of open-age assigned seconds divided by count_open_assigned_issues; issues missing first_assigned_at contribute 0 seconds but still count in the denominator; computed relative to the execution time; if the count is zero, return 0. - Medians (50th percentile of the applicable seconds, rounded to the nearest whole second): - median_close_time_seconds: among resolved issues; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_age_currently_open_seconds: among open issues measured to the execution time; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_assigned_close_time_seconds: among resolved issues where first_assigned_at and last_assigned_at exist; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds: among open issues where first_assigned_at exists, measured to the execution time; null if there are no applicable durations. - Days metrics: convert the corresponding seconds metric to days by dividing by 86400 and rounding to whole days; averages are always non-negative; medians are null when their seconds metric is null.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique project identifier; one row per project
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_closed_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of issues with a resolution timestamp
        tests:
        - count_closed_issues >= 0
      - name: count_open_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of issues without a resolution timestamp
        tests:
        - count_open_issues >= 0
      - name: count_open_assigned_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of open issues that have an assignee
        tests:
        - count_open_assigned_issues >= 0
      - name: avg_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from creation to resolution across resolved issues, rounded; returns 0 when none
        tests:
        - avg_close_time_seconds >= 0
      - name: avg_assigned_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from first to last assignment for resolved issues with an assignee, rounded; issues missing first_assigned_at add 0 seconds; returns 0 when denominator is 0
        tests:
        - avg_assigned_close_time_seconds >= 0
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from creation to the execution time across open issues, rounded; returns 0 when none
        tests:
        - avg_age_currently_open_seconds >= 0
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from first assignment to the execution time across open issues with an assignee, rounded; issues missing first_assigned_at add 0 seconds; returns 0 when denominator is 0
        tests:
        - avg_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds >= 0
      - name: avg_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: avg_close_time_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding
        tests:
        - avg_close_time_days >= 0
      - name: avg_assigned_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: avg_assigned_close_time_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding
        tests:
        - avg_assigned_close_time_days >= 0
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: avg_age_currently_open_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding
        tests:
        - avg_age_currently_open_days >= 0
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_assigned_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: avg_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding
        tests:
        - avg_age_currently_open_assigned_days >= 0
      - name: median_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from creation to resolution among resolved issues, rounded; null when none
        tests:
        - median_close_time_seconds IS NULL OR median_close_time_seconds >= 0
      - name: median_age_currently_open_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from creation to the execution time among open issues, rounded; null when none
        tests:
        - median_age_currently_open_seconds IS NULL OR median_age_currently_open_seconds >= 0
      - name: median_assigned_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from first to last assignment among resolved issues where both timestamps exist, rounded; null when none
        tests:
        - median_assigned_close_time_seconds IS NULL OR median_assigned_close_time_seconds >= 0
      - name: median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from first assignment to the execution time among open issues where first_assigned_at exists, rounded; null when none
        tests:
        - median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds IS NULL OR median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds >= 0
      - name: median_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: median_close_time_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding; null when the seconds value is null
        tests:
        - median_close_time_days IS NULL OR median_close_time_days >= 0
      - name: median_age_currently_open_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: median_age_currently_open_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding; null when the seconds value is null
        tests:
        - median_age_currently_open_days IS NULL OR median_age_currently_open_days >= 0
      - name: median_assigned_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: median_assigned_close_time_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding; null when the seconds value is null
        tests:
        - median_assigned_close_time_days IS NULL OR median_assigned_close_time_days >= 0
      - name: median_age_currently_open_assigned_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds converted to whole days by dividing by 86400 and rounding; null when the seconds value is null
        tests:
        - median_age_currently_open_assigned_days IS NULL OR median_age_currently_open_assigned_days >= 0

references.name: intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and exclude rows with a missing project_id; only projects present in this source appear in the output. - For each project_id: - Counts: - count_closed_issues: number of issues with a resolution timestamp. - count_open_issues: number of issues without a resolution timestamp. - count_open_assigned_issues: number of open issues with an assignee. - count_closed_assigned_issues (internal): number of resolved issues with an assignee. - Sum durations in seconds (non-applicable rows add 0): - Close time: seconds between created_at and resolved_at for resolved issues. - Assigned close time: seconds between first_assigned_at and last_assigned_at for resolved issues where first_assigned_at exists. - Age of currently open: seconds from created_at to the model execution time for open issues. - Age of currently open and assigned: seconds from first_assigned_at to the model execution time for open issues where first_assigned_at exists. - Averages (rounded to the nearest whole second): - avg_close_time_seconds: sum of close time seconds divided by count_closed_issues; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_assigned_close_time_seconds: sum of assigned close time seconds divided by count_closed_assigned_issues; issues missing first_assigned_at contribute 0 seconds but still count in the denominator; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: sum of open-age seconds divided by count_open_issues; computed relative to the execution time; if the count is zero, return 0. - avg_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds: sum of open-age assigned seconds divided by count_open_assigned_issues; issues missing first_assigned_at contribute 0 seconds but still count in the denominator; computed relative to the execution time; if the count is zero, return 0. - Medians (50th percentile of the applicable seconds, rounded to the nearest whole second): - median_close_time_seconds: among resolved issues; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_age_currently_open_seconds: among open issues measured to the execution time; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_assigned_close_time_seconds: among resolved issues where first_assigned_at and last_assigned_at exist; null if there are no applicable durations. - median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds: among open issues where first_assigned_at exists, measured to the execution time; null if there are no applicable durations. - Days metrics: convert the corresponding seconds metric to days by dividing by 86400 and rounding to whole days; averages are always non-negative; medians are null when their seconds metric is null.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_jira__sprint_performance_analytics
      description: Advanced sprint performance analytics with start/end snapshots, burndown, velocity trends, and risk/health classification
      grain: 'One row per sprint_id per generated snapshot (at most two: start and end/complete)'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__field
      business_logic: 'Data assembly: - From staging.stg_jira__sprint, keep sprints with started_at not null. Derive start_date = date(started_at), end_date = date(ended_at), complete_date = date(completed_at). - planned_duration_days = (ended_at - started_at) in days when both exist, else null. actual_duration_days = (completed_at - started_at) in days when both exist (not used later). Sprint issues: - Create sprint_issues by pairing issues with sprints (cross join) and keeping only issue rows where issue.created_at falls between sprint.started_at and coalesce(sprint.completed_at, sprint.ended_at, current_timestamp). Apply a global LIMIT 1000 without ordering, so metrics are based on an arbitrary subset of qualifying rows. - story_points per issue: take the latest active field value whose field name contains “story” and “point”; use the numeric value if the field is numeric or extract the first numeric substring; if unavailable/unparsable, default to 1. - time_spent_seconds and original_estimate_seconds default to 0 when null. Snapshots: - For each sprint, create: - Start snapshot: snapshot_date = start_date, day_number = 1 (always). - End snapshot: only when planned_duration_days > 1; snapshot_date = complete_date, else end_date, else current_date; day_number = planned_duration_days. Metrics per snapshot (group by sprint and snapshot): - total_story_points_committed: sum of story_points across all included issue rows (no de-duplication). - story_points_completed: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at date is on/before snapshot_date. story_points_remaining: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at is null or its date is after snapshot_date. - total_issues_committed: count of issue rows. issues_completed: count where resolved on/before snapshot_date. issues_remaining: count where unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date. - total_estimated_hours: sum(original_estimate_seconds)/3600.0. hours_spent_completed: sum(time_spent_seconds) for issues resolved by snapshot_date divided by 3600.0. total_hours_spent: sum(time_spent_seconds)/3600.0. Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.'
      columns:
      - name: sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint primary identifier used for grouping and ordering
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint name from staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Snapshot date (start_date; and end/complete/current_date when planned_duration_days > 1)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_number
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Snapshot index: 1 at start; planned_duration_days at end/complete; ordered ascending within each sprint'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - day_number >= 1
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Planned sprint duration in days as (ended_at − started_at)/86400; null if ended_at is null; non-negative when present
        tests:
        - planned_duration_days IS NULL OR planned_duration_days >= 0
      - name: total_story_points_committed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for included issue rows; defaults to 1 per issue when the field is missing or unparseable; no de-duplication
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_story_points_committed >= 0
      - name: story_points_completed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_completed >= 0
      - name: story_points_remaining
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_issues_committed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of included issue rows within the sprint window
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_issues_committed >= 0
      - name: issues_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_completed >= 0
      - name: issues_remaining
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_estimated_hours
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total original estimate hours across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_estimated_hours >= 0
      - name: hours_spent_completed
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent on issues resolved by snapshot_date (seconds summed for those issues and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - hours_spent_completed >= 0
      - name: total_hours_spent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_hours_spent >= 0
      - name: ideal_story_points_remaining
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ideal remaining story points based on a straight-line burndown from committed at day 1 to 0 at the end; if no planned duration, equals committed
        tests:
        - not_null
        - ideal_story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: daily_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in story_points_remaining since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be negative
      - name: completion_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: story_points_completed divided by committed; 0 when committed is 0; range [0,1]'
        tests:
        - completion_ratio >= 0 AND completion_ratio <= 1
      - name: timeline_progress_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: day_number divided by planned_duration_days when planned_duration_days > 0, else 1; may exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1'
        tests:
        - timeline_progress_ratio >= 0
      - name: scope_change_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in committed story points since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: scope_change_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Change in committed issue count since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: burndown_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Difference between actual remaining and ideal remaining story points; positive means behind ideal, negative means ahead
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: performance_index
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of completion to timeline progress when progress is > 0; null otherwise; values > 1 indicate ahead of timeline
      - name: velocity_trend_3d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots within the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values
      - name: predicted_completion_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Forecasted completion snapshot index: current day_number plus remaining divided by daily_velocity when both positive; otherwise null'
        tests:
        - predicted_completion_day IS NULL OR predicted_completion_day > day_number
      - name: sprint_risk_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label based on completion vs timeline thresholds and scope change: Behind/Ahead/Scope Creep/On Track'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score from 0 to 100 using penalties for risk and variance and bonuses for positive indicators, clamped to the range
        tests:
        - not_null
        - sprint_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: velocity_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Velocity tier from velocity_trend_3d: High/Good/Low/No Progress/Negative Velocity (Negative on null)'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_phase
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Phase bucket by timeline_progress_ratio: Early (≤0.3), Mid (≤0.6), Late (≤0.9), Final (>0.9)'
        tests:
        - not_null

references.name: staging.stg_jira__sprint
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Data assembly: - From staging.stg_jira__sprint, keep sprints with started_at not null. Derive start_date = date(started_at), end_date = date(ended_at), complete_date = date(completed_at). - planned_duration_days = (ended_at - started_at) in days when both exist, else null. actual_duration_days = (completed_at - started_at) in days when both exist (not used later). Sprint issues: - Create sprint_issues by pairing issues with sprints (cross join) and keeping only issue rows where issue.created_at falls between sprint.started_at and coalesce(sprint.completed_at, sprint.ended_at, current_timestamp). Apply a global LIMIT 1000 without ordering, so metrics are based on an arbitrary subset of qualifying rows. - story_points per issue: take the latest active field value whose field name contains “story” and “point”; use the numeric value if the field is numeric or extract the first numeric substring; if unavailable/unparsable, default to 1. - time_spent_seconds and original_estimate_seconds default to 0 when null. Snapshots: - For each sprint, create: - Start snapshot: snapshot_date = start_date, day_number = 1 (always). - End snapshot: only when planned_duration_days > 1; snapshot_date = complete_date, else end_date, else current_date; day_number = planned_duration_days. Metrics per snapshot (group by sprint and snapshot): - total_story_points_committed: sum of story_points across all included issue rows (no de-duplication). - story_points_completed: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at date is on/before snapshot_date. story_points_remaining: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at is null or its date is after snapshot_date. - total_issues_committed: count of issue rows. issues_completed: count where resolved on/before snapshot_date. issues_remaining: count where unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date. - total_estimated_hours: sum(original_estimate_seconds)/3600.0. hours_spent_completed: sum(time_spent_seconds) for issues resolved by snapshot_date divided by 3600.0. total_hours_spent: sum(time_spent_seconds)/3600.0. Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.'

Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.'

business_logic: 'Data assembly: - From staging.stg_jira__sprint, keep sprints with started_at not null. blocks.original_text:
- name: int_jira__user_activity_metrics
      description: Daily Jira user engagement metrics with rolling windows, tiers, consistency, lifecycle, productivity, and churn risk (one row per user_id, activity_date, project_id)
      grain: One row per user_id per activity_date per project_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Build base_activities (union all): - issue_created: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = issue.created_at as date, project_id = issue.project_id, weight = 1; include only if issue.creator_user_id is not null. - issue_assigned: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = issue.created_at as date, project_id = issue.project_id, weight = 2; include only if issue.assignee_user_id is not null. - comment_created: user_id = comment.author_user_id, activity_date = comment.created_at as date, project_id from the linked issue, weight = 1; include only if comment.author_user_id is not null. - field_updated: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = history.updated_at as date, project_id from the linked issue, weight = 0.5; include only if history.is_active is true and issue.assignee_user_id is not null. - From base_activities, exclude rows with null user_id; then aggregate per (user_id, activity_date, project_id): - daily_activity_score = sum of activity_weight; duplicates are kept. - daily_activity_count = total activity rows; distinct_activity_types = count of unique activity_type (both internal only). - Compute rolling metrics on these daily rows, partitioned by user_id and ordered by activity_date (row-based windows; gaps are ignored; if a user has multiple project rows on the same date, each row is counted separately): - rolling_7d_activity_score = sum of daily_activity_score across the current row and up to 6 prior rows. - rolling_30d_activity_score = sum of daily_activity_score across the current row and up to 29 prior rows. - active_days_in_7d = number of rows across the current row and up to 6 prior rows. - active_days_in_30d = number of rows across the current row and up to 29 prior rows. - prev_day_activity = the previous row’s daily_activity_score for the same user. - Derive patterns: - activity_velocity = 0 if there is no previous row; otherwise daily_activity_score minus the previous row’s value. - engagement_tier_7d: ≥20 → "Highly Active"; ≥10 → "Moderately Active"; ≥5 → "Lightly Active"; >0 → "Minimally Active"; else "Inactive". - engagement_tier_30d: ≥50 → "Highly Active"; ≥25 → "Moderately Active"; ≥10 → "Lightly Active"; >0 → "Minimally Active"; else "Inactive". - consistency_score_7d = round(active_days_in_7d / 7.0, 3); consistency_score_30d = round(active_days_in_30d / 30.0, 3). - user_pattern_type: if active_days_in_7d ≥ 5 and rolling_7d_activity_score ≥ 15 → "Power User"; else if active_days_in_7d ≥ 3 and consistency_score_7d ≥ 0.4 → "Regular User"; else if rolling_7d_activity_score > 0 and active_days_in_7d ≤ 2 → "Sporadic User"; else "Dormant User". - Lifecycle stage: - If activity_date equals the user''s earliest activity_date → "New". - Else if activity_date is within 30 calendar days of the earliest activity_date → "Onboarding". - Else if rolling_30d_activity_score is greater than the value 7 rows earlier for the same user → "Growing". - Else if rolling_30d_activity_score is less than the value 7 rows earlier for the same user → "Declining". - Else "Stable". - Productivity and churn risk: - is_productive_today = true if daily_activity_score > 0 and consistency_score_7d > 0.5; else false. - at_churn_risk = true if rolling_7d_activity_score = 0 and the value 7 rows earlier for the same user is > 0; else false. - Return rows where user_id is not null; ordering is by user_id, activity_date (ordering does not affect values).'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier used for grouping and window partitioning; sourced from issue.assignee_user_id or comment.author_user_id; non-null in output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of aggregated activity for the user and project (from issue.created_at, comment.created_at, or field_history.updated_at coerced to date); non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project associated to the activity (always from the linked issue); non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: daily_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Sum of activity weights for the user-date-project (issue_created=1, issue_assigned=2, comment_created=1, field_updated=0.5); duplicates preserved; positive; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: rolling_7d_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Row-based sum across the current and previous 6 user rows; skips inactive days; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: rolling_30d_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Row-based sum across the current and previous 29 user rows; skips inactive days; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_days_in_7d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of user rows in the current-and-previous-6-row window; minimum 1; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_days_in_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of user rows in the current-and-previous-29-row window; minimum 1; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Change versus the previous user row by activity_date: 0 if no previous row; otherwise daily_activity_score minus the previous row’s value; may be negative; 1-decimal precision'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_tier_7d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from rolling_7d_activity_score: ≥20 Highly Active; ≥10 Moderately Active; ≥5 Lightly Active; >0 Minimally Active; else Inactive'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_tier_30d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from rolling_30d_activity_score: ≥50 Highly Active; ≥25 Moderately Active; ≥10 Lightly Active; >0 Minimally Active; else Inactive'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: consistency_score_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: active_days_in_7d divided by 7.0; row-based; values >0 and ≤1'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: consistency_score_30d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: active_days_in_30d divided by 30.0; row-based; values >0 and ≤1'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: user_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: Power User (active_days_in_7d≥5 and rolling_7d_activity_score≥15), Regular User (active_days_in_7d≥3 and consistency_score_7d≥0.4), Sporadic User (rolling_7d_activity_score>0 and active_days_in_7d≤2), else Dormant User'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage: New (first activity_date), Onboarding (within 30 days of first), Growing (rolling_30d exceeds the value 7 rows earlier), Declining (rolling_30d is below the value 7 rows earlier), else Stable'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_productive_today
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if daily_activity_score > 0 and consistency_score_7d > 0.5; else false; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: at_churn_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if rolling_7d_activity_score = 0 and the value 7 rows earlier is > 0; else false; never null
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: int_jira__user_metrics
      description: 'User-level metrics for assigned issues: counts plus average and median time-to-close and open-age, derived from last_assigned_at, resolved_at, and the current time.'
      grain: One row per user_id (assignee_user_id)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      business_logic: 'Dataset and grain: - Use intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and keep only records with assignee_user_id present. - Produce one record per assignee_user_id, labeled as user_id. Per-user counts: - count_closed_issues: number of assigned issues that are resolved. - count_open_issues: number of assigned issues that remain unresolved. Per-issue durations (in seconds): - Close duration: time between last_assigned_at and resolved_at for resolved issues; computed only when both timestamps exist, otherwise treated as missing. - Open age: time between last_assigned_at and the query runtime for unresolved issues; computed only when last_assigned_at exists, otherwise treated as missing. Sums: - sum_close_time_seconds: sum of non-missing close durations. - sum_current_open_seconds: sum of non-missing open ages. Averages (seconds): - avg_close_time_seconds: if there are no closed issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of close durations by the closed issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: if there are no open issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of open ages by the open issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. Medians (seconds): - median_close_time_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing close durations, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. - median_age_currently_open_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing open ages, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. Days conversions: - avg_close_time_days and avg_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates; 0 seconds yields 0 days. - median_close_time_days and median_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates. Notes: - Open-age metrics depend on query execution time due to use of the current time. - Rounding is to the nearest integer for both seconds and days.'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user identifier; one row per user.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_closed_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of assigned issues that are resolved, regardless of last_assigned_at.
      - name: count_open_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of assigned issues that are unresolved, regardless of last_assigned_at.
      - name: avg_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; 0 if no closed issues; NULL if none of the closed issues have a valid duration; rounded to the nearest second.
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average seconds from last_assigned_at to the current time for unresolved issues; 0 if no open issues; NULL if none have a valid duration; rounded to the nearest second.
      - name: avg_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average days converted from avg_close_time_seconds by dividing by 86400 and rounding; NULL if the seconds metric is NULL.
      - name: avg_age_currently_open_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average days converted from avg_age_currently_open_seconds by dividing by 86400 and rounding; NULL if the seconds metric is NULL.
      - name: median_close_time_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; excludes missing durations; rounded to the nearest second; NULL if no valid durations.
      - name: median_age_currently_open_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median seconds from last_assigned_at to the current time for unresolved issues; excludes missing durations; rounded to the nearest second; NULL if no valid durations.
      - name: median_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median days converted from median_close_time_seconds by dividing by 86400 and rounding; NULL if the seconds metric is NULL.
      - name: median_age_currently_open_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Median days converted from median_age_currently_open_seconds by dividing by 86400 and rounding; NULL if the seconds metric is NULL.

references.line_text: business_logic: 'Dataset and grain: - Use intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and keep only records with assignee_user_id present. - Produce one record per assignee_user_id, labeled as user_id. Per-user counts: - count_closed_issues: number of assigned issues that are resolved. - count_open_issues: number of assigned issues that remain unresolved. Per-issue durations (in seconds): - Close duration: time between last_assigned_at and resolved_at for resolved issues; computed only when both timestamps exist, otherwise treated as missing. - Open age: time between last_assigned_at and the query runtime for unresolved issues; computed only when last_assigned_at exists, otherwise treated as missing. Sums: - sum_close_time_seconds: sum of non-missing close durations. - sum_current_open_seconds: sum of non-missing open ages. Averages (seconds): - avg_close_time_seconds: if there are no closed issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of close durations by the closed issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: if there are no open issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of open ages by the open issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. Medians (seconds): - median_close_time_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing close durations, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. - median_age_currently_open_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing open ages, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. Days conversions: - avg_close_time_days and avg_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates; 0 seconds yields 0 days. - median_close_time_days and median_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates. Notes: - Open-age metrics depend on query execution time due to use of the current time. - Rounding is to the nearest integer for both seconds and days.'

- name: jira__daily_issue_field_history
      description: Simplified per-row snapshot using the created_at date; fields copied from int_jira__issue_join with status name joined from staging via left join.
      grain: One row per source row in intermediate.int_jira__issue_join (issue_id may repeat)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      - staging.stg_jira__status
      business_logic: '- Create a base set from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join: issue_id; date_day = the date part of created_at; date_week = same as date_day; assignee = assignee_user_id; reporter = reporter_user_id; priority = priority_id; issue_type = issue_type_id; components, story_points, and story_point_estimate are set to NULL; carry status_id for joining. - Left join to staging.stg_jira__status to add status name by matching status_id as text on both sides; if no match, status is NULL. - Compute issue_day_id by hashing the string formed as date_day + "|" + issue_id (in that order); if date_day or issue_id is NULL, issue_day_id is NULL. - No aggregation, filtering, or sorting; output preserves one row per input row; string values keep original casing and spacing unless set to NULL above.'

        data_type: DATE
        description: Date part of created_at; NULL if created_at is NULL.
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Equal to date_day; no weekly rollup.
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue identifier from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join; may be NULL.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status name joined from staging.stg_jira__status by status_id; NULL if no match.

      - name: reporter
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from reporter_user_id; may be NULL.
      - name: priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from priority_id; may be NULL.
      - name: story_points
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL in this model.
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL in this model.
      - name: issue_day_id
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: Deterministic hash of date_day and issue_id joined by '|' in that order; NULL if either input is NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__daily_sprint_issue_history
      description: Daily issue-level sprint history built from a global date spine, enriched with current issue fields and deterministic sprint/issue status flags for burndown
      grain: One row per sprint_id + issue_id + date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_sprint
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      business_logic: '- Build sprint_issue_mapping from intermediate.int_jira__issue_sprint by keeping rows with a non-null current_sprint_id and selecting sprint_id, issue_id, issue_key, sprint_name, sprint_started_at, sprint_ended_at, sprint_completed_at, and board_id. - Create a global date spine: - start_date is the earliest issue creation date across staging.stg_jira__issue. - end_date is the latest of the issue resolution date, or today for unresolved issues. - Generate one date_day for each calendar day from start_date through end_date inclusive. - For each date_day, set date_week to (year of date_day) * 100 + (week-of-year of date_day). - Cross join the mapping with the date spine and retain only days on or after the sprint start date; include days up to seven days after the sprint end when an end date exists; if the end date is missing, keep all days on or after the start date. - Enrich each row by joining marts.jira__issue_enhanced on issue_id to bring the current, non-historical fields: issue_created_at, issue_resolved_at, assignee_user_id, assignee_name, original_estimate_seconds, remaining_estimate_seconds, time_spent_seconds, and status. - Derive story_points deterministically from a hash of issue_id: compute r = abs(hash(issue_id) mod 10); map r=0→8, r=1→5, r=2→3, r=3→2, r=4→1; all other r values yield NULL; copy story_points into story_point_estimate. - Per-day flags: - is_sprint_active is true on and after the sprint start date and, when present, through the sprint end date; otherwise false. - is_sprint_completed is true on and after the sprint completion date when present; otherwise false. - is_issue_open is true on and after the issue creation date only while the issue has no resolution timestamp; otherwise NULL; zero on the end date. - Generate sprint_issue_day_id as a stable 64-bit hash of the string "date_day|sprint_id|issue_id", with date_day formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and "|" as the delimiter. - Return all columns and order rows by sprint_id, issue_id, and date_day.'

date)),current_date),current_date) mx from staging.stg_jira__issue), dates as (select unnest(generate_series(mn,mx,interval 1 day))::date date_day from bounds), spine as (select m.*,d.date_day from mapping m cross join dates d where d.date_day>=cast(m.sprint_started_at as date) and (m.sprint_ended_at is null or d.date_day<=cast(m.sprint_ended_at as date)+7)), enriched as (select s.*,i.created_at issue_created_at,i.resolved_at issue_resolved_at,i.assignee_user_id,i.assignee_name,i.original_estimate_seconds,i.remaining_estimate_seconds,i.time_spent_seconds,i.current_status status,abs(hash(s.issue_id)%10) r from spine s left join marts.jira__issue_enhanced i using(issue_id)) select sprint_id,issue_id,issue_key,date_day,year(date_day)*100+week(date_day) date_week,sprint_name,sprint_started_at,sprint_ended_at,sprint_completed_at,board_id,issue_created_at,issue_resolved_at,assignee_user_id,assignee_name,original_estimate_seconds,remaining_estimate_seconds,time_spent_seconds,status,case r when 0 then 8 when 1 then 5 when 2 then 3 when 3 then 2 when 4 then 1 end::integer story_points,case r when 0 then 8 when 1 then 5 when 2 then 3 when 3 then 2 when 4 then 1 end::integer business_logic: '- Build sprint_issue_mapping from intermediate.int_jira__issue_sprint by keeping rows with a non-null current_sprint_id and selecting sprint_id, issue_id, issue_key, sprint_name, sprint_started_at, sprint_ended_at, sprint_completed_at, and board_id. - Create a global date spine: - start_date is the earliest issue creation date across staging.stg_jira__issue. - end_date is the latest of the issue resolution date, or today for unresolved issues. - Generate one date_day for each calendar day from start_date through end_date inclusive. - For each date_day, set date_week to (year of date_day) * 100 + (week-of-year of date_day). - Cross join the mapping with the date spine and retain only days on or after the sprint start date; include days up to seven days after the sprint end when an end date exists; if the end date is missing, keep all days on or after the start date. - Enrich each row by joining marts.jira__issue_enhanced on issue_id to bring the current, non-historical fields: issue_created_at, issue_resolved_at, assignee_user_id, assignee_name, original_estimate_seconds, remaining_estimate_seconds, time_spent_seconds, and status. - Derive story_points deterministically from a hash of issue_id: compute r = abs(hash(issue_id) mod 10); map r=0→8, r=1→5, r=2→3, r=3→2, r=4→1; all other r values yield NULL; copy story_points into story_point_estimate. - Per-day flags: - is_sprint_active is true on and after the sprint start date and, when present, through the sprint end date; otherwise false. - is_sprint_completed is true on and after the sprint completion date when present; otherwise false. - is_issue_open is true on and after the issue creation date only while the issue has no resolution timestamp; otherwise false. - is_issue_resolved_in_sprint is true on and after the resolution date when the resolution occurred on or before the sprint end; otherwise false. - days_left_in_sprint is the whole-day difference between the sprint end date and date_day when date_day is within the sprint start–end window (inclusive); otherwise NULL; zero on the end date. - Generate sprint_issue_day_id as a stable 64-bit hash of the string "date_day|sprint_id|issue_id", with date_day formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and "|" as the delimiter. - Return all columns and order rows by sprint_id, issue_id, and date_day.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__issue_enhanced
      description: Enhanced JIRA issue view built from base issues joined with the most recent daily field history and duration metrics computed at query time
      grain: One row per issue_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      - marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Begin with all columns from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join as the base issue record. - From marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history, select the most recent record per issue_id based on the largest date_day; if multiple rows share the same most recent date_day, one is chosen arbitrarily because no secondary tie-break is defined. - Left join the most recent daily field history to the base issue on issue_id. - Compute three duration metrics in seconds: - open_duration_seconds: time from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if created_at is NULL. - any_assignment_duration_seconds: time from first_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if first_assigned_at is NULL. - last_assignment_duration_seconds: time from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if last_assigned_at is NULL. - Output includes all base issue columns plus status, components, assignee, reporter, priority, story_points, and story_point_estimate from the most recent daily field history.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary issue identifier from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: parent_issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: original_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original time estimate in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - original_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR original_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: remaining_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining time estimate in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - remaining_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR remaining_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: time_spent_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total time spent on the issue in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - time_spent_seconds IS NULL OR time_spent_seconds >= 0
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user identifier from base issue
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue creation timestamp from base issue; start point for open duration
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue resolution timestamp from base issue; if NULL, durations measure to query-time current timestamp
      - name: creator_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator user identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue description text from base issue
      - name: due_date
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Due date from base issue as stored (string)
      - name: environment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Environment field from base issue
      - name: issue_id_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary issue identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: parent_issue_id_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: priority_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from base issue
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: reporter_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from base issue
      - name: resolution_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolution identifier from base issue
      - name: status_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status identifier from base issue
      - name: status_changed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the last status change from base issue
      - name: issue_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue title or summary from base issue
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: work_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Work completion ratio from base issue
        tests:
        - work_ratio IS NULL OR work_ratio >= 0
      - name: revised_parent_issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Revised parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue type name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue key from base issue
      - name: is_parent_epic
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the parent issue is an Epic; value from base issue
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee display name from base issue
      - name: assignee_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee timezone from base issue
      - name: assignee_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee email from base issue
      - name: reporter_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter email from base issue
      - name: reporter_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter display name from base issue
      - name: reporter_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter timezone from base issue
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current status name from base issue
      - name: current_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current status category from base issue
      - name: resolution_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolution type name from base issue
      - name: current_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current priority name from base issue
      - name: current_sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current sprint identifier from base issue
      - name: current_sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current sprint name from base issue
      - name: count_sprint_changes
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Number of sprint changes from base issue
        tests:
        - count_sprint_changes >= 0
      - name: sprint_started_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint start timestamp from base issue
      - name: sprint_ended_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint end timestamp from base issue
      - name: sprint_completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint completion timestamp from base issue
      - name: is_active_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the current sprint is active; value from base issue
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of first assignment from base issue; used in assignment duration metrics
      - name: last_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the last assignment from base issue; used in assignment duration metrics
      - name: first_resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the issue was first resolved from base issue
      - name: fixes_versions
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fix versions from base issue
      - name: affects_versions
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Affected versions from base issue
      - name: conversation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenated conversation or comments from base issue
      - name: count_comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of comments from base issue
        tests:
        - count_comments >= 0
      - name: open_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from creation to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if creation time is missing
        tests:
        - open_duration_seconds IS NULL OR open_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: any_assignment_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from first assignment to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if never assigned
        tests:
        - any_assignment_duration_seconds IS NULL OR any_assignment_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: last_assignment_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from last assignment to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if no last assignment timestamp
        tests:
        - last_assignment_duration_seconds IS NULL OR last_assignment_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent status from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: components
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent component count from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - components IS NULL OR components >= 0
      - name: assignee
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent assignee display name from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: reporter
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent reporter display name from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent priority from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: story_points
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent story points from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - story_points IS NULL OR story_points >= 0
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent story point estimate from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - story_point_estimate IS NULL OR story_point_estimate >= 0

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Begin with all columns from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join as the base issue record. - From marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history, select the most recent record per issue_id based on the largest date_day; if multiple rows share the same most recent date_day, one is chosen arbitrarily because no secondary tie-break is defined. - Left join the most recent daily field history to the base issue on issue_id. - Compute three duration metrics in seconds: - open_duration_seconds: time from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if created_at is NULL. - any_assignment_duration_seconds: time from first_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if first_assigned_at is NULL. - last_assignment_duration_seconds: time from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if last_assigned_at is NULL. - Output includes all base issue columns plus status, components, assignee, reporter, priority, story_points, and story_point_estimate from the most recent daily field history.'
