blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      description: Transaction lines with a cyclically assigned accounting period and amount defaulted to 0 when NULL
      grain: One row per transaction line record from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines and assign each a sequential position (tl_row) with no specified ordering. - Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods and assign each a sequential position (period_row) with no specified ordering. - Let N be the number of available accounting periods. If N = 0 the query fails because the period assignment requires a modulo calculation. - For each transaction line at position k, assign the accounting period whose position is the remainder of (k - 1) divided by N, plus one. This cycles through the period list repeatedly in its arbitrary order, assigning exactly one period to each line when N >= 1. - Output one row per transaction line: pass through transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, and account_id unchanged; set transaction_accounting_period_id to the assigned period’s accounting_period_id; set unconverted_amount to 0 when the source line amount is NULL, otherwise use the original amount. No aggregation, filtering, rounding, or de-duplication is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the source transaction; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the transaction line; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period id assigned by cycling through available periods based on the transaction line’s position; ordering is arbitrary due to unordered row numbering; may be NULL if the source period id is NULL
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount with NULLs defaulted to 0; no rounding or currency conversion applied
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      description: Transaction lines replicated by reporting period with pass-through amounts and account classifications.
      grain: One row per combination of transaction_line_id and reporting_accounting_period_id; if no mapping, reporting_accounting_period_id is NULL.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id = accounting_period_id to add reporting_accounting_period_id; all transaction lines are retained, NULL is set when no mapping exists, and multiple rows can result if the mapping table has duplicates for a given accounting period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts on account_id to classify accounts: * is_income_statement is TRUE when the account type (compared case-insensitively) is one of income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs; otherwise FALSE, including when the type is missing. * account_category (case-insensitive type match): - Asset for acctrec, bank, deferexpense, fixedasset, othasset, othcurrasset, unbilledrec - Expense for cogs, expense, othexpense - Income for income, othincome - Liability for acctpay, credcard, deferrevenue, longtermliab, othcurrliab - Equity for equity, retained_earnings, net_income - Other for nonposting, stat - NULL when no type or no match. - Set converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Set converted_amount_using_reporting_month = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Create tran_with_converted_amounts_id by MD5 hashing the concatenation of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id joined with "_" in that order; if any component is NULL, the concatenation and the id are NULL; component values are used as-is without trimming or case changes.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction identifier passed through from transaction lines.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction line identifier used for row grain and surrogate key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction lines; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier used to join to account attributes; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period of the transaction line used to map reporting periods; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original transaction amount in transaction currency; values are passed through; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period derived from transaction_accounting_period_id; NULL if no mapping; duplicates possible if the mapping table has multiple rows per accounting period.
      - name: converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: converted_amount_using_reporting_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: is_income_statement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when account type is income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs (case-insensitive); otherwise FALSE, including when type is missing.
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category derived from account type (case-insensitive) per defined sets; NULL when unmatched or type is missing.
      - name: tran_with_converted_amounts_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id concatenated with '_' in that order; NULL if any component is NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      description: Transaction lines with cyclical account assignment and derived amounts/flags
      grain: One row per input row in staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines

      description: Account-by-period exchange rate selection by subsidiary pair using primary accounting books and top-level target subsidiaries
      grain: One row per account_id per accounting_period_id per from_subsidiary_id per to_subsidiary_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__consolidated_exchange_rates
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_books
      business_logic: '- From subsidiaries, keep only top-level subsidiaries (no parent). These define eligible to_subsidiary_id values. - From accounting_books, keep only primary books (is_primary equals "yes", case-insensitive). - From consolidated_exchange_rates, keep rows where to_subsidiary_id is top-level and accounting_book_id is primary. Retain accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, average_rate, current_rate, historical_rate. - Cross join all accounts with the filtered exchange rate rows to produce every combination of account and (accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id). - For each combination, set exchange_rate based on accounts.general_rate_type (case-insensitive): - "historical" → use historical_rate - "current" → use current_rate - "average" → use average_rate - any other value or NULL → exchange_rate = NULL - Output columns: accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, account_id, exchange_rate. No de-duplication, ordering, casting, or rounding is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Accounting period from the filtered consolidated exchange rates
      - name: from_subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Source subsidiary from the filtered consolidated exchange rates
      - name: to_subsidiary_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Target subsidiary limited to top-level subsidiaries with no parent
      - name: account_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account identifier; every account is cross-joined to each filtered period/subsidiary row
      - name: exchange_rate
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Selected rate value as text based on account.general_rate_type (historical/current/average, case-insensitive); NULL if type does not match or the chosen source rate is NULL

- name: int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods
      description: Mapping of non-quarter, non-year base accounting periods to same-calendar reporting periods that start on/after the base and are not in the future.
      grain: One row per (accounting_period_id, reporting_accounting_period_id) pair
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: '- Load accounting_periods from staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods and subsidiaries from staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries. - Select base periods where: - quarter is false - year_0 is false - fiscal_calendar_id exists in subsidiaries (distinct fiscal_calendar_id). - For each base period, join to multiplier periods from the same accounting_periods table where: - fiscal_calendar_id matches the base - quarter matches the base (both false) - year_0 matches the base (both false) - starting_at of the multiplier is on or after the base starting_at (as stored in the source) - the multiplier''s starting_at, truncated to seconds and interpreted as a timestamp, is not later than the current time at evaluation. - Emit one row per qualifying pair: - accounting_period_id = base.accounting_period_id - reporting_accounting_period_id = multiplier.accounting_period_id - No ordering, aggregation, or de-duplication is applied; duplicates from source are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the base non-quarter, non-year accounting period in a subsidiary fiscal calendar; may appear in multiple rows paired with later or equal reporting periods.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of a non-quarter, non-year reporting period in the same fiscal calendar that starts on or after the base and is not in the future when evaluated.
        tests:
        - not_null

alternatives.expression_sql: COALESCE(LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('income', 'other income', 'expense', 'other expense', 'cost of goods sold'), FALSE)

CASE WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('accounts receivable', 'bank', 'deferred expense', 'fixed asset', 'other asset', 'other current asset', 'unbilled receivable', 'prepaid expense') THEN 'Asset' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('cost of goods sold', 'expense', 'other expense') THEN 'Expense' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('income', 'other income') THEN 'Income' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('accounts payable', 'credit card', 'deferred revenue', 'long term liability', 'other current liability') THEN 'Liability' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('equity', 'retained earnings', 'net income') THEN 'Equity' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('non posting', 'statistical') THEN 'Other' END

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics derived from profitability (RFM-style), behavior patterns, retention scoring, and action recommendations
      grain: One row per customer_id (per build date = segmentation_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build a customer analytics view by combining profitability (cp), behavioral patterns (cbp), and retention (cr), then deriving insights and recommendations: - customer_behavior_patterns (cbp): - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Filter rows: tl.entity_id IS NOT NULL, t.account_type_name = ''Income'', t.converted_amount > 0. - Aggregate by tl.entity_id (as customer_id) and t.subsidiary_id: - Transaction frequency: total_transactions = distinct transaction_id count; active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier sourced from cp (and cbp), filtered to NOT NULL in final output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from cp; propagated as-is without trimming or case normalization
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email from cp; propagated as-is without validation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from cp (behavioral CTE uses t.subsidiary_id but final value comes from cp)
      - name: profitability_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Profitability classification from cp.customer_segment carried through unchanged
      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Revenue-based tier using overall percentile thresholds on cp.total_revenue: ≥P90 Platinum, ≥P70 Gold, ≥P50 Silver, ≥P30 Bronze, else Basic'
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage derived from customer_age_days, activity_status, retention_category, and cp.total_revenue vs cp average per defined precedence
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency-based activity: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost based on days_since_last_transaction'
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tenure-based retention: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New based on customer_lifespan_days'
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total revenue from cp; final rows require total_revenue > 0; units as defined in cp (no conversion here)
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit from cp; no additional adjustments applied
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from cp; may differ from cbp total_transactions; no distinct logic applied here
      - name: avg_transactions_per_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average transactions per 30-day month from cbp: total_transactions/(customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months>0 and lifespan>0 else 0 (no rounding)'
      - name: comprehensive_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score capped at 100 from weighted cp scores plus activity and retention bonuses per defined mapping
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Predicted retention probability from discrete thresholds: 0.95/0.80/0.60/0.30/0.10/0.05 per recency and total_transactions'
      - name: seasonal_preference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Quarter with highest distinct transaction count: ''Qx Peak'' with tie-breaker order Q1>Q2>Q3>Q4; else ''No Clear Pattern'''
      - name: transaction_consistency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Volatility classification: NULL or 0→Single Transaction; ≤0.3x avg Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance'
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Growth outlook from lifecycle_stage, value_tier, activity_status, and score: High Growth Potential, Expansion Ready, Loyalty Program Candidate, Recovery Priority, or Standard Growth'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation precedence: Win-Back Campaign, Retention Campaign, Onboarding Support, Upsell Opportunity, VIP Treatment, else Regular Engagement'
      - name: engagement_frequency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Suggested touch cadence: Platinum Weekly; Gold Bi-weekly; Silver Monthly; if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly'
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Days since customer creation from cp; integer day count
      - name: segmentation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date for all rows in the run
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_value_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of positive Income converted_amounts per customer from cbp; NULL if insufficient data
      - name: q1_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q1 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q2_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q2 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q3_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q3 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q4_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q4 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: customer_analytics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore
        tests:
        - not_null

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.9 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.7 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.5 THEN 'Silver' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.3 THEN 'Bronze' ELSE 'Basic' END

CASE WHEN customer_age_days <= 90 AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active', 'Active') THEN 'Onboarding' WHEN customer_age_days <= 365 AND total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM cp) THEN 'Growth' WHEN retention_category IN ('Long-term', 'Medium-term') AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active', 'Active') THEN 'Mature' WHEN activity_status = 'At Risk' THEN 'At Risk' WHEN activity_status IN ('Dormant', 'Lost') THEN 'Churned' ELSE 'Developing' END

CASE WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 365 THEN 'Long-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 180 THEN 'Medium-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 90 THEN 'Short-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 30 THEN 'New' ELSE 'Very New' END

CAST(LEAST(100, revenue_score * 10 + frequency_score * 5 + margin_score * 5 + CASE WHEN activity_status = 'Highly Active' THEN 15 WHEN activity_status = 'Active' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + retention_probability * 20) AS INT)

CAST(CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 30 AND total_transactions >= 5 THEN 0.95 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 60 AND total_transactions >= 3 THEN 0.80 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 90 AND total_transactions >= 2 THEN 0.60 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 180 THEN 0.30 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 365 THEN 0.10 ELSE 0.05 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2))

CASE WHEN q1_transactions >= GREATEST(q2_transactions, q3_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q1 Peak' WHEN q2_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q3_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q2 Peak' WHEN q3_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q2_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q3 Peak' WHEN q4_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q2_transactions, q3_transactions) THEN 'Q4 Peak' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END

CASE WHEN transaction_value_volatility IS NULL OR transaction_value_volatility = 0 THEN 'Single Transaction' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= 0.3 * avg_transaction_value THEN 'Very Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= 0.6 * avg_transaction_value THEN 'Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= avg_transaction_value THEN 'Moderate Variance' ELSE 'High Variance' END

CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Onboarding' AND comprehensive_customer_score >= 70 THEN 'High Growth Potential' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND value_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum') THEN 'Expansion Ready' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Mature' AND activity_status = 'Highly Active' THEN 'Loyalty Program Candidate' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'At Risk' AND value_tier IN ('Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum') THEN 'Recovery Priority' ELSE 'Standard Growth' END

CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Churned' AND value_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum') THEN 'Win-Back Campaign' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'At Risk' THEN 'Retention Campaign' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Onboarding' THEN 'Onboarding Support' WHEN growth_potential = 'Expansion Ready' THEN 'Upsell Opportunity' WHEN value_tier = 'Platinum' AND activity_status = 'Highly Active' THEN 'VIP Treatment' ELSE 'Regular Engagement' END

CASE WHEN value_tier = 'Platinum' THEN 'Weekly' WHEN value_tier = 'Gold' THEN 'Bi-weekly' WHEN value_tier = 'Silver' THEN 'Monthly' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'At Risk' THEN 'Immediate' ELSE 'Quarterly' END

references.name: intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build a customer analytics view by combining profitability (cp), behavioral patterns (cbp), and retention (cr), then deriving insights and recommendations: - customer_behavior_patterns (cbp): - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Filter rows: tl.entity_id IS NOT NULL, t.account_type_name = ''Income'', t.converted_amount > 0. - Aggregate by tl.entity_id (as customer_id) and t.subsidiary_id: - Transaction frequency: total_transactions = distinct transaction_id count; active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'

active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'

avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_financial_dashboard
      description: Executive financial dashboard aggregating ratios, cash flow, AR, customer metrics, trends, risk and benchmarks per subsidiary-period
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period from financial_ratios for the row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: dashboard_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date at query execution (same for all rows in a run)
      - name: current_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Liquidity ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: quick_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Quick ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: return_on_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: ROE from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: gross_margin_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: net_profit_margin
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit margin from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: overall_financial_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite financial health score from financial_ratios; NULL if missing in source
      - name: financial_health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Letter grade from financial_ratios corresponding to the health score; NULL if missing
      - name: net_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net cash flow for prior calendar month per subsidiary; NULL if no CF row for that month
      - name: operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Operating cash flow for prior calendar month per subsidiary; NULL if no CF row for that month
      - name: cash_flow_health
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cash flow health label from CF for prior month; NULL if no CF row
      - name: predicted_next_month_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted next month cash flow from CF; NULL if no prior-month CF row
      - name: cash_flow_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cash flow risk level from CF; used in risk scoring; NULL if no prior-month CF row
      - name: total_ar_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total AR amount summed across AR aging rows per subsidiary; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: overdue_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total overdue AR amount summed across AR aging rows per subsidiary; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: overdue_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of overdue amount to total AR when total AR>0; otherwise 0; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: weighted_average_days_outstanding
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Simple average of weighted_average_days_outstanding across AR rows; NULLs ignored; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: total_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of customer_profitability rows per subsidiary; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: high_value_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count where customer_segment in ('Champion','Loyal'); duplicates preserved; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: at_risk_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count where customer_segment='At Risk' or activity_status='At Risk'; duplicates preserved; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: total_customer_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of total_revenue across customer rows per subsidiary; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: average_customer_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of total_revenue across customer rows per subsidiary; NULLs ignored; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: avg_financial_health
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of overall_financial_health_score across fk rows per subsidiary; NULLs ignored
      - name: financial_health_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of overall_financial_health_score across fk rows per subsidiary; NULLs ignored
      - name: avg_net_margin
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of net_profit_margin across fk rows per subsidiary; NULLs ignored
      - name: avg_current_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of current_ratio across fk rows per subsidiary; NULLs ignored
      - name: cash_flow_consistency_percentage
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Percentage of fk rows with cash_flow_health in ('Excellent','Good'), rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when no rows
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of four risk components using defined thresholds; NULL inputs default each component to 5 points
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk bucket from total_risk_score: ≥70 Critical Risk, ≥50 High Risk, ≥30 Medium Risk, else Low Risk'
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Primary risk driver by priority: poor health, cash flow, receivables, liquidity; else No Major Risk Factors'
      - name: liquidity_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target category from current_ratio: ≥2.0 Above, ≥1.5 At, else Below Target'
      - name: profitability_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target category from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 Above, ≥0.05 At, else Below Target'
      - name: roe_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target category from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 Above, ≥0.10 At, else Below Target'
      - name: collection_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target category from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 Above, ≤0.15 At, else Below Target'
      - name: improvement_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation per priority: Ops & Liquidity, Working Capital, Cost, Collections, else Maintain'
      - name: overall_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Composite rating from overall_financial_health_score and risk_level per case order
      - name: key_alert
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match alert: Critical Risk→URGENT, High Risk cash flow→WARNING, current_ratio<1.0→ALERT, overdue>0.3→CAUTION, else Normal'
      - name: dashboard_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of subsidiary_id+'_'+dashboard_date; unique per (subsidiary_id, dashboard_date); casing/spacing preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

references.line_text: grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios

references.name: intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_operational_metrics
      description: Department/location monthly operational KPIs with trends, benchmarking, alerts, and recommendations derived from Netsuite transactions
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, performance_month; if multiple class_id exist for the same keys, rows are duplicated (class_id is part of the internal grouping but not exposed)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: '- Filter transactions to the last 24 months by accounting_period_ending. - Join transactions to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; left join departments, locations, and classes for display names. - Group by subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, class_id, the month start of accounting_period_ending (performance_month), and the quarter; compute: - department_revenue: sum of converted_amount where account type is Income; 0 if none. - department_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is COGS; non-negative. - department_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is Expense; non-negative. - transaction_count: count of distinct transaction_id. - revenue_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is Income. - expense_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is COGS or Expense. - unique_entities_involved: count of distinct tl.entity_id. - analysis_date: current_date. - Derive operational efficiency per grouped row: - revenue_to_expense_ratio: revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0; otherwise NULL. - gross_profit: revenue minus cogs. - gross_margin_percentage: (revenue minus cogs) divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - net_profit: revenue minus cogs minus expenses. - net_margin_percentage: net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - Additional intermediates (not selected later): average revenue per revenue transaction, average expense per expense transaction, and revenue per unique entity. - Compute trends per (subsidiary_id, department_id) using rows ordered by performance_month: - prev_month_revenue: value from the previous row in this order. - same_month_last_year_revenue: value from 12 rows prior in this order. - three_month_avg_revenue: average of the current row and the two immediately preceding rows (uses available rows when fewer than three). - three_month_avg_margin: same three-row window for gross_margin_percentage. - Note: because multiple location/class rows can exist for the same month, these windows operate over rows, not unique months; ties within a month use the engine’s row order. - Compute performance analysis: - month_over_month_growth: percentage change versus prev_month_revenue; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when prev_month_revenue <= 0 or missing. - year_over_year_growth: percentage change versus the revenue 12 rows prior; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: ''Accelerating'' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 90%; ''Declining'' if > 80%; else ''Sharp Decline''. - margin_trend: ''Improving'' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 95%; else ''Declining''. - performance_grade: ''Excellent'' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; ''Good'' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; ''Fair'' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; ''Poor'' when > 0; else ''Loss Making''. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: ''Revenue Decline Alert'' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else ''Loss Alert'' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else ''Efficiency Alert'' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else ''Margin Alert'' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else ''Normal''. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: ''Urgent restructuring required'' for ''Loss Making''; ''Review operations and cost structure'' for ''Poor'' with revenue_trend=''Declining''; ''Focus on cost optimization'' for margin_trend=''Declining'' with revenue_trend=''Stable''; ''Increase sales and marketing efforts'' for revenue_trend=''Declining'' with margin_trend=''Stable''; ''Scale successful practices'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent''; else ''Monitor performance closely''. - investment_recommendation: ''Increase Investment'' for ''Excellent'' with ''Accelerating'' revenue; ''Growth Investment'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent'' when internal_market_share < 0.3; ''Selective Investment'' for ''Fair'' with ''Improving'' margin; ''Review Investment'' for ''Poor'' or ''Loss Making''; else ''Maintain Current Investment''. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from transactions; grouping key used for window partitions and benchmarking
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from transaction lines; may be NULL; used for grouping and window partitions
      - name: department_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department display name from the departments table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from transaction lines; included in grouping; may be NULL
      - name: location_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location display name from the locations table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Month start date from accounting_period_ending; only the last 12 months are kept in the final result
      - name: department_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for Income lines per group; sign preserved; 0 when no Income lines exist
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS where COGS is the sum of absolute amounts for COGS lines
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS minus Expenses where Expenses is the sum of absolute amounts for Expense lines
      - name: gross_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio equals (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: net_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin ratio equals net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: revenue_to_expense_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0, otherwise NULL; unrounded
      - name: month_over_month_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the previous row’s revenue within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the previous value <= 0 or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the revenue 12 rows prior within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing
      - name: three_month_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average over the current row and the two preceding rows ordered by performance_month; unrounded; may include duplicate months
      - name: revenue_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing revenue to the three-row moving average: Accelerating, Stable, Declining, or Sharp Decline'
      - name: margin_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing gross margin to the three-row moving average: Improving, Stable, or Declining'
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade based on net margin and revenue-to-expense ratio with defined thresholds: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Loss Making'
      - name: revenue_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by department_revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: margin_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by net_margin_percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: revenue_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition average revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: margin_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin minus the partition average net margin within (subsidiary_id, performance_month); unitless
      - name: internal_market_share
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition total revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: alert_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Alert based on ordered rules: Revenue Decline Alert, Loss Alert, Efficiency Alert, Margin Alert, else Normal; NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts'
      - name: improvement_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation derived from performance_grade and trend combinations; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment guidance based on performance_grade, revenue_trend, and internal_market_share; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: current_date at model run time; identical across all rows in a run
      - name: operational_metrics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated with underscores; NULL if any component is NULL; may repeat across locations or classes

alternatives.expression_sql: AVG(department_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY subsidiary_id, department_id ORDER BY performance_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

CASE WHEN department_revenue > 1.1 * three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Accelerating' WHEN department_revenue > 0.9 * three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Stable' WHEN department_revenue > 0.8 * three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Declining' ELSE 'Sharp Decline' END
CASE WHEN gross_margin_percentage > 1.05 * three_month_avg_margin THEN 'Improving' WHEN gross_margin_percentage > 0.95 * three_month_avg_margin THEN 'Stable' ELSE 'Declining' END

CASE WHEN net_margin_percentage >= 0.2 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio >= 2 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN net_margin_percentage >= 0.1 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio >= 1.5 THEN 'Good' WHEN net_margin_percentage >= 0.05 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio >= 1.2 THEN 'Fair' WHEN net_margin_percentage > 0 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Loss Making' END

department_revenue / NULLIF(SUM(department_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY subsidiary_id, performance_month), 0)

CASE WHEN year_over_year_growth < -20 THEN 'Revenue Decline Alert' WHEN net_margin_percentage < 0 AND month_over_month_growth < -10 THEN 'Loss Alert' WHEN revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1 THEN 'Efficiency Alert' WHEN gross_margin_percentage < 0.1 THEN 'Margin Alert' ELSE 'Normal' END

CASE WHEN performance_grade = 'Loss Making' THEN 'Urgent restructuring required' WHEN performance_grade = 'Poor' AND revenue_trend = 'Declining' THEN 'Review operations and cost structure' WHEN margin_trend = 'Declining' AND revenue_trend = 'Stable' THEN 'Focus on cost optimization' WHEN revenue_trend = 'Declining' AND margin_trend = 'Stable' THEN 'Increase sales and marketing efforts' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Good', 'Excellent') THEN 'Scale successful practices' ELSE 'Monitor performance closely' END

CASE WHEN performance_grade = 'Excellent' AND revenue_trend = 'Accelerating' THEN 'Increase Investment' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Good', 'Excellent') AND internal_market_share < 0.3 THEN 'Growth Investment' WHEN performance_grade = 'Fair' AND margin_trend = 'Improving' THEN 'Selective Investment' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Poor', 'Loss Making') THEN 'Review Investment' ELSE 'Maintain Current Investment' END
CASE WHEN subsidiary_id IS NULL OR department_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MD5(subsidiary_id || '_' || department_id || '_' || CAST(performance_month AS TEXT)) END

where t.accounting_period_ending >= current_date - interval '24 months'
where performance_month >= current_date - interval '12 months'  -- Keep the last 12 months

business_logic: '- Filter transactions to the last 24 months by accounting_period_ending. - Join transactions to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; left join departments, locations, and classes for display names. - Group by subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, class_id, the month start of accounting_period_ending (performance_month), and the quarter; compute: - department_revenue: sum of converted_amount where account type is Income; 0 if none. - department_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is COGS; non-negative. - department_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is Expense; non-negative. - transaction_count: count of distinct transaction_id. - revenue_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is Income. - expense_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is COGS or Expense. - unique_entities_involved: count of distinct tl.entity_id. - analysis_date: current_date. - Derive operational efficiency per grouped row: - revenue_to_expense_ratio: revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0; otherwise NULL. - gross_profit: revenue minus cogs. - gross_margin_percentage: (revenue minus cogs) divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - net_profit: revenue minus cogs minus expenses. - net_margin_percentage: net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - Additional intermediates (not selected later): average revenue per revenue transaction, average expense per expense transaction, and revenue per unique entity. - Compute trends per (subsidiary_id, department_id) using rows ordered by performance_month: - prev_month_revenue: value from the previous row in this order. - same_month_last_year_revenue: value from 12 rows prior in this order. - three_month_avg_revenue: average of the current row and the two immediately preceding rows (uses available rows when fewer than three). - three_month_avg_margin: same three-row window for gross_margin_percentage. - Note: because multiple location/class rows can exist for the same month, these windows operate over rows, not unique months; ties within a month use the engine’s row order. - Compute performance analysis: - month_over_month_growth: percentage change versus prev_month_revenue; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when prev_month_revenue <= 0 or missing. - year_over_year_growth: percentage change versus the revenue 12 rows prior; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: ''Accelerating'' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 90%; ''Declining'' if > 80%; else ''Sharp Decline''. - margin_trend: ''Improving'' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 95%; else ''Declining''. - performance_grade: ''Excellent'' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; ''Good'' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; ''Fair'' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; ''Poor'' when > 0; else ''Loss Making''. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: ''Revenue Decline Alert'' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else ''Loss Alert'' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else ''Efficiency Alert'' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else ''Margin Alert'' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else ''Normal''. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: ''Urgent restructuring required'' for ''Loss Making''; ''Review operations and cost structure'' for ''Poor'' with revenue_trend=''Declining''; ''Focus on cost optimization'' for margin_trend=''Declining'' with revenue_trend=''Stable''; ''Increase sales and marketing efforts'' for revenue_trend=''Declining'' with margin_trend=''Stable''; ''Scale successful practices'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent''; else ''Monitor performance closely''. - investment_recommendation: ''Increase Investment'' for ''Excellent'' with ''Accelerating'' revenue; ''Growth Investment'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent'' when internal_market_share < 0.3; ''Selective Investment'' for ''Fair'' with ''Improving'' margin; ''Review Investment'' for ''Poor'' or ''Loss Making''; else ''Maintain Current Investment''. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.'
