blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_transaction_details
      description: Passthrough of intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details with no joins or transformations.
      grain: One row per source record
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      business_logic: '- Source: intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details - Operation: exact 1:1 passthrough of all source rows and columns - No joins, filters, aggregations, type coercions, renames, or derived fields - Column names, data types, and values are preserved as in the source - Null policy: all NULLs are preserved; no defaulting or imputation - Numeric policy: amounts remain DOUBLE with no rounding or currency logic applied - Boolean policy: TRUE/FALSE/NULL values are preserved as-is - Date policy: dates remain DATE with no timezone or format changes - Duplicates: preserved exactly as present in the source - Ordering: no ordering is applied; output row order is not guaranteed'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the specific transaction line.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the parent transaction.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary subsidiary identifier.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier for the line.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name.
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type classification.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number.
      - name: is_account_leftside
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates if the account is on the left side of the balance sheet.
      - name: sub_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alias subsidiary identifier.
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full subsidiary name.
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Short subsidiary name.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Amount in converted currency units; no additional conversion or rounding.
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original transaction amount; no rounding.
      - name: transaction_line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Transaction line amount; no rounding.
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period name.
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Accounting period end date.
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the accounting period is an adjustment period.
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the accounting period is closed.
      - name: transaction_details_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier for the transaction detail record.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_transaction_details_original
      description: Original Netsuite transaction line details assembled from core line records joined to related dimensions; includes sign-adjusted amounts and a surrogate key
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__items
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendors
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendor_categories
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: 'Build one row per transaction_lines.transaction_line_id: - Start from transaction lines; inner join transactions by transaction_id; inner join subsidiaries by subsidiary_id from the line. - Left join: - Converted amounts on matching transaction_line_id and transaction_id, keeping rows where transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Accounts by line.account_id; and parent account by accounts.parent_id (treated as text). - Accounting periods by transactions.accounting_period_id. - Customers twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Classes by line.class_id; items by line.item_id; locations by line.location_id. - Vendors twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Vendor categories twice: from each joined vendor’s vendor_category_id. - Departments by line.department_id. - Currencies twice: transaction currency by transactions.currency_id; subsidiary currency by subsidiaries.currency_id. - Deterministic rules: - entity_id takes the line entity_id when present; otherwise the transaction entity_id. - is_transaction_non_posting is the opposite of line.is_posting; remains NULL when is_posting is NULL. - Accounting period fields come from the joined accounting period; transaction_due_date comes from transactions.due_date_at. - Account flags: - is_accounts_payable is true when account_type_name equals ''acctpay'' ignoring case; is_accounts_receivable is true when it equals ''acctrec'' ignoring case. - is_expense_account is true when account_type_name is one of ''expense'',''othexpense'',''deferexpense'' ignoring case; is_income_account is true when it is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case. - If account_type_name is NULL, these flags are NULL. - parent_account_id/name use the parent account when available; otherwise fall back to the current account id/name. - is_account_intercompany and is_eliminate are always false. - Customer fields (id/alt_name/company_name/city/state/zipcode/country/date_first_order/customer_external_id) are taken from the transaction-side customer when transaction_type is ''custinvc'' or ''custcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side customer. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Vendor fields (vendor_category_id/name, vendor_id/alt_name/vendor_name/vendor_create_date) are taken from the transaction-side vendor and its category when transaction_type is ''vendbill'' or ''vendcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side vendor and its category. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Location fields come from the joined location; transaction currency fields come from the joined transaction currency; subsidiary_currency_symbol comes from the joined subsidiary currency; department fields come from the joined department; class fields from the joined class; item fields and sales_description from the joined item. - Amounts: - converted_amount is the converted amount using the transaction’s accounting period; its sign is flipped when the account type is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case; otherwise the sign is unchanged. If the converted amount row is missing, the value is NULL. - transaction_amount and transaction_line_amount follow the same sign inversion rule above, applied to line.amount and line.netamount respectively. If account_type_name is NULL, no inversion is applied. - transaction_details_id is the MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id concatenated with an underscore; inputs are treated as text; NULL when either input is NULL. - All rows from the joins are retained; NULLs from left joins are preserved; no explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:

        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Primary line key from transaction_lines.transaction_line_id; one output row per value
      - name: transaction_memo

      - name: is_transaction_non_posting

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_transaction_details_simple
      description: Simplified transaction details per transaction line with basic account, subsidiary, and amount fields plus placeholder accounting period values.
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines (one row per transaction_line_id). - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts on transaction_line_id to bring the converted amount using the transaction accounting period; if missing, set to 0. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts on account_id to bring account_name, account_type_name, account_number, and is_account_leftside; if no match, leave as NULL. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries on subsidiary_id to bring sub_id (dimension subsidiary_id), subsidiary_full_name, and subsidiary_name; if no match, leave as NULL. - Amount fields: - converted_amount: the transaction’s converted amount using the accounting period; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - transaction_amount: the line amount; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - transaction_line_amount: the line net amount; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - Accounting period placeholders: - accounting_period_name is the constant ''mock_period''. - accounting_period_ending is the current date at execution time. - is_accounting_period_adjustment and is_accounting_period_closed are both false. - Surrogate key: - transaction_details_id is an MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id joined by a single underscore; if either input is NULL, the result is NULL. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication; all joins are LEFT to preserve the base row cardinality.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Primary transaction line identifier from the source; one output row per value.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent transaction identifier from the source line; used to build the surrogate key.
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier stored on the transaction line (may differ from the dimension value).
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier on the transaction line used to join account attributes.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type name from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: is_account_leftside
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates the account’s balance-side classification; NULL if no account match.
      - name: sub_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from the subsidiaries dimension joined by subsidiary_id; NULL if no match.
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full subsidiary name from the dimension; NULL if no match.
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Short subsidiary name from the dimension; NULL if no match.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Converted amount using the transaction accounting period; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount from the source; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: transaction_line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line net amount from the source; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value 'mock_period' for all rows.
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Set to the current date at execution time.
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant false for all rows.
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant false for all rows.
      - name: transaction_details_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - unique
        description: MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id joined by an underscore; NULL if either input is NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_vendor_risk_analysis
      description: Vendor risk analysis per vendor-subsidiary using transaction details, lines, and transactions to compute spend, payables, delays, dependency, risk scoring, and recommendations
      grain: One row per vendor_id and subsidiary_id (filtered to vendor_id IS NOT NULL and total_vendor_spend > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      business_logic: '- Build vendor_transactions: - Join transaction_details to transaction_lines on transaction_line_id (inner), then to transactions on transaction_id (left). - Keep rows where vendor_id (from transaction_lines.entity_id) is present and account_type_name is one of AcctPay, Expense, or COGS. - Derive vendor fields: vendor_name is "Vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email is "vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and the domain "@vendor.com"; vendor_category_name is "General Supplier"; carry subsidiary_id from transaction_details. - Transaction/date fields: transaction_date from transactions; due_date from transactions; analysis_month is the month of accounting_period_ending. - Payment metrics per line: days_from_due_date is the day difference between the due date and today (use transaction_date when due date is missing; positive means overdue, negatives allowed); payable_amount is the absolute amount only for AcctPay with negative converted_amount, else 0; expense_amount is the absolute amount only for Expense or COGS, else 0. - Aggregate vendor_financial_metrics grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_category_name, subsidiary_id: - total_transactions is the count of distinct transaction_id. - active_months is the count of distinct analysis_month. - total_payables is the sum of payable_amount; total_expenses is the sum of expense_amount; total_vendor_spend is the sum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - avg_payable_amount is the average of payable_amount over lines with payable_amount > 0 (NULL if none). - max_transaction_amount is the maximum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - first_transaction_date is the earliest transaction_date; last_transaction_date is the latest transaction_date. - vendor_relationship_days is the day difference between first and last transaction_date (NULL if either date is NULL). - avg_payment_delay is the average days_from_due_date over lines with payable_amount > 0 (negatives possible; NULL if none). - overdue_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0 and days_from_due_date > 0; total_payable_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0. - days_since_last_transaction is the day difference between last_transaction_date and today (NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL). - analysis_date is set to today. - Compute vendor_dependency_analysis: - dependency_level uses total_vendor_spend compared to percentile thresholds of total_vendor_spend across all vendors: ≥90th → Critical Dependency; ≥70th → High Dependency; ≥50th → Medium Dependency; ≥30th → Low Dependency; otherwise Minimal Dependency. - overdue_payment_percentage is ((overdue_invoices / total_payable_invoices) × 100) rounded to 2 decimals; if total_payable_invoices = 0 then 0. - spend_concentration_ratio is total_vendor_spend divided by the total vendor spend within the same subsidiary_id; result is NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL. - relationship_stability: Very Stable if relationship_days ≥ 730 and active_months ≥ 12; Stable if ≥ 365 and ≥ 6; Developing if ≥ 180 and ≥ 3; New Relationship if ≥ 90; otherwise Very New. - activity_status: Active if days_since_last_transaction ≤ 30; Recent if ≤ 90; Inactive if ≤ 180; otherwise Dormant. - Compute vendor_risk_scoring: - vendor_risk_score is the sum of points: dependency_level (Critical 30, High 20, Medium 10, else 5) + overdue_payment_percentage (≥50 → 25, ≥30 → 20, ≥15 → 15, >0 → 10, else 0) + spend_concentration_ratio (≥0.2 → 25, ≥0.1 → 15, ≥0.05 → 10, else 5) + activity_status (Dormant 20, Inactive 15, Recent 5, Active 0). - business_impact_level: High Business Impact if dependency is Critical/High and concentration ≥ 0.1; Medium Business Impact if dependency is Medium and total_vendor_spend ≥ 10,000; Low Business Impact if total_vendor_spend ≥ 5,000; otherwise Minimal Business Impact. - supplier_tier: Strategic Partner if dependency is Critical and relationship is Very Stable/Stable; Key Supplier if dependency is High or Critical; Important Supplier if Medium; Regular Supplier if Low; otherwise Occasional Supplier. - management_priority: Urgent if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 20; High Priority if dependency is Critical/High; Medium Priority if dependency is Medium and overdue_payment_percentage > 0; Payment Focus if overdue_payment_percentage > 30; otherwise Standard Management. - Compute vendor_recommendations: - risk_level by vendor_risk_score: ≥70 High Risk; ≥50 Medium Risk; ≥30 Low Risk; otherwise Minimal Risk. - recommended_action: if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 and dependency is Critical then Diversify supplier base urgently; else if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 then Review vendor relationship and payment terms; else if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 0 then Prioritize payment processing; else if spend_concentration_ratio ≥ 0.2 then Consider supplier diversification; else if overdue_payment_percentage ≥ 30 then Improve payment processing; else if activity_status is Dormant and total_vendor_spend > 0 then Review vendor status; otherwise Maintain current relationship. - contract_recommendation by supplier_tier: Strategic Partner → Long-term strategic contract with SLA; Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'

      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; primary grouping key
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label 'Vendor_' plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id
      - name: vendor_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email 'vendor_' plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and '@vendor.com'
      - name: vendor_category_name
        data_type: VARCHAR

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; used in concentration ratio and ID; may be NULL

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of payable_amount and expense_amount across vendor transactions; rows retained only if > 0
      - name: total_payables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for AcctPay lines with negative amounts
      - name: total_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Expense or COGS lines
      - name: avg_payable_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average payable_amount over lines where payable_amount > 0; NULL if none
      - name: max_transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Maximum of (payable_amount + expense_amount) across vendor transactions
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct transaction_id across vendor transactions
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct months of accounting_period_ending
      - name: vendor_relationship_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between earliest and latest transaction_date; NULL if dates are missing
      - name: avg_payment_delay
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days since due date over payable lines; negatives allowed; NULL if no payable lines
      - name: overdue_payment_percentage
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Percentage of overdue payable lines rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when there are no payable lines
      - name: overdue_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of payable lines with days_from_due_date > 0
      - name: total_payable_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of lines where payable_amount > 0
      - name: dependency_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification by total_vendor_spend percentiles across all vendors: Critical/High/Medium/Low/Minimal Dependency'
      - name: spend_concentration_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Vendor's spend divided by total spend within the same subsidiary_id; NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL
      - name: relationship_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification by relationship_days and active_months: Very Stable/Stable/Developing/New Relationship/Very New'
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on days_since_last_transaction: Active (≤30), Recent (≤90), Inactive (≤180), Dormant (>180)'
      - name: vendor_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Points-based risk score from dependency, overdue %, concentration, and activity
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'From vendor_risk_score: High (≥70), Medium (≥50), Low (≥30), Minimal (<30)'
      - name: business_impact_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Impact classification based on dependency and spend thresholds
      - name: supplier_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from dependency_level and relationship_stability: Strategic/Key/Important/Regular/Occasional'
      - name: management_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority from dependency_level and overdue_payment_percentage: Urgent/High/Medium/Payment Focus/Standard'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Action recommendation from risk score, dependency, concentration, overdue %, and activity
      - name: contract_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contract guidance derived from supplier_tier
      - name: payment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment guidance based on overdue_payment_percentage and supplier_tier
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest transaction_date per vendor-subsidiary
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest transaction_date per vendor-subsidiary
      - name: days_since_last_transaction
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between last_transaction_date and today; NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Run date (today) for the analysis; identical across rows within a run
      - name: vendor_risk_analysis_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of vendor_id, subsidiary_id, and analysis_date joined by underscores; NULL if any component is NULL

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN pct >= 0.9 THEN 'Critical Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.7 THEN 'High Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.5 THEN 'Medium Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.3 THEN 'Low Dependency' ELSE 'Minimal Dependency' END

CASE WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 730 AND active_months >= 12 THEN 'Very Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 365 AND active_months >= 6 THEN 'Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 180 AND active_months >= 3 THEN 'Developing' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 90 THEN 'New Relationship' ELSE 'Very New' END

business_logic: '- Build vendor_transactions: - Join transaction_details to transaction_lines on transaction_line_id (inner), then to transactions on transaction_id (left). - Keep rows where vendor_id (from transaction_lines.entity_id) is present and account_type_name is one of AcctPay, Expense, or COGS. - Derive vendor fields: vendor_name is "Vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email is "vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and the domain "@vendor.com"; vendor_category_name is "General Supplier"; carry subsidiary_id from transaction_details. - Transaction/date fields: transaction_date from transactions; due_date from transactions; analysis_month is the month of accounting_period_ending. - Payment metrics per line: days_from_due_date is the day difference between the due date and today (use transaction_date when due date is missing; positive means overdue, negatives allowed); payable_amount is the absolute amount only for AcctPay with negative converted_amount, else 0; expense_amount is the absolute amount only for Expense or COGS, else 0. - Aggregate vendor_financial_metrics grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_category_name, subsidiary_id: - total_transactions is the count of distinct transaction_id. - active_months is the count of distinct analysis_month. - total_payables is the sum of payable_amount; total_expenses is the sum of expense_amount; total_vendor_spend is the sum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - avg_payable_amount is the average of payable_amount over lines with payable_amount > 0 (NULL if none). - max_transaction_amount is the maximum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - first_transaction_date is the earliest transaction_date; last_transaction_date is the latest transaction_date. - vendor_relationship_days is the day difference between first and last transaction_date (NULL if either date is NULL). - avg_payment_delay is the average days_from_due_date over lines with payable_amount > 0 (negatives possible; NULL if none). - overdue_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0 and days_from_due_date > 0; total_payable_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0. - days_since_last_transaction is the day difference between last_transaction_date and today (NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL). - analysis_date is set to today. - Compute vendor_dependency_analysis: - dependency_level uses total_vendor_spend compared to percentile thresholds of total_vendor_spend across all vendors: ≥90th → Critical Dependency; ≥70th → High Dependency; ≥50th → Medium Dependency; ≥30th → Low Dependency; otherwise Minimal Dependency. - overdue_payment_percentage is ((overdue_invoices / total_payable_invoices) × 100) rounded to 2 decimals; if total_payable_invoices = 0 then 0. - spend_concentration_ratio is total_vendor_spend divided by the total vendor spend within the same subsidiary_id; result is NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL. - relationship_stability: Very Stable if relationship_days ≥ 730 and active_months ≥ 12; Stable if ≥ 365 and ≥ 6; Developing if ≥ 180 and ≥ 3; New Relationship if ≥ 90; otherwise Very New. - activity_status: Active if days_since_last_transaction ≤ 30; Recent if ≤ 90; Inactive if ≤ 180; otherwise Dormant. - Compute vendor_risk_scoring: - vendor_risk_score is the sum of points: dependency_level (Critical 30, High 20, Medium 10, else 5) + overdue_payment_percentage (≥50 → 25, ≥30 → 20, ≥15 → 15, >0 → 10, else 0) + spend_concentration_ratio (≥0.2 → 25, ≥0.1 → 15, ≥0.05 → 10, else 5) + activity_status (Dormant 20, Inactive 15, Recent 5, Active 0). - business_impact_level: High Business Impact if dependency is Critical/High and concentration ≥ 0.1; Medium Business Impact if dependency is Medium and total_vendor_spend ≥ 10,000; Low Business Impact if total_vendor_spend ≥ 5,000; otherwise Minimal Business Impact. - supplier_tier: Strategic Partner if dependency is Critical and relationship is Very Stable/Stable; Key Supplier if dependency is High or Critical; Important Supplier if Medium; Regular Supplier if Low; otherwise Occasional Supplier. - management_priority: Urgent if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 20; High Priority if dependency is Critical/High; Medium Priority if dependency is Medium and overdue_payment_percentage > 0; Payment Focus if overdue_payment_percentage > 30; otherwise Standard Management. - Compute vendor_recommendations: - risk_level by vendor_risk_score: ≥70 High Risk; ≥50 Medium Risk; ≥30 Low Risk; otherwise Minimal Risk. - recommended_action: if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 and dependency is Critical then Diversify supplier base urgently; else if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 then Review vendor relationship and payment terms; else if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 0 then Prioritize payment processing; else if spend_concentration_ratio ≥ 0.2 then Consider supplier diversification; else if overdue_payment_percentage ≥ 30 then Improve payment processing; else if activity_status is Dormant and total_vendor_spend > 0 then Review vendor status; otherwise Maintain current relationship. - contract_recommendation by supplier_tier: Strategic Partner → Long-term strategic contract with SLA; Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite__balance_sheet
      description: Balance sheet view built from transaction lines with period-aware currency conversion, account mapping, and a synthetic CTA row
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id per reporting accounting_period_id per output account_name (includes synthetic CTA rows)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: 'Inputs - transactions_with_converted_amounts: precomputed transaction-level amounts including converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period and converted_amount_using_reporting_month, plus transaction_id, transaction_line_id, account_id, account_category, reporting_accounting_period_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, is_income_statement. - accounts: account metadata including account_id, name, type_name, account_number, is_balancesheet, is_leftside, general_rate_type. - accounting_periods: accounting period attributes including accounting_period_id, name, full_name, ending_at, is_adjustment, is_closed, year_id, fiscal_calendar_id. - subsidiaries: used only to select the fiscal_calendar_id of the top-level parent subsidiary (row with parent_id IS NULL). Steps 1) Join accounts to transactions on account_id (IDs compared as strings). 2) Join reporting_accounting_periods by reporting_accounting_period_id and transaction_accounting_periods by transaction_accounting_period_id (IDs compared as strings). 3) Restrict to periods in the top-level fiscal calendar: - reporting_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must equal the fiscal_calendar_id of the parentless subsidiary. - transaction_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must also equal that same fiscal_calendar_id (base rows only). 4) Keep rows where either the account is a balance sheet account (is_balancesheet equals true, case-insensitive ''t'') or the transaction is flagged is_income_statement = true. 5) Produce base balance sheet rows: - Period fields come from reporting_accounting_periods. - account_name and account_type_name: - If account is not a balance sheet account: - If reporting and transaction accounting periods are in the same fiscal year → "Net Income" - Else → "Retained Earnings" - Otherwise use accounts.name / accounts.type_name. - account_id and account_number are NULL for non-balance-sheet accounts; otherwise taken from accounts (account_id represented as a string). - converted_amount selection (all string comparisons case-insensitive): - If non-balance-sheet account and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if non-balance-sheet account: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true: → converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else → 0. Note: If the chosen source amount is NULL, the result is NULL; the literal 0 applies only when no predicate matched. - balance_sheet_sort_helper (case-insensitive on accounts.type_name): bank→1; accounts receivable→2; unbilled receivable→3; other current asset→4; fixed asset→5; other asset→6; deferred expense→7; accounts payable→8; credit card→9; other current liability→10; long term liability→11; deferred revenue→12; equity→13; non-balance-sheet with same year (Net Income)→15; other non-balance-sheet (Retained Earnings)→14; else NULL. 6) Union ALL a synthetic CTA row for each qualifying transaction line and reporting period: - account_category = ''Equity''; account_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_type_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_id = NULL; account_number = NULL. - converted_amount: - If the transaction''s account_category is ''equity'' (case-insensitive) OR is_income_statement = true: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else → converted_amount_using_reporting_month. - balance_sheet_sort_helper = 16. - Join only reporting_accounting_periods and apply the same reporting fiscal calendar filter and the same inclusion filter (account is balance sheet OR is_income_statement). No transaction-period calendar filter here. 7) Booleans is_accounting_period_adjustment and is_accounting_period_closed are true only when the corresponding period flag equals "yes" (case-insensitive), false otherwise, and NULL when the source flag is NULL. 8) No aggregation or deduplication is performed; UNION ALL preserves duplicates across scenarios.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts; duplicates allowed across rows
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier; may appear twice per period when a CTA row is generated
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Reporting accounting period identifier from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period end from accounting_periods.ending_at as stored
      - name: accounting_period_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period full_name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period short name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period adjustment flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period closed flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For base rows: passthrough from transactions; for CTA rows: literal ''Equity'''
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account name or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account type or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: accounts.account_id (as string) for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: account_number
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: accounts.account_number for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed converted amount selected from precomputed fields per deterministic rules (BS vs non-BS, left/right side, rate type, CTA logic); if chosen source is NULL the result is NULL; 0 only when no condition matched
      - name: balance_sheet_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Deterministic sort key: types map to 1–13; non-BS: Retained Earnings=14, Net Income=15; CTA=16; NULL otherwise'

- name: netsuite__transaction_details
      description: Simplified NetSuite transaction details created by joining the first 1000 transaction lines to matching transactions.
      grain: One row per transaction line that joins to a transaction (transaction_lines limited to the first 1000 rows, no ordering).
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transactions
      business_logic: '- Begin with staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines and take the first 1000 rows as returned by the database (no ordering specified). - Load all rows from staging.stg_netsuite__transactions. - Perform an inner join on transaction_id; only lines with a matching transaction_id in transactions are included. - Column construction: - transaction_line_id: passthrough from transaction_lines.transaction_line_id. - transaction_memo: passthrough from transaction_lines.memo; original casing and whitespace preserved. - is_transaction_non_posting: true when non_posting_line equals "yes" ignoring case; false if NULL or any other value. - transaction_id: passthrough from transactions.transaction_id. - transaction_status: passthrough from transactions.status. - transaction_date: passthrough from transactions.transaction_date; treated as a string, no parsing. - transaction_type: passthrough from transactions.transaction_type. - transaction_amount: amount from transaction_lines converted to DECIMAL(18,3); if NULL, set to 0. - No additional filtering or de-duplication is applied; duplicates from source tables are preserved. If either table has multiple rows for the same transaction_id, the join returns all matching combinations.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier for the transaction line from stg_netsuite__transaction_lines; duplicates and NULLs are preserved.
      - name: transaction_memo
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Memo from the transaction line; passthrough with original formatting; NULLs preserved.
      - name: is_transaction_non_posting
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when non_posting_line equals 'yes' case-insensitively; false if NULL or any other value.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction identifier from stg_netsuite__transactions; present only for joined rows and therefore non-NULL.
      - name: transaction_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction status from the transactions table; passthrough and may be NULL.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction date as stored in the transactions table; treated as a string without parsing.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction type from the transactions table; passthrough and may be NULL.
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Line amount converted to DECIMAL(18,3); NULL amounts become 0 and values are stored with three decimal places.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_qualtrics__contacts
      description: XM Directory contacts joined with mailing list aggregates and flags; one row per directory_id + contact_id
      grain: One row per directory_id + contact_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__contact_mailing_list_membership
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact. - From staging.stg_qualtrics__contact_mailing_list_membership, for each (directory_id, contact_id): - Count distinct mailing_list_id into two metrics: - count_mailing_lists_subscribed_to counts lists where is_unsubscribed = false. - count_mailing_lists_unsubscribed_from counts lists where is_unsubscribed = true. - Rows with is_unsubscribed = NULL do not contribute; NULL mailing_list_id are excluded. If membership rows exist but none match a condition, the corresponding count is 0. - Concatenate all mailing_list_id values with the delimiter ", " across all membership rows; NULL mailing_list_id are excluded; duplicates are preserved; order is not guaranteed. Result is NULL if no non-NULL mailing_list_id exist for the contact in the directory. - Left join these aggregates to directory_contact on (directory_id, contact_id). - Output: - Set is_xm_directory_contact = true and is_research_core_contact = false for all rows. - Rename ext_ref to external_data_reference; all other selected fields are passed through from directory_contact. - If a contact has no membership rows in a directory, mailing_list_ids and both count fields are NULL due to the left join.'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact identifier within the directory; pairs with directory_id to define the row
      - name: is_xm_directory_contact
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant true for all rows
      - name: is_research_core_contact
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant false for all rows
      - name: directory_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Directory identifier; used to join aggregates and define the grain with contact_id
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through email from directory_contact; nullable
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through email domain from directory_contact; nullable
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through first name from directory_contact; nullable
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through last name from directory_contact; nullable
      - name: external_data_reference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through of ext_ref from directory_contact (renamed); nullable
      - name: language
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through language from directory_contact; nullable
      - name: is_unsubscribed_from_directory
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Directory-level unsubscribe flag from directory_contact; pass-through
      - name: unsubscribed_from_directory_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Directory-level unsubscribe timestamp from directory_contact; pass-through; nullable
      - name: last_modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last modification timestamp from directory_contact; pass-through; nullable
      - name: mailing_list_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space concatenation of mailing_list_id per directory_id+contact_id; NULL ids excluded; duplicates preserved; order not guaranteed; NULL if no non-NULL mailing_list_id
      - name: count_mailing_lists_subscribed_to
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of mailing_list_id where is_unsubscribed=false per directory_id+contact_id; excludes NULL ids and NULL status; NULL if no membership rows; 0 if memberships exist but none match
      - name: count_mailing_lists_unsubscribed_from
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of mailing_list_id where is_unsubscribed=true per directory_id+contact_id; excludes NULL ids and NULL status; NULL if no membership rows; 0 if memberships exist but none match
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Contact creation timestamp from directory_contact; pass-through; nullable

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_qualtrics__response_quality
      description: 'Per-response quality metrics computed from Qualtrics staging data: timing category, overall rating, numeric score, analysis inclusion flag, and run timestamp'
      grain: One row per staging survey response with non-null duration_in_seconds and progress
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response using fields: response_id, survey_id, duration_in_seconds, progress, is_finished. - Filter out rows where duration_in_seconds OR progress is NULL; no other filtering, joins, ordering, or deduplication is applied. - Compute timing_quality from duration_in_seconds using inclusive thresholds where stated: - "Too Fast" if duration_in_seconds < 30 - "Too Slow" if duration_in_seconds > 3600 - "Optimal" if duration_in_seconds between 120 and 1800 inclusive - "Suboptimal" otherwise (covers 30–119 and 1801–3600, inclusive of 30 and 3600) - Compute overall_quality_rating with ordered precedence (first match wins): - "High Quality" if is_finished is true AND progress >= 0.95 AND duration_in_seconds between 60 and 3600 inclusive - "Good Quality" if is_finished is true AND progress >= 0.8 - "Fair Quality" if progress >= 0.5 - "Poor Quality" otherwise Note: is_finished NULL does not satisfy the true condition (no coercion). - Compute quality_score with the same conditions and precedence as overall_quality_rating: - 90 for "High Quality", 75 for "Good Quality", 60 for "Fair Quality", 30 for "Poor Quality". - Set include_in_analysis = true only if is_finished is true AND progress >= 0.8 AND duration_in_seconds between 30 and 7200 inclusive; else false. - Set analysis_date to the execution time using the environment’s current timestamp; same value for all rows in a run. - Output the original fields plus the derived fields; no aggregations, and duplicate response_id values (if present in staging) are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: response_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the survey response from staging; may repeat if the source contains duplicates
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: survey_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the survey to which the response belongs (passed through from staging; may be NULL)
      - name: duration_in_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Response duration in seconds from staging; non-null due to filter; used for threshold comparisons only
      - name: progress
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion fraction from staging; non-null due to filter; compared against 0.5, 0.8, and 0.95 thresholds
      - name: is_finished
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Staging completion flag; may be NULL; NULL does not satisfy true in condition checks
      - name: timing_quality
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Timing category from duration_in_seconds: ''Too Fast''(<30), ''Too Slow''(>3600), ''Optimal''(120–1800 inclusive), else ''Suboptimal'''
      - name: overall_quality_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered evaluation: High if finished and progress>=0.95 and duration 60–3600; else Good if finished and progress>=0.8; else Fair if progress>=0.5; else Poor'
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score mapped from rating rules: 90 (High), 75 (Good), 60 (Fair), 30 (Poor)'
      - name: include_in_analysis
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only if finished and progress>=0.8 and duration_in_seconds between 30 and 7200 inclusive; otherwise false
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp assigned to all rows in the run using the environment’s current timestamp

- name: int_qualtrics__survey
      description: Survey records enriched with published version metadata, counts of previously published versions, and related user emails.
      grain: One row per survey_id per published survey_version row
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_version
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__user
      business_logic: '- Load all survey fields from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey unchanged; NULLs, casing, and whitespace are preserved. - Load all survey_version records from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_version. - Define latest_version as the set of survey_version records flagged as published; no tie-breaking or deduplication is applied. - For agg_versions, for each survey_id count unique version_number values among survey_version records flagged as previously published; missing version_number values are ignored. - Load users from staging.stg_qualtrics__user to resolve emails by user_id. - Left join survey to latest_version on survey_id. - Left join users three times: - version_publisher on publisher_user_id to obtain publisher_email, - owner on owner_user_id to obtain owner_email, - creator on creator_user_id to obtain creator_email. - Left join agg_versions on survey_id. - Output survey.* plus: version_id, version_number, version_description, survey_version_created_at (from the published survey_version created_at), count_published_versions, publisher_user_id, publisher_email, creator_email, owner_email. - Null and duplication behavior: - Left joins preserve survey rows; if no match, joined fields are NULL. - No ordering or deduplication is performed; if multiple published versions exist for a survey, one row is produced per matching version. If the user table contains multiple rows per user_id, additional duplicate combinations may appear.'
      columns:
      - name: survey_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique survey identifier used to join to versions and users.
      - name: survey_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable survey name from the survey record.
      - name: survey_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle status of the survey from the survey record.
      - name: brand_base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Base URL for the Qualtrics brand associated with the survey.
      - name: brand_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Qualtrics brand identifier associated with the survey.
      - name: bundle_short_name
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Bundle short name value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: composition_type
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composition type value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: auto_scoring_category
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Auto scoring category setting from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: default_scoring_category
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Default scoring category setting from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: division_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Division identifier associated with the survey; integer and may be NULL.
      - name: creator_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the survey creator, used to look up creator_email; may be NULL.
      - name: owner_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the survey owner, used to look up owner_email; may be NULL.
      - name: project_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project category value from the survey record.
      - name: project_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project type value from the survey record.
      - name: registry_sha
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Registry SHA value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: registry_version
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Registry version value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: schema_version
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Schema version value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: scoring_summary_after_questions
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether to show scoring summary after questions; may be NULL.
      - name: scoring_summary_after_survey
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether to show scoring summary after the survey; may be NULL.
      - name: scoring_summary_category
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Scoring summary category value from the survey record; numeric and may be NULL.
      - name: last_accessed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the survey was last accessed; may be NULL.
      - name: last_activated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the survey was last activated; may be NULL.
      - name: last_modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the survey was last modified; may be NULL.
      - name: version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier from a survey_version marked as published; NULL if none.
      - name: version_number
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Version number from a survey_version marked as published; NULL if none.
      - name: version_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Description from a survey_version marked as published; NULL if none.
      - name: survey_version_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp from a survey_version marked as published; NULL if none.
      - name: count_published_versions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per survey_id, count of unique version_number where the version was previously published; missing version numbers are ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: publisher_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the publisher from a published survey_version; NULL if none.
      - name: publisher_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email resolved by matching publisher_user_id to the user table; NULL if no match.
      - name: creator_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email resolved by matching creator_user_id to the user table; NULL if no match.
      - name: owner_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email resolved by matching owner_user_id to the user table; NULL if no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_qualtrics__survey_embedded_data
      description: Aggregates embedded key/value pairs per response into a single JSON-like string.
      grain: One row per response_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_embedded_data
      business_logic: '- Read rows from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_embedded_data using fields response_id, key, value. - Group records by response_id. - For each response_id, build embedded_data by concatenating all non-null "key:value" pairs with ", " as the separator, then wrap the result with leading "{" and trailing "}". - Pair order is not specified; original casing and whitespace are preserved; there is no quoting or escaping; duplicate pairs are kept. - If key or value is NULL, that pair is excluded; if all pairs are excluded, embedded_data is NULL (no braces). - Finally, retain unique combinations of response_id and embedded_data; because embedded_data is already constructed per response_id, the result remains one row per response_id.'
      columns:
      - name: response_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Survey response identifier used for grouping; exactly one output row per response_id; may be NULL.

      description: Simplified per-survey response metrics (counts, averages, completion rate) with execution timestamp

      business_logic: '- Load survey_id, survey_name, and survey_status from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey. - From staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response, exclude responses with NULL survey_id and aggregate by survey_id: - total_responses: count of unique response_id. - completed_responses: count of unique response_id where is_finished is true. - avg_completion_rate: average of progress; NULL values are ignored. - avg_completion_time_seconds: average of duration_in_seconds (in seconds); NULL values are ignored. - Left join these aggregates to the survey base on survey_id. - Replace missing aggregates with 0. - Set completion_rate to completed_responses divided by total_responses when total_responses > 0; otherwise 0. - Set analysis_date to the current timestamp at run time. - Keep only surveys with total_responses greater than 0.'

        - not_null

- name: int_qualtrics__user_engagement
      description: Aggregated Qualtrics response metrics per user with engagement labels and scores
      grain: One row per user_identifier with at least one response where recorded_date is not null
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      business_logic: '- Input filtering: only survey_response rows with recorded_date present are used. - User identifier: use recipient_email when available; otherwise use the literal prefix "anonymous_" followed by response_id. Casing and spacing from source are preserved. The output includes only users with at least one non-null response_id, so identifiers are present. - Group by user_identifier and compute: - total_responses: number of unique response_id values; missing IDs are ignored. - completed_responses: number of unique response_id values where the response is marked finished; missing IDs are ignored. - surveys_participated: number of unique survey_id values; missing survey IDs are ignored. - avg_completion_progress: average of progress values; missing values are ignored; returns NULL if none exist. - avg_response_duration: average of duration_in_seconds (in seconds); missing values are ignored; returns NULL if none exist. - completion_rate_score: if total_responses > 0, compute completed_responses / total_responses * 100; otherwise 0. No explicit rounding is applied. - engagement_level: based on total_responses thresholds: 10 or more → High Engagement; 5–9 → Medium Engagement; 2–4 → Low Engagement; 1 → Single Response. - overall_engagement_score: 5 points per response plus 10 points per completed response, capped at 100. - analysis_date: set to the current timestamp at model execution; identical across rows within a run. - Final filter: keep only users where total_responses > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: user_identifier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recipient email if present; otherwise 'anonymous_' plus response_id; one row per identifier; non-null in output
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: total_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique response_id values for the user; missing IDs ignored; strictly greater than zero
      - name: completed_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique response_id values marked finished for the user; missing IDs ignored
      - name: surveys_participated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique survey_id values associated with the user; missing values ignored
      - name: avg_completion_progress
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of progress values across the user's responses; ignores missing; returns NULL if none
      - name: avg_response_duration
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of duration_in_seconds across the user's responses; ignores missing; unit is seconds; returns NULL if none
      - name: engagement_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label by total_responses: High (>=10), Medium (>=5), Low (>=2), else Single Response'
      - name: completion_rate_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion percentage computed as completed_responses divided by total_responses times 100; 0–100; unrounded
      - name: overall_engagement_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Score equals 5 per response plus 10 per completed response, capped at 100
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Current timestamp at model execution; identical across rows in a run; time zone preserved

- name: qualtrics__channel_performance
      description: Channel-level performance metrics, market share, ranks, tiering, and recommendations computed from Qualtrics survey responses
      grain: One row per non-null distribution_channel with at least one non-null response_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      business_logic: '- Read all records from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response (fields used: distribution_channel, survey_id, response_id, is_finished, recipient_email, progress, duration_in_seconds). - Exclude rows where distribution_channel is NULL. - For each distribution_channel, compute: - surveys_using_channel: number of unique survey_id values (NULL survey_id ignored). - total_responses: number of unique response_id values (NULL response_id ignored). - completed_responses: number of unique response_id values where is_finished is true. - unique_participants: number of unique participant identifiers using recipient_email, defaulting to ''anonymous_'' + response_id when email is NULL; NULL outcomes are not counted. - completion_rate: completed_responses divided by total_responses; if total_responses is 0, set to 0. - avg_progress: arithmetic mean of progress, ignoring NULL values. - avg_duration: arithmetic mean of duration_in_seconds (seconds), ignoring NULL values. - rushed_responses: number of unique response_id values where duration_in_seconds < 60. - lengthy_responses: number of unique response_id values where duration_in_seconds > 3600. - efficiency_score: if total_responses > 0 and avg_duration > 0, compute completion_rate × duration_factor × 100, where duration_factor is 1.0 when avg_duration is between 120 and 1800 seconds inclusive, otherwise 0.8; else 0. - Across all channels (no partition), compute: - market_share: total_responses divided by the sum of total_responses across all channels. - completion_rank: rank by completion_rate descending (ties share ranks with gaps). - efficiency_rank: rank by efficiency_score descending (ties share ranks with gaps). - Classify: - channel_tier: Tier 1 - Premium when completion_rate ≥ 0.8 and efficiency_score ≥ 80; Tier 2 - Strong when completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and efficiency_score ≥ 60; Tier 3 - Average when completion_rate ≥ 0.4; otherwise Tier 4 - Underperforming. - strategic_recommendation: Scale and optimize when completion_rate ≥ 0.7 and market_share ≥ 0.2; Invest for growth when completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and market_share < 0.1; Improve or consider replacement when completion_rate < 0.4; otherwise Monitor and maintain. - Set analysis_date to the current timestamp at query execution. - Return only channels with total_responses > 0 and order rows by efficiency_score descending, then market_share descending.'
      columns:
      - name: distribution_channel
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel identifier used for grouping; non-null; exactly one row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: surveys_using_channel
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique survey_id count within the channel; NULL survey_id ignored
      - name: total_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique response_id count within the channel; NULL response_id ignored
      - name: completed_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique response_id count where is_finished is true; NULL response_id ignored
      - name: unique_participants
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique count using recipient_email, falling back to 'anonymous_' + response_id when email is NULL; NULL outcomes not counted; original casing preserved
      - name: completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of completed_responses to total_responses when total_responses > 0, else 0; no rounding
      - name: avg_progress
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of progress for the channel; NULL values ignored; no rounding
      - name: avg_duration
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of duration_in_seconds in seconds; NULL values ignored; no rounding
      - name: rushed_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique response_id count where duration_in_seconds < 60; NULL durations ignored
      - name: lengthy_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique response_id count where duration_in_seconds > 3600; NULL durations ignored
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_responses > 0 and avg_duration > 0, completion_rate × duration_factor × 100 where duration_factor is 1.0 for 120–1800 seconds inclusive, else 0.8; otherwise 0; no rounding
      - name: market_share
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Channel total_responses divided by the sum across all channels; computed before final filtering; no rounding
      - name: completion_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank across all channels by completion_rate descending; ties share ranks with gaps; computed before final filtering
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank across all channels by efficiency_score descending; ties share ranks with gaps; computed before final filtering
      - name: channel_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier 1 if completion_rate ≥ 0.8 and efficiency_score ≥ 80; Tier 2 if completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and efficiency_score ≥ 60; Tier 3 if completion_rate ≥ 0.4; else Tier 4
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Scale and optimize if completion_rate ≥ 0.7 and market_share ≥ 0.2; Invest for growth if completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and market_share < 0.1; Improve or consider replacement if completion_rate < 0.4; else Monitor and maintain
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp at query execution; identical across output rows; time zone preserved

else 0. - Across all channels (no partition), compute: - market_share: total_responses divided by the sum of total_responses across all channels. - completion_rank: rank by completion_rate descending (ties share ranks with gaps). - efficiency_rank: rank by efficiency_score descending (ties share ranks with gaps). - Classify: - channel_tier: Tier 1 - Premium when completion_rate ≥ 0.8 and efficiency_score ≥ 80; blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__contact
      description: Contact profile with directory attributes and aggregated survey engagement metrics
      grain: One row per contact_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_qualtrics__contacts
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_qualtrics__contacts as the base; one output row per contacts.contact_id. - Build distribution_response by: - Joining distribution_contact to distribution on distribution_id to add survey_id. - Left joining survey_response on both response_id and survey_id to add distribution_channel, progress, duration_in_seconds, is_finished, recorded_date; retain sent_at, opened_at, response_started_at, response_completed_at from distribution_contact. - For each contact_id, compute channel-specific counts as the number of distinct survey_id meeting each condition; survey_id must be present, and counts default to 0 when no matches: - Sent via email: sent_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Sent via SMS: sent_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Opened via email: opened_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Opened via SMS: opened_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Started via email: response_started_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Started via SMS: response_started_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Completed via email: response_completed_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Completed via SMS: response_completed_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - For each contact_id, compute overall survey engagement across all distribution_response rows: - total_count_surveys: distinct survey_id across all rows; defaults to 0 when none. - total_count_completed_surveys: distinct survey_id where is_finished is true; defaults to 0 when none. - avg_survey_progress_pct: average of progress over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs. - avg_survey_duration_in_seconds: average of duration_in_seconds over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs. - last_survey_response_recorded_at: the latest recorded_date; NULL when none. - first_survey_response_recorded_at: the earliest recorded_date; NULL when none. - Compute medians per contact_id over non-NULL values using the 50th percentile with continuous interpolation: - median_survey_duration_in_seconds from duration_in_seconds. - median_survey_progress_pct from progress. - Join directory by contacts.directory_id to bring directory_name (name) and is_in_default_directory (is_default). - Final output includes all contact fields plus the computed aggregates and directory attributes; all joins are left joins to maintain one row per contact_id.'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique contact identifier and aggregation key
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: is_xm_directory_contact
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pass-through; indicates an XM directory contact
      - name: is_research_core_contact
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pass-through; indicates a research core contact
      - name: directory_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; directory key used to join directory attributes
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; contact email address
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; domain portion of the email
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; contact first name
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; contact last name
      - name: external_data_reference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; external reference identifier
      - name: language
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; language preference
      - name: is_unsubscribed_from_directory
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pass-through; directory unsubscribe flag
      - name: unsubscribed_from_directory_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Pass-through; timestamp when unsubscribed
      - name: last_modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Pass-through; last modification timestamp
      - name: mailing_list_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through; associated mailing list identifiers (format unchanged)
      - name: count_mailing_lists_subscribed_to
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Pass-through; number of mailing lists the contact is subscribed to
      - name: count_mailing_lists_unsubscribed_from
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Pass-through; number of mailing lists the contact unsubscribed from
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Pass-through; contact creation timestamp
      - name: count_surveys_sent_email
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys sent via email (sent_at present and channel is email); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_sent_sms
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys sent via SMS (sent_at present and channel is smsinvite); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_opened_email
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys opened via email (opened_at present and channel is email); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_opened_sms
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys opened via SMS (opened_at present and channel is smsinvite); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_started_email
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys started via email (response_started_at present and channel is email); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_started_sms
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys started via SMS (response_started_at present and channel is smsinvite); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_completed_email
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys completed via email (response_completed_at present and channel is email); defaults to 0
      - name: count_surveys_completed_sms
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys completed via SMS (response_completed_at present and channel is smsinvite); defaults to 0
      - name: total_count_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct survey count across all responses; defaults to 0
      - name: total_count_completed_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct survey count with is_finished true; defaults to 0
      - name: avg_survey_progress_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average progress over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs
      - name: avg_survey_duration_in_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average duration_in_seconds over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs
      - name: median_survey_progress_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Median (50th percentile) of progress over non-NULL values; continuous interpolation; NULL when none
      - name: median_survey_duration_in_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Median (50th percentile) of duration_in_seconds over non-NULL values; continuous interpolation; NULL when none
      - name: last_survey_response_recorded_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest recorded_date across responses; NULL when none
      - name: first_survey_response_recorded_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Earliest recorded_date across responses; NULL when none
      - name: directory_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Directory name joined by directory_id; NULL when no match
      - name: is_in_default_directory
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Directory default flag joined by directory_id; NULL when no match
