references.name: intermediate.int_qualtrics__contacts
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_qualtrics__contacts as the base; one output row per contacts.contact_id. - Build distribution_response by: - Joining distribution_contact to distribution on distribution_id to add survey_id. - Left joining survey_response on both response_id and survey_id to add distribution_channel, progress, duration_in_seconds, is_finished, recorded_date; retain sent_at, opened_at, response_started_at, response_completed_at from distribution_contact. - For each contact_id, compute channel-specific counts as the number of distinct survey_id meeting each condition; survey_id must be present, and counts default to 0 when no matches: - Sent via email: sent_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Sent via SMS: sent_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Opened via email: opened_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Opened via SMS: opened_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Started via email: response_started_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Started via SMS: response_started_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - Completed via email: response_completed_at present and distribution_channel is "email". - Completed via SMS: response_completed_at present and distribution_channel is "smsinvite". - For each contact_id, compute overall survey engagement across all distribution_response rows: - total_count_surveys: distinct survey_id across all rows; defaults to 0 when none. - total_count_completed_surveys: distinct survey_id where is_finished is true; defaults to 0 when none. - avg_survey_progress_pct: average of progress over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs. - avg_survey_duration_in_seconds: average of duration_in_seconds over non-NULL values; NULL when no non-NULL inputs. - last_survey_response_recorded_at: the latest recorded_date; NULL when none. - first_survey_response_recorded_at: the earliest recorded_date; NULL when none. - Compute medians per contact_id over non-NULL values using the 50th percentile with continuous interpolation: - median_survey_duration_in_seconds from duration_in_seconds. - median_survey_progress_pct from progress. - Join directory by contacts.directory_id to bring directory_name (name) and is_in_default_directory (is_default). - Final output includes all contact fields plus the computed aggregates and directory attributes; all joins are left joins to maintain one row per contact_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__daily_breakdown
      description: Daily Qualtrics contact and response metrics with zero-filled counts per calendar day
      grain: One row per date_day
      source_models:
      - mart.qualtrics__response
      - mart.qualtrics__contact
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__contact_mailing_list_membership
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact
      business_logic: '- Build a continuous daily date spine from the earliest survey send date to seven days after today; if no sends exist, start at 2016-01-01. Each spine entry is a midnight timestamp named date_day. - Aggregate responses by the calendar day of survey_response_recorded_at; records with an unparseable recorded timestamp are excluded. Compute: - Distinct surveys with at least one response that day. - Distinct responses that day, and distinct finished responses that day. - Channel-based distinct response counts using Qualtrics channel values: anonymous; social (reported as social_media); gl (reported as personal_link); qr (reported as qr_code); email; smsinvite (reported as sms). For each channel, also count finished responses. Uncategorized includes channels not in that list. - Aggregate distribution activity by the day the survey was sent: distinct contacts sent, opened, started, and completed. Opened/started/completed are attributed to the sent day (based on sent_at), not to their own event timestamps. - Aggregate contacts by day: distinct contacts created and distinct contacts unsubscribed from the directory. - Aggregate mailing list unsubscriptions by day: distinct contacts unsubscribed from a mailing list. - Left join all aggregates to the spine on date_day and replace missing counts with 0 to ensure one row per day.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Midnight timestamp for the calendar day from the spine; one row per day
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_contacts_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts created on this day; 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_unsubscribed_from_directory
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts that unsubscribed from the directory on this day; 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_unsubscribed_from_mailing_list
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts that unsubscribed from a mailing list on this day; 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_sent_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts with surveys sent on this day (based on sent_at); 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_opened_sent_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts who opened a sent survey, counted on the sent day; 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_started_sent_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts who started a sent survey, counted on the sent day; 0 if none
      - name: count_contacts_completed_sent_surveys
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct contacts who completed a sent survey, counted on the sent day; 0 if none
      - name: count_distinct_surveys_responded_to
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct surveys with at least one response recorded on this day; records with unparseable times are excluded; 0 if none
      - name: total_count_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day; records with unparseable times are excluded; 0 if none
      - name: total_count_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day; 0 if none
      - name: count_anonymous_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the anonymous channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_anonymous_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the anonymous channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_social_media_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the social channel (reported as social_media); 0 if none
      - name: count_social_media_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the social channel (reported as social_media); 0 if none
      - name: count_personal_link_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the gl channel (reported as personal_link); 0 if none
      - name: count_personal_link_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the gl channel (reported as personal_link); 0 if none
      - name: count_qr_code_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the qr channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_qr_code_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the qr channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_email_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the email channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_email_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the email channel; 0 if none
      - name: count_sms_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from the smsinvite channel (reported as sms); 0 if none
      - name: count_sms_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from the smsinvite channel (reported as sms); 0 if none
      - name: count_uncategorized_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct responses recorded on this day from channels outside anonymous, social, gl, qr, email, smsinvite; 0 if none
      - name: count_uncategorized_completed_survey_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct finished responses recorded on this day from channels outside anonymous, social, gl, qr, email, smsinvite; 0 if none

current_date + interval 7 days,

business_logic: '- Build a continuous daily date spine from the earliest survey send date to seven days after today; if no sends exist, start at 2016-01-01. Each spine entry is a midnight timestamp named date_day. - Aggregate responses by the calendar day of survey_response_recorded_at; records with an unparseable recorded timestamp are excluded. Compute: - Distinct surveys with at least one response that day. - Distinct responses that day, and distinct finished responses that day. - Channel-based distinct response counts using Qualtrics channel values: anonymous; social (reported as social_media); gl (reported as personal_link); qr (reported as qr_code); email; smsinvite (reported as sms). For each channel, also count finished responses. Uncategorized includes channels not in that list. - Aggregate distribution activity by the day the survey was sent: distinct contacts sent, opened, started, and completed. Opened/started/completed are attributed to the sent day (based on sent_at), not to their own event timestamps. - Aggregate contacts by day: distinct contacts created and distinct contacts unsubscribed from the directory. - Aggregate mailing list unsubscriptions by day: distinct contacts unsubscribed from a mailing list. - Left join all aggregates to the spine on date_day and replace missing counts with 0 to ensure one row per day.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__directory
      description: Directory attributes enriched with deterministic 30-day contact, distribution, and mailing list aggregates
      grain: One row per directory_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution
      business_logic: '- Base: output includes all columns from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory with one row per directory_id. - General rules: All “unique counts” treat values as exact matches, ignore NULLs, and return 0 when no contributing rows exist. The 30-day window is inclusive of events up to 30 days before the execution timestamp. Distribution metrics consider only contacts with a non-null sent_at within this window. - Mailing lists: per directory_id, count unique mailing_list_id from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list. - Contacts (from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact), per directory_id: - count_distinct_emails: unique email values. - count_distinct_phones: unique phone values. - total_count_contacts: unique contact_id values. - total_count_unsubscribed_contacts: unique contact_id values flagged as unsubscribed in the directory; timestamp not required. - count_contacts_created_30d: unique contacts whose created_at falls within the last 30 days. - count_contacts_unsubscribed_30d: unique contacts flagged as unsubscribed with unsubscribed_from_directory_at within the last 30 days. - Distributions: inner join staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact to staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact on contact_id (restricting to contacts in the directory); left join staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution on distribution_id to access survey_id. Filter to rows with sent_at present within the last 30 days. Per directory_id: - count_contacts_sent_survey_30d: unique contacts sent at least one survey. - count_contacts_opened_survey_30d: unique contacts with an open timestamp. - count_contacts_started_survey_30d: unique contacts with a response start timestamp. - count_contacts_completed_survey_30d: unique contacts with a response completion timestamp. - count_surveys_sent_30d: unique surveys sent. - Final: left join all aggregates to the base directory by directory_id and replace missing aggregates with 0.'
      columns:
      - name: is_deduped_on_email
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the directory deduplicates contacts by email; passthrough from source
      - name: is_deduped_on_ext_ref
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the directory deduplicates contacts by external reference; passthrough from source
      - name: is_deduped_on_first_name
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the directory deduplicates contacts by first name; passthrough from source
      - name: is_deduped_on_last_name
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the directory deduplicates contacts by last name; passthrough from source
      - name: is_deduped_on_phone
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the directory deduplicates contacts by phone; passthrough from source
      - name: directory_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique directory identifier and grouping key; one output row per directory_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: is_default
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether this is the default directory; passthrough from source
      - name: name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Directory name; passthrough from source
      - name: count_distinct_emails
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique email values; nulls ignored; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_distinct_phones
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique phone values; nulls ignored; returns 0 when none
      - name: total_count_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contact_id values; nulls ignored; returns 0 when none
      - name: total_count_unsubscribed_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique unsubscribed contact_id values; timestamp not required; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_created_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts created within the last 30 days; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_unsubscribed_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts unsubscribed within the last 30 days; requires unsubscribed flag and timestamp; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_sent_survey_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts sent at least one survey within the last 30 days; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_opened_survey_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts who opened a survey among those sent within the last 30 days; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_started_survey_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts who started a response among those sent within the last 30 days; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_contacts_completed_survey_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique contacts who completed a response among those sent within the last 30 days; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_surveys_sent_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique surveys sent within the last 30 days; null survey identifiers ignored; returns 0 when none
      - name: count_mailing_lists
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per directory, count of unique mailing lists; null identifiers ignored; returns 0 when none

references.name: staging.stg_qualtrics__directory
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Base: output includes all columns from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory with one row per directory_id. - General rules: All “unique counts” treat values as exact matches, ignore NULLs, and return 0 when no contributing rows exist. The 30-day window is inclusive of events up to 30 days before the execution timestamp. Distribution metrics consider only contacts with a non-null sent_at within this window. - Mailing lists: per directory_id, count unique mailing_list_id from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list. - Contacts (from staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact), per directory_id: - count_distinct_emails: unique email values. - count_distinct_phones: unique phone values. - total_count_contacts: unique contact_id values. - total_count_unsubscribed_contacts: unique contact_id values flagged as unsubscribed in the directory; timestamp not required. - count_contacts_created_30d: unique contacts whose created_at falls within the last 30 days. - count_contacts_unsubscribed_30d: unique contacts flagged as unsubscribed with unsubscribed_from_directory_at within the last 30 days. - Distributions: inner join staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact to staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_contact on contact_id (restricting to contacts in the directory); left join staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution on distribution_id to access survey_id. Filter to rows with sent_at present within the last 30 days. Per directory_id: - count_contacts_sent_survey_30d: unique contacts sent at least one survey. - count_contacts_opened_survey_30d: unique contacts with an open timestamp. - count_contacts_started_survey_30d: unique contacts with a response start timestamp. - count_contacts_completed_survey_30d: unique contacts with a response completion timestamp. - count_surveys_sent_30d: unique surveys sent. - Final: left join all aggregates to the base directory by directory_id and replace missing aggregates with 0.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__distribution
      description: Qualtrics distributions enriched with owner, mailing list, parent subject, and aggregated delivery/response metrics
      grain: One row per distribution_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__user
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact
      business_logic: 'Base: - Start from staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution as the base (one row per distribution_id). Enrichments: - Owner details: left join staging.stg_qualtrics__user on owner_user_id = user_id to add owner_email, owner_first_name, owner_last_name. - Parent subject: self-join on parent_distribution_id = distribution_id to add parent_distribution_header_subject from the parent row. - Mailing list name: left join staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list on recipient_mailing_list_id = mailing_list_id to add recipient_mailing_list_name. Distribution-contact metrics: - Build distribution_contact from staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact and derive per contact: - time_to_open_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and opened_at. - time_to_start_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and response_started_at. - time_to_complete_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and response_completed_at. - Durations are NULL if either endpoint is NULL; units are seconds. - Aggregate per distribution_id: - Status counts: for each status value (pending, success, error, opened, complaint, skipped, blocked, failure, unknown, softbounce, hardbounce, surveystarted, surveypartiallyfinished, surveyfinished, surveyscreenedout, sessionexpired), count contact records whose lowercase status equals the value; NULL and non-matching statuses are excluded. - Contact totals: number of unique contact_ids; and unique contact_ids with sent_at/opened_at/response_started_at/response_completed_at present. - First/last timestamps: earliest and latest of sent_at, opened_at, and response_completed_at across contacts; null if no non-null values. - Averages: mean of non-null time_to_open/start/complete durations; null if no non-null values. - Median metrics: - For each duration (open/start/complete), compute the continuous median (50th percentile) across non-null values, using linear interpolation when needed. Final projection: - Select all base columns and add enrichment/metric columns. - Coalesce only the numeric counts (status counts and distinct contact counts) to 0; timestamps, averages, and medians may remain NULL. Output: - One row per distribution_id from the base, with left-join semantics for enrichments and metrics.'
      columns:
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp of the distribution in Qualtrics
      - name: header_from_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender email address used in the distribution header
      - name: header_from_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender display name used in the distribution header
      - name: header_reply_to_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reply-to email address configured for the distribution
      - name: header_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email subject configured on this distribution
      - name: distribution_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier of the distribution; primary key for this table
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: message_library_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the Qualtrics message library used by the distribution
      - name: message_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the message within the referenced message library
      - name: message_text
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Message body text associated with the distribution
      - name: last_modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last modification timestamp of the distribution in Qualtrics
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Qualtrics organization identifier that owns the distribution
      - name: owner_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Qualtrics user_id of the distribution owner (join key to users)
      - name: parent_distribution_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: If this distribution is a child, the distribution_id of its parent
      - name: recipient_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recipient contact identifier targeted by the distribution (if applicable)
      - name: recipient_library_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the contact library associated to recipients
      - name: recipient_mailing_list_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the mailing list targeted by the distribution
      - name: recipient_sample_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the recipient sample associated with the distribution
      - name: request_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status of the distribution request as recorded by Qualtrics
      - name: request_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type of distribution request (e.g., Email, SMS)
      - name: send_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled or actual send timestamp for the distribution
      - name: survey_link_expires_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when distributed survey links expire
      - name: survey_link_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type of survey link generated (e.g., individual, anonymous)
      - name: survey_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the survey being distributed
      - name: parent_distribution_header_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subject line from the parent distribution
      - name: recipient_mailing_list_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable name of the recipient mailing list
      - name: owner_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address of the distribution owner
      - name: owner_first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name of the distribution owner
      - name: owner_last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name of the distribution owner
      - name: current_count_surveys_pending
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'pending' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_success
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'success' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_error
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'error' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'opened' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_complaint
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'complaint' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_skipped
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'skipped' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_blocked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of contact records with status 'blocked' (case-insensitive); NULL/other statuses excluded; 0 if none
      - name: current_count_surveys_failure

references.name: staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Base: - Start from staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution as the base (one row per distribution_id). Enrichments: - Owner details: left join staging.stg_qualtrics__user on owner_user_id = user_id to add owner_email, owner_first_name, owner_last_name. - Parent subject: self-join on parent_distribution_id = distribution_id to add parent_distribution_header_subject from the parent row. - Mailing list name: left join staging.stg_qualtrics__directory_mailing_list on recipient_mailing_list_id = mailing_list_id to add recipient_mailing_list_name. Distribution-contact metrics: - Build distribution_contact from staging.stg_qualtrics__distribution_contact and derive per contact: - time_to_open_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and opened_at. - time_to_start_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and response_started_at. - time_to_complete_in_seconds: seconds between sent_at and response_completed_at. - Durations are NULL if either endpoint is NULL; units are seconds. - Aggregate per distribution_id: - Status counts: for each status value (pending, success, error, opened, complaint, skipped, blocked, failure, unknown, softbounce, hardbounce, surveystarted, surveypartiallyfinished, surveyfinished, surveyscreenedout, sessionexpired), count contact records whose lowercase status equals the value; NULL and non-matching statuses are excluded. - Contact totals: number of unique contact_ids; and unique contact_ids with sent_at/opened_at/response_started_at/response_completed_at present. - First/last timestamps: earliest and latest of sent_at, opened_at, and response_completed_at across contacts; null if no non-null values. - Averages: mean of non-null time_to_open/start/complete durations; null if no non-null values. - Median metrics: - For each duration (open/start/complete), compute the continuous median (50th percentile) across non-null values, using linear interpolation when needed. Final projection: - Select all base columns and add enrichment/metric columns. - Coalesce only the numeric counts (status counts and distinct contact counts) to 0; timestamps, averages, and medians may remain NULL. Output: - One row per distribution_id from the base, with left-join semantics for enrichments and metrics.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__survey
      description: Survey-level rollup of base survey attributes joined with question counts, response aggregates, medians, and distribution-channel counts
      grain: One row per survey_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__question
      business_logic: '- Start with all columns from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey as the base survey record; output one row per survey_id. - Questions: from staging.stg_qualtrics__question, group by survey_id and count distinct question_id as count_questions; left join to the base; if no matches, set count_questions to 0. - Response aggregates: from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response, group by survey_id and compute: - Averages: avg_response_duration_in_seconds from duration_in_seconds and avg_survey_progress_pct from progress, both over non-null values; if no contributing rows, leave as NULL. - Totals: count_survey_responses as distinct response_id; count_completed_survey_responses as distinct response_id where the response is marked finished. - 30-day window: count_survey_responses_30d and count_completed_survey_responses_30d include responses whose recorded_date can be parsed to a timestamp and falls within the last 30 calendar days relative to query time, with the boundary included; the completed variant also requires finished responses; rows with unparseable recorded_date are excluded from these 30-day counts. - Channel buckets (distinct response_id): anonymous (''anonymous''), social media (''social''), personal link (''gl''), QR code (''qr''), email (''email''), and SMS (''smsinvite''); for each, also compute a completed version requiring finished responses. Uncategorized buckets include responses whose channel is a non-null value not in the listed set; responses with NULL channel are excluded from all channel buckets, including uncategorized. - Medians: per survey_id, compute the median (50th percentile) of duration_in_seconds and of progress over non-null values; if no contributing rows, leave as NULL. - Join: left join question, response aggregates, and medians to the base by survey_id. Coalesce all count metrics to 0; averages and medians remain NULL when no data. All counts use distinct response_id or question_id.'
      columns:
      - name: survey_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key from the base survey; exactly one output row per survey_id
      - name: survey_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Survey display name passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: survey_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Survey lifecycle status passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: brand_base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Qualtrics brand base URL passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: brand_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Qualtrics brand identifier passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: bundle_short_name
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Bundle short name code passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: composition_type
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Survey composition type code passed through from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey
      - name: auto_scoring_category

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start with all columns from intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey as the base survey record; output one row per survey_id. - Questions: from staging.stg_qualtrics__question, group by survey_id and count distinct question_id as count_questions; left join to the base; if no matches, set count_questions to 0. - Response aggregates: from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response, group by survey_id and compute: - Averages: avg_response_duration_in_seconds from duration_in_seconds and avg_survey_progress_pct from progress, both over non-null values; if no contributing rows, leave as NULL. - Totals: count_survey_responses as distinct response_id; count_completed_survey_responses as distinct response_id where the response is marked finished. - 30-day window: count_survey_responses_30d and count_completed_survey_responses_30d include responses whose recorded_date can be parsed to a timestamp and falls within the last 30 calendar days relative to query time, with the boundary included; the completed variant also requires finished responses; rows with unparseable recorded_date are excluded from these 30-day counts. - Channel buckets (distinct response_id): anonymous (''anonymous''), social media (''social''), personal link (''gl''), QR code (''qr''), email (''email''), and SMS (''smsinvite''); for each, also compute a completed version requiring finished responses. Uncategorized buckets include responses whose channel is a non-null value not in the listed set; responses with NULL channel are excluded from all channel buckets, including uncategorized. - Medians: per survey_id, compute the median (50th percentile) of duration_in_seconds and of progress over non-null values; if no contributing rows, leave as NULL. - Join: left join question, response aggregates, and medians to the base by survey_id. Coalesce all count metrics to 0; averages and medians remain NULL when no data. All counts use distinct response_id or question_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: qualtrics__survey_analytics
      description: Survey-level performance and quality metrics joined to a per-survey quality summary, restricted to surveys with total_responses > 0.
      grain: One row per survey_id with total_responses > 0
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_qualtrics__survey_performance
      - intermediate.int_qualtrics__response_quality
      business_logic: '- Load survey_performance with survey_id, survey_name, survey_status, total_responses, completed_responses, completion_rate, and avg_completion_time_seconds. - Load response_quality with survey_id, response_id, include_in_analysis, quality_score, and overall_quality_rating. - Build a quality_summary per survey_id: - total_assessed_responses = number of distinct response_id values. - high_quality_responses = number of responses where include_in_analysis is true; false or null are not counted. - avg_quality_score = average of quality_score values; records with null quality_score are ignored; no rounding. - excellent_responses = number of responses where overall_quality_rating equals "High Quality" (exact string match). - Left join survey_performance to quality_summary by survey_id. - When quality_summary is missing, set avg_quality_score, high_quality_responses, and excellent_responses to 0; if avg_quality_score is null, use 0. - Compute quality_adjusted_completion_rate: - If total_responses > 0 and total_assessed_responses > 0, multiply completion_rate by the fraction high_quality_responses / total_responses (fractional division; no truncation); otherwise use completion_rate; if completion_rate is null, the result is null. - Assign performance_tier using inclusive thresholds: - High Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.8 and avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) ≥ 80. - Good Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) ≥ 60. - Average Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.4. - Otherwise Needs Improvement. - Compute roi_score as completion_rate * 60 plus avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) * 0.4; if completion_rate is null, roi_score is null; no rounding. - Set analysis_date to the current timestamp (same value for all rows in a run). - Filter out surveys where total_responses ≤ 0 or total_responses is null. - Order the final output by roi_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: survey_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique survey identifier and join key; one output row per survey_id after filtering to total_responses > 0.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: survey_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Survey name from survey_performance; passed through with nulls preserved.
      - name: survey_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current survey status from survey_performance; passed through with nulls preserved.
      - name: total_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total responses from survey_performance; strictly greater than 0 in the output due to final filter.
      - name: completed_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Completed response count from survey_performance; passed through with nulls preserved.
      - name: completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion rate from survey_performance used in adjustments, tiering, and ROI; passed through with nulls preserved.
      - name: avg_completion_time_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average completion time in seconds from survey_performance; passed through without rounding; nulls preserved.
      - name: avg_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of quality_score per survey ignoring nulls; uses 0 when no matching quality_summary or the average is null.
      - name: high_quality_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of responses where include_in_analysis is true; uses 0 when no matching quality_summary; no de-dup beyond distinct response counting in total_assessed_responses.
      - name: excellent_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of responses where overall_quality_rating equals 'High Quality'; uses 0 when no matching quality_summary; exact string match; no de-duplication.
      - name: quality_adjusted_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_responses > 0 and total_assessed_responses > 0, completion_rate multiplied by high_quality_responses divided by total_responses (fractional division); otherwise completion_rate; null when completion_rate is null; no rounding.
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: High Performer, Good Performer, Average Performer, or Needs Improvement based on inclusive completion_rate thresholds and avg_quality_score using 0 when missing.'
      - name: roi_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Score computed as completion_rate * 60 plus avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) * 0.4; null when completion_rate is null; no rounding.
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp from current_timestamp; identical across rows within a run and not null.

business_logic: '- Load survey_performance with survey_id, survey_name, survey_status, total_responses, completed_responses, completion_rate, and avg_completion_time_seconds. - Load response_quality with survey_id, response_id, include_in_analysis, quality_score, and overall_quality_rating. - Build a quality_summary per survey_id: - total_assessed_responses = number of distinct response_id values. - high_quality_responses = number of responses where include_in_analysis is true; false or null are not counted. - avg_quality_score = average of quality_score values; records with null quality_score are ignored; no rounding. - excellent_responses = number of responses where overall_quality_rating equals "High Quality" (exact string match). - Left join survey_performance to quality_summary by survey_id. - When quality_summary is missing, set avg_quality_score, high_quality_responses, and excellent_responses to 0; if avg_quality_score is null, use 0. - Compute quality_adjusted_completion_rate: - If total_responses > 0 and total_assessed_responses > 0, multiply completion_rate by the fraction high_quality_responses / total_responses (fractional division; no truncation); otherwise use completion_rate; if completion_rate is null, the result is null. - Assign performance_tier using inclusive thresholds: - High Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.8 and avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) ≥ 80. - Good Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.6 and avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) ≥ 60. - Average Performer when completion_rate ≥ 0.4. - Otherwise Needs Improvement. - Compute roi_score as completion_rate * 60 plus avg_quality_score (using 0 when missing) * 0.4; if completion_rate is null, roi_score is null; no rounding. - Set analysis_date to the current timestamp (same value for all rows in a run). - Filter out surveys where total_responses ≤ 0 or total_responses is null. - Order the final output by roi_score descending.'
description: Execution timestamp from current_timestamp; identical across rows within a run and not null.

- name: qualtrics__user_cohort_analysis
      description: 'Monthly user cohort metrics from Qualtrics responses: cohort size, per-user averages, value-tier counts, and a 0–100 health score'
      grain: One row per cohort_month
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response
      business_logic: 'Build cohorts from staging.stg_qualtrics__survey_response: - Keep only records with recorded_date present. - Define user_identifier: use recipient_email when available; otherwise use the literal prefix "anonymous_" followed by response_id. - Per user_identifier: - first_response_date: the earliest timestamp parsed from recorded_date. - cohort_month: the first calendar day of the month of first_response_date. - total_responses: count of distinct response_id. - completed_responses: count of distinct response_id where is_finished is true (null/false excluded). - completion_rate (percent): if total_responses > 0, completed_responses / total_responses × 100; otherwise 0. Use decimal division. - user_value_tier by total_responses: ≥20 Power User; ≥10 High Value; ≥5 Medium Value; ≥2 Low Value; else One-time User. Aggregate by cohort_month: - cohort_size: distinct users in the cohort. - avg_responses_per_user: average of per-user total_responses. - avg_completion_rate: average of per-user completion_rate (percent). - power_users/high_value_users/medium_value_users/low_value_users/one_time_users: counts of users in each tier. - cohort_health_score: 0.6 × avg_completion_rate + 40 × (count of Power or High Value users ÷ cohort_size). Expected range 0–100. Finalize: - Exclude cohorts where cohort_size = 0. - Return one row per cohort_month; sorted descending by cohort_month (sorting does not affect values).'
      columns:
      - name: cohort_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month of each user's first response; cohort grouping key.
      - name: cohort_size
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct users in the cohort_month.
      - name: avg_responses_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean per-user count of distinct responses within the cohort.
      - name: avg_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean per-user completion rate in percent, where per-user rate is completed distinct responses divided by total distinct responses times 100.
      - name: power_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of users with total_responses ≥ 20 in the cohort.
      - name: high_value_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of users with total_responses ≥ 10 and < 20 in the cohort.
      - name: medium_value_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of users with total_responses ≥ 5 and < 10 in the cohort.
      - name: low_value_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of users with total_responses ≥ 2 and < 5 in the cohort.
      - name: one_time_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of users with total_responses = 1 in the cohort.
      - name: cohort_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: '0–100 score: 0.6×avg_completion_rate + 40×(share of Power or High Value users in the cohort).'

- name: stg_qualtrics__directory_contact
      description: "Cleaned and validated Qualtrics directory contact records including email normalization, phone digitization, and unsubscribe tracking"
      source_table: "raw.directory_contact"
      primary_key: ["contact_id"]
      columns:
        - name: contact_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "contact_id IS NOT NULL"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: directory_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: unsubscribed_from_directory_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: is_unsubscribed_from_directory
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: email
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "email IS NULL OR email = LOWER(TRIM(email))"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "email IS NULL OR email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: email_domain
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "email_domain IS NULL OR email_domain = LOWER(TRIM(email_domain))"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: ext_ref
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "ext_ref IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(ext_ref)) = LENGTH(ext_ref)"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: first_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "first_name IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(first_name)) = LENGTH(first_name)"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: last_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "last_name IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(last_name)) = LENGTH(last_name)"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: phone
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "phone IS NULL OR REGEXP_REPLACE(phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = phone"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "phone IS NULL OR LENGTH(phone) >= 5"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: language
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "language IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(language)) = LENGTH(language)"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: last_modified_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "last_modified_at IS NULL OR last_modified_at >= created_at"

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__account_classifications
      description: Account classifications, multipliers, adjusted balances, and parent account presentation derived from QuickBooks accounts
      grain: One row per source account record keyed by (account_id, source_relation); duplicates from source may exist
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_quickbooks__account with all columns passed through unchanged. - Derive classification: - If source classification is not NULL, keep it. - Else map by exact case-sensitive account_type: - Asset: account_type IN (''Bank'',''Other Current Asset'',''Fixed Asset'',''Other Asset'',''Accounts Receivable'') - Equity: account_type = ''Equity'' - Expense: account_type IN (''Expense'',''Other Expense'',''Cost of Goods Sold'') - Liability: account_type IN (''Accounts Payable'',''Credit Card'',''Long Term Liability'',''Other Current Liability'') - Revenue: account_type IN (''Income'',''Other Income'') - If none match and source classification is NULL, classification remains NULL. - Derive multiplier: -1 when classification IN (''Liability'',''Equity''); 1 when classification = ''Asset''; else NULL. - Derive financial_statement_helper: ''balance_sheet'' when classification IN (''Asset'',''Liability'',''Equity''); else ''income_statement''. - Derive transaction_type: ''debit'' when classification IN (''Asset'',''Expense''); else ''credit''. - Compute adjusted_balance by multiplying balance by multiplier; if either input is NULL, adjusted_balance is NULL; numeric scale as DECIMAL(38,6). - Left join the same accounts table as parent_accounts on parent_account_id = parent_accounts.account_id and matching source_relation. - parent_account_number: if is_sub_account = TRUE, use parent_accounts.account_number; else use own account_number; NULL if parent not found. - parent_account_name: if is_sub_account = TRUE, use parent_accounts.fully_qualified_name; else use own fully_qualified_name; NULL if parent not found. - No aggregation or sorting is performed; source ordering is preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary account identifier; pairs with source_relation to define row grain
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source relation identifier used with account_id for grain and parent joins
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number; used when not a sub-account to populate parent_account_number
      - name: is_sub_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if this account has a parent_account_id; controls selection of parent_account_number and parent_account_name
      - name: parent_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the parent account; joined on account_id and source_relation and referenced when is_sub_account is TRUE
      - name: name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from source
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: QuickBooks account type; used for classification derivation via exact case-sensitive matching
      - name: account_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: QuickBooks account subtype from source
      - name: balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Account balance from source used to compute adjusted_balance
      - name: balance_with_sub_accounts
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Balance including sub-accounts passed through unchanged
      - name: is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if the account is active in the source
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Account creation timestamp from source
      - name: currency_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency identifier/code from source
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optional account description from source
      - name: fully_qualified_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hierarchical fully qualified account name; used when not a sub-account to populate parent_account_name
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last update timestamp from source
      - name: classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Final classification: source value if present, otherwise derived from account_type to Asset/Equity/Expense/Liability/Revenue; may be NULL'
      - name: multiplier
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Balance multiplier based on classification: -1 for Liability/Equity, 1 for Asset, else NULL'
      - name: financial_statement_helper
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Statement grouping helper: ''balance_sheet'' for Asset/Liability/Equity, else ''income_statement'''
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Normal balance direction: ''debit'' for Asset/Expense, else ''credit'''
      - name: adjusted_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Balance multiplied by multiplier; NULL if balance or multiplier is NULL
      - name: parent_account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'If is_sub_account TRUE: parent account_number via join; else own account_number; NULL if parent not found'
      - name: parent_account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'If is_sub_account TRUE: parent fully_qualified_name via join; else own fully_qualified_name; NULL if parent not found'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
      description: 'Double-entry accounting entries for QuickBooks bills: debit expense and credit accounts payable, one or more rows per bill line'
      grain: One row per (transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_type, account_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Source tables: - Bills from staging.stg_quickbooks__bill - Bill lines from staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line - Items from staging.stg_quickbooks__item - Accounts from staging.stg_quickbooks__account - Identify Accounts Payable accounts by keeping accounts where account_type is Accounts Payable, active, and not a sub-account; retain account_id and source_relation. - Join bills to bill_lines on bill_id and source_relation; left join items on item_id and source_relation. - For each joined bill line: - Determine bill line type: - Account-based if an expense account is present on the line - Item-based if an expense item is present - Otherwise no account mapping - Set account_id to the expense account from the line, falling back to the item’s expense account. - Set class_id from the line’s account-based class, falling back to the item-based class. - Compute converted_amount as amount multiplied by the bill exchange rate, defaulting the rate to 1 when missing. - Exclude lines without any account mapping to ensure the debit account_id exists. - Output two legs per remaining bill line using a union of: - Debit leg: expense account_id; transaction_type = debit. - Credit leg: join to AP accounts by source_relation and emit one row per matching AP account; if none match, emit one row with a NULL account_id; transaction_type = credit. - Set customer_id to NULL on all rows; carry through vendor_id, department_id, created_at, and updated_at from bills; set transaction_source to bill. - No explicit output ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bill identifier from stg_quickbooks__bill; repeats across debit and credit legs and is not unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used for joining bills, lines, items, and selecting AP accounts; passed through unchanged
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Bill line index from stg_quickbooks__bill_line; preserved for both debit and credit legs
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill transaction date from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through as-is
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL placeholder; no customer is associated with bill entries
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor ID from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Original bill line amount from stg_quickbooks__bill_line; used on both legs without rounding or aggregation
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Amount converted by multiplying amount by the bill exchange rate, defaulting the rate to 1 when missing
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Debit leg uses the expense account from the line or the item’s expense account; credit leg uses the AP account matched by source_relation, or NULL if none match
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class from the account-based class on the line, falling back to the item-based class; passed to both legs
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Bill creation timestamp from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through with timezone
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Bill last update timestamp from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through with timezone
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Leg indicator: debit for expense line, credit for accounts payable; never NULL'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value bill identifying the originating transaction
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
      description: Unified cash flow from invoices, bills, and customer payments with timing categories, signed net amounts, and cumulative/rolling sums ordered by transaction_date
      grain: One row per invoice, bill, or customer payment (union-all cash flow record)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice (invoice_id, customer_id, transaction_date, due_date, total_amount, balance, source_relation)
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill (bill_id, vendor_id, transaction_date, due_date, total_amount, balance, source_relation)
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment (payment_id, customer_id, transaction_date, total_amount, source_relation)
      business_logic: '- Filter sources: - Invoices: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Bills: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Payments received: include rows where customer_id and total_amount are not null. - Payments made: none included (vendor payments are handled via bills; the CTE returns an empty set). - Build accounts receivable (Invoice): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = COALESCE(balance, 0); realized_amount = total_amount - outstanding_amount. - cash_flow_status: ''Collected'' if outstanding_amount = 0; ''No Due Date'' if due_date is null; otherwise: ''Outstanding - Not Due'' if current_date <= due_date; else past-due buckets based on days past due: 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+. - expected_cash_date: transaction_date if settled (outstanding_amount = 0); else due_date if present; else transaction_date + 30 days. - Build accounts payable (Bill): - cash_flow_direction = ''Outflow''; counterparty_type = ''Vendor''. - outstanding_amount and realized_amount computed as for receivables; cash_flow_status uses ''Paid'' when outstanding_amount = 0; expected_cash_date follows the same rule. - Build actual cash inflows (Payment Received): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = 0; realized_amount = total_amount; due_date = transaction_date; cash_flow_status = ''Collected''; expected_cash_date = transaction_date. - Actual cash outflows (Payment Made): empty (no rows). - Union-all all cash flow records; duplicates are preserved; realized_amount is taken from each source as defined above. - Derive time dimensions from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, and the start dates of the containing month, quarter, and week. - cash_flow_timing: - ''Realized'' if cash_flow_status is ''Collected'' or ''Paid''. - Otherwise compare expected_cash_date to current_date: ''Overdue'' (on or before today), ''Due Soon (30 days)'' (within 30 days), ''Due Medium Term (60 days)'' (within 60 days), ''Due Long Term (90 days)'' (within 90 days), else ''Due Future (90+ days)''. - Signed net amounts: - net_cash_flow_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on total_amount. - net_realized_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on realized_amount. - net_outstanding_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on outstanding_amount. - Window metrics (computed over all rows ordered by transaction_date and including the current row): - cumulative_cash_flow: running total of net_realized_amount from the beginning through the row’s transaction_date. - rolling_30d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 30 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive), including all rows with the same date. - rolling_90d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 90 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive). - cash_flow_health (first matching rule applies): - ''Payment Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount < 0. - ''Collection Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount > 0. - ''Negative 30d Trend'' if rolling_30d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Negative 90d Trend'' if rolling_90d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Positive'' if cumulative_cash_flow > 0. - Else ''Neutral''. - liquidity_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -10000 and cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue''. - ''Medium Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -5000 and cash_flow_timing is ''Overdue'' or ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - ''Low Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < 0 and cash_flow_timing = ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - Else ''No Risk''. - cash_conversion_days: number of days between due_date and transaction_date when both exist; for payments this typically equals 0 because due_date equals transaction_date; null if either date is missing. - Notes: All timing/status logic uses current_date at execution; rolling windows are inclusive of the row’s date and computed across the entire dataset.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier (invoice_id, bill_id, or payment_id); not unique across types; present for all included records
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Literal type per source: ''Invoice'', ''Bill'', or ''Payment Received'' (no ''Payment Made'' rows included)'
      - name: cash_flow_direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Cash flow sign category: ''Inflow'' for invoices/payments received; ''Outflow'' for bills'
      - name: counterparty_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer ID for inflows and Vendor ID for bills; may be null for some invoices
      - name: counterparty_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Counterparty class: ''Customer'' for inflows and ''Vendor'' for bills'
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Source transaction date used for all time dimensions and window ordering
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: For invoices/bills, the source due_date (nullable); for payments, set equal to transaction_date
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Monetary amount from source; non-null by filter; used as the unsigned base for netting and realized/outstanding splits
      - name: outstanding_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: 'Unpaid balance: COALESCE(balance, 0) for invoices/bills; 0 for payments'
      - name: realized_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: 'Amount realized to cash: total_amount - outstanding_amount for invoices/bills; total_amount for payments'
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating source relation identifier carried through unchanged
      - name: cash_flow_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Status based on outstanding_amount and due_date vs current_date: ''Collected''/''Paid'', ''No Due Date'', ''Outstanding - Not Due'', or past-due buckets (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days)'
      - name: expected_cash_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP

business_logic: '- Filter sources: - Invoices: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Bills: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Payments received: include rows where customer_id and total_amount are not null. - Payments made: none included (vendor payments are handled via bills; the CTE returns an empty set). - Build accounts receivable (Invoice): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = COALESCE(balance, 0); realized_amount = total_amount - outstanding_amount. - cash_flow_status: ''Collected'' if outstanding_amount = 0; ''No Due Date'' if due_date is null; otherwise: ''Outstanding - Not Due'' if current_date <= due_date; else past-due buckets based on days past due: 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+. - expected_cash_date: transaction_date if settled (outstanding_amount = 0); else due_date if present; else transaction_date + 30 days. - Build accounts payable (Bill): - cash_flow_direction = ''Outflow''; counterparty_type = ''Vendor''. - outstanding_amount and realized_amount computed as for receivables; cash_flow_status uses ''Paid'' when outstanding_amount = 0; expected_cash_date follows the same rule. - Build actual cash inflows (Payment Received): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = 0; realized_amount = total_amount; due_date = transaction_date; cash_flow_status = ''Collected''; expected_cash_date = transaction_date. - Actual cash outflows (Payment Made): empty (no rows). - Union-all all cash flow records; duplicates are preserved; realized_amount is taken from each source as defined above. - Derive time dimensions from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, and the start dates of the containing month, quarter, and week. - cash_flow_timing: - ''Realized'' if cash_flow_status is ''Collected'' or ''Paid''. - Otherwise compare expected_cash_date to current_date: ''Overdue'' (on or before today), ''Due Soon (30 days)'' (within 30 days), ''Due Medium Term (60 days)'' (within 60 days), ''Due Long Term (90 days)'' (within 90 days), else ''Due Future (90+ days)''. - Signed net amounts: - net_cash_flow_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on total_amount. - net_realized_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on realized_amount. - net_outstanding_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on outstanding_amount. - Window metrics (computed over all rows ordered by transaction_date and including the current row): - cumulative_cash_flow: running total of net_realized_amount from the beginning through the row’s transaction_date. - rolling_30d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 30 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive), including all rows with the same date. - rolling_90d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 90 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive). - cash_flow_health (first matching rule applies): - ''Payment Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount < 0. - ''Collection Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount > 0. - ''Negative 30d Trend'' if rolling_30d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Negative 90d Trend'' if rolling_90d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Positive'' if cumulative_cash_flow > 0. - Else ''Neutral''. - liquidity_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -10000 and cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue''. - ''Medium Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -5000 and cash_flow_timing is ''Overdue'' or ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - ''Low Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < 0 and cash_flow_timing = ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - Else ''No Risk''. - cash_conversion_days: number of days between due_date and transaction_date when both exist; for payments this typically equals 0 because due_date equals transaction_date; null if either date is missing. - blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      description: Customer lifecycle metrics derived from QuickBooks invoices (balance not null), payments, and invoice lines; one row per (customer_id, source_relation) with activity segments and KPIs
      grain: One row per (customer_id, source_relation) with at least one invoice where balance is not NULL
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__customer
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment
      business_logic: 'Overview - Build metrics from: - Customers: staging.stg_quickbooks__customer - Invoices: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice filtered to balance is not null and customer_id is not null - Invoice lines: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line joined to the filtered invoices - Payments: staging.stg_quickbooks__payment filtered to customer_id is not null - Keep only customers that have at least one qualifying invoice. - Metrics using current_date are evaluated at run time. Invoice summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_invoices: distinct invoice count - total_invoice_amount: sum of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero - outstanding_balance: sum of invoice balance, treating nulls as zero - first_invoice_date: earliest invoice transaction_date - last_invoice_date: latest invoice transaction_date - active_months: distinct count of months with invoices based on transaction_date - avg_invoice_amount: average of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero Payment summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_payments: distinct payment count - total_payment_amount: sum of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero - first_payment_date: earliest payment transaction_date - last_payment_date: latest payment transaction_date - avg_payment_amount: average of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero; later defaulted to 0 if no payments exist Product diversity (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - Join filtered invoices to invoice_lines on invoice_id - Only count lines where the item_id is present - unique_products_purchased: distinct count of item_ids - total_quantity_purchased: sum of sales item quantity, treating nulls as zero Activity and segments (left-join payment and product diversity to invoice summary) - Missing payment and product metrics default to 0 (dates may remain null) - days_since_last_invoice: difference in days between current date and last_invoice_date - days_since_last_payment: difference in days between current date and last_payment_date; null if no payments - customer_value_segment by total_invoice_amount: - > 50,000 → High Value - > 10,000 → Medium Value - else → Low Value - payment_behavior by comparing total_payment_amount to total_invoice_amount: - ≥ 95% → Excellent - ≥ 80% → Good - ≥ 50% → Fair - else → Poor - activity_status by days_since_last_invoice: - ≤ 30 → Highly Active - ≤ 90 → Active - ≤ 180 → Moderately Active - ≤ 365 → Inactive - else → Lost Final selection and derived metrics - Join customers to the activity results on (customer_id, source_relation) and keep only matches. - Bring through customer attributes (name, company_name, display_name, is_active, created_at, balance). - payment_rate_percentage: - If total_payments = 0 → 0 - Else → (total_payment_amount / total_invoice_amount) × 100 rounded to 2 decimals; result may be null or non-finite if total_invoice_amount = 0 - customer_lifespan_days: - If both first and last invoice dates exist → inclusive days between them (last − first + 1) - Else → 0 - monthly_revenue_avg: - If active_months > 0 and total_invoice_amount > 0 → total_invoice_amount / active_months rounded to 2 decimals - Else → 0'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from stg_quickbooks__customer; join key to all metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used in joins; pairs with customer_id to define grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from stg_quickbooks__customer.name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name from stg_quickbooks__customer.company_name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from stg_quickbooks__customer.display_name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: customer_is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Customer active flag from stg_quickbooks__customer.is_active (no coercion)
      - name: customer_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Customer creation timestamp from stg_quickbooks__customer.created_at
      - name: customer_current_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Current balance from stg_quickbooks__customer.balance (no transformation)
      - name: total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of invoices with balance not null for the customer
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_invoice_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total invoiced amount across qualifying invoices, treating null amounts as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total outstanding balance across qualifying invoices, treating null balances as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest invoice transaction_date among qualifying invoices
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest invoice transaction_date among qualifying invoices
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of months with invoice activity based on transaction_date
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount across qualifying invoices, treating null amounts as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of payments for the customer; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_payment_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total payment amount for the customer, treating null amounts as zero; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest payment transaction_date; NULL if no payments
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest payment transaction_date; NULL if no payments
      - name: avg_payment_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average payment amount, treating null amounts as zero; 0 if no payments
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unique_products_purchased
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of item_ids from invoice lines joined to qualifying invoices; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_quantity_purchased
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total quantity from invoice lines joined to qualifying invoices, treating null quantities as zero; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: days_since_last_invoice
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between current date and last_invoice_date at execution time
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: days_since_last_payment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between current date and last_payment_date at execution time; NULL if no payments
      - name: customer_value_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Value tier by total_invoice_amount: >50k High, >10k Medium, else Low'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Repayment tier by total_payment_amount vs total_invoice_amount: ≥95% Excellent; ≥80% Good; ≥50% Fair; else Poor'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Engagement tier by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 Moderately Active; ≤365 Inactive; else Lost'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_payments=0 then 0; else (total_payment_amount/total_invoice_amount)*100 rounded to 2 decimals; may be null or non-finite if denominator is 0
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive days between first and last invoice dates if present (last − first + 1), else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: monthly_revenue_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If active_months>0 and total_invoice_amount>0 then total_invoice_amount/active_months rounded to 2 decimals, else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: New Customer if total_invoices=1; else Champion if days_since_last_invoice≤30 and total_invoices≥5; else Loyal Customer if days_since_last_invoice≤60 and total_invoice_amount≥5000; else Potential Loyalist if ≤90; else At Risk if ≤180; else Cannot Lose Them if ≤365; else Lost Customer
        tests:
        - not_null
