references.name: staging.stg_quickbooks__customer
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Overview - Build metrics from: - Customers: staging.stg_quickbooks__customer - Invoices: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice filtered to balance is not null and customer_id is not null - Invoice lines: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line joined to the filtered invoices - Payments: staging.stg_quickbooks__payment filtered to customer_id is not null - Keep only customers that have at least one qualifying invoice. - Metrics using current_date are evaluated at run time. Invoice summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_invoices: distinct invoice count - total_invoice_amount: sum of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero - outstanding_balance: sum of invoice balance, treating nulls as zero - first_invoice_date: earliest invoice transaction_date - last_invoice_date: latest invoice transaction_date - active_months: distinct count of months with invoices based on transaction_date - avg_invoice_amount: average of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero Payment summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_payments: distinct payment count - total_payment_amount: sum of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero - first_payment_date: earliest payment transaction_date - last_payment_date: latest payment transaction_date - avg_payment_amount: average of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero; later defaulted to 0 if no payments exist Product diversity (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - Join filtered invoices to invoice_lines on invoice_id - Only count lines where the item_id is present - unique_products_purchased: distinct count of item_ids - total_quantity_purchased: sum of sales item quantity, treating nulls as zero Activity and segments (left-join payment and product diversity to invoice summary) - Missing payment and product metrics default to 0 (dates may remain null) - days_since_last_invoice: difference in days between current date and last_invoice_date - days_since_last_payment: difference in days between current date and last_payment_date; null if no payments - customer_value_segment by total_invoice_amount: - > 50,000 → High Value - > 10,000 → Medium Value - else → Low Value - payment_behavior by comparing total_payment_amount to total_invoice_amount: - ≥ 95% → Excellent - ≥ 80% → Good - ≥ 50% → Fair - else → Poor - activity_status by days_since_last_invoice: - ≤ 30 → Highly Active - ≤ 90 → Active - ≤ 180 → Moderately Active - ≤ 365 → Inactive - else → Lost Final selection and derived metrics - Join customers to the activity results on (customer_id, source_relation) and keep only matches. - Bring through customer attributes (name, company_name, display_name, is_active, created_at, balance). - payment_rate_percentage: - If total_payments = 0 → 0 - Else → (total_payment_amount / total_invoice_amount) × 100 rounded to 2 decimals; result may be null or non-finite if total_invoice_amount = 0 - customer_lifespan_days: - If both first and last invoice dates exist → inclusive days between them (last − first + 1) - Else → 0 - monthly_revenue_avg: - If active_months > 0 and total_invoice_amount > 0 → total_invoice_amount / active_months rounded to 2 decimals - Else → 0'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__invoice_double_entry
      description: Double-entry view of QuickBooks invoice lines producing offsetting AR and revenue/discount entries
      grain: One line-side row plus one AR-side row per invoice line in invoice_filter per source_relation; AR side repeats once per AR account; rows are uniquely identified by (transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_type, account_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Load invoices, invoice_lines, items (including parent to provide parent_income_account_id), and accounts from staging. - Identify Accounts Receivable accounts per source_relation as those marked Accounts Receivable, active, and not sub-accounts. - Join invoices to invoice_lines on invoice_id and source_relation; left join items on sales_item_item_id and source_relation. - For each joined line: - amount equals the invoice line amount. - converted_amount equals amount multiplied by the invoice exchange rate if present; otherwise amount. - invoice_line_transaction_type is: - invoice_lines.detail_type when present; - otherwise SalesItemLineDetail if any of the following are present: invoice_lines.account_id, invoice_lines.sales_item_account_id, items.parent_income_account_id, items.income_account_id; - otherwise DiscountLineDetail if invoice_lines.discount_account_id is present; - otherwise NoAccountMapping. - account_id (line side) is the first non-null among invoice_lines.account_id, invoice_lines.sales_item_account_id, items.income_account_id, invoice_lines.discount_account_id. - class_id is the first non-null among sales_item_class_id, discount_class_id, and the invoice class_id. - Remove lines where invoice_line_transaction_type is SubTotalLineDetail or NoAccountMapping. - Emit rows: - Line side: one row per remaining invoice line with the mapped line account_id; transaction_type is credit unless DiscountLineDetail, then debit; transaction_source is invoice unless DiscountLineDetail, then invoice discount. - AR side: for each AR account in the same source_relation, emit one row with that AR account_id; if no AR accounts exist, emit a single AR row with account_id NULL; transaction_type is debit unless DiscountLineDetail, then credit; transaction_source matches the line side. - Carry transaction_id (invoice_id), source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id as NULL, department_id, created_at, and updated_at on all emitted rows.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system key used to scope joins and select AR accounts
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Invoice line position
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice transaction date
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the invoice
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Unchanged invoice line amount repeated on all emitted rows
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Line amount multiplied by the invoice exchange rate when present, else equal to amount
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting account; line side uses the mapped line account, AR side uses an active non-sub Accounts Receivable account for the source_relation; may be NULL if the line mapping is missing or no AR account exists; AR side emits one row per AR account
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class from sales item class, else discount class, else the invoice class
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from the invoice
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Invoice creation timestamp
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Invoice update timestamp
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line side is credit except discount lines which are debit; AR side is debit except discount lines which are credit
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Set to 'invoice' except discount lines which use 'invoice discount'

- name: int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
      description: Debit and credit lines for QuickBooks journal entries joined to their headers.
      grain: One row per journal entry line that matches a header (by source_relation and journal_entry_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__journal_entry
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__journal_entry_line
      business_logic: '- Load journal entry headers and lines from their staging tables. - Inner join lines to headers on matching journal_entry_id and source_relation; only matched pairs are kept. If duplicates exist in sources, all joined rows are preserved; no de-duplication or aggregation is performed; output ordering is not specified. - Column mapping: - transaction_id comes from the header journal_entry_id; source_relation comes from the header; index comes from the line. - transaction_date, created_at, and updated_at come from the header. - customer_id, vendor_id, amount, account_id, class_id, and department_id come from the line; values are passed through with nulls preserved. - converted_amount is the line amount multiplied by the header exchange rate; if the exchange rate is null, use 1; if amount is null, the result is null; sign is preserved; stored as DECIMAL(38,12) with no extra rounding beyond the data type. - transaction_type is ''debit'' when the line posting_type equals ''Debit'' exactly; otherwise ''credit'' (including null or any other value); output is lowercase and never null. - transaction_source is the constant ''journal entry'' for all rows.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Header journal_entry_id used as the transaction identifier; combines with source_relation and line index to identify a line; nulls preserved.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier from the header; used in the join to match lines; nulls preserved.
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index from the journal entry line; no renumbering; duplicates and nulls preserved.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Journal entry date from the header; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Original line amount from the line; DECIMAL(28,6); sign and nulls preserved; no extra rounding.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Line amount multiplied by the header exchange rate (defaults to 1 when null); null if amount is null; sign preserved; DECIMAL(38,12).
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.

      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from line posting_type: ''debit'' if exactly ''Debit'', otherwise ''credit'' (including null); lowercase; never null.'
        tests:
        - not_null

        description: Constant 'journal entry' for all rows; lowercase with space; never null.
        tests:

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
      description: Double-entry accounting view of payment transactions with paired debit and credit entries.
      grain: 'Two rows per payment line (payment_id, source_relation, index): one debit and one credit; duplicates can occur when multiple matching account rows exist for the same source_relation.'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Load payments and payment_lines; join on payment_id and source_relation. - Build account lookups from accounts: - ar_accounts: active, non-sub Accounts Receivable accounts, keyed by source_relation. - undeposited_funds_accounts: active accounts whose name contains "undeposited" (case-insensitive), keyed by source_relation. - For each joined payment/payment_line, produce: - Debit row: account_id is payments.deposit_to_account_id when present; otherwise use the undeposited funds account for the same source_relation. - Credit row: account_id is the Accounts Receivable account for the same source_relation. - Common fields on both rows: - transaction_id from payments.payment_id; source_relation from payments.source_relation; index from payment_lines.index. - transaction_date from payments.transaction_date; customer_id from payments.customer_id; vendor_id is NULL. - amount from payment_lines.amount. - converted_amount equals amount multiplied by payments.exchange_rate, using 1 when exchange_rate is NULL; NULL amount remains NULL. - class_id is NULL; department_id from payments.department_id. - created_at and updated_at from payments. - transaction_type is "debit" for the cash/undeposited funds entry and "credit" for the A/R entry; transaction_source is "payment". - Account lookups join only on source_relation; if multiple matching accounts exist, rows are duplicated accordingly. No explicit sorting is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment identifier copied from payments.payment_id.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from payments.source_relation.
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index from payment_lines.index identifying the payment line within the payment.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Payment transaction date from payments.transaction_date.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the payment from payments.customer_id.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL for payments.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Line amount from payment_lines.amount; same value on both debit and credit rows; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Amount multiplied by exchange_rate from payments, using 1 when exchange_rate is NULL; NULL amount yields NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Debit: deposit_to_account_id when present, otherwise the active undeposited funds account for the same source_relation; Credit: the active Accounts Receivable account for the same source_relation; may be NULL and can duplicate when multiple matches exist.'
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from payments.department_id.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Creation timestamp from payments.created_at.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last update timestamp from payments.updated_at.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Debit for the cash/undeposited funds entry and credit for the A/R entry.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Literal value 'payment' identifying the originating transaction type.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      description: Invoice-level revenue analysis with time dimensions, collection/aging status, customer aggregates, monthly trends, and quality rating
      grain: One row per invoice_id from staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice where total_amount is not null and > 0
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__customer
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      business_logic: '- Filter invoices: include only rows with a positive, non-null total_amount. - Build invoice-level base: - outstanding_balance equals the stored balance (may be null); collected_amount equals total_amount minus balance, treating a missing balance as 0. - Derive time fields from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, day-of-week (0=Sunday..6=Saturday), first day of month, and first day of quarter; if transaction_date is missing, all derived time fields are null. - collection_status: Fully Collected when balance is missing or zero; Uncollected when balance equals total_amount; Partially Collected when balance is between 0 and total_amount; otherwise Unknown. - aging_bucket based on today and due_date: No Due Date if due_date is missing; Not Due when today is on or before due_date; otherwise bucket by days overdue into 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, or 90+ Days Overdue. - invoice_size_category by total_amount: Large (≥10,000), Medium (≥1,000), Small (≥100), else Micro. - Customer aggregates (by customer_id and source_relation over the filtered invoices) with customer attributes joined: - total_invoices: number of distinct invoices; total_revenue: sum of invoice amounts; avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest transaction_date. - revenue_last_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated in the last 6 months (relative to today); revenue_prev_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated from 12 to 6 months ago; invoices outside each window add 0 to that window. - collection_rate: share of revenue that is fully collected (fully collected revenue divided by total revenue), without rounding. - customer_tier by total_revenue: Enterprise (≥50,000), Corporate (≥10,000), SMB (≥2,000), else Individual. - Monthly aggregates (by revenue_month_start across the filtered invoices): - monthly_total_revenue: total revenue that month; monthly_avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount that month; monthly_active_customers: number of distinct non-null customers that month. - Growth metrics computed by ascending month start: - month_over_month_growth_pct: percent change vs the previous month’s total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the previous month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - year_over_year_growth_pct: percent change vs the same month 12 months earlier, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the comparison month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - Final output: - Left join invoice rows to customer aggregates on (customer_id, source_relation) and to monthly aggregates on revenue_month_start. If customer_id is null or no customer record matches, customer fields are null. If transaction_date is null, monthly fields are null. - customer_revenue_growth_pct: percent change between last_6 and previous_6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when previous_6 months revenue is greater than 0, else null. - revenue_quality_rating: Excellent when fully collected and not due; Good when fully collected; Fair when partially collected and not overdue; Poor when overdue; otherwise Unknown. - Note: A product-level analysis is computed but not used in the final result.'
      columns:
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique invoice identifier; one output row per filtered invoice_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier carried from the invoice and used to join customer attributes
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from the invoice; may be null and determines the join to customer aggregates
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice transaction date that drives all time-derived fields and monthly joins; may be null
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice due date used for aging; null yields aging_bucket of No Due Date
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Total invoice amount strictly greater than 0 and used in sums, averages, tiers, and collection metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Invoice balance as stored; may be null and used to determine collection_status
      - name: collected_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: Total amount minus balance, treating a missing balance as 0; equals total_amount when balance is missing
      - name: revenue_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1–4) of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week-of-year number from transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_dayofweek
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day-of-week number from transaction_date (0=Sunday..6=Saturday); null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar month of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_quarter_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar quarter of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: collection_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Collection state from balance vs total_amount: Fully Collected, Uncollected, Partially Collected, or Unknown'
      - name: aging_bucket
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Aging category relative to today and due_date: No Due Date, Not Due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, or 90+ Days Overdue'
      - name: invoice_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Invoice size bucket by total_amount: Large (≥10,000), Medium (≥1,000), Small (≥100), else Micro'
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name joined by (customer_id, source_relation) from the customer table; may be null
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer company name joined by (customer_id, source_relation); may be null
      - name: customer_total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct invoices for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_first_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest transaction_date for the customer; null if all dates are null or there is no match
      - name: customer_last_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest transaction_date for the customer; null if all dates are null or there is no match
      - name: customer_revenue_last_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from invoices dated in the last 6 months; 0 if none; null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_revenue_prev_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from invoices dated 6–12 months before today; 0 if none; null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_collection_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of customer revenue that is fully collected (0–1); null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Customer value tier by total_revenue: Enterprise (≥50,000), Corporate (≥10,000), SMB (≥2,000), else Individual; null if no match'
      - name: customer_revenue_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change between last_6 and previous_6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous_6 is not positive or missing
      - name: monthly_total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from all invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: monthly_avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount for all invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: monthly_active_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct non-null customers with invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: month_over_month_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent growth vs the previous month’s revenue, rounded to 2 decimals; null when the previous month’s revenue is not positive or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent growth vs the same month in the prior year, rounded to 2 decimals; null when the comparison month’s revenue is not positive or missing
      - name: revenue_quality_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Rating: Excellent (fully collected and not due), Good (fully collected), Fair (partially collected and not overdue), Poor (overdue), else Unknown'

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN balance IS NULL OR balance = 0 THEN 'Fully Collected' WHEN balance = total_amount THEN 'Uncollected' WHEN balance > 0 AND balance < total_amount THEN 'Partially Collected' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL THEN 'No Due Date' WHEN CURRENT_DATE <= due_date THEN 'Not Due' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN '1-30 Days Overdue' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days Overdue' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 90 THEN '61-90 Days Overdue' ELSE '90+ Days Overdue' END
CASE WHEN total_amount >= 10000 THEN 'Large' WHEN total_amount >= 1000 THEN 'Medium' WHEN total_amount >= 100 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Micro' END
CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6' MONTH THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12' MONTH AND transaction_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6' MONTH THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
SUM(CASE WHEN collection_status = 'Fully Collected' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0)
CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 50000 THEN 'Enterprise' WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 10000 THEN 'Corporate' WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 2000 THEN 'SMB' ELSE 'Individual' END
ROUND((monthly_total_revenue - LAG(monthly_total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month_start), 0) * 100, 2)
ROUND((monthly_total_revenue - LAG(monthly_total_revenue, 12) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_total_revenue, 12) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month_start), 0) * 100, 2)

CASE WHEN b.collection_status = 'Fully Collected' AND b.aging_bucket = 'Not Due' THEN 'Excellent' WHEN b.collection_status = 'Fully Collected' THEN 'Good' WHEN b.collection_status = 'Partially Collected' AND b.aging_bucket NOT LIKE '%Overdue' THEN 'Fair' WHEN b.aging_bucket LIKE '%Overdue' THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Unknown' END

business_logic: '- Filter invoices: include only rows with a positive, non-null total_amount. - Build invoice-level base: - outstanding_balance equals the stored balance (may be null); collected_amount equals total_amount minus balance, treating a missing balance as 0. - Derive time fields from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, day-of-week (0=Sunday..6=Saturday), first day of month, and first day of quarter; if transaction_date is missing, all derived time fields are null. - collection_status: Fully Collected when balance is missing or zero; Uncollected when balance equals total_amount; Partially Collected when balance is between 0 and total_amount; otherwise Unknown. - aging_bucket based on today and due_date: No Due Date if due_date is missing; Not Due when today is on or before due_date; otherwise bucket by days overdue into 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, or 90+ Days Overdue. - invoice_size_category by total_amount: Large (≥10,000), Medium (≥1,000), Small (≥100), else Micro. - Customer aggregates (by customer_id and source_relation over the filtered invoices) with customer attributes joined: - total_invoices: number of distinct invoices; total_revenue: sum of invoice amounts; avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest transaction_date. - revenue_last_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated in the last 6 months (relative to today); revenue_prev_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated from 12 to 6 months ago; invoices outside each window add 0 to that window. - collection_rate: share of revenue that is fully collected (fully collected revenue divided by total revenue), without rounding. - customer_tier by total_revenue: Enterprise (≥50,000), Corporate (≥10,000), SMB (≥2,000), else Individual. - Monthly aggregates (by revenue_month_start across the filtered invoices): - monthly_total_revenue: total revenue that month; monthly_avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount that month; monthly_active_customers: number of distinct non-null customers that month. - Growth metrics computed by ascending month start: - month_over_month_growth_pct: percent change vs the previous month’s total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the previous month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - year_over_year_growth_pct: percent change vs the same month 12 months earlier, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the comparison month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - Final output: - Left join invoice rows to customer aggregates on (customer_id, source_relation) and to monthly aggregates on revenue_month_start. If customer_id is null or no customer record matches, customer fields are null. If transaction_date is null, monthly fields are null. - customer_revenue_growth_pct: percent change between last_6 and previous_6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when previous_6 months revenue is greater than 0, else null. - revenue_quality_rating: Excellent when fully collected and not due; Good when fully collected; Fair when partially collected and not overdue; Poor when overdue; otherwise Unknown. - Note: A product-level analysis is computed but not used in the final result.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis
      description: Vendor spending analytics per bill enriched with vendor performance, monthly trends, purchase category, and payment/aging status
      grain: One row per bill joined to each qualifying bill line (multiple rows per bill when multiple qualifying lines exist; a single row with NULL purchase_category if none)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__vendor
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      business_logic: '- Keep bills where total_amount is not null and greater than 0. - Build bill_spend_base (one row per bill): - bill_date = transaction_date; due_date, total_amount, outstanding_balance = balance; paid_amount = total_amount minus balance treating null balance as 0. - Derive spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month, and spend_month_start (first day of the bill’s month) from bill_date. - payment_status: - Fully Paid if balance is null or 0 - Unpaid if balance equals total_amount - Partially Paid if balance is between 0 and total_amount - Unknown otherwise - aging_status (relative to current_date): - No Due Date if due_date is null - Not Due if current_date is on or before due_date - 1-30 Days Past Due if due_date passed by up to 30 days - 31-60 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 31-60 days - 61-90 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 61-90 days - 90+ Days Past Due otherwise - purchase_size_category by total_amount: - Large Purchase (>= 10000), Medium Purchase (>= 1000), Small Purchase (>= 100), else Micro Purchase - payment_timeliness (relative to current_date): - If due_date is not null and balance = 0: - Early Payment if current_date is on or before due_date - On Time Payment if paid up to 5 days after due_date - Late Payment if 6-30 days after due_date - Very Late Payment if more than 30 days after due_date - Otherwise Incomplete Payment - Build purchase_category_analysis (one row per bill line with amount > 0): - Join bill lines to items by item_expense_item_id. - Determine purchase_category by lowercasing the item name (if present) otherwise the line description and matching keywords: - Office Supplies: contains office or supplies - Technology: contains software or tech - Professional Services: contains service or consult - Travel & Transportation: contains travel or transport - Marketing & Advertising: contains market or advert - Rent & Facilities: contains rent or lease - Utilities: contains util, electric, or water - Other otherwise - Build vendor_performance_analysis (group by vendor_id and source_relation, then enrich with vendor names): - total_bills = distinct bill count; total_spend = sum of bill amounts; total_paid = sum of paid amounts; total_outstanding = sum of balances - avg_bill_amount = average bill amount - first_transaction_date = earliest bill_date; last_transaction_date = latest bill_date - fully_paid_bills = count of bills with payment_status = Fully Paid - payment_completion_rate = fully paid bills divided by all bills times 100 (not rounded) - on_time_payments = count of bills with payment_timeliness in Early Payment or On Time Payment - on_time_payment_rate = on_time_payments divided by bills with a timeliness value (i.e., excluding Incomplete Payment) times 100; null if none - spend_last_6_months = total spend where bill_date is within the last 6 months relative to current_date - spend_prev_6_months = total spend from 12 to 6 months ago relative to current_date - vendor_tier by total_spend: Strategic Vendor (>= 50000), Major Vendor (>= 10000), Regular Vendor (>= 2000), else Occasional Vendor - payment_risk_level by total_outstanding to total_spend ratio: High (> 0.3), Medium (> 0.1), else Low - Build monthly_spend_trends (group by spend_month_start, spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month): - monthly_total_spend, monthly_paid_amount, monthly_avg_bill_amount, monthly_bill_count (distinct bills), monthly_active_vendors (distinct vendors) - month_over_month_growth_pct = ((current month total - previous month total) / previous month total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the previous month total is not available or is 0 or less - year_over_year_growth_pct = ((current month total - same month prior year total) / prior year total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the prior year total is not available or is 0 or less - Final output: - Start from bill_spend_base; left join vendor_performance_analysis on vendor_id and source_relation; left join monthly_spend_trends on spend_month_start; left join purchase_category_analysis on bill_id. - vendor_spend_growth_pct = ((last 6 months spend - previous 6 months spend) / previous 6 months spend) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous period is 0 or less. - spend_efficiency_rating: - Excellent if Fully Paid and payment_timeliness is Early Payment or On Time Payment - Good if Fully Paid - Fair if Partially Paid and Not Due - Poor if any Past Due - Unknown otherwise - Joining purchase_category on bill_id returns multiple rows per bill when multiple qualifying lines exist; if no qualifying line, purchase_category is null and only one row is returned.'
      columns:
      - name: bill_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bill identifier; duplicates appear when multiple qualifying bill lines exist
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system relation carried from the bill and used to join vendor details
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from the bill used to compute and join vendor performance metrics; may be NULL
      - name: bill_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill transaction date used for time dimensions and trends; may be NULL
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill due date used for aging and timeliness logic; NULL yields No Due Date and Incomplete Payment
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Total bill amount; only positive, non-null bills are included
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Open balance from the bill; can be NULL; used in payment status and risk calculations
      - name: paid_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: Computed as total_amount minus outstanding_balance, treating NULL balance as 0; equals total_amount when balance is NULL or zero
      - name: spend_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1-4) extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1-12) extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the bill’s month; join key for monthly trends
      - name: payment_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Payment state by balance: Fully Paid (balance is NULL or 0), Unpaid (balance = total_amount), Partially Paid (between 0 and total_amount), Unknown otherwise'
      - name: aging_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Aging vs current_date: No Due Date if due_date is NULL; else Not Due or a Past Due bucket (1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) based on days past due'
      - name: purchase_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bill size bucket by total_amount: Large (>=10000), Medium (>=1000), Small (>=100), else Micro'
      - name: payment_timeliness
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For fully paid bills with a due_date: Early Payment (on/before due date), On Time Payment (≤5 days late), Late Payment (6–30 days late), Very Late Payment (>30 days late); otherwise Incomplete Payment'
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor name joined by vendor_id and source_relation
      - name: vendor_company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor company name from the vendor record
      - name: vendor_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor display name from the vendor record
      - name: vendor_total_bills
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct bill count per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_total_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average bill amount per vendor across all filtered bills (not rounded)
      - name: vendor_first_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest bill_date per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_last_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent bill_date per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_payment_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of fully paid bills among all bills for the vendor (not rounded)
      - name: vendor_on_time_payment_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of bills that are Early or On Time among bills with a timeliness value; NULL if none
      - name: vendor_spend_last_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount for the vendor over the last 6 months relative to current_date
      - name: vendor_spend_prev_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount for the vendor from 12 to 6 months ago relative to current_date
      - name: vendor_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Vendor tier by total spend: >=50000 Strategic Vendor, >=10000 Major Vendor, >=2000 Regular Vendor, else Occasional Vendor'
      - name: payment_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk by outstanding-to-total spend ratio: >0.3 High, >0.1 Medium, else Low'
      - name: vendor_spend_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN balance IS NULL OR balance = 0 THEN 'Fully Paid' WHEN balance = total_amount THEN 'Unpaid' WHEN balance > 0 AND balance < total_amount THEN 'Partially Paid' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL THEN 'No Due Date' WHEN CURRENT_DATE <= due_date THEN 'Not Due' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN '1-30 Days Past Due' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days Past Due' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 90 THEN '61-90 Days Past Due' ELSE '90+ Days Past Due' END
CASE WHEN total_amount >= 10000 THEN 'Large Purchase' WHEN total_amount >= 1000 THEN 'Medium Purchase' WHEN total_amount >= 100 THEN 'Small Purchase' ELSE 'Micro Purchase' END

CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL OR balance IS NULL OR balance <> 0 THEN 'Incomplete Payment' WHEN CURRENT_DATE <= due_date THEN 'Early Payment' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 5 THEN 'On Time Payment' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', due_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN 'Late Payment' ELSE 'Very Late Payment' END
100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_status = 'Fully Paid' THEN bill_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id), 0)

100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_timeliness IN ('Early Payment', 'On Time Payment') THEN bill_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_timeliness <> 'Incomplete Payment' THEN bill_id END), 0)
CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bill_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6' MONTH THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bill_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12' MONTH AND bill_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6' MONTH THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 50000 THEN 'Strategic Vendor' WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 10000 THEN 'Major Vendor' WHEN SUM(total_amount) >= 2000 THEN 'Regular Vendor' ELSE 'Occasional Vendor' END

CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(outstanding_balance, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0) > 0.3 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(COALESCE(outstanding_balance, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END
ROUND((monthly_total_spend - LAG(monthly_total_spend) OVER (ORDER BY spend_month_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_total_spend) OVER (ORDER BY spend_month_start), 0) * 100, 2)
ROUND((monthly_total_spend - LAG(monthly_total_spend, 12) OVER (ORDER BY spend_month_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_total_spend, 12) OVER (ORDER BY spend_month_start), 0) * 100, 2)

business_logic: '- Keep bills where total_amount is not null and greater than 0. - Build bill_spend_base (one row per bill): - bill_date = transaction_date; due_date, total_amount, outstanding_balance = balance; paid_amount = total_amount minus balance treating null balance as 0. - Derive spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month, and spend_month_start (first day of the bill’s month) from bill_date. - payment_status: - Fully Paid if balance is null or 0 - Unpaid if balance equals total_amount - Partially Paid if balance is between 0 and total_amount - Unknown otherwise - aging_status (relative to current_date): - No Due Date if due_date is null - Not Due if current_date is on or before due_date - 1-30 Days Past Due if due_date passed by up to 30 days - 31-60 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 31-60 days - 61-90 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 61-90 days - 90+ Days Past Due otherwise - purchase_size_category by total_amount: - Large Purchase (>= 10000), Medium Purchase (>= 1000), Small Purchase (>= 100), else Micro Purchase - payment_timeliness (relative to current_date): - If due_date is not null and balance = 0: - Early Payment if current_date is on or before due_date - On Time Payment if paid up to 5 days after due_date - Late Payment if 6-30 days after due_date - Very Late Payment if more than 30 days after due_date - Otherwise Incomplete Payment - Build purchase_category_analysis (one row per bill line with amount > 0): - Join bill lines to items by item_expense_item_id. - Determine purchase_category by lowercasing the item name (if present) otherwise the line description and matching keywords: - Office Supplies: contains office or supplies - Technology: contains software or tech - Professional Services: contains service or consult - Travel & Transportation: contains travel or transport - Marketing & Advertising: contains market or advert - Rent & Facilities: contains rent or lease - Utilities: contains util, electric, or water - Other otherwise - Build vendor_performance_analysis (group by vendor_id and source_relation, then enrich with vendor names): - total_bills = distinct bill count; total_spend = sum of bill amounts; total_paid = sum of paid amounts; total_outstanding = sum of balances - avg_bill_amount = average bill amount - first_transaction_date = earliest bill_date; last_transaction_date = latest bill_date - fully_paid_bills = count of bills with payment_status = Fully Paid - payment_completion_rate = fully paid bills divided by all bills times 100 (not rounded) - on_time_payments = count of bills with payment_timeliness in Early Payment or On Time Payment - on_time_payment_rate = on_time_payments divided by bills with a timeliness value (i.e., excluding Incomplete Payment) times 100; null if none - spend_last_6_months = total spend where bill_date is within the last 6 months relative to current_date - spend_prev_6_months = total spend from 12 to 6 months ago relative to current_date - vendor_tier by total_spend: Strategic Vendor (>= 50000), Major Vendor (>= 10000), Regular Vendor (>= 2000), else Occasional Vendor - payment_risk_level by total_outstanding to total_spend ratio: High (> 0.3), Medium (> 0.1), else Low - Build monthly_spend_trends (group by spend_month_start, spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month): - monthly_total_spend, monthly_paid_amount, monthly_avg_bill_amount, monthly_bill_count (distinct bills), monthly_active_vendors (distinct vendors) - month_over_month_growth_pct = ((current month total - previous month total) / previous month total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the previous month total is not available or is 0 or less - year_over_year_growth_pct = ((current month total - same month prior year total) / prior year total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the prior year total is not available or is 0 or less - Final output: - Start from bill_spend_base; left join vendor_performance_analysis on vendor_id and source_relation; left join monthly_spend_trends on spend_month_start; left join purchase_category_analysis on bill_id. - vendor_spend_growth_pct = ((last 6 months spend - previous 6 months spend) / previous 6 months spend) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous period is 0 or less. - spend_efficiency_rating: - Excellent if Fully Paid and payment_timeliness is Early Payment or On Time Payment - Good if Fully Paid - Fair if Partially Paid and Not Due - Poor if any Past Due - Unknown otherwise - Joining purchase_category on bill_id returns multiple rows per bill when multiple qualifying lines exist; if no qualifying line, purchase_category is null and only one row is returned.'

- name: quickbooks__balance_sheet
      description: Rows from the general ledger filtered to balance_sheet, with transaction_date mirrored into all date fields and running balances exposed without transformation.
      grain: One row per general ledger record classified as balance_sheet
      source_models:
      - marts.quickbooks__general_ledger
      business_logic: '- Read marts.quickbooks__general_ledger. - Filter to rows where financial_statement_helper = ''balance_sheet''. - For each remaining row, output one row with: - calendar_date = transaction_date - period_first_day = transaction_date - period_last_day = transaction_date - amount = running_balance - converted_amount = running_converted_balance - account_ordinal = 1 (constant) - All other fields are passed through unchanged from the source. - No aggregation, deduplication, or re-ordering is performed; all source rows that match the filter are preserved 1:1. - Null handling: all fields are carried through as-is from the source; the literal account_ordinal is always non-null. - Rounding/scale: numeric values are copied as-is from the source with DECIMAL scales preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: calendar_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Copy of transaction_date from the general ledger; equals period_first_day and period_last_day for each row
        tests:

        description: Exact copy of transaction_date (same as calendar_date); not derived from a calendar period

        description: Exact copy of transaction_date (same as calendar_date); not derived from a calendar period
        tests:

        description: Passthrough identifier of the source relation for the ledger row; preserved as-is (NULLs preserved)
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough account class from the general ledger; preserved as-is (NULLs preserved)
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Passthrough class identifier from the general ledger; preserved as-is (NULLs preserved)
      - name: is_sub_account

blocks.original_text:
- name: quickbooks__cashflow_forecast
      description: Monthly cash flow forecast blending risk-adjusted receivables/outflows with historical trends and liquidity scoring
      grain: One row per forecast_month (month start date) that has outstanding_amount > 0 within the next 12 months
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
      business_logic: 'Data preparation: - Start from intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis (historical and outstanding cash flow records). - Historical_monthly_summary over transaction_type in Payment Received or Payment Made: - Group by transaction_month_start, transaction_year, transaction_quarter, transaction_month. - Compute monthly_cash_inflows (sum of net_realized_amount where Payment Received), monthly_cash_outflows (sum of absolute net_realized_amount where Payment Made), and monthly_net_cash_flow (sum of net_realized_amount for both types). - Compute outstanding_receivables/payables (sum of outstanding_amount where cash_flow_status starts with Outstanding and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute overdue_receivables/payables (sum of absolute net_outstanding_amount where cash_flow_timing is Overdue and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute inflow/outflow transaction counts and active_counterparties (distinct counterparty_id). - Future_cash_flows (forecast horizon): - Filter rows with outstanding_amount > 0 and expected_cash_date from current_date through 12 months ahead (inclusive). - Group by month: forecast_month is the first day of expected_cash_date’s month; also capture year, quarter, and month number. - Aggregations: - forecasted_inflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Inflow. - forecasted_outflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Outflow. - forecasted_net_cash_flow: inflows minus outflows (outflows subtracted). - high_confidence_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status is “Outstanding - Not Due”. - uncertain_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status contains “Past Due”. - risk_adjusted_inflows: inflow sum weighted by cash_flow_status: Not Due=0.95; 1–30 Days Past Due=0.85; 31–60 Days Past Due=0.70; 61–90 Days Past Due=0.50; all other statuses=0.30. - forecast_counterparties: distinct counterparty_id count within the month. Historical trends (last 24 months): - Filter to transaction_month_start within the past 24 months. - Compute moving averages of monthly_net_cash_flow: - ma_3_months: average over the current month and the prior two months. - ma_6_months: average over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute seasonal_avg as a running average by month-of-year, ordered by transaction_year. - Compute volatility_6_months as the rolling standard deviation over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute a month_sequence (not used downstream). Forecast model: - Join future_cash_flows to historical_trends by same month-of-year and the latest historical month before the forecast_month with that month-of-year. - blended_forecast per month: - If forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero and ma_3_months exists: 70% of (risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows) plus 30% of ma_3_months. - Else if forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero: risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows. - Else if seasonal_avg exists: seasonal_avg. - Else: ma_6_months (may be null). - forecast_confidence: - High if high_confidence_inflows > 2 × uncertain_inflows; Medium if high_confidence_inflows > uncertain_inflows; else Low. Liquidity analysis (ordered by forecast_month ascending): - cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: running total of blended_forecast from the first forecasted month through the current month. - next_3_months_cash_flow: the blended_forecast value for the month two months ahead; null if that month does not exist. - worst_case_3_months: sum of negative blended_forecast values from the current month through the next two months (non-negative values counted as zero). - liquidity_status from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: below -10000 Critical Cash Gap; below -5000 Moderate Cash Gap; below 0 Minor Cash Gap; otherwise Positive Cash Position. Final scoring and recommendations: - cash_flow_health_score from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: ≥50000→100; ≥20000→85; ≥5000→70; ≥0→55; ≥-5000→40; ≥-10000→25; else→10. - liquidity_risk_level from worst_case_3_months: < -20000 High Risk; < -10000 Medium Risk; < -2000 Low Risk; else Minimal Risk. - management_recommendation (first-match in order): cumulative_forecast < -10000 → Urgent; < -5000 → Monitor; worst_case_3_months < -10000 → Plan; next_3_months_cash_flow > 50000 → Opportunity; else → Maintain. - forecast_reliability: High confidence with ≥10 counterparties → Very Reliable; High → Reliable; Medium with ≥5 → Moderately Reliable; Medium → Somewhat Reliable; else → Use with Caution. Determinism: - All aggregations are per forecast_month; sums ignore nulls; window calculations order by forecast_month; no additional rounding; status text matches exactly; final output sorted by forecast_month ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: forecast_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month for expected cash dates; exactly one output row per month
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: forecast_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year number of forecast_month (four digits)
      - name: forecast_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1–4) of forecast_month
      - name: forecast_month_num
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of forecast_month
      - name: forecasted_inflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of outstanding amounts > 0 with direction Inflow for the month; 0 if none
      - name: forecasted_outflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of outstanding amounts > 0 with direction Outflow for the month; 0 if none
      - name: forecasted_net_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: 'Net expected cash flow per month: inflows minus outflows; 0 if none'
      - name: risk_adjusted_inflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,8)
        description: 'Inflow sum weighted by status: Not Due 0.95; 1–30 0.85; 31–60 0.70; 61–90 0.50; other 0.30; includes only outstanding amounts > 0'
      - name: blended_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended monthly forecast combining risk-adjusted inflows, outflows, and historical averages per the model; may be null
      - name: forecast_confidence
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High if high-confidence inflows exceed twice uncertain inflows; Medium if they exceed uncertain inflows; else Low
      - name: forecast_counterparties
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct counterparties contributing outstanding amounts in the month
      - name: cumulative_forecast_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of blended_forecast from the first forecasted month through the current month; null if no values exist
      - name: next_3_months_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended forecast for the month two months ahead; null if that future month is missing
      - name: worst_case_3_months
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of negative blended_forecast from current month through two months ahead; non-negative values treated as zero
      - name: liquidity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: below -10000 Critical Cash Gap; below -5000 Moderate Cash Gap; below 0 Minor Cash Gap; else Positive Cash Position'
      - name: cash_flow_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: ≥50000 100; ≥20000 85; ≥5000 70; ≥0 55; ≥-5000 40; ≥-10000 25; else 10'
      - name: liquidity_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk tier by worst_case_3_months: < -20000 High Risk; < -10000 Medium Risk; < -2000 Low Risk; else Minimal Risk'
      - name: management_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match rule: cumulative < -10000 Urgent; < -5000 Monitor; worst_case < -10000 Plan; next_3_months > 50000 Opportunity; else Maintain'
      - name: forecast_reliability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Very Reliable if High confidence with ≥10 counterparties; Reliable if High; Moderately Reliable if Medium with ≥5; Somewhat Reliable if Medium; else Use with Caution

references.name: intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Data preparation: - Start from intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis (historical and outstanding cash flow records). - Historical_monthly_summary over transaction_type in Payment Received or Payment Made: - Group by transaction_month_start, transaction_year, transaction_quarter, transaction_month. - Compute monthly_cash_inflows (sum of net_realized_amount where Payment Received), monthly_cash_outflows (sum of absolute net_realized_amount where Payment Made), and monthly_net_cash_flow (sum of net_realized_amount for both types). - Compute outstanding_receivables/payables (sum of outstanding_amount where cash_flow_status starts with Outstanding and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute overdue_receivables/payables (sum of absolute net_outstanding_amount where cash_flow_timing is Overdue and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute inflow/outflow transaction counts and active_counterparties (distinct counterparty_id). - Future_cash_flows (forecast horizon): - Filter rows with outstanding_amount > 0 and expected_cash_date from current_date through 12 months ahead (inclusive). - Group by month: forecast_month is the first day of expected_cash_date’s month; also capture year, quarter, and month number. - Aggregations: - forecasted_inflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Inflow. - forecasted_outflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Outflow. - forecasted_net_cash_flow: inflows minus outflows (outflows subtracted). - high_confidence_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status is “Outstanding - Not Due”. - uncertain_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status contains “Past Due”. - risk_adjusted_inflows: inflow sum weighted by cash_flow_status: Not Due=0.95; 1–30 Days Past Due=0.85; 31–60 Days Past Due=0.70; 61–90 Days Past Due=0.50; all other statuses=0.30. - forecast_counterparties: distinct counterparty_id count within the month. Historical trends (last 24 months): - Filter to transaction_month_start within the past 24 months. - Compute moving averages of monthly_net_cash_flow: - ma_3_months: average over the current month and the prior two months. - ma_6_months: average over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute seasonal_avg as a running average by month-of-year, ordered by transaction_year. - Compute volatility_6_months as the rolling standard deviation over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute a month_sequence (not used downstream). Forecast model: - Join future_cash_flows to historical_trends by same month-of-year and the latest historical month before the forecast_month with that month-of-year. - blended_forecast per month: - If forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero and ma_3_months exists: 70% of (risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows) plus 30% of ma_3_months. - Else if forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero: risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows. - Else if seasonal_avg exists: seasonal_avg. - Else: ma_6_months (may be null). - forecast_confidence: - High if high_confidence_inflows > 2 × uncertain_inflows; Medium if high_confidence_inflows > uncertain_inflows; else Low. Liquidity analysis (ordered by forecast_month ascending): - cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: running total of blended_forecast from the first forecasted month through the current month. - next_3_months_cash_flow: the blended_forecast value for the month two months ahead; null if that month does not exist. - worst_case_3_months: sum of negative blended_forecast values from the current month through the next two months (non-negative values counted as zero). - liquidity_status from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: below -10000 Critical Cash Gap; below -5000 Moderate Cash Gap; below 0 Minor Cash Gap; otherwise Positive Cash Position. Final scoring and recommendations: - cash_flow_health_score from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: ≥50000→100; ≥20000→85; ≥5000→70; ≥0→55; ≥-5000→40; ≥-10000→25; else→10. - liquidity_risk_level from worst_case_3_months: < -20000 High Risk; < -10000 Medium Risk; < -2000 Low Risk; else Minimal Risk. - management_recommendation (first-match in order): cumulative_forecast < -10000 → Urgent; < -5000 → Monitor; worst_case_3_months < -10000 → Plan; next_3_months_cash_flow > 50000 → Opportunity; else → Maintain. - forecast_reliability: High confidence with ≥10 counterparties → Very Reliable; High → Reliable; Medium with ≥5 → Moderately Reliable; Medium → Somewhat Reliable; else → Use with Caution. Determinism: - All aggregations are per forecast_month; sums ignore nulls; window calculations order by forecast_month; no additional rounding; status text matches exactly; final output sorted by forecast_month ascending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: quickbooks__customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics with revenue trends, behavior patterns, RFM-style scoring, growth percentages, and risk assessments (one row per customer_id, source_relation)
      grain: One row per customer_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      business_logic: '- Start with customer_base as all columns from intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle, one row per (customer_id, source_relation). - Build revenue_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis by month per (customer_id, source_relation): • monthly_customer_revenue = sum of total_amount • monthly_customer_invoices = distinct invoice count • monthly_avg_invoice_amount = average total_amount • monthly_collected_amount = sum of collected_amount • monthly_outstanding_balance = sum of outstanding_balance - Compute customer_revenue_trends by aggregating revenue_details per (customer_id, source_relation): • Define windows relative to current_date: - Last 3 months: months starting on or after 3 months ago - Previous 3 months: the 3 months immediately before the last 3 months - Current quarter: months on or after the start of the current quarter - Previous quarter: the 3 months immediately before the current quarter - Current year: months on or after the start of the current year - Previous year: months in the year immediately before the current year • For each window, sum monthly_customer_revenue; sums return 0 when a customer has revenue months outside the window but none inside; customers with no revenue rows have NULLs after the LEFT JOIN. • Activity and stability: - active_months = distinct count of revenue months across all time - active_months_last_12 = distinct count of revenue months within the last 12 months - last_revenue_month = most recent revenue month - revenue_volatility = sample standard deviation of monthly_customer_revenue - avg_monthly_revenue = average of monthly_customer_revenue - revenue_trend_correlation = Pearson correlation between month time and monthly_customer_revenue - Compute customer_behavior_patterns from customer_base: • Pass through base metrics (e.g., total_invoices, avg_invoice_amount, monthly_revenue_avg, customer_lifespan_days, payment_rate_percentage, total_payment_amount, unique_products_purchased, total_quantity_purchased). • acquisition_season by month of first_invoice_date: Winter (Dec/Jan/Feb), Spring (Mar–May), Summer (Jun–Aug), else Fall; defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL. • annual_transaction_frequency = round(total_invoices*365.0/customer_lifespan_days, 2) when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0. • customer_maturity_stage by customer_lifespan_days: ≥1095 Mature (3+ years); ≥730 Established (2+ years); ≥365 Developing (1+ year); ≥90 Growing (3+ months); else New (< 3 months). - Build customer_segmentation by LEFT JOINing customer_base to customer_revenue_trends and customer_behavior_patterns on (customer_id, source_relation), then compute: • recency_score by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30→5, ≤60→4, ≤90→3, ≤180→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • frequency_score by annual_transaction_frequency: ≥12→5, ≥6→4, ≥3→3, ≥1→2, else 1. • monetary_score by total_invoice_amount: ≥50000→5, ≥20000→4, ≥5000→3, ≥1000→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • growth_score: if revenue_prev_3_months>0 then by growth ratio (last_3 vs prev_3: >50%→5, >20%→4, >0→3, >-20%→2, else 1); else 3. • payment_score by payment_rate_percentage: ≥95→5, ≥85→4, ≥70→3, ≥50→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). - Final output: • Growth percentages (3m, QoQ, YoY) are computed only when the respective previous period > 0; value = round(((current - previous)/previous)*100, 2); else NULL. • overall_customer_score = round(average of the five scores, 1). • rfm_segment via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Lost''. • recommended_action via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Monitor and maintain''. • risk_assessment priority: - High Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>180 and total_invoice_amount>10000 - else Medium Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>90 and three-month growth%< -50 (growth%=0 when revenue_prev_3_months≤0) - else Payment Risk if payment_rate_percentage<70 - else Volatility Risk if revenue_volatility>avg_monthly_revenue - else Low Risk • Filter out rows where customer_id is NULL and order by total_invoice_amount descending, then overall_customer_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from lifecycle base; part of the grain; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source identifier from lifecycle base; part of the grain; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from lifecycle base
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name from lifecycle base
      - name: display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Current active flag from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Customer creation timestamp from lifecycle base
      - name: total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total invoice count from lifecycle base
      - name: total_invoice_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total invoiced amount from lifecycle base
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Outstanding balance from lifecycle base
      - name: first_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest invoice date from lifecycle base
      - name: last_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent invoice date from lifecycle base
      - name: avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount from lifecycle base
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of payments from lifecycle base
      - name: total_payment_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total payment amount from lifecycle base
      - name: payment_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Payment rate percentage from lifecycle base
      - name: unique_products_purchased

        description: Distinct products purchased from lifecycle base
      - name: total_quantity_purchased
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total quantity purchased from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between first and last activity from lifecycle base
      - name: monthly_revenue_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly revenue from lifecycle base
      - name: days_since_last_invoice
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent invoice from lifecycle base
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer activity status from lifecycle base
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_value_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer value segment from lifecycle base
      - name: payment_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment behavior label from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Maturity stage by lifespan thresholds (≥1095 Mature; ≥730 Established; ≥365 Developing; ≥90 Growing; else New)
      - name: acquisition_season
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season by month of first_invoice_date (Winter: Dec/Jan/Feb; Spring: Mar–May; Summer: Jun–Aug; else Fall); defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL'
      - name: annual_transaction_frequency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Annualized frequency rounded to 2 decimals when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0
      - name: revenue_last_3_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the last 3 months; 0 if only older months exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_3_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous 3 months; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_3m_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous 3 months; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_current_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the current quarter; 0 if only months outside the quarter exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous quarter; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_qoq_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous quarter; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_current_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the current year; 0 if only months outside the year exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous year; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_yoy_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous year; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of revenue months across all time; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: active_months_last_12
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of revenue months in the last 12 months; 0 if none; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly revenue; NULL if fewer than 2 months
      - name: avg_monthly_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of monthly revenue; NULL if no months
      - name: revenue_trend_correlation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Pearson correlation between month time and monthly revenue; range [-1,1]; NULL if fewer than 2 months
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by days_since_last_invoice (≤30:5, ≤60:4, ≤90:3, ≤180:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by annual_transaction_frequency (≥12:5, ≥6:4, ≥3:3, ≥1:2, else 1)
      - name: monetary_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by total_invoice_amount (≥50000:5, ≥20000:4, ≥5000:3, ≥1000:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: growth_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by 3-month growth ratio when previous period>0 (>50%:5, >20%:4, >0:3, >-20%:2, else 1); else 3
      - name: payment_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by payment_rate_percentage (≥95:5, ≥85:4, ≥70:3, ≥50:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: overall_customer_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of the five scores, rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Segment label from ordered rules on R/F/M; defaults to 'Lost'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommended action from ordered rules on R/F/M; defaults to 'Monitor and maintain'
      - name: risk_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label with priority: High Churn Risk (>180 days since last and total_invoice_amount>10000) → Medium Churn Risk (>90 days and three-month growth%< -50, growth%=0 if prev_3≤0) → Payment Risk (payment_rate<70) → Volatility Risk (volatility>avg_monthly_revenue) → Low Risk'

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 1095 THEN 'Mature' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 730 THEN 'Established' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 365 THEN 'Developing' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 90 THEN 'Growing' ELSE 'New' END

CASE WHEN MONTH(first_invoice_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN MONTH(first_invoice_date) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'Spring' WHEN MONTH(first_invoice_date) BETWEEN 6 AND 8 THEN 'Summer' ELSE 'Fall' END
CASE WHEN customer_lifespan_days > 0 AND total_invoices > 0 THEN ROUND(total_invoices * 365.0 / customer_lifespan_days, 2) ELSE 0 END
CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_month_start >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3' MONTH) THEN monthly_customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
