blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__overview_report
      description: Daily app-level overview combining impressions, page views, downloads, installations/deletions, sessions, active devices, and crashes
      grain: One row per (source_relation, app_id, date_day) present in intermediate.int_apple_store__app
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__discovery_and_engagement_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__crash_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__download_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__installation_and_deletion_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__session_daily
      business_logic: '- Use all rows from intermediate.int_apple_store__app as the reporting grain to define the complete set of (source_relation, app_id, date_day) keys. - Aggregate per key: • discovery_and_engagement_daily: sum impressions and page_views. • download_daily: sum first_time_downloads, redownloads, and total_downloads (total_downloads is taken as provided, not recomputed). • installation_and_deletion_daily: sum installations and deletions. • session_daily: sum sessions and active_devices. - Take crashes from crash_daily at the same keys without further aggregation (source expected to be unique per key). - Left join each aggregated dataset to the reporting grain on all three keys. - Left join app_dim on (source_relation, app_id) to add app_name. - For all numeric outputs, replace NULL with 0 after joins. Sums ignore NULL inputs and include all contributing rows (no de-duplication beyond the grouping keys). - Output exactly one row per reporting-grain key.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system label from the reporting grain used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day-level timestamp from the reporting grain used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier within source_relation used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name from app_dim joined on (source_relation, app_id); NULL if no matching app_dim row
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions by (source_relation, app_id, date_day) from discovery_and_engagement_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page views by (source_relation, app_id, date_day) from discovery_and_engagement_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Crash count from crash_daily for the key; 0 if missing
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of first-time downloads by key from download_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of redownloads by key from download_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total downloads by key from download_daily (not computed from other fields); 0 if missing
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of active devices by key from session_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of deletions by key from installation_and_deletion_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of installations by key from installation_and_deletion_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: sessions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of sessions by key from session_daily; 0 if missing

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__platform_version_report
      description: Daily Apple Store metrics by platform_version and source_type built at the reporting grain; missing measures default to 0.
      grain: One row per (app_id, date_day, source_type, platform_version, source_relation) present in intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_impressions_pv
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_app_crashes
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_downloads_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_install_deletions
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_sessions_activity
      business_logic: '- Establish the reporting grain as all rows from intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report keyed by (app_id, date_day, source_type, platform_version, source_relation). - Build app lookup from intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim selecting (app_id, app_name, source_relation). - Aggregate per-grain metrics within each intermediate source: - impressions/page_views: sum impressions, impressions_unique_device, page_views, page_views_unique_device grouped by the five keys. - downloads: sum first_time_downloads, redownloads, total_downloads grouped by the five keys. - installs/deletions: sum installations, deletions grouped by the five keys. - sessions/activity: sum sessions, active_devices grouped by the five keys. - Crashes: take values from intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_app_crashes at the same five-key grain; this dataset is expected to be unique per key. - LEFT JOIN each aggregated dataset and crashes to the reporting grain on an exact match of the five keys; LEFT JOIN app_dim on (app_id, source_relation) to attach app_name. - For all numeric metric columns, if a join yields no match or NULL, return 0; no rounding or scaling; integer types preserved. - No filtering or ordering is applied; no deduplication beyond the described GROUP BY aggregations. The output contains exactly one row per reporting grain key, with app_name NULL if no matching app_dim record.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Reporting timestamp from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name joined from int_apple_store__app_dim by (app_id, source_relation); NULL if no match; casing preserved.
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Traffic source category from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform version string from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: impressions_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions_unique_device over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page_views over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: page_views_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page_views_unique_device over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Crash count taken as-is at the five-key grain from app_crashes; NULLs become 0; dataset expected unique per key.
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of first_time_downloads over the five-key grain from downloads_daily; NULLs become 0.
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of redownloads over the five-key grain from downloads_daily; NULLs become 0.
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT

      - name: active_devices

      - name: deletions

        description: Sum of deletions over the five-key grain from install_deletions; NULLs become 0.
      - name: installations

        description: Sum of installations over the five-key grain from install_deletions; NULLs become 0.
      - name: sessions

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__subscription_report
      description: Daily subscription KPIs per product and territory; joins summary and events to the reporting grain and enriches with country names/regions; missing measures are zero-filled.
      grain: One row per date_day × vendor_number × app_apple_id × subscription_name × territory_short × state × source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report as the driver; output one row per key: date_day, vendor_number, app_apple_id, subscription_name, country (as territory_short), state, source_relation. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary on vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, and source_relation to bring active_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events on the same keys to bring event_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes on country_code_alpha_2 = reporting country; set territory_long to alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; set region and sub_region from the match. - Pass through app_name and source_relation from the reporting grain; set territory_short from the reporting country and state from the reporting state. - Null handling: replace missing active_* and event_* measures with 0; geography fields from country_codes are null when no country match; other string fields are passed through unchanged. - No aggregation, sorting, or filtering is applied; row multiplicity follows the joins and assumes uniqueness of joined sources on the stated keys.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day timestamp from the reporting grain; used in joins; no timezone conversion.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Vendor identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_apple_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Application Apple ID from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name passed through from the reporting grain.
      - name: subscription_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subscription product name from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Country name from country_codes: use alternative name when available, otherwise the standard country name; null if no country match.'
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter ISO alpha-2 country code from the reporting grain; preserved as stored.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from the reporting grain; may be null.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
      - name: active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on introductory free trials from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-as-you-go introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-up-front introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_standard_price_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions at standard price from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_standard_price_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: event_renew
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Renewal event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_renew >= 0
      - name: event_cancel
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cancel event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_cancel >= 0
      - name: event_subscribe
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Subscribe event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_subscribe >= 0

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__territory_report
      description: Daily territory/source metrics per app, built from reporting grain with left-joined measures and country metadata, zero-filled for missing measures.
      grain: One row per (source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory) from intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_impressions_page_views
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_downloads_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_install_deletions
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_sessions_activity
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report as the complete reporting grain: one row per (source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory). - LEFT JOIN app_dim on app_id and source_relation to add app_name; if no match, app_name is NULL. - LEFT JOIN territory_impressions_page_views on app_id, date_day, source_type, territory, and source_relation; set impressions, impressions_unique_device, page_views, and page_views_unique_device to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_downloads_daily on the same keys; set first_time_downloads, redownloads, and total_downloads to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_install_deletions on the same keys; set deletions and installations to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_sessions_activity on the same keys; set active_devices and sessions to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN country_codes on territory equals the two-letter country code; set territory_long to the alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; territory_short mirrors the source territory code and is NULL only when the source territory is NULL; region and sub_region come from country_codes and are NULL when no match. - No aggregation or sorting is applied; base rows are preserved and any duplicates in joined sources will propagate. String casing and spacing are unchanged, and date_day is not truncated or timezone-adjusted.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain, also used in all joins.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp from the reporting grain; intended as a day but any time component is preserved.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier from the reporting grain and the join key to all metric tables and app_dim.
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name from app_dim joined on app_id and source_relation; NULL when no match.
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Traffic source category from the reporting grain; passed through unchanged.
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country long name from country_codes, preferring the alternative name when present; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter country code from the reporting grain; NULL only when the source territory is NULL.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched territory; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched territory; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Impressions from territory_impressions_page_views at the full grain; missing values output as 0.
      - name: impressions_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Unique-device impressions from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Page views from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: page_views_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Unique-device page views from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: First-time downloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Redownloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total downloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active devices from territory_sessions_activity; missing values output as 0.
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: App deletions from territory_install_deletions; missing values output as 0.
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: App installations from territory_install_deletions; missing values output as 0.
      - name: sessions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sessions from territory_sessions_activity; missing values output as 0.

- name: stg_apple_store__app_session_daily
      description: "Daily app session activity standardized from raw sessions feed."
      source_table: raw.app_session_standard_daily
      columns:
        - name: date_day
          data_type: DATE
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "date_day IS NOT NULL AND date_day <= CURRENT_DATE AND date_day >= '2020-01-01'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: app_id
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: app_version
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "(app_version RLIKE '^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$' OR app_version RLIKE '^[0-9]+$') AND NOT (app_version RLIKE '[A-Za-z]')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "NOT (app_version RLIKE '[A-Za-z]')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: device
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "device IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(device) <> ''"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "device NOT LIKE '%Android%' AND device NOT LIKE '%Samsung%' AND device NOT LIKE '%HUAWEI%'"

        - name: source_type

        - name: page_type

        - name: app_download_date
          data_type: DATE

          data_type: VARCHAR

            - rule: "territory = UPPER(TRIM(territory))"

            - rule: "LENGTH(TRIM(territory)) = 2"

          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: total_session_duration
          data_type: BIGINT

- name: int_intercom__company_history
      description: "Typed company snapshots with derived helpers such as website_domain and company_age_days."
      grain: "One row per company_id per source snapshot"
      source_models: [staging.stg_intercom__company_history]
      business_logic: >
        For each company snapshot sourced from staging, carry forward typed attributes and derive helper fields.
        Extract website_domain from the website URL using hostname extraction and lowercase normalization.
        Compute company_age_days when created_at is present as the day difference between created_at and the last updated timestamp.
      columns:
        - name: company_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Company identifier."
          tests: [not_null]
        - name: company_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Company name as recorded in Intercom."
          tests: []
        - name: website
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Raw website value."
          tests: []
        - name: website_domain
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Domain extracted from website and normalized to lowercase."
          tests: []
        - name: industry
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Industry classification string."
          tests: []
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Company record creation timestamp."
          tests: []
        - name: updated_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Most recent update timestamp for the snapshot."
          tests: []
        - name: user_count
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "User count metric derived from the source; negatives coerced to zero upstream."
          tests: ["user_count >= 0"]
        - name: session_count
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Session count metric; negatives coerced to zero upstream."
          tests: ["session_count >= 0"]
        - name: monthly_spend
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Monthly spend; negative values nulled upstream."
          tests: ["monthly_spend >= 0"]
        - name: plan_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Commercial plan identifier."
          tests: []
        - name: plan_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Commercial plan name."
          tests: []
        - name: company_age_days
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Age in days between creation and last update, when computable."
          tests: ["company_age_days >= 0"]

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_intercom__contact_latest
      description: "Latest contact snapshot with activity windows, retention flags, and email-domain extraction."
      grain: "One row per contact_id (latest snapshot)"
      source_models: [staging.stg_intercom__contact_history]
      business_logic: >
        Determine the latest snapshot per contact using the most recent update timestamp (falling back to creation time).
        Compute last_activity_at as the greatest of last_contacted_at, last_email_clicked_at, last_email_opened_at, and last_replied_at when present.
        Derive activity window flags (1d, 7d, 30d) by comparing last_activity_at to now.
        Set retention flags for 7d and 30d if last_activity_at occurs at least 7 or 30 days after signed_up_at respectively.
        Extract the email_domain by taking the substring after '@' from the lowercase email, defaulting to a placeholder when missing.
      columns:
        - name: contact_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Contact identifier."
          tests: [not_null]
        - name: admin_id
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Associated admin identifier when present."
          tests: []
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Contact record creation timestamp."
          tests: []
        - name: updated_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Most recent update timestamp for the contact snapshot."
          tests: []
        - name: signed_up_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Contact registration timestamp when applicable."
          tests: []
        - name: contact_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Trimmed contact name."
          tests: []
        - name: contact_role
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Role classification for the contact."
          tests: []
        - name: contact_email
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Lowercased and trimmed email address."
          tests: []
        - name: email_domain
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Extracted domain part of the contact_email in lowercase."
          tests: []
        - name: last_replied_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Last reply timestamp recorded for the contact."
          tests: []
        - name: last_email_clicked_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Last email click timestamp recorded for the contact."
          tests: []
        - name: last_email_opened_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Last email open timestamp recorded for the contact."
          tests: []
        - name: last_contacted_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Last time the contact was contacted."
          tests: []
        - name: last_activity_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Greatest of activity-related timestamps used for activity windows and retention."
          tests: []
        - name: is_active_1d
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if last_activity_at within the past 1 day."
          tests: []
        - name: is_active_7d
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if last_activity_at within the past 7 days."
          tests: []
        - name: is_active_30d
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if last_activity_at within the past 30 days."
          tests: []
        - name: retained_7d
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if last_activity_at occurs at least 7 days after signed_up_at."
          tests: []
        - name: retained_30d
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if last_activity_at occurs at least 30 days after signed_up_at."
          tests: []
        - name: is_unsubscribed_from_emails
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "Whether the contact unsubscribed from emails."
          tests: []

- name: int_intercom__conversation_part_aggregates
      description: "Per-conversation aggregates and key event timestamps derived from conversation parts."
      grain: "One row per conversation_id"
      source_models: [staging.stg_intercom__conversation_part_history, staging.stg_intercom__conversation_history]
      business_logic: >
        For each conversation, compute counts of parts, assignments, and reopen events.
        Identify first and last timestamps for assignments, contact replies, admin responses, and reopen events.
        The first contact reply considers parts authored by a contact (user or lead) and is used for time-to-close metrics downstream.
      columns:
        - name: conversation_id
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Conversation identifier."
          tests: [not_null]

          description: "Creation time of the conversation carried forward for time-based metrics."

        - name: count_total_parts

          description: "Total number of parts associated with the conversation."
          tests: ["count_total_parts >= 0"]
        - name: first_contact_reply_at

          description: "Timestamp of the first reply authored by a contact (user or lead)."
          tests: []
        - name: first_assignment_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first assignment-related part."
          tests: []
        - name: first_admin_response_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first admin-authored comment with body content."
          tests: []
        - name: first_reopen_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first reopen event for the conversation."
          tests: []
        - name: last_assignment_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last assignment-related part."
          tests: []
        - name: last_contact_reply_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last contact-authored reply."
          tests: []
        - name: last_admin_response_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last admin-authored response with body content."
          tests: []
        - name: last_reopen_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last reopen event for the conversation."
          tests: []
        - name: count_assignments
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Number of assignment-related parts."
          tests: ["count_assignments >= 0"]
        - name: count_reopens
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Number of reopen events."
          tests: ["count_reopens >= 0"]

        Determine the latest snapshot per conversation using the most recent update timestamp (falling back to creation time).
        Carry forward typed attributes and rename fields to a canonical naming scheme for downstream consumption.
        Missing assignee types are set to a default category and rating values are typed for consistent analytics.
      columns:

          tests: []
        - name: conversation_initiated_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "How the conversation was initiated (e.g., delivered as system or user message)."
          tests: []
        - name: conversation_subject
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Subject/title of the conversation when present."
          tests: []
        - name: conversation_assignee_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Assignee category for the conversation; defaults to unassigned if missing."
          tests: []
        - name: conversation_author_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Type of the source author (admin, user, lead)."
          tests: []
        - name: conversation_state
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Conversation state ('open' or 'closed')."
          tests: ["conversation_state IN ('open','closed')"]
        - name: is_read
          data_type: BOOLEAN

blocks.original_text:
- name: intercom__company_metrics
      description: "Company-level support and engagement KPIs aggregated across conversations and contacts."
      grain: "One row per company_id"
      source_models: [
        intermediate.int_intercom__latest_conversation,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_part_aggregates,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_part_events,
        intermediate.int_intercom__contact_company_history,
        intermediate.int_intercom__contact_latest,
        intermediate.int_intercom__company_history
      ]
      business_logic: >
        Map conversations to companies via the first contact author and contact-to-company history.
        Compute conversation totals, closed counts, average parts, and average rating for each company.
        Derive conversion-by-channel counts and guarded conversion rates by dividing by the total number of contacts only when the denominator is positive.
        Compute median time metrics per company based on per-conversation minutes and provide date continuity diagnostics using active day coverage within min..max ranges.
        Provide active and retained contact counts based on 7-day and 30-day windows and registration-based retention ratios guarded by denominators.
      columns:
        - name: company_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Company identifier."
          tests: [not_null]
        - name: company_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Company name."
          tests: []
        - name: website
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Company website."
          tests: []
        - name: industry
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Industry classification."
          tests: []
        - name: plan_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Plan identifier."
          tests: []
        - name: plan_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Plan name."
          tests: []
        - name: total_conversations
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Total number of conversations mapped to the company."
          tests: ["total_conversations >= 0"]
        - name: total_conversations_closed
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Number of conversations in a closed state."
          tests: ["total_conversations_closed >= 0"]
        - name: avg_conversation_parts
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Average number of parts per conversation."
          tests: ["avg_conversation_parts >= 0"]
        - name: avg_conversation_rating
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Average conversation rating."
          tests: ["avg_conversation_rating >= 0"]
        - name: contacts_total
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Total number of contacts associated with the company."
          tests: ["contacts_total >= 0"]
        - name: conv_rate_overall
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Conversations per contact overall (guarded by positive denominator)."
          tests: ["conv_rate_overall >= 0"]
        - name: conv_rate_email
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Conversations per contact via email channel."
          tests: ["conv_rate_email >= 0"]
        - name: conv_rate_messenger
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Conversations per contact via messenger channel."
          tests: ["conv_rate_messenger >= 0"]
        - name: conv_rate_other
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Conversations per contact via other channels."
          tests: ["conv_rate_other >= 0"]
        - name: contacts_active_7d
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Active contacts in the past 7 days."
          tests: ["contacts_active_7d >= 0"]
        - name: contacts_active_30d
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Active contacts in the past 30 days."
          tests: ["contacts_active_30d >= 0"]
        - name: registration_retention_7d
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Share of registered contacts retained at 7 days."
          tests: ["registration_retention_7d BETWEEN 0 AND 1"]
        - name: registration_retention_30d
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Share of registered contacts retained at 30 days."
          tests: ["registration_retention_30d BETWEEN 0 AND 1"]
        - name: p50_time_to_first_response_min
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Median minutes to first admin response across the company's conversations."
          tests: ["p50_time_to_first_response_min >= 0"]
        - name: p50_time_to_first_close_min
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Median minutes from first contact reply to first close."
          tests: ["p50_time_to_first_close_min >= 0"]
        - name: p50_time_to_last_close_min
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Median minutes from first contact reply to last close."
          tests: ["p50_time_to_last_close_min >= 0"]
        - name: p50_reopens
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Median number of reopens per conversation."
          tests: ["p50_reopens >= 0"]
        - name: missing_days
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Count of missing active days within the min..max range of conversation days."
          tests: ["missing_days >= 0"]
        - name: is_date_continuous
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "True if the company's conversations span continuous days without gaps within the observed range."
          tests: []

- name: intercom__conversation_enhanced
      description: "Human-friendly conversation snapshot enriched with actors, tags, event timestamps, and company names."
      grain: "One row per conversation_id"
      source_models: [
        intermediate.int_intercom__latest_conversation,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_part_events,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_string_aggregates,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_tags_aggregate,
        intermediate.int_intercom__contact_company_names
      ]
      business_logic: >
        Provide a consolidated conversation record including enriched fields: event timestamps for first/last close and admin close, aggregated tag names, aggregated admin and contact actors, and company names linked to the first contacting author.
        This model is intended for BI consumption and ad hoc analysis where a single record per conversation is preferred.
      columns:
        - name: conversation_id
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Conversation identifier."
          tests: [not_null]

          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Creation timestamp of the conversation."
          tests: [not_null]

          tests: []

          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Subject/title."
          tests: []

          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Assignee category."
          tests: []

          tests: []
        - name: last_close_at

          description: "Last close timestamp."

          description: "Last admin close timestamp."

blocks.original_text:
- name: intercom__conversation_metrics
      description: "Per-conversation KPIs and durations derived from latest snapshot and part aggregates."
      grain: "One row per conversation_id"
      source_models: [
        intermediate.int_intercom__latest_conversation,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_part_aggregates,
        intermediate.int_intercom__conversation_part_events
      ]
      business_logic: >
        Combine the latest conversation snapshot with part aggregates and event attributions.
        Compute time-to-first assignment and time-to-first response from conversation creation, plus time-to-close metrics relative to the first contact reply.
        Include counts of assignments and reopens for context, with appropriate guards to avoid division by zero or negative durations.
      columns:
        - name: conversation_id
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Conversation identifier."
          tests: [not_null]
        - name: conversation_created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Conversation creation timestamp."
          tests: [not_null]
        - name: count_reopens
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Number of reopen events."
          tests: ["count_reopens >= 0"]
        - name: count_total_parts
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Total number of parts in the conversation."
          tests: ["count_total_parts >= 0"]
        - name: count_assignments
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Total number of assignment events."
          tests: ["count_assignments >= 0"]
        - name: first_contact_reply_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first contact reply used for time-to-close calculations."
          tests: []
        - name: first_assignment_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first assignment."
          tests: []
        - name: time_to_first_assignment_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from creation to the first assignment, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_first_assignment_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: first_admin_response_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the first admin response."
          tests: []
        - name: time_to_first_response_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from creation to the first admin response, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_first_response_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: time_to_admin_first_close_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from first contact reply to first admin close, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_admin_first_close_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: time_to_first_close_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from first contact reply to first close, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_first_close_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: last_assignment_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last assignment."
          tests: []
        - name: time_to_last_assignment_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from creation to the last assignment, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_last_assignment_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: last_contact_reply_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last contact reply."
          tests: []
        - name: last_admin_response_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last admin response."
          tests: []
        - name: last_reopen_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "Timestamp of the last reopen event."
          tests: []
        - name: time_to_admin_last_close_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from first contact reply to the last admin close, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_admin_last_close_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: time_to_last_close_minutes
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "Minutes from first contact reply to the last close, when computable."
          tests: ["time_to_last_close_minutes >= 0"]
        - name: first_close_by_admin_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Admin author_id for the first close."
          tests: []
        - name: last_close_by_admin_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Admin author_id for the last close."
          tests: []
        - name: first_close_by_author_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Author_id for the first close event."
          tests: []
        - name: last_close_by_author_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Author_id for the last close event."
          tests: []

      description: "Admin dimension with email-based inclusion checks and deletion filtering; outputs admin_id, name, job_title."

          on_failure: delete_row
        - rule: "_fivetran_deleted is not true (null treated as false)"
          on_failure: delete_row

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__campaign_flow_metrics
      description: Campaign/flow-level metrics aggregated from events with touch resolution via direct IDs or attributed parent events
      grain: One row per (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, derive per event a touch_id and touch_type: use campaign_id and ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present; otherwise use flow_id and ''flow'' when flow_id is present. - For events without a direct touch_id but with event_attribution: - Remove all "$" characters from the event_attribution payload. - Extract the attributed parent event_id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id; if not found, use attributed_event_id; remove any surrounding double quotes and treat an empty string as NULL. - In the same source_relation, find that parent event_id among all events to obtain its touch_id and touch_type. - Resolve the last-touch per event: - Use the parent event’s touch_id and touch_type when an attributed parent is found; otherwise use the event’s own. - Populate last_touch_campaign_id when the resolved touch_type is campaign, and last_touch_flow_id when it is flow; only one is set when resolved, and both may be NULL if unresolved. - Aggregate by (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id): - total_count_unique_people is the distinct count of person_id across all events; NULL person_id is excluded. - first_event_at and last_event_at are the minimum and maximum occurred_at; NULL timestamps are ignored. - Revenue sums are computed per event type, matching the exact type names case-insensitively; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negative values are kept. - Event counts tally the number of events for each type; duplicates are counted and person_id is not considered. - Unique counts tally distinct person_id per event type within the group; NULL person_id is excluded. - Conversion rates use event counts (not unique counts); if the denominator is zero the rate is NULL; otherwise use floating-point division with no rounding. - GMV gross is the sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; GMV net is gross minus the sums for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negatives are kept.'
      columns:
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign identifier when the final touch is a campaign; derived from the event or its attributed parent; NULL otherwise
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow identifier when the final touch is a flow; derived from the event or its attributed parent; NULL otherwise
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event variation identifier used in grouping; NULL values form their own group
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier; joins and grouping are scoped within each source_relation
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of person_id within the group across all event types; NULL person_id excluded
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at within the group; NULL occurred_at ignored; NULL only if all are NULL
      - name: last_event_at

        description: Latest occurred_at within the group; NULL occurred_at ignored; NULL only if all are NULL
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order

        description: Sum of numeric_value for 'refunded order' events; NULL numeric_value treated as 0; negatives preserved

references.name: staging.stg_klaviyo__event
references.line_text: business_logic: '- From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, derive per event a touch_id and touch_type: use campaign_id and ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present; otherwise use flow_id and ''flow'' when flow_id is present. - For events without a direct touch_id but with event_attribution: - Remove all "$" characters from the event_attribution payload. - Extract the attributed parent event_id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id; if not found, use attributed_event_id; remove any surrounding double quotes and treat an empty string as NULL. - In the same source_relation, find that parent event_id among all events to obtain its touch_id and touch_type. - Resolve the last-touch per event: - Use the parent event’s touch_id and touch_type when an attributed parent is found; otherwise use the event’s own. - Populate last_touch_campaign_id when the resolved touch_type is campaign, and last_touch_flow_id when it is flow; only one is set when resolved, and both may be NULL if unresolved. - Aggregate by (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id): - total_count_unique_people is the distinct count of person_id across all events; NULL person_id is excluded. - first_event_at and last_event_at are the minimum and maximum occurred_at; NULL timestamps are ignored. - Revenue sums are computed per event type, matching the exact type names case-insensitively; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negative values are kept. - Event counts tally the number of events for each type; duplicates are counted and person_id is not considered. - Unique counts tally distinct person_id per event type within the group; NULL person_id is excluded. - Conversion rates use event counts (not unique counts); if the denominator is zero the rate is NULL; otherwise use floating-point division with no rounding. - GMV gross is the sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; GMV net is gross minus the sums for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negatives are kept.'

- name: int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched
      description: Campaigns with campaign-attributed engagement and GMV metrics aggregated per variation and left-joined to campaign records.
      grain: One row per (campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation); campaigns without attributed events produce one row with variation_id and all metrics NULL.
      source_models:

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__event_attribution
      description: Resolves touch attribution using direct campaign/flow or, when no direct touch exists, a referenced child event; session_start_at and session_event_type mirror the original event.
      grain: One row per (source_relation, event_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event as events; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Compute direct touch fields: - touch_id = campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id, otherwise null. - touch_type = ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present, ''flow'' when flow_id is present, otherwise null. - Parse event_attribution only for events with event_attribution present and no direct touch (touch_id is null): - Clean by removing all ''$'' characters from the JSON string. - Extract an attributed child event id using the first non-null path in this order: relationships.attributed-event.data.id, then attributed_event_id. - Normalize by stripping double quotes and converting empty strings to null. - Inherit child touch details: - Match the extracted child id to events on event_id within the same source_relation. - Retrieve child''s touch_id and touch_type; child''s event type is not used. - Keep rows only where a non-null child id was extracted; the child match itself may be missing, yielding nulls. - Final output: - Left join inherited data to events on (event_id, source_relation). - session_start_at = original occurred_at (inherited occurred_at equals the event''s occurred_at). - session_event_type = original type (inherited event_type duplicates the event''s type). - last_touch_id = child''s touch_id when available, otherwise the direct touch_id. - session_touch_type = child''s touch_type when available, otherwise the direct touch_type. - Determinism and null handling: - JSON paths are evaluated in the stated order; quote stripping and empty-to-null normalization are applied exactly once. - Child lookup is scoped to the same source_relation; no deduplication, sorting, or additional filtering is applied. - If extraction fails or no matching child exists, last_touch_id/session_touch_type fall back to direct values; if those are null, results remain null. - event_attribution in the output is unchanged from staging; cleaning is only for parsing.'

      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign id from staging; may be null.

        description: Flow id from staging; may be null.

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier from staging; may be null.
      - name: FLOW_MESSAGE_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow message id from staging; may be null.
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier from staging; used to match attributed child events.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: metric_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric id from staging; may be null.
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person id from staging; may be null.
      - name: type

        description: Event type from staging; mirrored in session_event_type.
      - name: UUID

        description: Event UUID from staging; may be null.
      - name: numeric_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric value from event properties in staging; may be null.

        description: Raw JSON from staging that may reference a child event; output is unchanged.

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Compare-at price from event properties in staging; may be null.

        description: 'Direct touch id: campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id, otherwise null.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event as events; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Compute direct touch fields: - touch_id = campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id, otherwise null. - touch_type = ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present, ''flow'' when flow_id is present, otherwise null. - Parse event_attribution only for events with event_attribution present and no direct touch (touch_id is null): - Clean by removing all ''$'' characters from the JSON string. - Extract an attributed child event id using the first non-null path in this order: relationships.attributed-event.data.id, then attributed_event_id. - Normalize by stripping double quotes and converting empty strings to null. - Inherit child touch details: - Match the extracted child id to events on event_id within the same source_relation. - Retrieve child''s touch_id and touch_type; child''s event type is not used. - Keep rows only where a non-null child id was extracted; the child match itself may be missing, yielding nulls. - Final output: - Left join inherited data to events on (event_id, source_relation). - session_start_at = original occurred_at (inherited occurred_at equals the event''s occurred_at). - session_event_type = original type (inherited event_type duplicates the event''s type). - last_touch_id = child''s touch_id when available, otherwise the direct touch_id. - session_touch_type = child''s touch_type when available, otherwise the direct touch_type. - Determinism and null handling: - JSON paths are evaluated in the stated order; quote stripping and empty-to-null normalization are applied exactly once. - Child lookup is scoped to the same source_relation; no deduplication, sorting, or additional filtering is applied. - If extraction fails or no matching child exists, last_touch_id/session_touch_type fall back to direct values; if those are null, results remain null. - event_attribution in the output is unchanged from staging; cleaning is only for parsing.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__events
      description: Events enriched with inherited touch attribution, joined dimensions, session features, and non-negative revenue fields
      grain: One row per (source_relation, event_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__flow
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__person
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__metric
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive direct touch fields: touch_id is campaign_id when present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' or ''flow'' accordingly. - For events with event_attribution and no direct touch_id, inherit touch from the attributed child: - Remove "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the child event id by first looking for relationships.attributed-event.data.id, else attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty values as NULL. - Join back to the events set on source_relation and the extracted child event_id to obtain the child''s touch_id and touch_type. - Set last_touch_id and session_touch_type to the child''s values when found; otherwise use the event’s direct touch_id and touch_type. - Derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day (date type). - For each person, prev_event_at is the timestamp of the immediately prior event ordered by occurred_at; when none exists it is NULL; ties on identical timestamps follow engine-defined order. - Session features: - inter_event_minutes is the rounded difference in minutes between prev_event_at and occurred_at; NULL when prev_event_at is NULL. - session_seq is a running count per person that starts at 1 and increases by 1 when prev_event_at is NULL or the gap between events exceeds 30 minutes. - Join dimensions with LEFT JOINs scoped by source_relation: - Campaign: only when the effective touch type (session_touch_type if present else touch_type) is ''campaign''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Flow: only when the effective touch type is ''flow''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Person: join on person_id. - Metric: join on metric_id. - If a key is not applicable or no match is found, the related dimension fields are NULL. - Derived flags and normalized revenue: - is_engagement_event = 1 when type is one of {''active on site'',''viewed product'',''opened email'',''clicked email'',''received email''} ignoring case; else 0. - amount_positive = numeric_value when type is ''placed order'' or ''ordered product'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0. - amount_negative = numeric_value when type is ''refunded order'' or ''cancelled order'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used to scope joins and grain
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier unique within source_relation; one output row per (source_relation, event_id)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier for the event; used for window partitioning and person dimension join
      - name: metric_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric identifier for the event; used to join metric dimension fields
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event type; used to derive flags via case-insensitive matching to specific values
      - name: UUID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event UUID when provided; may be NULL
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variant or variation identifier when present; may be NULL
      - name: numeric_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric amount parsed from event properties; used for revenue normalization; may be NULL
      - name: event_attribution
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Raw JSON attribution string used to inherit touch from an attributed child; may be NULL
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp; used for date derivation, window lag, and session segmentation
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date derived from occurred_at by truncating to the day; NULL only if occurred_at is NULL
      - name: touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Direct touch identifier from the event: campaign_id if present else flow_id; NULL if neither exists'
      - name: touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Direct touch type: ''campaign'' if campaign_id is present, ''flow'' if flow_id is present; NULL if neither'
      - name: last_touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Resolved touch identifier: inherited from the attributed child when available, otherwise the direct touch_id; may be NULL'
      - name: session_touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Resolved touch type: inherited from the attributed child when available, otherwise the direct touch_type; ''campaign''/''flow'' or NULL'
      - name: prev_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Previous occurred_at for the same person ordered by occurred_at; NULL for the first event; ties follow engine-defined order
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign id when the effective touch type is 'campaign' (equals last_touch_id if present else touch_id), otherwise NULL
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow id when the effective touch type is 'flow' (equals last_touch_id if present else touch_id), otherwise NULL
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from campaign dimension joined on the resolved campaign id; NULL if not applicable or no match
      - name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type from campaign dimension joined on the resolved campaign id; NULL if not applicable or no match
      - name: campaign_subject_line
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign subject line from campaign dimension joined on the resolved campaign id; NULL if not applicable or no match
      - name: flow_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow name from flow dimension joined on the resolved flow id; NULL if not applicable or no match
      - name: person_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from person dimension joined on person_id; NULL if no person match
      - name: person_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from person dimension joined on person_id; NULL if no person match
      - name: person_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from person dimension joined on person_id; NULL if no person match
      - name: person_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from person dimension joined on person_id; NULL if no person match
      - name: person_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timezone from person dimension joined on person_id; NULL if no person match
      - name: integration_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Integration id from metric dimension joined on metric_id; NULL if no metric match
      - name: integration_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Integration name from metric dimension joined on metric_id; NULL if no metric match
      - name: integration_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Integration category from metric dimension joined on metric_id; NULL if no metric match
      - name: inter_event_minutes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rounded difference in minutes between prev_event_at and occurred_at; NULL when prev_event_at is NULL
      - name: session_seq
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running session counter per person ordered by occurred_at; starts at 1 and increments when the gap exceeds 30 minutes; ties follow engine-defined order
      - name: is_engagement_event
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag: 1 if type is one of {''active on site'',''viewed product'',''opened email'',''clicked email'',''received email''} ignoring case, else 0'
      - name: amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Non-negative amount for ''placed order'' or ''ordered product'': numeric_value when present and ≥ 0, otherwise 0'
      - name: amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Non-negative amount for ''refunded order'' or ''cancelled order'': numeric_value when present and ≥ 0, otherwise 0'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__flows_enriched
      description: Flow dimension enriched with flow-attributed engagement counts, GMV, and rates derived from events.
      grain: One row per flow_id per source_relation per variation_id (variation_id is NULL when no metrics).
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__flow
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Load all flows from staging.stg_klaviyo__flow. - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, assign a touch_id using campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' when campaign_id exists, otherwise ''flow'' when flow_id exists. - Identify child events lacking a touch_id but having event_attribution; remove dollar signs from event_attribution; parse the JSON to extract the attributed event id from either relationships.attributed-event.data.id or attributed_event_id; strip quotes and treat empty strings as NULL. - Build a lookup from event_id to (touch_id, touch_type, source_relation) using all events. - For each event, resolve the flow attribution: - If an attributed parent event is found, inherit its touch_id and touch_type; otherwise use the event’s own touch_id and touch_type. - Keep last_touch_flow_id only when the resulting touch_type is ''flow''; otherwise there is no flow attribution. - Retain person_id, variation_id, source_relation, event type, and numeric_value. - Keep only events with a non-null last_touch_flow_id and group by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id), variation_id, and source_relation. - For each group: - total_count_unique_people: distinct count of person_id (NULL values are ignored). - count_* metrics: number of events where the lowercase event type exactly matches the phrase (''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''refunded order''); NULL types do not match. - gmv_gross: sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - gmv_net: gmv_gross minus the sum of numeric_value for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - email_open_rate: opened divided by received as a floating-point ratio; NULL when received equals 0. - email_click_to_open_rate: clicked divided by opened as a floating-point ratio; NULL when opened equals 0. - Left join these metrics to flows on flow_id and source_relation so all flows are retained; when a flow has no attributed events, all metrics (including variation_id) are NULL. - Compute flow_variation_key as the MD5 hash of flow_id, a pipe character "|", and variation_id (use an empty string when variation_id is NULL). All steps are performed independently within each source_relation.'
      columns:

        description: Indicates whether the flow is archived.
      - name: trigger_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: The flow's trigger type.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier that scopes joins and metrics.
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow variation identifier from metrics grouping; NULL when no attributed events.
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of people with events attributed to the flow; NULL person_id values are ignored.
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'received email'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'opened email'; NULL types do not count.

        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'clicked email'; NULL types do not count.

        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'placed order'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'ordered product'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'refunded order'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for 'placed order' and 'ordered product' events; missing amounts are treated as 0.
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: GMV gross minus the sum of numeric_value for 'refunded order' and 'cancelled order'; missing amounts are treated as 0.
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened divided by received as a floating-point ratio; NULL when received equals 0.
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicked divided by opened as a floating-point ratio; NULL when opened equals 0.
      - name: flow_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of flow_id, a pipe '|', and variation_id (empty string when NULL) for a deterministic flow+variation key.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      description: Person-level campaign/flow touch metrics resolved via event_attribution; aggregated per person/touch/variation/source_relation
      grain: One row per person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and process within each source_relation. - Derive each event’s direct touch: - Use campaign_id as touch_id when present; otherwise use flow_id. - touch_type is "campaign" when campaign_id is present, else "flow" when flow_id is present; if both are present, treat it as "campaign". - For events where event_attribution is present and no direct touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution; parse as JSON to extract the attributed event id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id, falling back to attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes; treat an empty string as null. - Within the same source_relation, find the event with that id and take its touch_id and touch_type as inherited. - Resolve per-event touch: - Use the inherited touch_id and touch_type when available; otherwise use the direct values. - last_touch_campaign_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise null. - last_touch_flow_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "flow"; otherwise null. - Aggregate by person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation: - first_event_at is the earliest occurred_at; last_event_at is the latest; null timestamps are ignored, and if all are null the result is null. - Revenue metrics: for each listed event type, sum numeric_value for matching events, treating missing numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive; the numeric_value sign is preserved. - Engagement metrics: for each listed event type, count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive; non-matching or null types contribute 0. - Output one row per group with resolved touch identifiers, timestamps, revenue sums, and counts.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique person identifier used for grouping
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign touch identifier when the resolved touch type is campaign; otherwise NULL; for direct events, campaign overrides flow if both exist
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow touch identifier when the resolved touch type is flow; otherwise NULL
      - name: variation_id

        description: Latest occurred_at in the group; NULL if all timestamps are NULL
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order

        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'refunded order' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order

references.name: staging.stg_klaviyo__event
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and process within each source_relation. - Derive each event’s direct touch: - Use campaign_id as touch_id when present; otherwise use flow_id. - touch_type is "campaign" when campaign_id is present, else "flow" when flow_id is present; if both are present, treat it as "campaign". - For events where event_attribution is present and no direct touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution; parse as JSON to extract the attributed event id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id, falling back to attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes; treat an empty string as null. - Within the same source_relation, find the event with that id and take its touch_id and touch_type as inherited. - Resolve per-event touch: - Use the inherited touch_id and touch_type when available; otherwise use the direct values. - last_touch_campaign_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise null. - last_touch_flow_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "flow"; otherwise null. - Aggregate by person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation: - first_event_at is the earliest occurred_at; last_event_at is the latest; null timestamps are ignored, and if all are null the result is null. - Revenue metrics: for each listed event type, sum numeric_value for matching events, treating missing numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive; the numeric_value sign is preserved. - Engagement metrics: for each listed event type, count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive; non-matching or null types contribute 0. - Output one row per group with resolved touch identifiers, timestamps, revenue sums, and counts.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__person_metrics
      description: Per-person metrics from Klaviyo events including activity windows, continuity diagnostics, event counts, revenue sums, and conversion rates
      grain: One row per person_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Inputs: person_id, source_relation, occurred_at (timestamp), type (event name), numeric_value. - Event normalization: - occurred_on is the calendar date of occurred_at (time removed). If occurred_at is NULL, occurred_on is NULL. - Event type matching is case-insensitive exact string comparison; spacing and punctuation are not altered. - Activity span per person_id + source_relation: - first_event_on is the earliest occurred_on date; last_event_on is the latest. Both are NULL when all occurred_on are NULL. - Date spine and continuity: - Build an inclusive list of every calendar day from first_event_on through last_event_on for each person_id + source_relation. - missing_day_count equals the number of spine days that have no events on that exact date; multiple events on a day do not change this count; set to NULL when the span is undefined. - Aggregations per person_id + source_relation: - Revenue sums: For the listed revenue types, sum numeric_value; treat NULL numeric_value as 0; retain negative values. - Event counts: Count every event whose type matches the listed name; events with NULL type do not match. - Active periods: Count distinct calendar days, distinct Monday-based calendar weeks, and distinct calendar months with at least one event; NULL dates are ignored. - Conversion rates: - Divide the specified numerator by its denominator; return NULL when the denominator is zero; computed with floating-point division and not rounded. - Output includes one row for each (person_id, source_relation) present in the events.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      description: Persons from the person table left-joined with per-person, per-source_relation event metrics aggregated from staging events.
      grain: One row per person_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__person (all columns)
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event (person_id, source_relation, occurred_at, type, numeric_value)
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_klaviyo__person; this defines the output grain (one row per person_id and source_relation). - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, project person_id, source_relation, occurred_on as the calendar date of occurred_at (day-level truncation, no timezone conversion), type, and numeric_value. - Aggregate events by (person_id, source_relation): - first_event_on = minimum occurred_on; last_event_on = maximum occurred_on. - Revenue sums: for each target type (''refunded order'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''cancelled order''), sum numeric_value for matching events; treat null numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - Event counts: for each target type (''active on site'', ''viewed product'', ''ordered product'', ''placed order'', ''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email''), count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - email_open_rate = count_opened_email divided by count_received_email when count_received_email > 0; otherwise null; no rounding. - Join: left join the aggregated metrics to the person rows on person_id and source_relation; retain all person columns and add metric fields. - Null policy: - If a person_id/source_relation has no matching events, all metric fields (dates, sums, counts, rate) are null from the left join. - If events exist but none match a specific metric’s type, that metric’s sum or count is 0. - Determinism: - Each event contributes to at most one of the listed revenue sums and to at most one of the listed count metrics based on its type. - Events with null type do not match any target type; duplicates in events are included as-is. - Revenue sums include only numeric_value from matching events; null numeric_value contributes 0.'
