        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier from the person table.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ADDRESS_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 1 from the person table.
      - name: ADDRESS_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 2 from the person table.

        description: City from the person table.

        description: Postal code from the person table.

        description: Timestamp the person record was created in the source.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address from the person table.
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from the person table.
      - name: LATITUDE
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latitude from the person table.
      - name: LONGITUDE
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Longitude from the person table.
      - name: ORGANIZATION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization from the person table.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number from the person table.
      - name: REGION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from the person table.
      - name: timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timezone from the person table.
      - name: TITLE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Title from the person table.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the person record was last updated in the source.
      - name: LAST_EVENT_DATE
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent event timestamp stored on the person record in the source.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source system identifier from the person table.
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest occurred_on date across that person and source_relation; null when no events.
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest occurred_on date across that person and source_relation; null when no events.
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'refunded order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'placed order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'ordered product'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'cancelled order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'active on site' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_viewed_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'viewed product' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'ordered product' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'placed order' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'received email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'opened email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'clicked email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened-to-received email ratio when received > 0; otherwise null; no rounding.

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__campaigns
      description: Campaign analysis with enriched attributes joined to campaign-attributed event aggregates and derived rates
      grain: One row per campaign_id per variation_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched (c) as the base, one row per campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation. - From intermediate.int_klaviyo__events (e), keep only events with a non-null last_touch_campaign_id (campaign-attributed). - For each (campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation), compute: - active_days: number of distinct occurred_on values (no date truncation). - total_placed_orders: count of events where type equals "placed order" (case-insensitive). - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - product_view_to_order_rate_campaign: if there is at least one event where type equals "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the number of "ordered product" events by the number of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_campaign: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Left join these aggregates to c on campaign_id, variation_id, and source_relation; select all c columns plus the aggregate fields. - When no events match a given c row, all aggregate fields are null. Event counts are row-level (no de-duplication) except active_days, which is distinct on occurred_on. Event type comparisons are case-insensitive.'
      columns:
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier; join key to aggregates
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type label from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign created timestamp as stored in the enriched campaigns model (no transformation)
      - name: EMAIL_TEMPLATE_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email template identifier from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: from_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender email address from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: FROM_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender display name from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: scheduled_to_send_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled send timestamp from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: SENT_AT
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Actual send timestamp from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: STATUS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign status label from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: STATUS_ID
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric status identifier from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: SUBJECT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email subject line from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: is_archived
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive flag as stored in the enriched campaigns model (no normalization)
      - name: scheduled_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Scheduling timestamp as stored in the enriched campaigns model (no transformation)
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier; part of the grain and join key
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier; part of the grain and join key
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct people attributed count from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total received email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total opened email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicked email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total placed order events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total ordered product events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total refunded order events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross GMV from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net GMV from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened-to-received email rate from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicked-to-opened email rate from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: campaign_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stable key for campaign_id+variation_id+source_relation provided by the enriched campaigns model
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct occurred_on values among campaign-attributed events; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_placed_orders
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'placed order' (case-insensitive); counts all matching rows; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_positive with nulls treated as 0 within the sum; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_negative with nulls treated as 0 within the sum; NULL when no events joined
      - name: product_view_to_order_rate_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Number of 'ordered product' events divided by 'viewed product' events (case-insensitive); NULL when there are zero 'viewed product' events; no rounding
      - name: gmv_net_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Net GMV from aggregates: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative (null amounts treated as 0 within sums); NULL when no events joined'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched (c) as the base, one row per campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation. - From intermediate.int_klaviyo__events (e), keep only events with a non-null last_touch_campaign_id (campaign-attributed). - For each (campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation), compute: - active_days: number of distinct occurred_on values (no date truncation). - total_placed_orders: count of events where type equals "placed order" (case-insensitive). - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - product_view_to_order_rate_campaign: if there is at least one event where type equals "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the number of "ordered product" events by the number of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_campaign: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Left join these aggregates to c on campaign_id, variation_id, and source_relation; select all c columns plus the aggregate fields. - When no events match a given c row, all aggregate fields are null. Event counts are row-level (no de-duplication) except active_days, which is distinct on occurred_on. Event type comparisons are case-insensitive.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__events
      description: Analysis-ready Klaviyo events with per-event sequencing, net revenue, and per-person daily rollups
      grain: One row per source event from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_klaviyo__events with no filtering or de-duplication; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Per-event enrichments: - event_net_revenue: treat nulls as zero, then amount_positive minus amount_negative. - person_event_seq: 1, 2, ... per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order. - prev_occurred_on: the previous occurred_on date per person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; date_gap_days: whole-day difference between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on. For the first-by-date event per person, both are NULL. Ordering uses date only; multiple events on the same date are not further ordered. - is_attributed: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0. - Per-person daily aggregates (per_day): - Group by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on. - day_opened_email: count events whose type equals "Opened Email" (case-insensitive). - day_clicked_email: count events whose type equals "Clicked Email" (case-insensitive). - day_placed_order: count events whose type equals "Placed Order" (case-insensitive). - day_ordered_product: count events whose type equals "Ordered Product" (case-insensitive). - day_amount_positive: sum amount_positive treating nulls as zero; day_amount_negative: sum amount_negative treating nulls as zero. - Join per-event rows to per-day aggregates by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on using a left join; if any join key is NULL or unmatched, daily fields are NULL. - day_net_revenue: day_amount_positive minus day_amount_negative. - day_click_to_open_rate: day_clicked_email divided by day_opened_email when day_opened_email > 0; otherwise NULL; no rounding. - Daily aggregates are per (person_id, source_relation, occurred_on) and repeat for all events sharing that key; no additional de-duplication is performed.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating source/system identifier; part of the daily aggregate join key
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier from the source; combined with source_relation typically defines a source event record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier used for per-person sequencing and daily grouping
      - name: metric_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric identifier from Klaviyo as provided by the source
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event type; daily counts compare case-insensitively to the phrases Opened Email, Clicked Email, Placed Order, and Ordered Product
      - name: UUID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event UUID when available from the source
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier when present from the source
      - name: numeric_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric value parsed upstream from event properties; passed through unchanged
      - name: event_attribution
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Attribution payload as provided by the source
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp used to order person_event_seq ascending
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Event calendar date used for daily grouping and date-based lag/gap calculations
      - name: touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct touch identifier from the source event
      - name: touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct touch type from the source (e.g., campaign or flow)
      - name: last_touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved touch identifier from the source (direct or inherited)
      - name: session_touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Session-resolved touch type; used with touch_type to set is_attributed
      - name: prev_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Upstream previous event timestamp for the person when provided
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign id for campaign-attributed events from the source
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow id for flow-attributed events from the source
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type label from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: campaign_subject_line
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign subject line from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: flow_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow name from upstream flow metadata
      - name: person_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person city from the source profile data
      - name: person_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person country from the source profile data
      - name: person_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person region from the source profile data
      - name: person_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person email address from the source profile data
      - name: person_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person timezone from the source profile data
      - name: integration_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration identifier from the source metric metadata
      - name: integration_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration name from the source metric metadata
      - name: integration_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration category from the source metric metadata
      - name: inter_event_minutes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Minutes between the previous and current event for the person as provided by the source
      - name: session_seq
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Monotonic session sequence per person as provided by the source
      - name: is_engagement_event
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Upstream flag for engagement-type events; passed through unchanged
      - name: amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Positive revenue amount from the source; downstream treats NULL as 0
      - name: amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Refund/cancellation amount from the source; downstream treats NULL as 0
      - name: event_net_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Per-event net revenue: amount_positive (NULL as 0) minus amount_negative (NULL as 0)'
      - name: person_event_seq
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order
      - name: prev_occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Previous event date for the person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; NULL for the first-by-date event
      - name: date_gap_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Difference in days between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on; NULL when prev_occurred_on is NULL
      - name: is_attributed
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_klaviyo__events with no filtering or de-duplication; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Per-event enrichments: - event_net_revenue: treat nulls as zero, then amount_positive minus amount_negative. - person_event_seq: 1, 2, ... per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order. - prev_occurred_on: the previous occurred_on date per person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; date_gap_days: whole-day difference between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on. For the first-by-date event per person, both are NULL. Ordering uses date only; multiple events on the same date are not further ordered. - is_attributed: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0. - Per-person daily aggregates (per_day): - Group by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on. - day_opened_email: count events whose type equals "Opened Email" (case-insensitive). - day_clicked_email: count events whose type equals "Clicked Email" (case-insensitive). - day_placed_order: count events whose type equals "Placed Order" (case-insensitive). - day_ordered_product: count events whose type equals "Ordered Product" (case-insensitive). - day_amount_positive: sum amount_positive treating nulls as zero; day_amount_negative: sum amount_negative treating nulls as zero. - Join per-event rows to per-day aggregates by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on using a left join; if any join key is NULL or unmatched, daily fields are NULL. - day_net_revenue: day_amount_positive minus day_amount_negative. - day_click_to_open_rate: day_clicked_email divided by day_opened_email when day_opened_email > 0; otherwise NULL; no rounding. - Daily aggregates are per (person_id, source_relation, occurred_on) and repeat for all events sharing that key; no additional de-duplication is performed.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__flows
      description: Flow-level dataset joining enriched flow attributes with flow-attributed event aggregates to expose activity, revenue, and rates per flow_id+variation_id+source_relation
      grain: One row per flow_id per variation_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Base rows: take all records from intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched; each row is keyed by (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation) and is preserved even if there are no matching events. - Event filter: use only events that have a non-null last_touch_flow_id (i.e., events attributed to a flow). - Grouping: aggregate events by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id, variation_id, source_relation); no other deduplication is applied. - Aggregations per group: - active_days: count distinct occurred_on values exactly as stored (no date truncation); null occurred_on values do not contribute. - total_placed_orders: count of events whose type equals "placed order" using a case-insensitive comparison; other events do not contribute. - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - product_view_to_order_rate_flow: if there is at least one event of type "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the count of "ordered product" events by the count of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_flow: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Join: left join the aggregates to the base on exact equality of (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation). - Null policy: - If no events match a base row, all aggregate fields are null. - If a group exists but a specific metric has no qualifying events, that metric is 0 for counts and sums; the rate is null when its denominator is 0. - Types/units: division produces a double; sums are in the same currency units as the source; no rounding or formatting is applied.'

references.name: intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Base rows: take all records from intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched; each row is keyed by (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation) and is preserved even if there are no matching events. - Event filter: use only events that have a non-null last_touch_flow_id (i.e., events attributed to a flow). - Grouping: aggregate events by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id, variation_id, source_relation); no other deduplication is applied. - Aggregations per group: - active_days: count distinct occurred_on values exactly as stored (no date truncation); null occurred_on values do not contribute. - total_placed_orders: count of events whose type equals "placed order" using a case-insensitive comparison; other events do not contribute. - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - product_view_to_order_rate_flow: if there is at least one event of type "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the count of "ordered product" events by the count of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_flow: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Join: left join the aggregates to the base on exact equality of (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation). - Null policy: - If no events match a base row, all aggregate fields are null. - If a group exists but a specific metric has no qualifying events, that metric is 0 for counts and sums; the rate is null when its denominator is 0. - Types/units: division produces a double; sums are in the same currency units as the source; no rounding or formatting is applied.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      description: Person by campaign/flow touch dataset with span days, conversion rates, net revenue, and a conversion flag.
      grain: One row per person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow and retain all columns without filtering or re-aggregation. - Compute touch_span_days: if first_event_at and last_event_at are present, truncate both to calendar day, take the day difference, and add 1 so same-day spans equal 1; otherwise set NULL. - Compute rates only when denominators are greater than zero; otherwise set NULL: - product_view_to_order_rate_touch: ordered product count divided by viewed product count. - email_open_rate_touch: opened email count divided by received email count. - email_click_to_open_rate_touch: clicked email count divided by opened email count. Use floating-point division, no rounding or capping; if the numerator is NULL the result is NULL. - Compute net_revenue_touch as placed order revenue plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled order revenue; treat NULL inputs as zero. - Compute has_converted as 1 when count_placed_order > 0, else 0; NULL counts are treated as not greater than zero.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier for the touch grouping.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier for the last attributed touch; may be NULL.
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow identifier for the last attributed touch; may be NULL.
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier for the attributed touch when available.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin data source relation name.
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First event timestamp in the touch window from the source.
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last event timestamp in the touch window from the source.
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total refunded order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total placed order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total ordered product revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_checkout_started
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total checkout-started revenue from the source.
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total cancelled order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active-on-site events from the source.
      - name: count_viewed_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of viewed product events; denominator for the view-to-order rate.
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of ordered product events; numerator for the view-to-order rate.
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of placed order events used to set the conversion flag.
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of refunded order events from the source.
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of received email events; denominator for the email open rate.
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of clicked email events; numerator for the click-to-open rate.
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of opened email events; numerator for open rate and denominator for click-to-open.
      - name: count_marked_email_as_spam
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of emails marked as spam; passthrough.
      - name: count_unsubscribed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email unsubscribe events; passthrough.
      - name: count_received_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of received SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_clicked_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of clicked SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_sent_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of sent SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_unsubscribed_from_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of SMS unsubscribe events; passthrough.
      - name: touch_span_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive number of calendar days between first_event_at and last_event_at after truncating to day; NULL if either is NULL.
      - name: product_view_to_order_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of viewed-product events that led to an ordered product when views > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: email_open_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of received emails that were opened when received > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of opened emails that were clicked when opens > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: net_revenue_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Placed plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled revenue; NULL inputs treated as zero.
      - name: has_converted
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when count_placed_order > 0 else 0; NULL counts behave as not greater than zero.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow and retain all columns without filtering or re-aggregation. - Compute touch_span_days: if first_event_at and last_event_at are present, truncate both to calendar day, take the day difference, and add 1 so same-day spans equal 1; otherwise set NULL. - Compute rates only when denominators are greater than zero; otherwise set NULL: - product_view_to_order_rate_touch: ordered product count divided by viewed product count. - email_open_rate_touch: opened email count divided by received email count. - email_click_to_open_rate_touch: clicked email count divided by opened email count. Use floating-point division, no rounding or capping; if the numerator is NULL the result is NULL. - Compute net_revenue_touch as placed order revenue plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled order revenue; treat NULL inputs as zero. - Compute has_converted as 1 when count_placed_order > 0, else 0; NULL counts are treated as not greater than zero.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__persons
      description: Enriched person profile joined with activity spans, retention flags/rates, and paid retention by month
      grain: One row per (person_id, source_relation) present in intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched (p) and retain all columns unchanged. - Left join intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics (pm) on (person_id, source_relation) to add first_event_on, last_event_on, active_days, active_weeks, active_months, and missing_day_count; these fields are NULL when no pm row exists. - Derive paid_months from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events by filtering to events whose type text equals "placed order" ignoring case; for each (person_id, source_relation), count the number of distinct calendar months with at least one such event as paid_retained_month_count. - Left join paid_months on (person_id, source_relation); when missing, set paid_retained_month_count to 0. - Compute inclusive activity spans from pm dates: - days_span: number of calendar days from first_event_on through last_event_on, inclusive; NULL if either date is NULL. - weeks_span: number of calendar weeks spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - months_span: number of calendar months spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - Retention rates (floating-point division, no rounding): - active_retention_rate_day: active_days divided by days_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_week: active_weeks divided by weeks_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_month: active_months divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - Retention flags: - has_7day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 7 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - has_30day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 30 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - Paid retention rate: - paid_retention_rate_month: paid_retained_month_count divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL (uses the 0 default when the paid month count is missing). - All rows from p are preserved; no additional filtering or deduplication beyond the left joins.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched (p) and retain all columns unchanged. - Left join intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics (pm) on (person_id, source_relation) to add first_event_on, last_event_on, active_days, active_weeks, active_months, and missing_day_count; these fields are NULL when no pm row exists. - Derive paid_months from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events by filtering to events whose type text equals "placed order" ignoring case; for each (person_id, source_relation), count the number of distinct calendar months with at least one such event as paid_retained_month_count. - Left join paid_months on (person_id, source_relation); when missing, set paid_retained_month_count to 0. - Compute inclusive activity spans from pm dates: - days_span: number of calendar days from first_event_on through last_event_on, inclusive; NULL if either date is NULL. - weeks_span: number of calendar weeks spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - months_span: number of calendar months spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - Retention rates (floating-point division, no rounding): - active_retention_rate_day: active_days divided by days_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_week: active_weeks divided by weeks_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_month: active_months divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - Retention flags: - has_7day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 7 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - has_30day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 30 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - Paid retention rate: - paid_retention_rate_month: paid_retained_month_count divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL (uses the 0 default when the paid month count is missing). - All rows from p are preserved; no additional filtering or deduplication beyond the left joins.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_recharge__calendar_spine
      description: Daily date spine from the earliest subscription creation to the latest available cancellation/update/creation date, inclusive.
      grain: One row per calendar day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_recharge__subscription
      business_logic: '- Determine first_date as the earliest subscription_created_at across all subscriptions. - For each subscription row, select the available date in this priority: cancellation date, then update date, otherwise creation date; then take the latest of those across all rows as last_date. - Convert first_date and last_date to DATE by dropping any time component; no timezone adjustments are applied. - Produce a closed, continuous daily sequence from first_date through last_date with a 1-day step. - Emit one row per day with date_day equal to the sequence value; dates are unique and non-null. - If either bound is missing (e.g., no input rows), no rows are produced. - No explicit ordering is applied in the final output; consumers should not rely on row order.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date for each day in the inclusive spine; bounds are cast to DATE (time truncated); unique per day; no explicit ordering.
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_recharge__customer_daily_rollup
      description: Customer-by-day scaffold built from the calendar spine and customers; rows span from each customer's creation date through the last calendar day; week/month/year dates are derived from date_day with weeks starting Monday.
      grain: One row per customer_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_recharge__calendar_spine (uses date_day)
      - staging.stg_recharge__customer (uses customer_id, customer_created_at)
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Calendar spine providing all candidate days (date_day). - Customers with customer_id and customer_created_at. - For each customer, combine with every calendar day and keep only those days on or after the customer''s creation date, comparing at day precision (time ignored). - Customers with a NULL creation timestamp produce no rows. - Calendar records with NULL date_day produce no rows. - Derive additional dates from date_day: - date_week: Monday of the week containing date_day (ISO week start). - date_month: First day of the month containing date_day. - date_year: First day of the year containing date_day. - No ordering or deduplication is applied; duplicates from source tables propagate. - Output covers all qualifying dates up to the maximum date_day present in the calendar spine.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customer identifier; present only for customers with a non-NULL creation timestamp.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day included for each date on or after the customer's creation date, comparing at day precision.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Monday of the week for date_day.
      - name: date_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month for date_day.
      - name: date_year
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the year for date_day.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_recharge__customer_details
      description: Customer attributes with per-charge item and amount aggregates, distinct charge count, and active subscription count.
      grain: One row per customer_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_recharge__customer
      - staging.stg_recharge__order_line_item
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge
      - staging.stg_recharge__subscription
      business_logic: '- Base customers: include all customers with customer_id, created/updated timestamps, hash, email, and shopify_customer_id; customers with no charges or subscriptions are kept. - Per-charge totals: - For each charge_id, sum item quantities across its line items; treat missing quantities as zero. - For each charge_id, compute the extended price (price × quantity) per line item with missing values treated as zero, sum across lines, then round the charge-level total to two decimal places. - Charges: use charge_id and customer_id from the charges table (processed_at is not used). - Join: left join charges to per-charge totals on charge_id so charges without line items are retained and their per-charge totals are null. - Customer-level order aggregates over the joined charges: - total_orders: count of charge rows per customer. - total_amount_ordered: sum of per-charge totals; treat missing totals as zero; round to two decimals. - avg_order_amount: average of per-charge totals; treat missing totals as zero; round to two decimals. - total_quantity_ordered: sum of per-charge quantities; treat missing quantities as zero. - avg_item_quantity_per_order: average of per-charge quantities; treat missing quantities as zero; round to two decimals. - total_order_line_item_total: same computation as total_amount_ordered; round to two decimals. - avg_order_line_item_total: same computation as avg_order_amount; round to two decimals. - Distinct charges: per customer, count distinct charge_id from the charges table. - Active subscriptions: per customer, count subscriptions where the status, normalized to lowercase and with null treated as empty, equals “active”. - Final output: left join all aggregates to customers; when aggregates are missing, return zero. Set total_amount_charged, avg_amount_charged, total_amount_taxed, total_amount_discounted, and total_refunds to constant 0.0.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique customer identifier and grain key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the customer was created.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the most recent customer update.
      - name: customer_hash
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source-provided customer hash.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email as stored; casing and whitespace are preserved.
      - name: shopify_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Shopify customer identifier.
      - name: total_orders
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of charges associated with the customer; zero when none.
        tests:
        - total_orders >= 0
      - name: total_amount_ordered
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of per-charge order totals built from price×quantity per line; charge-level totals are rounded to two decimals, the final sum is rounded to two decimals; missing values treated as zero.
        tests:
        - total_amount_ordered >= 0
      - name: avg_order_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-charge order totals with missing values treated as zero; rounded to two decimals; zero when none.
        tests:
        - avg_order_amount >= 0
      - name: total_quantity_ordered
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of item quantities across all charges with missing quantities treated as zero; zero when none.
        tests:
        - total_quantity_ordered >= 0
      - name: avg_item_quantity_per_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per-charge item quantity with missing quantities treated as zero; rounded to two decimals; zero when none.
        tests:
        - avg_item_quantity_per_order >= 0
      - name: total_order_line_item_total
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of per-charge rounded line item totals; equals total_amount_ordered under this logic; rounded to two decimals; zero when none.
        tests:
        - total_order_line_item_total >= 0
      - name: avg_order_line_item_total
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-charge rounded line item totals; equals avg_order_amount; rounded to two decimals; zero when none.
        tests:
        - avg_order_line_item_total >= 0
      - name: charges_count

        tests:

blocks.original_text:
- name: recharge__billing_history
      description: Order-level billing totals per order with item and shipping aggregates by the order’s charge, plus charge timestamps and status; total price equals items plus shipping; refunds fixed at 0.0.
      grain: One row per order_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_recharge__order
      - staging.stg_recharge__order_line_item
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge_shipping_line
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge
      business_logic: '- Start with all orders: one row per order_id including customer_id, charge_id, and order_processed_at. - Aggregate line items per charge_id: - Sum quantities across all line items; treat NULL quantities as zero. - Sum price multiplied by quantity across all line items; treat NULL prices/quantities as zero; round the final sum to two decimals. - One aggregate row per charge_id; if a charge_id has no line items, no aggregate row is produced. - Aggregate shipping per charge_id: - Sum shipping line prices; treat NULL prices as zero; round the final sum to two decimals. - One aggregate row per charge_id; if a charge_id has no shipping lines, no aggregate row is produced. - Charge attributes per charge_id: - Bring in processed_at as charge_created_at and charge_status; if no charge record exists, these are NULL. - Join: - Left join the line-item aggregates, shipping aggregates, and charge attributes to orders on charge_id. - All orders are retained; when a charge_id has no matching aggregate or charge, the joined fields are NULL. - No de-duplication beyond grouping by charge_id; every source row contributes to its respective sums. - Derived totals: - calculated_order_total_price = item total plus shipping; treat NULL item totals or NULL shipping as zero before summing; round to two decimals; always populated. - calculated_order_total_refunds = 0.0 for all rows.'
      columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique order identifier; one output row per order_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customer identifier from the order; not replaced by any charge-level customer.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: charge_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Associated charge identifier used to aggregate line items and shipping.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: order_processed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Order processed timestamp from the orders source.
      - name: charge_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Charge processed timestamp; NULL when no matching charge.
      - name: charge_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Charge status; NULL when no matching charge.
      - name: total_shipping
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of shipping line prices per charge_id, rounded to two decimals; NULL when no shipping lines.
      - name: order_item_quantity
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of line item quantities per charge_id; NULL when no line items.
      - name: order_line_item_total
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of line item price times quantity per charge_id, rounded to two decimals; NULL when no line items.
      - name: calculated_order_total_price
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Item total plus shipping with NULLs treated as zero, rounded to two decimals; always populated.
      - name: calculated_order_total_refunds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Fixed at 0.0 for all rows.

blocks.original_text:
- name: recharge__charge_line_item_history
      description: Union of line items, shipping, and tax components per charge with header fields and sequence numbers ordered by component type.
      grain: One row per charge_id + component line record
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge_line_item
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge_shipping_line
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge_tax_line
      business_logic: '- Build three component datasets: - Line items: take charge_id, convert price to a double-precision amount, use product_title as item_title, and set line_item_type to "charge line". - Shipping lines: take charge_id, convert price to a double-precision amount, use title as item_title, and set line_item_type to "shipping". - Tax lines: take charge_id, convert price to a double-precision amount, use title as item_title, and set line_item_type to "tax". - Append (stack) the three datasets; preserve duplicates and NULLs. - For each stacked row, match to the charge header on charge_id to add: - processed_at as charge_created_at, customer_id, and address_id; if no header matches, these fields are NULL. - Within each charge_id, assign a 1-based sequence number ordered only by line_item_type in alphabetical order ("charge line" then "shipping" then "tax"); when multiple rows share the same type, their relative order is unspecified. - Output one row per component with: charge_id, charge_row_num, charge_created_at, customer_id, address_id, amount, item_title, line_item_type. Text values are passed through as-is; amounts retain original sign and are not rounded.'
      columns:
      - name: charge_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Charge identifier for the component; groups rows for sequencing.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: charge_row_num
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based sequence within each charge_id ordered by line_item_type; ties within the same type have arbitrary order.
        tests:
        - charge_row_num >= 1
        - not_null
      - name: charge_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: processed_at from the charge header matched by charge_id; NULL if no header match.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customer identifier from the charge header; NULL if no header match.
      - name: address_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Address identifier from the charge header; NULL if no header match.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Component amount converted from source price to double; NULL if price is NULL; sign unchanged.
      - name: item_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Component title: product_title for line items or title for shipping/tax; may be NULL.'
      - name: line_item_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Component type indicating source: ''charge line'', ''shipping'', or ''tax''; non-NULL and used for sequencing.'
        tests:
        - not_null

      business_logic: '- Start from the dense customer-date scaffold (customer_id, date_day). - Left join billing history on matching customer_id and where the calendar date of order_processed_at equals date_day. - For each customer_id + date_day: - date_week: the Monday of the week containing date_day. - date_month: the first day of the calendar month containing date_day. - date_year: the first day of the calendar year containing date_day. - Aggregate across all joined billing rows (no de-duplication): - no_of_orders: count of rows with a non-null order_id; returns 0 when there are no joined rows. - calculated_order_total_price_realized: sum of calculated_order_total_price with nulls treated as 0, rounded to 2 decimal places; returns 0.00 when there are no joined rows. - order_line_item_total_realized: sum of order_line_item_total with nulls treated as 0, rounded to 2 decimal places; returns 0.00 when there are no joined rows. - order_item_quantity_realized: sum of order_item_quantity with nulls treated as 0; returns 0 when there are no joined rows. - Output one row per customer_id + date_day from the spine.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customer identifier paired with date_day to define the grain.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine; used to join to billing by the date of order_processed_at.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Monday of the week containing date_day.
      - name: date_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar month containing date_day.
      - name: date_year
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar year containing date_day.
      - name: no_of_orders
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of joined billing rows with non-null order_id for the customer-day; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - no_of_orders >= 0
      - name: calculated_order_total_price_realized
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of calculated_order_total_price (nulls as 0) for the customer-day, rounded to 2 decimals; 0.00 when none.
        tests:
        - calculated_order_total_price_realized >= 0
      - name: order_line_item_total_realized
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of order_line_item_total (nulls as 0) for the customer-day, rounded to 2 decimals; 0.00 when none.
        tests:
        - order_line_item_total_realized >= 0
      - name: order_item_quantity_realized
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of order_item_quantity (nulls as 0) for the customer-day; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - order_item_quantity_realized >= 0

- name: recharge__subscription_overview
      description: Subscription-level overview with base attributes plus charge counts, remaining charges until expiration, and normalized charge interval in days
      grain: One row per subscription_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_recharge__subscription
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge_line_item
      - staging.stg_recharge__charge
      business_logic: '- Start with all rows from staging.stg_recharge__subscription; output one row per subscription_id. - From staging.stg_recharge__charge, use charge_id, customer_id, address_id, charge_status, and processed_at as charge_created_at. - From staging.stg_recharge__charge_line_item, link charge_id to subscription_id to associate charges with subscriptions at the line-item level (each line item counts; no deduplication). - Join line items to charges on charge_id to bring charge_status per line item. - For each subscription_id, compute: - count_successful_charges: number of joined line-item rows where charge_status equals "success" (case-insensitive); all other statuses and NULLs are ignored; defaults to 0 when no matches. - count_queued_charges: number of joined line-item rows where charge_status equals "queued" (case-insensitive); all other statuses and NULLs are ignored; defaults to 0 when no matches. - Compute charges_until_expiration: - If subscription_next_charge_scheduled_at is NULL, set to NULL. - Otherwise, remaining = (expire_after_specific_number_of_charges, treating NULL as 0) minus (count_successful_charges, treating NULL as 0). - If remaining is negative, set to NULL; otherwise use remaining. - Compute charge_interval_frequency_days from charge_interval_frequency and order_interval_unit: - If unit is "month" (case-insensitive), multiply frequency by 30. - If unit is "week" (case-insensitive), multiply frequency by 7. - For any other unit or NULL, use the frequency as-is. - Treat NULL frequency as 0 in all cases. - Output all subscription fields plus the derived counts and intervals; left joins ensure subscriptions with no related charges are retained.'
      columns:
      - name: subscription_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique subscription identifier; grouping key with exactly one output row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customer owning the subscription as provided by the subscription source
      - name: address_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Address associated with the subscription as provided by the subscription source
      - name: subscription_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the subscription was created from the source system
      - name: subscription_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the most recent subscription update from the source system
      - name: subscription_cancelled_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Cancellation timestamp if the subscription is cancelled; otherwise NULL
      - name: shopify_product_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Shopify product identifier linked to the subscription
      - name: shopify_variant_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Shopify variant identifier linked to the subscription
      - name: product_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product title associated with the subscription
      - name: variant_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variant title associated with the subscription
      - name: sku
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stock keeping unit for the subscribed item
      - name: price
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Configured subscription price as stored in the source (no transformation applied)
      - name: quantity
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Configured subscription quantity as stored (no transformation applied)
      - name: subscription_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current subscription status as provided by the source
      - name: subscription_next_charge_scheduled_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the next scheduled charge, used to determine whether charges_until_expiration can be computed
      - name: charge_interval_frequency
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Configured charge interval frequency; treated as 0 when NULL for day normalization
      - name: expire_after_specific_number_of_charges
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Maximum allowed number of successful charges before expiration; treated as 0 when NULL in remaining calculation
      - name: order_interval_frequency
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Configured order interval frequency as stored; not used in current derivations
      - name: order_interval_unit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Order interval unit used for day normalization: month→30 days, week→7 days, otherwise treated as days; comparison is case-insensitive'
      - name: order_day_of_week
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Configured order day of week if applicable (as stored)
      - name: order_day_of_month
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Configured order day of month if applicable (as stored)
      - name: external_product_id_ecommerce
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: External ecommerce product identifier associated with the subscription
      - name: external_variant_id_ecommerce
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: External ecommerce variant identifier associated with the subscription
      - name: cancellation_reason
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cancellation reason when present (as stored)
      - name: cancellation_reason_comments
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Additional comments on the cancellation reason when present (as stored)
      - name: count_successful_charges
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of line-item rows linked to the subscription with charge_status equal to 'success' (case-insensitive); other statuses and NULLs ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: count_queued_charges
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of line-item rows linked to the subscription with charge_status equal to 'queued' (case-insensitive); other statuses and NULLs ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: charges_until_expiration
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Remaining successful charges allowed: if no next charge is scheduled or the remaining count is negative then NULL; otherwise the difference between the allowed charges (NULL as 0) and successful charges (NULL as 0)'
      - name: charge_interval_frequency_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Charge interval normalized to days: month→frequency×30, week→frequency×7, otherwise frequency; frequency NULL treated as 0; unit comparison is case-insensitive'

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_recharge__customer
      description: "Cleaned customer entities with validated identifiers and normalized email attributes."
      source_table: raw.customer
      columns:
        - name: customer_id
          data_type: BIGINT
          source_expression: "id"
        - name: email
          data_type: VARCHAR
          source_expression: "lower(trim(email))"
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "email RLIKE '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "LENGTH(email) <= 255"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: shopify_customer_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "shopify_customer_id RLIKE '^[0-9]{7,16}$'"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "LENGTH(shopify_customer_id) BETWEEN 7 AND 16"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: customer_created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          source_expression: "cast(created_at as timestamp)"
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "customer_created_at IS NOT NULL AND customer_created_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "customer_created_at BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59'"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: customer_updated_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          source_expression: "cast(updated_at as timestamp)"
        - name: customer_hash
          data_type: VARCHAR
          source_expression: "hash"
      row_filters:
        - rule: "NOT (case when lower(cast(_fivetran_deleted as varchar)) in ('true','t','1','yes','y') then true when lower(cast(_fivetran_deleted as varchar)) in ('false','f','0','no','n','') then false when try_cast(_fivetran_deleted as double) = 0 then false when try_cast(_fivetran_deleted as double) is not null then true else false end)"
          on_failure: delete_row

- name: social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      description: Standardizes Facebook posts from staging, filters to last two years, and adds content classification, text metrics, date buckets, per-page window features, and engagement rate
      grain: One row per post_id per page_id (source duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_social_media__facebook_posts
      business_logic: '- Source and filters: - Read from staging.stg_social_media__facebook_posts. - Cast page_id and post_id to text. - Require created_timestamp to be non-NULL and within the last two years relative to CURRENT_DATE. - Replace NULLs: post_message and post_url -> empty string; shares and impressions -> 0. - Set likes, comments, and clicks to 0 (not available in source). - Content typing and link flag (evaluated on the lowercased message, matched anywhere in the text): - content_type precedence: link if a URL pattern ("http://" or "https://") is present; else photo if "image" or "photo" is present; else video if "video" is present; else text. - has_link is TRUE when a URL pattern is present, otherwise FALSE. - Text metrics: - text_length_chars is the number of characters in the trimmed message. - text_word_count is 0 if the trimmed message is empty; otherwise count spaces in the trimmed message and add 1; only the space character is treated as a separator, and consecutive spaces each add to the count. - Date buckets from created_timestamp: - day/week/month are the start-of-day, start-of-week (engine default week start), and start-of-month buckets. - Per-page windows: - page_recency_rank is the row number per page_id ordered by created_timestamp descending; 1 is most recent; ties on timestamp are ordered arbitrarily. - rolling_7_post_shares is the sum of shares over the current post and the six immediately prior posts per page_id ordered by created_timestamp; includes the current row and uses the 0 defaults for missing shares. - Final fields: - platform is the literal "facebook". - engagement_rate is 0.0 when impressions are 0; otherwise (likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions; computed as a double and not capped.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Facebook page identifier cast to text; may be NULL; used as the partition key for window functions
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Facebook page name passed through from source; may be NULL
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Facebook post identifier cast to text; duplicates from source are preserved
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post message text with NULLs replaced by empty string; original casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Post creation timestamp required to be non-NULL and within the last two years relative to CURRENT_DATE
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Literal value 'facebook' for all rows
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Clicks set to 0 because not available in source; non-NULL constant
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impressions from source with NULLs replaced by 0; non-NULL; used as the engagement_rate denominator when greater than 0
      - name: likes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Likes set to 0 because not available in source; non-NULL constant
      - name: shares
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Shares from source with NULLs replaced by 0; non-NULL; used in rolling_7_post_shares and engagement_rate
      - name: comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Comments set to 0 because not available in source; non-NULL constant
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post URL with NULLs replaced by empty string; original text preserved
      - name: content_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived label with precedence: link if a URL pattern is present; else photo if ''image'' or ''photo'' is present; else video if ''video'' is present; otherwise text'
      - name: has_link
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when the lowercased message contains a URL pattern ('http://' or 'https://'); otherwise FALSE; non-NULL
      - name: text_length_chars
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Character count of the trimmed message; 0 for empty string; non-NULL
      - name: text_word_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Word count based on spaces in the trimmed message: 0 if empty; else number of spaces plus 1; only the space character is treated as a separator'
      - name: day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start-of-day date bucket derived from created_timestamp
      - name: week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start-of-week date bucket derived from created_timestamp using the engine’s default week start
      - name: month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start-of-month date bucket derived from created_timestamp
      - name: page_recency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per page_id ordered by created_timestamp descending; 1 is most recent; ties are ordered arbitrarily
      - name: rolling_7_post_shares
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of shares over the current and six prior posts per page_id ordered by created_timestamp; includes the current row; shares default to 0
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If impressions are 0 then 0.0; otherwise (likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions; computed as a double and not capped

      description: Standardized LinkedIn organization posts with filters, normalized metrics, derived URL, category, and engagement rate.
      grain: One row per LinkedIn post_id per organization_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_social_media__linkedin_posts
      business_logic: '- Source: staging.stg_social_media__linkedin_posts (fields used: organization_id, post_id, created_timestamp, post_message, content_type). - Row filters: include only rows where organization_id is not null, created_timestamp is not null, and created_timestamp is within the last 4 years from the current date. - Identifiers: page_id equals organization_id; page_name uses organization_id unless its trimmed value is an empty string, in which case page_name is set to null; otherwise whitespace is preserved. - Post identity: post_id is converted to text; platform is the constant ''linkedin''. - Message: post_message is the first non-null of post_title or post_message; if both are null it defaults to ''LinkedIn Post''; post_title is sourced from post_message; casing and whitespace are preserved. - Metrics: clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments set to 0 when null; integers are otherwise preserved (including negatives if present); no scaling or rounding. - URL: post_url is ''https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/'' followed by post_id; if post_id is null then post_url is null. - Category: content_type is mapped exactly (case-sensitive) as follows: ''article''→''Article'', ''share''→''Shared Content'', ''media''→''Media Post'', ''poll''→''Poll''; all other or null values map to ''Text Post''. - Engagement rate: if the source engagement_rate is positive, use it; otherwise, if impressions are greater than 0, compute (clicks + likes + comments + shares) divided by impressions as a floating-point value; else return 0.0; no rounding; zero or negative impressions produce 0.0. - No aggregation or de-duplication; if the source has multiple rows for the same (organization_id, post_id), all are retained; output order is unspecified.'

      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: LinkedIn organization_id copied from source; non-null due to filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Set to organization_id unless its trimmed value is empty, then null; otherwise original whitespace is preserved
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post identifier converted to text; used to build post_url
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant platform label 'linkedin'
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Click count; null becomes 0; negatives (if any) are preserved
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impression count; null becomes 0; negatives are preserved; used as denominator when greater than 0
      - name: likes
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Like count; null becomes 0
      - name: shares
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Share count; null becomes 0
      - name: comments
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Comment count; null becomes 0
      - name: post_url

        description: Built as 'https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/' plus post_id; null if post_id is null
      - name: post_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Mapped from content_type: article→Article, share→Shared Content, media→Media Post, poll→Poll, else Text Post; case-sensitive'
      - name: calculated_engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If source engagement_rate is positive use it; else if impressions > 0 use (clicks+likes+comments+shares)/impressions; otherwise 0.0; double precision with no rounding

- name: social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      description: Standardizes YouTube videos to a unified post-level schema and derives ratios for the last two years of videos
      grain: One row per post_id (video_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_social_media__youtube_videos
      business_logic: '- Source and filter: use staging.stg_social_media__youtube_videos rows where video_id is present and video_published_at is within the last two years. - Mapping: - page_id: channel_id cast to text; nulls remain null. - page_name: channel title; if missing, set to ''Unknown Channel''. - post_id: video_id cast to text (always present due to filter). - created_timestamp: video_published_at (always present due to filter). - platform: constant ''youtube''. - post_message: video_description cast to text; original casing and spacing preserved. - clicks and impressions: both set to the video''s views; views come from the source clicks field; default to 0 when missing. - likes, comments, shares: interactions default to 0 when missing; shares use the source estimated_shares. - post_url: passed through from source; may represent a thumbnail URL; may be null. - privacy_status: passed through. - channel_subscribers and channel_total_videos: default to 0; total_videos is 0 in the current SQL. - calculated_engagement_rate: - Use the provided engagement_rate when it is positive; otherwise, if views > 0, compute (likes + comments + shares) divided by views; else 0.0; no rounding or capping. - Derived ratios: - views_per_subscriber: clicks divided by channel_subscribers when subscribers > 0, else 0.0. - likes_per_view_ratio: likes divided by clicks when clicks > 0, else 0.0. - No aggregation, de-duplication, or ordering; rows mirror the filtered source.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel identifier cast to text; nulls preserved
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel title with fallback to 'Unknown Channel' when missing
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: YouTube video identifier cast to text; non-null due to the source filter on video_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Video description text; original casing and whitespace preserved; may be null
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Video publish timestamp limited to the last two years by the filter; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant platform label 'youtube'
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: YouTube views treated as clicks; sourced from the staging clicks field; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Proxy equal to clicks (views); defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: likes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total likes default to 0 when missing
      - name: shares
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Estimated shares from the source estimated_shares; default to 0 when missing
      - name: comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total comments default to 0 when missing
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: URL passed through from source (may be a thumbnail URL); may be null
      - name: calculated_engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Engagement rate: use provided value when positive; otherwise (likes + comments + shares) divided by views when views > 0; else 0.0; no rounding'
        tests:
        - calculated_engagement_rate >= 0
      - name: privacy_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Video privacy status passed through; may be null
      - name: channel_subscribers
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Channel subscribers default to 0 when missing
      - name: channel_total_videos
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Total videos default to 0; currently always 0 in this model
      - name: views_per_subscriber
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by channel_subscribers when subscribers > 0; otherwise 0.0; no rounding
      - name: likes_per_view_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Likes divided by clicks when clicks > 0; otherwise 0.0; no rounding
