- name: social_media_reporting__ctr_by_platform
      description: Monthly CTR and engagement metrics by platform and normalized content type with post and active account counts
      grain: One row per platform per month per content_type
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Union all posts from the five intermediate reporting models and assign a platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, youtube. - Derive content_type per source: - Facebook: if content_type is null, use "text". - Instagram: if content_format is null, use "feed post". - LinkedIn: if post_category is null, use "text post". - Twitter: classify the lowercased post_message: if it contains an http(s):// URL → "link"; else if it mentions "image" or "photo" → "photo"; else if it mentions "video" → "video"; otherwise "text". - YouTube: always "video". - Normalize each row: - month = created_timestamp truncated to the calendar month (first day). - content_type is lowercased. - clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments: treat null as 0. - Aggregate by platform, month, content_type: - posts_count: number of rows (union-all, no de-duplication). - active_accounts_count: distinct count of page_id. - clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments: sum of normalized values. - Compute rates from aggregated totals: - ctr: clicks divided by impressions when impressions > 0 and at least one active account; otherwise 0.0. - engagement_rate: (likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions when impressions > 0; otherwise 0.0. - Output one row per (platform, month, content_type); rates are DOUBLE with no rounding or capping.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lowercase platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, or youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar month derived from created_timestamp
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: content_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lowercased normalized content type per source with defaults; Twitter classified from message patterns
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: posts_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of posts in the group; includes posts with zero metrics; duplicates from sources are preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_accounts_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of page_id with at least one post in the group; accounts with zero metrics are included
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across posts; null clicks treated as 0 before summation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across posts; null impressions treated as 0 before summation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of likes across posts; null likes treated as 0 before summation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of shares across posts; null shares treated as 0 before summation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of comments across posts; null comments treated as 0 before summation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by impressions when impressions > 0 and active_accounts_count > 0; otherwise 0.0; not rounded or capped
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of likes, shares, and comments divided by impressions when impressions > 0; otherwise 0.0; not rounded or capped
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: social_media_reporting__daily_kpis
      description: Daily KPIs by platform and content type with lowercase content_type, platform-specific date spine (DuckDB range, end-exclusive), zero-filling, and CTR/engagement rate calculations
      grain: One row per (platform, day, content_type); if no activity on a day, a single 'text' content_type row per platform is produced
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Ingest five intermediate reporting models and assign platform: - facebook: content type defaults to "text" when missing. - instagram: content type defaults to "Feed Post" when missing. - linkedin: content type defaults to "Text Post" when missing. - twitter: derive content type from the post message (lowercased): contains a URL → "link"; contains "image" or "photo" → "photo"; contains "video" → "video"; otherwise "text". - youtube: content type is "video". - Normalize rows: - day is the calendar day derived from created_timestamp. - content_type is lowercased; no de-duplication. - Aggregate by (platform, day, content_type): - posts_count: number of posts. - active_accounts_count: distinct count of page_id. - clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments: sums with nulls treated as zero. - Build a platform-specific date spine: - For each platform, find the earliest and latest day in normalized data. - Generate a daily series from the earliest day up to (but excluding) the latest boundary day using DuckDB''s date range generator. - Left join aggregates to the spine on (platform, day): - If no aggregates exist for a day, emit one row with content_type "text" and all metrics set to 0. - If aggregates exist, emit one row per content_type with the aggregated metrics. - Compute rates: - ctr: clicks divided by impressions when impressions > 0 and active_accounts_count > 0; otherwise 0.0. - engagement_rate: (clicks + likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions when impressions > 0; otherwise 0.0. - Outputs are non-null; counts and sums preserve source duplicates; only active_accounts_count uses a distinct page_id.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, or youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day derived from created_timestamp or the platform-specific spine; the spine starts at the earliest day and excludes the upper boundary day
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: content_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lowercased normalized content type; defaults to 'text' on spine-only days; twitter from message patterns, instagram from content_format (default 'Feed Post'), linkedin from post_category (default 'Text Post'), youtube 'video'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: posts_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of posts per (platform, day, content_type); duplicates preserved; zero on spine-only days
      - name: active_accounts_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of page_id per (platform, day, content_type); zero on spine-only days; used to guard the CTR denominator
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks per (platform, day, content_type) with nulls treated as zero; zero on spine-only days
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions per (platform, day, content_type) with nulls treated as zero; zero on spine-only days; denominator for rates
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of likes per (platform, day, content_type) with nulls treated as zero; zero on spine-only days
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of shares per (platform, day, content_type) with nulls treated as zero; zero on spine-only days
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of comments per (platform, day, content_type) with nulls treated as zero; zero on spine-only days
      - name: ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by impressions when impressions > 0 and active_accounts_count > 0; otherwise 0.0; computed after zero-filling
        tests:
        - ctr BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of clicks, likes, shares, and comments divided by impressions when impressions > 0; otherwise 0.0; computed after zero-filling
        tests:
        - engagement_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1

- name: social_media_reporting__retention_kpis
      description: Weekly retention KPIs by platform using posting-activity cohorts over a fixed 13-week window
      grain: One row per platform per cohort_week per week_offset
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Union page activity from the five source models; only keep rows where created_timestamp is present. - Assign platform as one of: "facebook", "instagram", "linkedin", "twitter", "youtube". - Weekly normalization: - Bucket activity into ISO weeks starting Monday 00:00. - A page is considered active in a week if it posts at least once; multiple posts in the same week do not increase the activity count. - Cohorts: - For each (page_id, platform), set cohort_week to the earliest week with activity. - For each (platform, cohort_week), cohort_pages is the number of unique pages in that cohort. - Observation spine: - Generate week_offset values from 0 to 12 inclusive. - For each cohort, create 13 rows and set target_week to the start of the week that is week_offset weeks after cohort_week; when week_offset = 0, target_week equals cohort_week. - Activity presence: - Build distinct (platform, week, page_id) combinations so each active page-week is counted once. - Retention: - For each spine row, retained_pages is the number of unique pages active on the platform in target_week; this is not limited to members of the cohort. - KPI: - retention_rate = retained_pages divided by cohort_pages when cohort_pages > 0; otherwise 0.0. - No rounding; stored as double precision; values may exceed 1.0 due to the numerator scope. - Output: - Emit platform, cohort_week, week_offset, target_week, cohort_pages, retained_pages, retention_rate. - No explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform name in lowercase: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, or youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date (Monday) of the first week the page is active for the platform
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: week_offset
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of weeks since cohort_week, inclusive 0 to 12
        tests:
        - not_null
        - week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 12
      - name: target_week
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Start-of-week timestamp at week_offset weeks after cohort_week; equals cohort_week when offset is 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages in the cohort for each (platform, cohort_week)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retained_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages active on the platform in target_week; one count per page-week; not limited to cohort members
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of retained_pages to cohort_pages; if cohort_pages is 0 then 0.0; no rounding; may exceed 1.0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - retention_rate >= 0

      columns:
        - name: post_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: ig_post_id
          data_type: VARCHAR

          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: post_caption

          data_type: VARCHAR

          data_type: VARCHAR

          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: media_type_category
          data_type: VARCHAR

- name: stg_social_media__twitter_user_history
      description: "Cleaned and standardized Twitter user profile attributes for safe downstream joins and reporting."
      source_table: raw.twitter_user_history
      columns:
        - name: id
          data_type: BIGINT
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: _fivetran_synced
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: screen_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          description: >
            Best-effort cleaning to keep only [A-Za-z0-9_]; rows with NULL/blank or harmful characters are removed.
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "screen_name = CASE WHEN screen_name IS NULL OR TRIM(screen_name) = '' THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(screen_name, '[^A-Za-z0-9_]', '') END"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "screen_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT (screen_name RLIKE '[!@#$%^&*()+=<>?}{|,]')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: url
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "url IS NULL OR url RLIKE '^https?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?'"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "url IS NULL OR (url RLIKE '^(https?://)?[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?' AND url RLIKE '^https?://')"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP

          data_type: BIGINT

          data_type: BIGINT

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_social_media__youtube_videos
      description: "YouTube videos staged with standardized fields and basic derived metrics; recent 2-year window."
      source_table: raw.youtube_video
      notes:
        - "Include only videos with view data: statistics_view_count IS NOT NULL."
        - "Restrict to last 2 years: snippet_published_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years'."
        - "post_url is constructed as https://img.youtube.com/vi/{video_id}/default.jpg."
        - "All numeric metrics default to 0 when NULL."
        - "impressions and clicks both mirror statistics_view_count per SQL."
      columns:
        - name: video_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "CAST(id AS VARCHAR)."
        - name: video_published_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "snippet_published_at."
        - name: video_title
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: video_description
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: channel_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: channel_title
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: page_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: post_url
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Thumbnail URL used as post URL: https://img.youtube.com/vi/{video_id}/default.jpg."
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "post_url RLIKE '^https://img.youtube.com/vi/.+/default.jpg'"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: privacy_status
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: clicks
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: impressions
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "COALESCE(statistics_view_count, 0) — estimated as views in SQL."
        - name: likes
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: comments
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: estimated_shares
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: >
            CASE WHEN statistics_like_count > 10 THEN FLOOR(statistics_like_count / 10) ELSE 0 END.
        - name: subscribers
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "COALESCE(channel_info.channel_subscribers, 0)."
        - name: engagement_rate
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN (likes + comments + estimated_shares)::DOUBLE / impressions ELSE 0.0 END."
        - name: _fivetran_synced
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "_fivetran_synced from raw.youtube_video."

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__ad_group_report
      description: Daily ad group performance aggregated from hourly stats with latest ad group, campaign, and advertiser attributes plus CPC/CPM/CTR metrics.
      grain: One row per date_day per source_relation per advertiser_id per campaign_id per ad_group_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      business_logic: '- Begin with hourly facts from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_report_hourly. - Derive date_day by converting stat_time_hour to a calendar date (time removed). - Left join latest ad group attributes on ad_group_id; then left join advertiser on advertiser_id; then left join latest campaign on campaign_id. - Group by: source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. - For all activity metrics, aggregate daily values by summing hourly inputs; NULL inputs are ignored and the sum is NULL if all inputs are NULL. - total_conversion_value is the daily sum of row-level (purchase value + sales lead value); rows where either term is NULL yield NULL for that row and are omitted from the sum; result is NULL if all rows are NULL. - Rate metrics: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; returns NULL when total clicks is zero or NULL; unit is currency per click; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, scaled per 1,000 impressions; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; unit is currency per 1,000 impressions; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, expressed as a percentage; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; no rounding. - All joins are LEFT, so missing dimension records do not suppress fact aggregation; unmatched dimension fields remain NULL. - No explicit ordering is applied to the output.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the hourly source relation; included in the grouping so distinct sources produce separate rows.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date derived from stat_time_hour; defines the daily aggregation window.
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser ID from the latest ad group record; NULL if the ad group has no matching advertiser.
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name from the advertiser dimension; NULL if no advertiser match.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from the latest campaign via the ad group; NULL if no campaign match.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the campaign dimension; NULL if no campaign match.
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group ID from hourly facts; primary key used for joins and aggregation.
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group name from the latest ad group record; NULL if no ad group match.
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser currency code from the advertiser dimension; NULL if no advertiser match.
      - name: interest_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interest category from the latest ad group record; NULL if no ad group match.
      - name: gender
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target gender from the latest ad group record; NULL if no ad group match.
      - name: audience_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Audience type from the latest ad group record; NULL if no ad group match.
      - name: budget
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latest ad group budget carried through by the grouping; NULL if no ad group match; unit is currency.
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly impressions for the group; unit is count.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly clicks for the group; unit is count.
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly spend for the group; unit is currency.
      - name: reach
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly reach for the group; unit is count.
      - name: conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly conversions for the group; unit is count.
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly likes for the group; unit is count.
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly comments for the group; unit is count.
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly shares for the group; unit is count.
      - name: profile_visits
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly profile visits for the group; unit is count.
      - name: follows
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly follows for the group; unit is count.
      - name: video_watched_2_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 2-second video watches for the group; unit is count.
      - name: video_watched_6_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 6-second video watches for the group; unit is count.
      - name: video_views_p_25
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 25% video views for the group; unit is count.
      - name: video_views_p_50
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 50% video views for the group; unit is count.
      - name: video_views_p_75
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 75% video views for the group; unit is count.
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly real-time conversions for the group; unit is count.
      - name: total_purchase_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly purchase value for the group; unit is currency.
      - name: total_sales_lead_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly sales lead value for the group; unit is currency.
      - name: total_conversion_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum across rows of purchase value plus sales lead value; rows with either term NULL are omitted; unit is currency.
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost per click computed as total spend divided by total clicks; returns NULL when total clicks is zero or NULL; no rounding; unit is currency per click.
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost per thousand impressions computed as total spend divided by total impressions scaled to 1,000; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; no rounding; unit is currency per 1,000 impressions.
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily click-through rate computed as total clicks divided by total impressions expressed as a percentage; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; no rounding.

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__ad_report
      description: Daily ad performance aggregated from hourly with latest ad/ad group/campaign/advertiser attributes (no URL breakdown)
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, ad_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (stat_time_hour, source_relation, ad_id, impressions, clicks, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, total_sales_lead_value)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ad_id, ad_name, ad_group_id, advertiser_id, campaign_id, source_relation)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_group_id, ad_group_name, advertiser_id, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget, source_relation)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaign_id, campaign_name, source_relation)
      business_logic: '- Start from hourly facts; derive date_day by converting the hourly timestamp to its calendar date. - Join latest dimensions: - ads on matching ad_id - ad_groups on matching ad_group_id and source_relation - advertiser on matching advertiser_id - campaigns on matching campaign_id and source_relation - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, ad_id, ad_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. - For each group, aggregate all hourly metrics by summing; sums ignore NULL inputs and return NULL if all inputs are NULL; no additional casting or rounding. - Compute rate metrics from the aggregated sums with zero-safe division: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, scaled per 1,000 impressions - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, expressed as a percentage If a denominator is zero or NULL, the result is NULL; no rounding is applied. - total_conversion_value is the daily sum of each hour’s (purchase value + sales lead value), equivalent to summing both components separately. - Dimension attributes come from the latest snapshots; if a joined record is missing, the attribute is NULL. All such attributes are included in the GROUP BY.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the data source; grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date derived from stat_time_hour
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser ID from the latest ad group record; NULL if ad group is missing
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name from the latest advertiser record; NULL if advertiser is missing
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from the latest campaign record joined on source_relation; NULL if missing
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the latest campaign record; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group ID from the latest ad group record joined on source_relation; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group name from the latest ad group record; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad ID from hourly facts; grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad name from the latest ad record; NULL if missing
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser currency code used for spend-derived metrics
      - name: interest_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interest category from the latest ad group record
      - name: gender
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target gender from the latest ad group record
      - name: audience_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Audience type from the latest ad group record
      - name: budget
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ad group budget from the latest snapshot; included in grouping without aggregation
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly impressions
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly clicks
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly spend in advertiser currency
      - name: reach
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly reach
      - name: conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly conversions
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly likes
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly comments
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly shares
      - name: profile_visits
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly profile visits
      - name: follows
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly follows
      - name: video_watched_2_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 2-second video plays
      - name: video_watched_6_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 6-second video plays
      - name: video_views_p_25
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 25% video views
      - name: video_views_p_50
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 50% video views
      - name: video_views_p_75
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 75% video views
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly real-time conversions
      - name: total_purchase_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly purchase value
      - name: total_sales_lead_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly sales lead value
      - name: total_conversion_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of each hour’s purchase value plus sales lead value
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend divided by total clicks; NULL if clicks are zero or NULL; no rounding
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend per 1,000 impressions; NULL if impressions are zero or NULL; no rounding
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate as clicks divided by impressions times 100; NULL if impressions are zero or NULL; no rounding

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__advertiser_report
      description: Daily advertiser performance aggregated from hourly ad reports with advertiser attributes
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (hourly). - Derive date_day by taking the calendar date from stat_time_hour (cast to date); no timezone adjustments. - Left join to intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ads) on ad_id and source_relation; unmatched hourly rows are kept and advertiser_id may be NULL; multiple matches in ads duplicate rows and thus their measures. - Left join to intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) on advertiser_id and source_relation; unmatched rows are kept and advertiser_name and currency may be NULL; multiple matches in advertiser duplicate rows and thus their measures. - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency to produce one row per combination. - For each group, compute totals for clicks, impressions, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, and total_sales_lead_value by summing the corresponding hourly values; missing inputs are ignored; the total is NULL if all inputs are missing. - total_conversion_value is the sum across the group of (purchase value + sales lead value) evaluated per row; if either component of a row is missing, that row does not contribute; the result is NULL if no row contributes. - daily_cpc divides the group’s total spend by the group’s total clicks; if total clicks are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding. - daily_cpm divides the group’s total spend by the group’s total impressions and multiplies by 1000; if total impressions are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding. - daily_ctr divides the group’s total clicks by the group’s total impressions and multiplies by 100; if total impressions are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding; expressed as a percentage.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier used for joining and grouping
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date extracted from stat_time_hour
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser ID from ad history; may be NULL when no match
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name from advertiser data; may be NULL
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser currency from advertiser data; may be NULL
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks for the group
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions for the group
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: reach
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total reach for the group
        tests:
        - reach >= 0
      - name: conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total conversions for the group
        tests:
        - conversion >= 0
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total likes for the group
        tests:
        - likes >= 0
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total comments for the group
        tests:
        - comments >= 0
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total shares for the group
        tests:
        - shares >= 0
      - name: profile_visits
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total profile visits for the group
        tests:
        - profile_visits >= 0
      - name: follows
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total follows for the group
        tests:
        - follows >= 0
      - name: video_watched_2_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total 2-second video watches for the group
        tests:
        - video_watched_2_s >= 0
      - name: video_watched_6_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total 6-second video watches for the group
        tests:
        - video_watched_6_s >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_25
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 25% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_25 >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_50
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 50% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_50 >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_75
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 75% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_75 >= 0
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total real-time conversions for the group
        tests:
        - real_time_conversion >= 0
      - name: total_purchase_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total purchase value for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_purchase_value >= 0
      - name: total_sales_lead_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total sales lead value for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_sales_lead_value >= 0
      - name: total_conversion_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of per-row purchase value plus sales lead value across the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_conversion_value >= 0
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total spend divided by group total clicks; NULL when clicks are zero or missing; unrounded
        tests:
        - daily_cpc >= 0
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total spend divided by group total impressions times 1000; NULL when impressions are zero or missing; unrounded
        tests:
        - daily_cpm >= 0
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total clicks divided by group total impressions times 100; NULL when impressions are zero or missing; unrounded; percentage
        tests:
        - daily_ctr BETWEEN 0 AND 100

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__campaign_country_report
      description: Daily TikTok Ads campaign performance aggregated by campaign and country with latest campaign and advertiser attributes
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, campaign_id, and country_code
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_country_report
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      business_logic: '- Start from country_report and rename stat_time_day to date_day; retain source_relation, campaign_id, country_code, clicks, impressions, spend, conversion, and real_time_conversion. - Left join campaigns by campaign_id to attach the latest campaign_name, campaign_type, created_at, objective_type, status, split_test_variable, budget, and budget_mode. - Left join advertiser by campaigns.advertiser_id to attach advertiser_id, advertiser_name, and currency. - Aggregate at the combination of source_relation, date_day, campaign_id, and country_code. Joined campaign and advertiser attributes are carried through for each group; if no match, those attributes are NULL. - For each group, compute totals for clicks, impressions, spend, conversion, and real_time_conversion by summing the respective values; NULL inputs are ignored, and if all inputs are NULL the total is NULL. - Derived metrics: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; result is NULL if total clicks is 0 or NULL. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, then multiplied by 1,000; result is NULL if total impressions is 0 or NULL. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, then multiplied by 100; result is NULL if total impressions is 0 or NULL. - No rounding or formatting is applied; monetary values are interpreted in the advertiser’s currency. All source rows contribute to totals; no de-duplication is performed.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source table identifier from country_report; part of the aggregation key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date sourced from country_report.stat_time_day; part of the aggregation key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from country_report used to link campaign attributes; part of the aggregation key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest campaign name from campaigns; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: campaign_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest campaign type from campaigns; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Campaign creation timestamp from the latest campaigns record; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country code from country_report; part of the aggregation key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser identifier joined via campaigns; NULL if advertiser does not join
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name joined via campaigns; NULL if advertiser does not join
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser account currency; unit used for spend, CPC, and CPM; NULL if advertiser does not join
      - name: objective_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest campaign objective type from campaigns; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest campaign operational status from campaigns; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: split_test_variable
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest split-test variable from campaigns; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: budget
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latest campaign budget from campaigns; carried through without aggregation; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: budget_mode
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest budget mode from campaigns; carried through without aggregation; NULL if the campaign does not join
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks across all country_report rows in the group; NULLs are ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions across all country_report rows in the group; NULLs are ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend across all country_report rows in the group; NULLs are ignored; interpreted in advertiser currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total conversions across all country_report rows in the group; NULLs are ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per click computed as total spend divided by total clicks; NULL if clicks are 0 or NULL; no rounding applied
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per 1,000 impressions computed as total spend divided by total impressions and multiplied by 1,000; NULL if impressions are 0 or NULL; no rounding applied
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate percentage computed as total clicks divided by total impressions and multiplied by 100; NULL if impressions are 0 or NULL; no rounding applied
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_data: HUGEINT
        description: Total real-time conversions across all country_report rows in the group; NULLs are ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__campaign_report
      description: Daily campaign performance aggregated from hourly stats with joins to latest campaign attributes and advertiser details, including CPC/CPM/CTR rates
      grain: One row per date_day x source_relation x campaign_id x campaign_name x advertiser_id x advertiser_name x currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_report_hourly (hourly). - Create date_day by converting stat_time_hour to a calendar date. - Left join intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaigns) on campaign_id. - Left join intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) on advertiser_id from the campaigns join. - Aggregate by source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, and currency. - For all count/value metrics (impressions, clicks, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, total_sales_lead_value): - Compute daily totals by summing hourly values within each group. - Null hourly values are ignored in the sum; the total is null if all values are null for the group. - total_conversion_value: - For each hourly record, add purchase value and sales lead value, then sum these combined values across the group. - The result is null if all combined values are null. - Rate metrics: - daily_cpc = total spend divided by total clicks; returns null if total clicks is zero or missing; no rounding. - daily_cpm = total spend divided by total impressions, multiplied by 1,000; returns null if impressions are zero or missing; no rounding. - daily_ctr = total clicks divided by total impressions, multiplied by 100; returns null if impressions are zero or missing; no rounding. - Join behavior: - If a campaign_id does not match in campaigns, campaign_name is null and advertiser fields are also null due to the subsequent join. - If advertiser_id does not match, advertiser_name and currency are null. - If campaigns or advertiser contain multiple matches for a key, hourly rows are duplicated prior to aggregation and produce separate output rows per distinct joined attributes. - All matching hourly records are included; no de-duplication or ordering is applied.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__url_report
      description: Daily ad performance with URL breakdown; includes only ads whose landing_page_url is non-null
      grain: One row per unique combination of date_day, source_relation, ad_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, and grouped context fields (advertiser_id/name, campaign_name, ad_group_name, ad_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (hourly). 2) Left join latest dimension snapshots: - hourly.ad_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ads) - ads.ad_group_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_groups) - ads.advertiser_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) - ads.campaign_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaigns) 3) Keep only rows where ads.landing_page_url is present (non-null). 4) Derive date_day by casting hourly.stat_time_hour to a date (no timezone adjustments). 5) Group by all selected dimensions: source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id/name, campaign_id/name, ad_group_id/name, ad_id, ad_name, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. 6) For each group, add up all hourly numeric metrics; null inputs are ignored in the addition, and if all inputs are null the result is null. For total_conversion_value, first compute purchase value plus sales lead value per row, then add those row results across the group; if either component is missing on a row, that row contributes nothing. 7) Compute rate metrics from the aggregated totals: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; if total clicks is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, multiplied by 1000; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, multiplied by 100; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. 8) URL and UTM fields are taken directly from ads without parsing, normalization, trimming, or case changes. 9) Context fields (currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget) are grouping keys; differences create separate rows.'

references.name: intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly
references.line_text: business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (hourly). 2) Left join latest dimension snapshots: - hourly.ad_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ads) - ads.ad_group_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_groups) - ads.advertiser_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) - ads.campaign_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaigns) 3) Keep only rows where ads.landing_page_url is present (non-null). 4) Derive date_day by casting hourly.stat_time_hour to a date (no timezone adjustments). 5) Group by all selected dimensions: source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id/name, campaign_id/name, ad_group_id/name, ad_id, ad_name, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. 6) For each group, add up all hourly numeric metrics; null inputs are ignored in the addition, and if all inputs are null the result is null. For total_conversion_value, first compute purchase value plus sales lead value per row, then add those row results across the group; if either component is missing on a row, that row contributes nothing. 7) Compute rate metrics from the aggregated totals: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; if total clicks is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, multiplied by 1000; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, multiplied by 100; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. 8) URL and UTM fields are taken directly from ads without parsing, normalization, trimming, or case changes. 9) Context fields (currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget) are grouping keys; differences create separate rows.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history
      description: "Typed ad group attributes with selected targeting fields and recency flag."
      source_table: raw.tiktok_adgroup_history_data
      columns:
        - name: source_relation
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: ad_group_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: updated_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "updated_at is a valid timestamp"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: advertiser_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: campaign_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: interest_category
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: ad_group_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: frequency
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: frequency_schedule
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: age_groups
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: languages
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: gender
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: budget_mode
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: budget
          data_type: DOUBLE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "budget is numeric"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: landing_page_url
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: secondary_optimization_event
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: creative_material_mode
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: audience_type
          data_type: VARCHAR

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_twilio__account_latest
      description: Latest account snapshot per account_id chosen by most recent updated_at (NULLs last), then most recent created_at (NULLs last).
      grain: One row per account_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_twilio__account_history
      business_logic: '- Input: rows from staging.stg_twilio__account_history using columns account_id, friendly_name, status, type, created_at, updated_at. - For each account_id, sort rows by updated_at in descending order with NULLs placed last; break ties by created_at in descending order with NULLs placed last. - From this ordered set, select the first row for each account_id. - The selected row represents the latest snapshot; all output columns are passed through unchanged (casing and whitespace preserved). - Tie handling: if updated_at and created_at are identical across multiple rows (including both NULL), selection among those tied rows is arbitrary because no further tie-breakers are applied. - Result: exactly one row per account_id.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twilio account identifier; exactly one output row per value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: friendly_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from the selected latest row; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account status from the selected latest row; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type from the selected latest row; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp from the selected row; secondary sort key (descending, NULLs last); pass-through.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Update timestamp from the selected row; primary sort key (descending, NULLs last); pass-through.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_twilio__account_metrics
      description: Per-account metrics by joining account_history with aggregated call and message data; counts and costs default to 0 when missing, averages remain NULL when undefined.
      grain: 'One row per row in staging.stg_twilio__account_history (key: account_id)'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_twilio__account_history
      - staging.stg_twilio__call
      - staging.stg_twilio__message
      business_logic: '- Take all rows from staging.stg_twilio__account_history with fields: account_id, friendly_name, status, type, created_at, updated_at. - Build call_metrics by grouping staging.stg_twilio__call by account_id: - total_calls: count of all call rows. - completed_calls: count of calls where status equals ''completed''; other or NULL statuses are not counted. - failed_calls: count of calls where status equals ''failed''; other or NULL statuses are not counted. - avg_call_duration_s: mean of non-NULL call_duration_s; result is NULL if no non-NULL durations exist. - total_call_cost_usd: sum of non-NULL price_in_usd. - Build message_metrics by grouping staging.stg_twilio__message by account_id: - total_messages: count of all message rows. - delivered_messages: count of messages where status equals ''delivered''; other or NULL statuses are not counted. - failed_messages: count of messages where status equals ''failed''; other or NULL statuses are not counted. - total_message_cost_usd: sum of non-NULL price. - avg_segments_per_message: mean of non-NULL num_segments; result is NULL if no non-NULL segments exist. - Left join call_metrics and message_metrics to each account_history row on account_id. - After joining, default missing counts and costs to 0; averages are not defaulted and may remain NULL. - Compute total_communication_cost_usd as the sum of call and message costs with missing values treated as 0.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from account_history; used to join metrics.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Friendly name from account_history.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account status from account_history.
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type from account_history.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp from account_history; may be NULL.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Update timestamp from account_history; may be NULL.
      - name: total_calls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of calls for the account; 0 when no matching calls.
      - name: completed_calls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of calls with status 'completed'; other or NULL statuses not counted; 0 when none.
      - name: failed_calls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of calls with status 'failed'; other or NULL statuses not counted; 0 when none.
      - name: avg_call_duration_s
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean call duration in seconds; NULLs ignored; NULL when undefined; no rounding.
      - name: total_call_cost_usd
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-NULL call price_in_usd; 0 when no matching calls.
      - name: total_messages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of messages for the account; 0 when no matching messages.
      - name: delivered_messages
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of messages with status 'delivered'; other or NULL statuses not counted; 0 when none.
      - name: failed_messages
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of messages with status 'failed'; other or NULL statuses not counted; 0 when none.
      - name: total_message_cost_usd
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-NULL message price; 0 when no matching messages.
      - name: avg_segments_per_message
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of non-NULL num_segments per message; NULL when undefined; no rounding.
      - name: total_communication_cost_usd
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of call and message costs with missing values treated as 0.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_twilio__messages
      description: Unified Twilio messages with a normalized phone_number and day/week/month buckets derived from timestamp_sent; union of inbound and outbound subsets.
      grain: One row per message_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_twilio__message
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_twilio__message. - Build the inbound subset by keeping rows where the direction string contains "inbound"; set phone_number to the sender (message_from); compute num_characters as the character count of body; compute body_no_spaces by removing the space character from body; retain all other fields as-is. - Build the outbound subset by keeping rows where the direction string contains "outbound"; set phone_number to the recipient (message_to); compute num_characters and body_no_spaces the same way; place the original sender (message_from) in the column named message_to; retain all other fields as-is. - Combine inbound and outbound with a UNION ALL; no de-duplication; output order is not defined. - Derive date buckets from timestamp_sent: date_day is the calendar date of the timestamp, date_week is the start date of the week containing the timestamp, and date_month is the first day of the month containing the timestamp. - Null handling: if body is NULL, num_characters and body_no_spaces are NULL; if timestamp_sent is NULL, date_day/date_week/date_month are NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: message_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique Twilio message identifier; exactly one output row per message_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twilio account identifier associated with the message.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the source message record was created.
      - name: timestamp_sent
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Message send timestamp used to derive date_day, date_week, and date_month.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date corresponding to timestamp_sent.
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date of the week containing timestamp_sent.
      - name: date_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month containing timestamp_sent.
      - name: direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Original direction string; only rows where it contains 'inbound' or 'outbound' are included.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Normalized phone number: inbound uses message_from; outbound uses message_to.'
      - name: message_to
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inbound rows retain the original recipient; outbound rows store the original sender.
      - name: body
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Message content from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: body_no_spaces
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Body with the space character removed; other whitespace and casing are unchanged.
      - name: num_characters
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of characters in body; NULL if body is NULL.
      - name: num_media
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Attached media count from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: num_segments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Number of segments from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: price
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Message cost from the source; currency indicated by price_unit; NULLs preserved.
      - name: price_unit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency or unit associated with price.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Message delivery status from the source.
      - name: error_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Error code from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: error_message
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Error message value from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: messaging_service_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twilio messaging service identifier associated with the message.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp in the source.

      grain: One row per account_id per account_name per account_status per account_type per date_day per date_week per date_month per price_unit
      source_models:

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twilio__messages. - Left join intermediate.int_twilio__account_latest on account_id to add the latest account_name (friendly_name), account_status, and account_type; unmatched accounts have NULL attributes. - Left join intermediate.int_twilio__usage_record_daily on account_id and date_day equals start_date to add daily usage prices; unmatched dates contribute no usage. - Group by account_id, date_day, date_week, date_month, price_unit, account_name, account_status, and account_type. - For each group: - Count outbound messages where direction contains "outbound". - Count inbound messages where direction contains "inbound". - Count messages by exact status value for: accepted, scheduled, canceled, queued, sending, sent, failed, delivered, undelivered, receiving, received, and read. - All counts include only rows with a non-NULL message_id and keep duplicates; no de-duplication. - Total messages is the count of rows with a non-NULL message_id. - Total messages spend is the sum of message price, rounded to 2 decimals and multiplied by -1; result is NULL when every price in the group is NULL; interpreted in the group''s price_unit with no conversion. - Total account spend is the sum of daily_price across matched usage rows, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when there is no match or the sum is NULL. - Output one row per unique combination of the grouping fields listed in grain.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: twilio__message_enhanced
      description: Message-level enrichment that left joins selected messaging service attributes and derives num_words from upstream fields.
      grain: One row per message_id; duplicates can occur if messaging_service_id matches multiple service rows
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twilio__messages
      - intermediate.int_twilio__messaging_service
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twilio__messages with no filtering or deduplication; select only the message fields listed in the output. - Left join to intermediate.int_twilio__messaging_service on messaging_service_id; select only the listed service attributes. - If there is no matching service row, all service attributes are NULL. - If multiple service rows share the same messaging_service_id, the message row is duplicated (no tie-breaking or deduplication). - Derive num_words from upstream fields: - Compute as the number of spaces in the body plus one, using total character count (num_characters) and the count of non-space characters (length of body_no_spaces) provided upstream. - If num_characters or body_no_spaces is NULL, num_words is NULL. - No post-processing or clipping; bodies with no spaces yield 1. - No additional transformations, casting, ordering, or aggregation.'
      columns:
      - name: message_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique message identifier from messages; may repeat if the join produces multiple matches.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: messaging_service_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier used to join to messaging service; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: timestamp_sent
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: When the message was sent; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Day bucket for the message; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Week bucket for the message; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: date_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month bucket for the message; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owning Twilio account SID; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: When the message record was created; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inbound or outbound direction; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number associated with the message; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: body
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Message text content; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: num_characters
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total character count of body from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: num_words
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Approximate word count computed as (spaces in body) + 1 using upstream num_characters and body_no_spaces; NULL if inputs are NULL.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Delivery status from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: error_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Error code from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: error_message
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Error message value from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: num_media
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Number of media attachments from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: num_segments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Number of message segments from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: price
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Message cost from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: price_unit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency unit for price; pass-through from messages; may be NULL.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from messages; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: friendly_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Messaging service friendly name from the join; NULL if no match.
      - name: inbound_method
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HTTP method for inbound handling from the join; NULL if no match.
      - name: us_app_to_person_registered
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: A2P registration flag from the join; NULL if no match.
      - name: use_inbound_webhook_on_number
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag to use inbound webhook on number from the join; NULL if no match.
      - name: use_case
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Messaging service use case from the join; NULL if no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: twilio__number_overview
      description: Phone-number-level aggregation of message counts and total price from intermediate.int_twilio__messages
      grain: One row per phone_number
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twilio__messages
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_twilio__messages (columns used: phone_number, message_id, direction, price). - Group by phone_number; produce exactly one output row per distinct phone_number (including a single NULL group if present). - For each group: - total_outbound_messages: count rows where direction contains "outbound" and message_id is not NULL. - total_inbound_messages: count rows where direction contains "inbound" and message_id is not NULL. - total_messages: count rows where message_id is not NULL. - total_spend: sum price; NULL prices are ignored; result is NULL if all prices are NULL; no rounding or casting. - No deduplication beyond grouping; every input row contributes according to these rules. - Output ordering is not specified.'
      columns:
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number used as the grouping key; may be NULL
        tests:
        - unique
      - name: total_outbound_messages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of non-NULL message_id in rows where direction contains 'outbound'; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_inbound_messages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of non-NULL message_id in rows where direction contains 'inbound'; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_messages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of non-NULL message_id for the phone_number across all directions
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of price for the phone_number; NULL prices ignored; NULL if all prices are NULL; no rounding applied

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_twilio__messages (columns used: phone_number, message_id, direction, price). - Group by phone_number; produce exactly one output row per distinct phone_number (including a single NULL group if present). - For each group: - total_outbound_messages: count rows where direction contains "outbound" and message_id is not NULL. - total_inbound_messages: count rows where direction contains "inbound" and message_id is not NULL. - total_messages: count rows where message_id is not NULL. - total_spend: sum price; NULL prices are ignored; result is NULL if all prices are NULL; no rounding or casting. - No deduplication beyond grouping; every input row contributes according to these rules. - Output ordering is not specified.'

- name: stg_twilio__account_history
      description: "Cleaned account history snapshots, one row per raw record with validated labels and temporal fields (reflecting current SQL behavior)."
      source_table: raw.twilio_account_history_data
      columns:
        - name: account_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "created_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "created_at >= '2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: updated_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: friendly_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "friendly_name = TRIM(friendly_name)"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "friendly_name RLIKE '^[A-Za-z0-9\\s._-]+'"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "LENGTH(friendly_name) BETWEEN 3 AND 100"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: owner_account_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: status
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "status IN ('active','suspended','closed')"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "status IS NOT NULL AND status != ''"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: type
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "type IN ('Trial','Full')"
              on_failure: delete_row

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first
      description: Selects the first URL per tweet using earliest start_index then index (NULLs treated as 999999), with host and path derived from expanded_url and UTM parameters passed through.
      grain: One row per tweet_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_twitter_ads__tweet_url
      business_logic: '- Partition rows by tweet_id. - Within each tweet_id, order ascending by start_index and then index, treating NULL as 999999 for both fields; select the first row. If multiple rows tie on both fields, the chosen row is non-deterministic. - For the selected row: - Pass through base_url, expanded_url, display_url, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term without changes. - Derive url_host by taking the text after "://" up to the next "/" or "?" or "#"; if no such pattern exists, set NULL; the host may include a port. - Derive url_path: - If expanded_url contains "//", set url_path to "/" plus the substring between the first occurrence of "//" and the "?" (if present) or the end of the string. - This substring includes the hostname and any path; the query string is excluded, and a fragment (after "#") is kept if present. - If expanded_url does not contain "//", set url_path to NULL. - All derived and passed-through values preserve original casing and spacing.'
      columns:
      - name: tweet_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique tweet identifier; exactly one output row per tweet_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Value passed through from the source with no transformation; may be NULL.
      - name: url_host
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Host extracted from expanded_url between '://' and the next '/' '?' or '#'; may include a port; NULL if no match.
      - name: url_path
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: If expanded_url contains '//', '/' plus the substring from after '//' up to before '?' or end (includes hostname and any path, excludes query, keeps fragment if present); otherwise NULL.
      - name: utm_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM source passed through from the source as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: utm_medium
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM medium passed through from the source as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: utm_campaign
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM campaign passed through from the source as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: utm_content
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM content passed through from the source as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: utm_term
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM term passed through from the source as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: expanded_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full expanded URL passed through unmodified; may include query and fragment; casing and whitespace preserved.
      - name: display_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display-friendly URL passed through unmodified; casing and whitespace preserved.
