blocks.original_text:
- name: twitter_ads__account_report
      description: Daily account performance aggregated from promoted tweet activity and left-joined to account attributes
      grain: One row per date_day x account_id x placement from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base (duplicated if multiple matching account rows exist)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts
      business_logic: '- Aggregate rows from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base by date_day, account_id, and placement. - For each group, compute totals for clicks, impressions, spend, spend_micro, url_clicks, total_conversions, and total_conversions_sale_amount by adding values in the group. - Null handling: NULL values are excluded from each total; if all values for a metric in a group are NULL, the total is NULL. - Numeric behavior: values are added without casting or rounding; spend and total_conversions_sale_amount retain double precision; spend_micro retains integer micro units. - Left join the aggregated result to intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts on account_id to enrich with account attributes; if no match, attributes are NULL; if multiple matches exist, the aggregated row repeats for each matching account. - No filters are applied; groups with NULL date_day or NULL account_id are included.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the base data used for aggregation; carried through unchanged and may be NULL
      - name: placement
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inventory placement from the base data; aggregated by exact value; case and spacing preserved; may be NULL
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from the base data used for aggregation and joining; may be NULL (attributes then remain NULL)
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from accounts; NULL if no account match; duplicated if multiple account rows match
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Account soft-delete flag from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account timezone from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: industry_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account industry category from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: approval_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account approval status from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: business_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Business name from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: business_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Business identifier from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Account creation timestamp from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Account last update timestamp from accounts; NULL if no account match
      - name: timezone_switched_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the account timezone was switched; NULL if no account match
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total clicks for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: count'
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total impressions for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: count'
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Total spend for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: account currency (no rounding)'
      - name: spend_micro
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total spend in micro units for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: micro currency (1e-6 of account currency)'
      - name: url_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total URL clicks for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: count'
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total conversions for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: count'
      - name: total_conversions_sale_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Total conversion sale amount for the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; unit: account currency (double precision)'

- name: twitter_ads__keyword_report
      description: Daily keyword performance aggregated by line item and keyword, enriched with campaign and account context
      grain: One row per combination of date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, keyword_id, keyword, currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__keyword_report_base
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts
      business_logic: '- Use the keyword report base as the fact source, providing date_day, placement, account_id, line_item_id, keyword_id, keyword, and raw metrics (clicks, impressions, spend, spend_micro, url_clicks, total_conversions, total_conversions_sale_amount). - Left join line_items on line_item_id to add campaign_id, line_item_name, and currency. - Left join campaigns on campaign_id to add campaign_name. - Left join accounts on account_id to add account_name. - Aggregate by date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, keyword_id, keyword, and currency. - For each group, sum clicks, impressions, spend, spend_micro, url_clicks, total_conversions, and total_conversions_sale_amount; NULL inputs are excluded from sums, and if all inputs are NULL the result is NULL; no rounding or scaling is applied; spend and sale amounts are in standard currency units, spend_micro is in micro-units. - Joins are left; unmatched records retain NULL attributes and form their own groups; if joined tables contain duplicate keys, base rows may fan out prior to aggregation and sums reflect that multiplicity. - No filters, deduplication, or explicit ordering; text fields are passed through unchanged.'

        description: Line item name from the line_items join; may be NULL
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword identifier from the base report
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: keyword
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword text from the base report; may be NULL
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency code from the line_items join; may be NULL
      - name: clicks

      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Impressions summed within each group; excludes NULLs

      - name: spend_micro

blocks.original_text:
- name: twitter_ads__line_item_report
      description: Daily line item performance by placement with summed metrics and joined line item, campaign, and account attributes.
      grain: One row per unique combination of date_day, placement, account_id, line_item_id, and all joined line item/campaign attributes.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_item_report_base
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_item_report_base (r). - Left join line items (li) on line_item_id; left join campaigns (c) on li.campaign_id; left join accounts (a) on account_id. - Select reporting keys and all non-aggregated attributes from r, li, c, and a. - Group by every selected non-aggregated column to ensure deterministic aggregation. - Aggregate r metrics using SUM: clicks, impressions, spend, spend_micro, url_clicks, total_conversions, total_conversions_sale_amount. - SUM ignores NULLs; if all inputs are NULL the result is NULL; no rounding or casting is applied. - Units: spend and total_conversions_sale_amount are in standard currency units; spend_micro is in micro units (1e-6). - Left joins mean unmatched dimension records produce NULLs in joined attributes. - No filtering or ordering is applied. - Assumptions to prevent metric duplication: line_items is unique on line_item_id, campaigns on campaign_id, and accounts on account_id; otherwise, joined duplicates would split groups and multiply sums.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date for the aggregated metrics.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: placement
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inventory placement associated with the delivery.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twitter Ads account ID from the base report.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from the accounts join; NULL if no match.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the campaigns join; NULL if no campaign match.
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item ID from the base report; grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: line_item_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item name from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Line item soft-delete flag from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: line_item_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item lifecycle status from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: campaign_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign lifecycle status from the campaigns join; NULL if no campaign match.
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO currency code from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: advertiser_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser domain from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: advertiser_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Advertiser user ID from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: bid_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bid type from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: bid_unit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bid unit from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: charge_by
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Charging unit from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: objective
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optimization objective from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: optimization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optimization strategy from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: product_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product type from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: primary_web_event_tag
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Primary web event tag identifier from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: start_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Line item start timestamp from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: end_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Line item end timestamp from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Line item creation timestamp from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Line item last update timestamp from the line items join; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: target_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Target cost per acquisition in standard currency units; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: total_budget_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total budget in standard currency units; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: bid_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Bid amount in standard currency units; NULL if no line item match.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks over the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions over the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of spend over the group in standard currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: spend_micro
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of spend_micro over the group in micro currency units (1e-6); NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - spend_micro >= 0
      - name: url_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of URL clicks over the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - url_clicks >= 0
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total conversions over the group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - total_conversions >= 0
      - name: total_conversions_sale_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversion sale amount over the group in standard currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests:
        - total_conversions_sale_amount >= 0

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_item_report_base (r). - Left join line items (li) on line_item_id; left join campaigns (c) on li.campaign_id; left join accounts (a) on account_id. - Select reporting keys and all non-aggregated attributes from r, li, c, and a. - Group by every selected non-aggregated column to ensure deterministic aggregation. - Aggregate r metrics using SUM: clicks, impressions, spend, spend_micro, url_clicks, total_conversions, total_conversions_sale_amount. - SUM ignores NULLs; if all inputs are NULL the result is NULL; no rounding or casting is applied. - Units: spend and total_conversions_sale_amount are in standard currency units; spend_micro is in micro units (1e-6). - Left joins mean unmatched dimension records produce NULLs in joined attributes. - No filtering or ordering is applied. - Assumptions to prevent metric duplication: line_items is unique on line_item_id, campaigns on campaign_id, and accounts on account_id; otherwise, joined duplicates would split groups and multiply sums.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: twitter_ads__url_report
      description: Daily placement-level metrics for promoted tweets that have a first expanded URL, enriched with URL components and campaign/account/tweet attributes; metrics are summed across the grouped dimensions.
      grain: One row per unique combination of date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, promoted_tweet_id, tweet_id, tweet_name, tweet_full_text, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, expanded_url, display_url, currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweets
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweets
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base r (daily metrics by placement). - Join dimensions (LEFT JOINs in the query): • r.promoted_tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweets pt • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweets t • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first u (first URL per tweet) • pt.line_item_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items li • li.campaign_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns c • r.account_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts a - Apply filter: require u.expanded_url to be non-NULL, which effectively makes the join to u (and thus to pt) act as an inner join; other joins remain left and may yield NULL attributes. - Group by all selected dimensions exactly: date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, promoted_tweet_id, tweet_id, tweet_name, tweet_full_text, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, expanded_url, display_url, currency. - Aggregate using SUM over r.clicks, r.impressions, r.spend, r.spend_micro, r.url_clicks, r.total_conversions, r.total_conversions_sale_amount. • SUM ignores NULL inputs; if all values in a group are NULL, the result is NULL. • No rounding or unit conversion is applied; spend is in currency units and spend_micro in micro-units of the same currency. - No de-duplication is performed; multiple matches on joins replicate metric rows and are then aggregated within identical dimension sets.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day from r.date_day; defines the daily aggregation period.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: placement
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inventory placement from r.placement; used as a grouping dimension.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twitter Ads account ID from r.account_id; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from a.account_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from c.campaign_id via line_item → campaign; used as a grouping dimension; may be NULL.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from c.campaign_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item ID from li.line_item_id via pt.line_item_id; used as a grouping dimension; may be NULL.
      - name: line_item_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item name from li.line_item_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: promoted_tweet_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Promoted tweet ID from r.promoted_tweet_id; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: tweet_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Underlying tweet ID from pt.tweet_id; non-NULL due to URL filter; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: tweet_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tweet name label from t.tweet_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: tweet_full_text
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full tweet text from t.tweet_full_text; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Expanded URL without query string from u.base_url; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: url_host
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Host component of the expanded URL from u.url_host; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: url_path
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Path component of the expanded URL from u.url_path; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL or empty.
      - name: utm_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM source from u.utm_source; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_medium
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM medium from u.utm_medium; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_campaign
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM campaign from u.utm_campaign; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_content
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM content from u.utm_content; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_term
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM term from u.utm_term; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: expanded_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full expanded URL from u.expanded_url; non-NULL due to filter; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: display_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display-friendly URL from u.display_url; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign currency code from c.currency; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.clicks within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.impressions within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of r.spend within each dimension group in currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: spend_micro
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.spend_micro within each dimension group in micro-units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: url_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.url_clicks within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.total_conversions within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: total_conversions_sale_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of r.total_conversions_sale_amount within each dimension group in currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base r (daily metrics by placement). - Join dimensions (LEFT JOINs in the query): • r.promoted_tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweets pt • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweets t • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first u (first URL per tweet) • pt.line_item_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items li • li.campaign_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns c • r.account_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts a - Apply filter: require u.expanded_url to be non-NULL, which effectively makes the join to u (and thus to pt) act as an inner join; other joins remain left and may yield NULL attributes. - Group by all selected dimensions exactly: date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, promoted_tweet_id, tweet_id, tweet_name, tweet_full_text, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, expanded_url, display_url, currency. - Aggregate using SUM over r.clicks, r.impressions, r.spend, r.spend_micro, r.url_clicks, r.total_conversions, r.total_conversions_sale_amount. • SUM ignores NULL inputs; if all values in a group are NULL, the result is NULL. • No rounding or unit conversion is applied; spend is in currency units and spend_micro in micro-units of the same currency. - No de-duplication is performed; multiple matches on joins replicate metric rows and are then aggregated within identical dimension sets.'

      columns:
        - name: account_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: approval_status
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "approval_status IN ('ACCEPTED','PENDING','REJECTED')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: business_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: business_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: created_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: is_deleted
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: industry_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: timezone
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "timezone IN ('America/Los_Angeles','America/New_York','Europe/London','Asia/Tokyo','Australia/Sydney','UTC')"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: timezone_switched_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: updated_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: is_latest_version
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          constraints: [not_null]

- name: stg_twitter_ads__campaign_history
      description: "Cleaned campaign attributes with normalized status and budget amounts (micro to standard units) and latest-version flag."
      source_table: raw.twitter_campaign_history_data
      columns:
        - name: account_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: created_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: currency
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: daily_budget_amount_local_micro
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: daily_budget_amount
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "ROUND(daily_budget_amount_local_micro / 1e6, 2)."
        - name: is_deleted
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: duration_in_days
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: end_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: entity_status
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Normalized as UPPER(TRIM(entity_status)); only {ACTIVE, PAUSED, DELETED, DRAFT} retained."
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "entity_status = UPPER(TRIM(entity_status))"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "entity_status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED','DELETED','DRAFT')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: frequency_cap
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: funding_instrument_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: campaign_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: campaign_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: is_servable
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: is_standard_delivery
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: start_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: total_budget_amount_local_micro
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "ROUND(total_budget_amount_local_micro / 1e6, 2)."
        - name: total_budget_amount
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: updated_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: is_latest_version
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          constraints: [not_null]
          description: "ROW_NUMBER()=1 within (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY updated_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST)."

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_xero__general_ledger_fact
      description: Journal header and line fact enriched with account_class, invoice/contact, and tracking pivots; one row per journal_id + journal_line_id
      grain: One row per journal_id per journal_line_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_xero__journal
      - staging.stg_xero__journal_line
      - staging.stg_xero__account
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice
      - staging.stg_xero__contact
      - staging.stg_xero__journal_line_has_tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_option
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_has_option
      business_logic: '- Create base rows by joining journal headers to journal lines on journal_id, then exclude rows where journal_id or journal_line_id is NULL to retain only existing journal lines. - Enrich account_class via a left join to the account table on account_id; account_code, account_name, and account_type come directly from the journal line unchanged. - When source_type is ACCPAY or ACCREC, join invoices on source_id to obtain contact_id, then join contacts on contact_id to obtain contact_name; otherwise leave contact fields NULL. - Build tracking dimensions from journal_line_has_tracking_category by mapping to active category–option pairs using category↔option relationships and matching by tracking option name; for each journal_id + journal_line_id, assign the single option name for categories Region, Department, Project, Location, Class, Customer, and any category with name containing "Cost Center". If multiple active options exist for a category on the same line, select the lexicographically highest option name; if none exist, set NULL. - Monetary amounts (gross_amount, net_amount, tax_amount) are carried through from the journal line without aggregation, rounding, or casting. - processed_at is set to the current execution timestamp.'
      columns:
      - name: journal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal header identifier; non-NULL due to final filter; groups lines within a journal
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: journal_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier for the journal line; non-NULL due to final filter; exactly one row per journal_id + journal_line_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: created_date_utc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal creation timestamp string (UTC) carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: journal_date
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal effective date string carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: journal_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Integer journal number from staging carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: reference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal reference from staging; casing and whitespace preserved; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: source_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source entity ID from journal header; used to link invoices when source_type is ACCPAY/ACCREC; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal source type; invoice/contact enrichment occurs only when value is ACCPAY or ACCREC; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: account_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Journal line account code carried through as numeric; no transformation; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal line account ID used to join the account table for account_class; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal line account name carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal line account type carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account class from the account table via account_id; NULL if no account match
        tests: []
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal line description carried through as-is; casing and whitespace preserved; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: gross_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross amount from the journal line carried through without aggregation or rounding; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: net_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net amount from the journal line carried through without aggregation or rounding; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: tax_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Tax amount from the journal line carried through without aggregation or rounding; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: tax_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tax name from the journal line carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: tax_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tax type from the journal line carried through as-is; NULL preserved
        tests: []
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice contact_id populated only when source_type is ACCPAY/ACCREC and source_id matches an invoice; NULL otherwise
        tests: []
      - name: contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact name joined via contact_id from the invoice; NULL if no invoice/contact match
        tests: []
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option for category 'Region'; if multiple exist on a line, the lexicographically highest is chosen; NULL when absent
        tests: []
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option for category 'Department'; if multiple exist on a line, the lexicographically highest is chosen; NULL when absent
        tests: []
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option for category 'Project'; if multiple exist on a line, the lexicographically highest is chosen; NULL when absent

      source_models:
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category

Lines with no active category–option assignments at all are excluded. - Category-name comparisons and option-name matching are case-sensitive; emitted option names preserve original casing and spacing.'

        tests:

- name: int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched
      description: Enriched Xero invoice line items with account, invoice/contact, and active tracking attributes; includes effective tax rate (percent, 2 decimals)
      grain: One row per line_item_id (rows with NULL line_item_id or NULL invoice_id are excluded)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice
      - staging.stg_xero__account
      - staging.stg_xero__contact
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_option
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_has_option
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item selecting: line_item_id, invoice_id, account_code, description, quantity, unit_amount, line_amount, tax_amount, tax_type, discount_rate, processed_at. - Exclude rows where line_item_id or invoice_id is NULL. - Join invoice header by invoice_id to add contact_id (left join; if no match, contact_id is NULL). - Join contacts by contact_id to add contact_name (left join; if no match, contact_name is NULL). - Join accounts by account_code after converting the line item account_code to text to match the account table; add account_name, account_type, account_class (left join; if no match, these are NULL). The output account_code remains the original numeric value from the line item. - Build tracking attributes: - Take invoice_id, line_item_id, tracking_option, tracking_category_id from staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category. - Construct the set of active category/option pairs by linking categories to options through their relationship and keeping only options marked active. - Keep only tracking pairs whose option name exactly matches an active option for that category. - For each (invoice_id, line_item_id), pivot to columns for Region, Department, Project, Location, Class, Customer, and any category whose name contains "Cost Center". If multiple active options exist for the same category on a line, choose the lexicographically greatest non-null option name; if none, leave NULL. - Compute effective_tax_rate as: tax_amount divided by (line_amount minus tax_amount), multiplied by 100, then rounded to 2 decimals. If the denominator is zero or any input is null, the result is null. - All numeric values (quantity, unit_amount, line_amount, tax_amount, discount_rate) and processed_at are passed through without rescaling; processed_at retains its timezone.'
      columns:
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier for the invoice line item; exactly one output row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier from the line item; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric account code from the line item; joined to accounts by converting to text; output remains numeric

        description: Account name from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []

        description: Account type from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level account classification from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item description from staging
        tests: []
      - name: quantity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Quantity from the line item; pass-through with no rounding or rescaling
        tests: []
      - name: unit_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unit amount from the line item; pass-through with no rescaling
        tests: []
      - name: line_amount

        description: Extended line amount from the line item; used with tax_amount to compute effective_tax_rate
        tests: []
      - name: tax_amount

        description: Tax amount for the line item; pass-through
        tests: []

        tests: []

        tests: []

        description: Contact identifier from the invoice header via left join; NULL if not found
        tests: []

        tests: []

        tests: []

        tests: []

        tests: []
      - name: customer

        tests: []
      - name: cost_center
        data_type: VARCHAR

        tests: []

The output account_code remains the original numeric value from the line item. - Build tracking attributes: - Take invoice_id, line_item_id, tracking_option, tracking_category_id from staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category. - Construct the set of active category/option pairs by linking categories to options through their relationship and keeping only options marked active. - Keep only tracking pairs whose option name exactly matches an active option for that category. - For each (invoice_id, line_item_id), pivot to columns for Region, Department, Project, Location, Class, Customer, and any category whose name contains "Cost Center". If multiple active options exist for the same category on a line, choose the lexicographically greatest non-null option name; if none, leave NULL. - Compute effective_tax_rate as: tax_amount divided by (line_amount minus tax_amount), multiplied by 100, then rounded to 2 decimals. If the denominator is zero or any input is null, the result is null. - All numeric values (quantity, unit_amount, line_amount, tax_amount, discount_rate) and processed_at are passed through without rescaling; processed_at retains its timezone.'

- name: int_xero__journal_line_pivoted_tracking_categories
      description: Pivot journal line tracking assignments into fixed columns for known categories using only active options.
      grain: One row per journal_id and journal_line_id that has at least one active tracking option.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_xero__journal_line_has_tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_option
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_has_option
      business_logic: '- Start with journal line tracking assignments, capturing journal_id, journal_line_id, the assigned option name, and the tracking_category_id. - Build the set of valid (category_id, category_name, option_name) pairs by joining categories to their options through the relationships table; keep only options flagged as active. No filters are applied to category status, option status, or archival flags. - Retain only journal line assignments whose category_id exists in the valid set and whose option name exactly matches an active option name for that category. Lines with no retained assignments are excluded from the output. - For each remaining (journal_id, journal_line_id), populate columns by category name: - region: category name exactly "Region" - department: category name exactly "Department" - project: category name exactly "Project" - location: category name exactly "Location" - class: category name exactly "Class" - customer: category name exactly "Customer" - cost_center: any category whose name contains "Cost Center" (substring match, case-sensitive) - Column selection rules: - If multiple active options map to the same column for a line, select the lexicographically greatest option name; duplicates do not change the result. - If no active option matches a column’s rule, the column is NULL. - Names are matched and output exactly as stored; casing and whitespace are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: journal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the journal containing the line.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: journal_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the journal line; aggregates all tracking assignments for the line.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Region'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Department'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Project'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Location'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Class'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: customer
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for category name exactly 'Customer'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.
      - name: cost_center
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active tracking option name for any category whose name contains 'Cost Center'; if multiple, the lexicographically greatest; NULL if none.

- name: xero__balance_sheet_report
      description: Daily balance sheet with running balances by account and tracking dimensions, plus per-category and subcategory totals
      grain: One row per report_date per account_code per account_name per account_type per account_class per region per department per project
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact, keeping rows where journal_date is present; select journal_date (cast to DATE), account_code, account_name, account_type, account_class, net_amount, region, department, project. - Create a continuous daily date spine from the minimum to the maximum journal_date (inclusive) at 1-day intervals. - For each date in the spine and for each combination of account_code, account_name, account_type, account_class, region, department, and project found in the ledger up to that date, compute a running_balance as the cumulative sum of net_amount for all ledger rows with journal_date on or before the report_date. Combinations with no prior activity yield no output after filtering (no backfilling before first activity). - Derive categories from account attributes: - balance_sheet_category: ASSET→"Assets"; LIABILITY→"Liabilities"; EQUITY/REVENUE/EXPENSE→"Equity"; anything else→"Other" (NULLs map to "Other"). - balance_sheet_subcategory: ASSET with type BANK or CURRENT→"Current Assets"; ASSET with type FIXED→"Fixed Assets"; LIABILITY with type CURRLIAB or TERMLIAB→"Liabilities"; EQUITY→"Equity"; anything else→"Other" (NULLs map to "Other"). - Keep only rows where running_balance is not equal to zero; rows with zero or NULL running_balance are excluded. - Set amount = running_balance. - Compute totals after filtering: - category_total = the sum of amount across all rows with the same report_date and balance_sheet_category. - subcategory_total = the sum of amount across all rows with the same report_date and balance_sheet_subcategory. - Set report_generated_at to the current timestamp at query time. The final ORDER BY (report_date DESC, then category, subcategory, account_code) is for presentation only.'
      columns:
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date from the daily spine between the minimum and maximum journal_date (inclusive)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: balance_sheet_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from account_class: ASSET→Assets, LIABILITY→Liabilities, EQUITY/REVENUE/EXPENSE→Equity, else Other (NULL→Other)'
      - name: balance_sheet_subcategory
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from account_class and account_type: ASSET + BANK/CURRENT→Current Assets; ASSET + FIXED→Fixed Assets; LIABILITY + CURRLIAB/TERMLIAB→Liabilities; EQUITY→Equity; else Other (NULL→Other)'
      - name: account_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account code from the ledger; part of the running balance grouping with name, type, class, and tracking dimensions
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the ledger; included in the grouping, so name changes create separate balances
      - name: amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative net amount up to report_date for the specific account_code, account_name, account_type, account_class, region, department, and project; zero balances are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension region from the ledger; NULLs are preserved and grouped separately
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension department from the ledger; NULLs are preserved and grouped separately
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension project from the ledger; NULLs are preserved and grouped separately
      - name: category_total
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total amount across rows with the same report_date and balance_sheet_category after filtering out zero balances
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subcategory_total
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total amount across rows with the same report_date and balance_sheet_subcategory after filtering out zero balances
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the report was generated
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: xero__general_ledger
      description: General ledger at journal line granularity with pass-through fields, derived source_id classifications, and a run timestamp
      grain: One row per journal_id and journal_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
      business_logic: '- Read all columns from intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact (aliased pj). - Keep only rows where both journal_id and journal_line_id are not null. - Populate derived IDs from source_id based on source_type: - invoice_id: set when source_type is ACCPAY or ACCREC; otherwise null. - bank_transaction_id: set when source_type is CASHREC or CASHPAID; otherwise null. - manual_journal_id: set when source_type is MANJOURNAL; otherwise null. - Set report_generated_at to the current timestamp at query execution time (time zone included). - Do not join, aggregate, cast, or reformat; preserve all other values, nulls, signs, casing, spacing, and precision exactly as in pj. - For reproducible result ordering, sort by journal_date descending, then by journal_id ascending, then by journal_line_id ascending. Physical storage may not guarantee row order.'
      columns:
      - name: journal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal header identifier from source; required and combined with journal_line_id to define grain; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: journal_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal line identifier from source; required and combined with journal_id to define grain; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_date_utc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creation timestamp string in UTC from source; pass-through
      - name: journal_date
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journal date string from source; pass-through and used for sorting
      - name: journal_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Journal sequence number from source; pass-through
      - name: reference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reference or memo from source; pass-through
      - name: source_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream document or transaction identifier; also used to derive invoice, bank, and manual journal IDs
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source type code controlling classification of derived IDs; pass-through
      - name: account_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account code numeric value from source; pass-through with original precision

blocks.original_text:
- name: xero__invoice_line_items
      description: Invoice line items enriched with invoice-level non-negative metrics, shares, sequencing, and run timestamp
      grain: One row per input line with non-null invoice_id and line_item_id; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched
      business_logic: '- Source rows from intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched where both line_item_id and invoice_id are present. - Pass through descriptive, account, contact, tracking fields, and processed_at unchanged. - Standardize amounts and quantity: - line_amount_nonneg: if line_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise keep line_amount. - tax_amount_nonneg: if tax_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise keep tax_amount. - line_net_of_tax: line_amount minus tax_amount (treat missing tax_amount as 0); if result is negative then 0; if line_amount is null then null. - quantity: set to null when source quantity is null or negative; otherwise keep the source value. - Per invoice_id, compute: - invoice_gross_nonneg: sum of line_amount_nonneg (nulls ignored; null if all inputs are null). - invoice_net_nonneg: sum of line_net_of_tax (nulls ignored; null if all inputs are null). - invoice_line_count: number of lines after the ID filters (includes lines with null amounts). - Attach invoice-level totals back to each line. - Per-line shares (only when denominators are positive): - line_share_gross: line_amount_nonneg divided by invoice_gross_nonneg; otherwise null. - line_share_net: line_net_of_tax divided by invoice_net_nonneg; otherwise null. - Within each invoice_id, order lines by line_item_id ascending to compute: - invoice_cum_gross_nonneg: cumulative sum of line_amount_nonneg from the first ordered line through the current line. - line_seq_in_invoice: 1-based sequence in that order. If multiple lines share the same line_item_id within an invoice, their relative order is unspecified. - Classify line_item_type by line_amount: positive → Revenue; negative → Expense/Refund; zero or null → Neutral. - Set report_generated_at to the current timestamp at model execution. - Final result: one row per input line that passed the ID filters, ordered by invoice_id and line_seq_in_invoice ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice line item identifier from source; NULLs are filtered out upstream
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier from source; NULLs are filtered out upstream
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account code of the line item (numeric code from source)
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name associated with the line item
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type classification from source
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account class/category from source
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Free-text line description from source
      - name: quantity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Quantity with guard: null if source quantity is null or negative; otherwise pass-through'
      - name: unit_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unit price from source (pass-through; no rounding)
      - name: line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount from source (pass-through; may be negative or null)
      - name: tax_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Tax amount from source (pass-through; may be negative or null)
      - name: tax_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tax type/code from source
      - name: discount_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Discount rate from source (pass-through; no transformation)
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact identifier associated with the invoice line
      - name: contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact name associated with the invoice line
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region tracking dimension from source
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department tracking dimension from source
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project tracking dimension from source
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location tracking dimension from source
      - name: class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class tracking dimension from source
      - name: customer
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer tracking dimension from source
      - name: cost_center
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cost center tracking dimension from source
      - name: line_amount_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If line_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise equal to line_amount
      - name: tax_amount_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If tax_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise equal to tax_amount
      - name: line_net_of_tax
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount minus tax (missing tax treated as 0), floored at 0; null if line_amount is null
      - name: invoice_gross_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-negative line amounts per invoice; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: invoice_net_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-negative net-of-tax amounts per invoice; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: invoice_line_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of lines per invoice after filtering out null line_item_id and invoice_id
      - name: line_share_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-line proportion of invoice gross; computed only when invoice gross is > 0; otherwise null
      - name: line_share_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-line proportion of invoice net; computed only when invoice net is > 0; otherwise null
      - name: invoice_cum_gross_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative sum of non-negative line amounts within invoice ordered by line_item_id; includes current row; tie order for duplicate line_item_id is unspecified
      - name: line_seq_in_invoice
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based position within invoice ordered by line_item_id; tie order for duplicate line_item_id is unspecified
      - name: line_item_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification by line_amount sign: positive Revenue; negative Expense/Refund; otherwise Neutral (includes null and zero)'
      - name: processed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: ETL processing timestamp from the source intermediate model
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Query run timestamp set at model execution time

If multiple lines share the same line_item_id within an invoice, their relative order is unspecified. - Classify line_item_type by line_amount: positive → Revenue; negative → Expense/Refund; zero or null → Neutral. - Set report_generated_at to the current timestamp at model execution. - Final result: one row per input line that passed the ID filters, ordered by invoice_id and line_seq_in_invoice ascending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: xero__profit_and_loss_report
      description: Monthly profit and loss summary by account and tracking dimensions with revenue/expense split, net, and a month-level cumulative net
      grain: One row per report_month per account_code per account_name per pl_category per pl_subcategory per region per department per project
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
      business_logic: '- Read journal lines from intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact. - Derive calendar-based period fields from journal_date: fiscal_year (year), fiscal_month (month number 1–12), and fiscal_quarter (calendar quarter; used only in aggregation). - For each journal line: - revenue_amount = net_amount when account_class is REVENUE; otherwise 0. - expense_amount = absolute value of net_amount when account_class is EXPENSE; otherwise 0. - net_amount remains unchanged from source. - pl_category: - Revenue if account_class is REVENUE - Expenses if account_class is EXPENSE - Balance Sheet if account_class is ASSET, LIABILITY, or EQUITY - Other otherwise - pl_subcategory: - Operating Revenue if account_type is REVENUE - Operating Expenses if account_type is EXPENSE and account_code starts with "4" - Administrative Expenses if account_type is EXPENSE and account_code starts with "6" - Cost of Goods Sold if account_type is DIRECTCOSTS - Overhead if account_type is OVERHEADS - Depreciation if account_type is DEPRECIATN - Other otherwise - Aggregate monthly: - report_month = first day of the calendar month of journal_date. - Group by report_month, fiscal_year, fiscal_month, fiscal_quarter, account_code, account_name, pl_category, pl_subcategory, region, department, project. - Compute monthly_revenue = sum of revenue_amount, monthly_expenses = sum of expense_amount, monthly_net = sum of net_amount. - Produce final rows only where monthly_revenue is nonzero or monthly_expenses is nonzero; set period_type to "Monthly". - Output revenue = monthly_revenue, expenses = monthly_expenses, net_amount = monthly_net. - Compute cumulative_net within each report_month as a running total of monthly_net ordered alphabetically by pl_category, then by account_code ascending; when order keys tie, row order is nondeterministic. - Set report_generated_at to the execution timestamp (identical across rows within a run). - Order the final result by report_month descending, then by pl_category priority (Revenue first, Expenses second, then others), then by account_code ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: report_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First calendar day of the month of journal_date
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: fiscal_year
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Calendar year of journal_date
      - name: fiscal_month
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of journal_date
      - name: period_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Static period label; always 'Monthly'
      - name: pl_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category from account_class: Revenue, Expenses, Balance Sheet, or Other'
      - name: pl_subcategory
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Detailed P&L subcategory from account_type and account_code prefix rules
      - name: account_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric ledger account code used for grouping and ordering; prefix checks treat it as a string; ordered ascending
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ledger account name from source; included in the monthly grouping
      - name: revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Monthly sum of revenue_amount (net_amount for REVENUE lines, else 0); may be negative; nulls ignored in sums; zero allowed
      - name: expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Monthly sum of expense_amount (absolute net_amount for EXPENSE lines, else 0); non-negative; nulls ignored in sums; zero allowed
      - name: net_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Monthly sum of raw net_amount across all journal lines in the grouping; sign preserved; nulls ignored in sums
      - name: cumulative_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Within report_month, running total of net_amount ordered by pl_category (alphabetical) then account_code ascending; ties are nondeterministic; nulls ignored
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension carried from source; part of the grouping; nulls preserved
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension carried from source; part of the grouping; nulls preserved
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking dimension carried from source; part of the grouping; nulls preserved
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp for the run; identical across rows; time zone per engine configuration

- name: int_youtube__age_pivot
      description: Normalized age-group view shares pivoted to columns per date/video/country, with total before normalization for audit
      grain: One row per date_day per video_id per country_code
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_youtube__channel_demographics
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_youtube__channel_demographics using date_day, video_id, country_code, age_group, views_percentage. - Keep only age_group in {''13-17'',''18-24'',''25-34'',''35-44'',''45-54'',''55-64'',''65-''}. - Aggregate views_percentage by (date_day, video_id, country_code, age_group) to get views_pct: - Null inputs are ignored in the sum; if all inputs are null for a group, views_pct is null. - Multiple rows for the same keys are combined by summation only. - For each (date_day, video_id, country_code), compute pct_sum as the sum of views_pct across the kept age groups: - Null views_pct are ignored; pct_sum is null only when all views_pct are null in the partition. - Normalize per age_group: - If pct_sum > 0, set pct_norm = views_pct / pct_sum and clamp to the range [0.0, 1.0]. - If pct_sum <= 0 or pct_sum is null, set pct_norm = 0.0. - No rounding; double precision is retained. - Pivot to age columns (''13-17'',''18-24'',''25-34'',''35-44'',''45-54'',''55-64'',''65-'') by summing pct_norm for rows matching each age label within (date_day, video_id, country_code): - If no row exists for an age label, the column is null. - If a row exists but pct_sum <= 0 or pct_sum is null, the column is 0.0. - If pct_sum > 0 but that age group’s views_pct is missing, the column is null (because pct_norm is null). - Set pct_total_before_normalization to the total of views_pct across the kept age groups for the (date_day, video_id, country_code); it is null only when all views_pct are null. - Output includes only (date_day, video_id, country_code) combinations that have at least one kept age group after filtering.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the demographic measurement.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: video_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: YouTube video identifier as stored.
        tests: []
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code as stored.
        tests: []
      - name: 13-17
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 13–17; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`13-17` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 18-24
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 18–24; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`18-24` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 25-34
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 25–34; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`25-34` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 35-44
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 35–44; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`35-44` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 45-54
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 45–54; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`45-54` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 55-64
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 55–64; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`55-64` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: 65-
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized share (0–1) for ages 65+; may be NULL if the age group is absent or its share was missing.
        tests:
        - '`65-` BETWEEN 0 AND 1'
      - name: pct_total_before_normalization
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total pre-normalization view share across included ages; NULL if all inputs are NULL.
        tests: []

- name: int_youtube__channel_basic
      description: Per-video daily metrics with derived engagement rates, net subscribers, and 7-row rolling windows.
      grain: One row per source record with non-null source date_day; duplicates retained; windows computed per video_id ordered by the cast date.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_youtube__channel_basic
      business_logic: '- Input rows come from staging.stg_youtube__channel_basic, keeping only records where the source date_day is not NULL. - Attempt to cast the source date_day to DATE; if casting fails, the resulting date_day is NULL and the row is kept. - Replace NULLs with defaults: - views, likes, dislikes, shares, subscribers_gained, subscribers_lost -> 0 - estimated_minutes_watched -> watch_time_minutes = 0.0 - estimated_red_minutes_watched -> red_watch_time_minutes = 0.0 - average_view_duration_seconds -> 0.0 - average_view_duration_percentage -> unchanged (may be NULL) - Derived metrics: - like_rate, dislike_rate, share_rate are computed as metric ÷ views only when views > 0; otherwise NULL; computed in double precision with no rounding or clamping. - net_subscribers = subscribers_gained - subscribers_lost. - avg_view_duration_seconds_weighted = average_view_duration_seconds when views > 0; otherwise NULL (no cross-row weighting). - Window calculations are computed separately for each video_id, ordered by date_day ascending (missing dates are not imputed): - prev_day_views equals the views from the immediately preceding row in that order; NULL for the first row per video_id. - views_rolling_7d is the sum of views across a 7-row rolling window (current row plus up to six prior rows). - watch_time_minutes_rolling_7d is the sum of watch_time_minutes across the same 7-row rolling window. - Output only the listed columns; no additional filtering or de-duplication is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date after attempting a cast from source; may be NULL if casting fails; used to order window calculations.
        tests: []
      - name: channel_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through channel identifier; not used to scope window calculations.
        tests: []
      - name: video_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through video identifier used to scope window calculations; may be NULL.
        tests: []
      - name: views
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily view count with NULLs replaced by 0.
        tests: []
      - name: likes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily like count with NULLs replaced by 0; may exceed views if present in source.
        tests: []
      - name: dislikes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily dislike count with NULLs replaced by 0.
        tests: []
      - name: shares
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily share count with NULLs replaced by 0.
        tests: []
      - name: subscribers_gained
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily subscribers gained with NULLs replaced by 0.
        tests: []
      - name: subscribers_lost
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily subscribers lost with NULLs replaced by 0.
        tests: []
      - name: net_subscribers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Subscribers gained minus subscribers lost; can be negative; never NULL.
        tests: []
      - name: watch_time_minutes
        data_type: DECIMAL(20,1)
        description: Estimated minutes watched for the day with NULLs replaced by 0.0.
        tests: []
      - name: red_watch_time_minutes
        data_type: DECIMAL(20,1)
        description: Estimated YouTube Red minutes watched for the day with NULLs replaced by 0.0.
        tests: []
      - name: average_view_duration_seconds
        data_type: DECIMAL(20,1)
        description: Average view duration in seconds for the day with NULLs replaced by 0.0.
        tests: []
      - name: average_view_duration_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Pass-through average view duration ratio from source; NULLs preserved.
        tests: []

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Input rows come from staging.stg_youtube__channel_basic, keeping only records where the source date_day is not NULL. - Attempt to cast the source date_day to DATE; if casting fails, the resulting date_day is NULL and the row is kept. - Replace NULLs with defaults: - views, likes, dislikes, shares, subscribers_gained, subscribers_lost -> 0 - estimated_minutes_watched -> watch_time_minutes = 0.0 - estimated_red_minutes_watched -> red_watch_time_minutes = 0.0 - average_view_duration_seconds -> 0.0 - average_view_duration_percentage -> unchanged (may be NULL) - Derived metrics: - like_rate, dislike_rate, share_rate are computed as metric ÷ views only when views > 0; otherwise NULL; computed in double precision with no rounding or clamping. - net_subscribers = subscribers_gained - subscribers_lost. - avg_view_duration_seconds_weighted = average_view_duration_seconds when views > 0; otherwise NULL (no cross-row weighting). - Window calculations are computed separately for each video_id, ordered by date_day ascending (missing dates are not imputed): - prev_day_views equals the views from the immediately preceding row in that order; NULL for the first row per video_id. - views_rolling_7d is the sum of views across a 7-row rolling window (current row plus up to six prior rows). - watch_time_minutes_rolling_7d is the sum of watch_time_minutes across the same 7-row rolling window. - Output only the listed columns; no additional filtering or de-duplication is applied.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_youtube__gender_pivot
      description: Normalized female/male viewer shares pivoted per date/video/country, with the pre-normalization total retained.
      grain: One row per date_day per video_id per country_code
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_youtube__channel_demographics
      business_logic: '- Inputs: date_day, video_id, country_code, gender, views_percentage. - Keep only gender values female and male; exclude all others. - Per (date_day, video_id, country_code, gender), sum views_percentage to get views_pct; NULL inputs are ignored, and if all inputs for a gender are NULL, views_pct is NULL. - Per (date_day, video_id, country_code), compute pct_sum as the total of views_pct across the included genders; NULL gender totals are ignored, and if both are NULL, pct_sum is NULL. - Normalize per gender: - If pct_sum > 0, divide views_pct by pct_sum and cap the result to the [0,1] range. - If pct_sum is 0 or NULL, set the normalized share to 0.0. - No rounding; results are double precision. - Pivot to one row per (date_day, video_id, country_code): - female is the aggregated normalized share for gender=female; male is the aggregated normalized share for gender=male. - If a gender has no row in the group, its column is NULL; if multiple rows exist for a gender, their normalized shares are summed (the prior aggregation typically yields one row per gender). - pct_total_before_normalization is the total views_pct across the included genders carried into the pivot (equal for all gender rows in the group); if both gender totals are NULL, this field is NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date used as a grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: video_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: YouTube video identifier used as a grouping key.
        tests: []
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country or region code from the source.
        tests: []
      - name: female
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized female share in [0,1]; 0.0 when the group total is 0 or NULL; NULL if no female row exists; no rounding.
        tests: []
      - name: male
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Normalized male share in [0,1]; 0.0 when the group total is 0 or NULL; NULL if no male row exists; no rounding.
        tests: []
      - name: pct_total_before_normalization
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total of female and male views percentages before normalization; NULL if both gender totals are NULL; no rescaling.
        tests: []
